## 3. SOP 问题回答

### 3.1 哪些协议必须拥有独立函数级flow?

全部83个协议。26个Command、33个Query、6个Inbound Event Consumer、10个Outbound Event和8个Operations Job必须各有独立小节、独立ASCII调用图、关键Rust伪代码、事务 / no-write边界、错误分支、状态 / 事件副作用、测试切口和停审记录。共享模板只约束共同顺序，不能替代任何一条flow。

### 3.2 如何分批且保持owner边界?

- Command按identity / registry、descriptor / relation、exposure / trace / reference三批展开。
- Query按identity / registry / descriptor、relation / exposure、trace / derived、reference四批展开。
- Inbound独立一批，逐consumer证明source gate、typed replay与no-core-truth-write。
- Outbound按六类append-only truth/relation change与四类view/impact/derived/reference source拆两批。
- Job按reconciliation / material维护与reference / collaboration恢复拆两批。
- 最终batch只做跨flow审计、historical audit、正式回填草稿和Step 10 handoff，不补写遗漏单flow。

### 3.3 每条flow的入口与调用链如何固定?

入口只使用Step 8 exact handler / producer / runner和application callable。application service再调用Step 6 factory / member / policy与Step 7 Port。`api`、`worker`、`jobs`不得直接调用repository、resolver、UoW、capture repository、handoff或collaboration Port；`infra`不得重做domain policy。

### 3.4 DTO在何处校验、派生和构造对象?

- entry先做route / logical name / trigger、envelope metadata、schema version与concrete body type对称校验。
- application在reserve前完成不需要外部读取的required / variant / duplicate-free / forbidden-body初检，并固定digest输入。
- 需要repository / resolver的owner、expected version、canonical state或safe-summary校验在application内完成。
- system id、time、change / trace record id只来自`IdGeneratorPort`、`ClockPort`与validated operation context；expected version只来自`Loaded<T>`。
- domain object只能通过Step 6 factory / member / policy构造或推进；application不得直接改字段。

### 3.5 Port读取 / 写入面如何审计?

每条flow的调用图和伪代码只能写Step 7已存在的exact method。若需要新的lookup、page、save、append、typed replay、resolver或collaboration method，立即停止该flow并登记reopen，不得使用“load current”“save result”“publish event”等无formal callable的占位语句掩盖缺口。

### 3.6 事务在哪里开始、提交和回滚?

- Command、fresh accepted / stable replayable rejection Consumer在application service内`begin()`；该次accepted的本地truth / effect、outbound capture、stored result / typed receipt和idempotency completion使用同一UoW。
- source truth / material / reference revision与完整outbound snapshot / initial capture必须同一UoW；任一失败整体rollback。
- multi-target Job允许partial completion；每个actual changed target及其完整outbound snapshot / initial capture使用该target的local UoW原子提交，不得选择whole-run UoW将所有target绑成全成全败。
- Job的final typed report、stored shell / surface和idempotency completion使用final-report UoW。per-target commit、final-report visibility及crash / reentry的exact ordering由batch `9.11`先闭合flow、再交Step 11 / 13收稳；不得假定已在一个whole-run UoW内解决。
- Query不begin UoW。
- external resolver read不能被本地rollback；audit handoff / event collaboration只在相关local commit后发生，其失败不回滚已提交truth。
- post-commit stable event intent binding使用独立短UoW；bind失败保留`Captured`供repair扫描。

### 3.7 状态、事件和测试如何承接?

每条flow必须列出实际读取 / 推进的Step 6 state、形成的change / trace / impact / material / reference revision、是否形成10类Outbound capture，以及不形成哪些副作用。测试切口至少覆盖fresh success、stable rejection / not-visible / partial outcome、duplicate或no-write、missing / mismatch、version / transaction failure和owner-boundary禁入；本Step只定义测试切口，不声称测试已运行。

### 3.8 当前是否需要回开Step 6 / 7 / 8?

batch `9.0`只做结构审计，未发现阻塞。后续batch `9.1~9.3`触发的object / Port / protocol缺口均已按§10受控回开并重新审计,当前unresolved upstream blocker为`0`。已知`CapabilityRequestDigest`具体算法、transaction exact physical ordering、error code、config binding分别由Step 13、11、12、14承接，不构成当前缺口；后续逐flow若发现调用面或字段来源无法1:1落码，继续按§10立即回开。

## 4. 当前文档问题诊断与改动前后

| 维度 | 旧正式`03` / 概要阶段口径 | 当前Step 9目标口径 |
|---|---|---|
| flow主语 | ProviderContract、CapabilityDecision、CostRecord、QueryCapabilities、execution gateway | capability identity、registry、descriptor、seam、method relation、formal exposure、trace / impact、derived material、external ref / collaboration |
| 覆盖方式 | P0图 + 同构接口说明，允许简单Query复用generic读路径 | Step 8的83个protocol全部独立flow；共享模板不替代独立小节 |
| 函数粒度 | application / repository自然语言占位 | exact handler / service、Step 6函数、Step 7 Port签名和Rust伪代码 |
| transaction | “保存后发布”或旧outbox暗示 | local truth / material / ref + snapshot / capture + result / completion边界明确；external协作post-commit |
| duplicate | generic bytes或隐式重算风险 | Command immutable surface、Consumer typed receipt、Job 8-variant typed report；均no-rerun |
| Query | 旧QueryCapabilities可能刷新policy / cache或做allow-deny | resolver-first、field-level surface、strict no-write / no-refresh / no-execution |
| Inbound | 可能把owner event直接改relation / exposure truth | 只写declared ref / canonical state或downstream summary，完整typed receipt |
| Outbound | transient event / concrete relay产品易回流 | exact committed source + immutable snapshot / capture；delivery owner仍在external Port |
| Job | reconciliation / refresh可能被误用作truth repair | 只维护material / report / reference state / collaboration，不改core truth |

改动取舍:

- 保留L1参考项目“shared discipline -> 分族逐flow -> final audit”的结构，但把本项目已收稳的durable capture和typed Job replay纳入强制模板。
- 不采用概要阶段“简单Query不独立画图”的裁剪，因为详细设计SOP和Step 8 handoff已要求83 / 83独立flow。
- 不在Step 9发明完整错误enum、digest codec、DDL或配置；只固定调用位置、输入来源、stable classification和后续owner。
- 不使用“outbox”作为本项目本地产品名；只使用Step 6/7正式的payload snapshot、event capture与external collaboration seam。

## 6. 单flow固定结构与写入门禁

### 6.1 每条flow必须输出

每条flow使用以下固定结构，任何一项不得以“同shared template”省略:

```text
#### <FlowName>

1. 入口与目标表
2. DTO字段 -> application input -> object / Port source表
3. 函数级ASCII调用图
4. Rust风格关键伪代码
5. transaction / no-write / post-commit boundary表
6. error / rejection / degraded / partial mapping表
7. state / change / trace / capture / handoff副作用表
8. 测试切口
9. 单flow停审记录
```

入口与目标表至少包含:

| 项 | 必填内容 |
|---|---|
| 协议 | Step 8 exact request / response / payload / report type |
| entry | exact handler / producer / runner method |
| application | exact service / mapper / facade method |
| target | Step 6 truth / material / technical helper或external callable outcome |
| required Port | Step 7 exact trait + method names |
| transaction | local UoW、no-write或post-commit phase |
| state / side effect | actual transition / append / capture / no-op |
| Step 10 handoff | state machine candidate与触发函数 |

### 6.2 ASCII图门禁

每张图必须自上而下写明`validate`、`call`、`load`、`tx begin`、`save / append / capture`、`commit / rollback`和external call的位置。示意:

```text
[Typed entry]
  | validate exact protocol / metadata / schema
  | call CapabilityXxxService::exact_method(context, input)
  v
[Application service]
  | validate stable fields + compute declared digest
  | tx begin when write channel
  | call CapabilityIdempotencyRepository::reserve_if_absent(...)
  v
[Load + Domain]
  | call ExactRepository::get_with_version(...)
  | call ExactObject::factory_or_member(...)
  v
[Persist]
  | save / append exact local effect with expected version
  | capture exact outbound envelope in the same UoW when declared
  | save exact stored result / typed receipt / typed job report
  | complete idempotency record
  | tx commit
  v
[Post-commit]
  | load official capture + snapshot
  | call external collaboration / handoff when declared
```

上图对Command / Consumer表达一个accepted UoW；对multi-target Job只能分别投影为“单target local UoW”与“final-report UoW”，不得把整张图解释为whole-run transaction。Job的具体分段以§7.3为准。

图后必须说明它没有表达的下游细节，例如Step 11 isolation、Step 12 error code或Step 14 physical binding；不能用图替代伪代码与表格。

### 6.3 Rust伪代码门禁

- 每个关键调用前使用`// [Type::function(Type param)]`或`// [object.function(Type param)]`。
- 函数名、参数类型、返回类型必须能回指Step 6 / 7 / 8；无法回指即停止并reopen。
- 可以用`match`表达已定义enum / union分支，但不得写未定义的helper如`load_everything()`、`publish()`、`repair_truth()`。
- `CapabilityRequestDigest`的具体构造函数名尚未在Step 6 / 7定义；伪代码使用`let request_digest: CapabilityRequestDigest = /* Step 13 canonical digest over declared fields */;`并在每条flow列出declared fields，不伪造public builder。
- error variant全集留Step 12时，伪代码可返回现有`DomainError / ApplicationError`并在error mapping表固定stable classification；不得自造最终code。
- 所有新增public struct / enum / field / variant / trait / function仍必须有英文`///`。Step 9原则上只写调用伪代码；若回开产生public type，必须执行机械Rustdoc审计。

### 6.4 单flow停审门禁

| 审查项 | pass条件 | failure action |
|---|---|---|
| protocol identity | exact Step 8 protocol / method / flow name一一对应 | 回开Step 8 |
| DTO construction | 每个required field有body / metadata / lookup / id / clock来源 | 回开Step 6或8 |
| domain function | factory / member / policy exact存在，参数匹配 | 回开Step 6 |
| Port callable | 每个load / save / append / resolver / replay / capture / collaboration method exact存在 | 回开Step 7 |
| expected version | mutable save只取自`Loaded<T>.expected_version`；create为formal `None` / initial contract | 回开Step 7 / 11 |
| transaction | local atomic set、rollback与post-commit boundary清楚 | 当前flow暂停，补齐后再审 |
| error surface | missing / invalid / forbidden / conflict / unavailable / consistency分支可映射 | 当前flow暂停或回开Step 8 |
| state / side effect | actual state、change / trace / report / capture、明确空副作用均列明 | 当前flow暂停，补Step 10 handoff |
| replay / no-write | write duplicate不重跑；Query严格no-write | 当前flow暂停 |
| owner boundary | 无governance/method/secret/runtime/SDK/marketplace/audit body越界 | blocker，不得继续下一flow |
| test cut | fresh / duplicate-or-no-write / failure / boundary至少四类 | 当前flow暂停 |

## 7. Shared Write-channel Guard

### 7.1 Command shared guard

Command的具体domain mutation各不相同，但进入accepted / replay / conflict分支的顺序必须一致:

```text
[API command handler]
  | validate route == command_name == concrete body type, schema v1
  | build CapabilityOperationContext::from_command(...)
  | call exact Capability*CommandService method
  v
[Application command service]
  | context.assert_write_metadata_complete()
  | validate body-local required / variant / forbidden fields
  | canonical_field_bytes = concrete_body.canonical_request_field_bytes()
  | request_digest = digest_command_request(context.operation_name, canonical_field_bytes)
  | now = ClockPort::now()
  | reservation = CapabilityIdempotencyRecord::reserve(context, digest, now)
  | tx = CapabilityUnitOfWorkManager::begin()
  | reserve_result = CapabilityIdempotencyRepository::reserve_if_absent(reservation, tx.as_ref())
  |
  | Existing + same operation/digest + Completed
  |   -> result_ref = existing.completed_result_ref()
  |   -> rollback current uncommitted tx
  |   -> StoredCapabilityResultRepository::get(result_ref)
  |   -> return stored command response/rejection with replay mapping;no domain/repository/capture call
  |
  | Existing + mismatch
  |   -> rollback current uncommitted tx
  |   -> preserve original reservation/result;return conflict rejection per Step 12/13
  |
  | Reserved(loaded_reservation)
  |   -> load exact prerequisites / expected versions
  |   -> call Step 6 factory / member / policy
  |   -> save truth / relation / summary / reference state and append change / trace
  |   -> scan affected views / mutable materials once per changed truth subject
  |   -> mark actual non-stale materials stale + save / capture each new revision
  |   -> map + serialize + snapshot + capture every declared outbound source in same tx
  |   -> save immutable command shell / complete surface
  |   -> loaded_reservation.value.complete(result_ref, same now)
  |   -> idempotency_repo.save(..., loaded_reservation.expected_version, tx)
  |   -> commit tx
  v
[Post-commit]
  | external collaboration / audit handoff only when concrete flow declares it
  | external failure never rolls back committed local truth
```

Command rules:

- rejected beforeapplication / reserve has no local result。A stable replayable rejection afterreservation may save`CommandRejection`;each concrete flow must say whether its branch is pre-reserve or stable stored rejection。
- accepted flow may produce zero、one or multipletraceability refs andevent captures。Exact side-effect inventory comes fromthe protocol card;entry cannotquery repositories aftercommit tocomplete response。
- Command duplicate uses generic immutable command shell / surface because the complete serialized response is itself the replay source。It never usesConsumer / Job typed methods。
- Conflict / in-progress classification details remainStep 13,但Step 9必须证明mismatch不覆盖original reservation / result。
- exact physical ordering amongtruth save、change append、trace append、capture、stored result andidempotency save is handed toStep 11;they remainone declared local UoW here。
- core truth Command的affected-material传播遵循Step 7 §11.3.1:actual stale only、immutable report excluded、each material own `Loaded.expected_version`、availability capture same UoW。Any material conflict rolls back the whole Command;duplicate never scans。
- `CapabilityIdempotencyReserveResult::Reserved`returns`Loaded<CapabilityIdempotencyRecord>`afterStep 9 reopen;fresh completion must use that loaded expected version,never object version or assumed create version。

### 7.2 Inbound Consumer shared guard

```text
[Worker ingress]
  | validate trusted source family / actor / logical event / schema header
  | unsupported schema -> return UnsupportedSchema without payload decode / reserve
  | decode exact typed payload and call exact handler
  v
[Application consumer service]
  | build CapabilityOperationContext::from_inbound_event(...)
  | validate body-free fields / target variant
  | canonical_field_bytes = concrete_payload.canonical_request_field_bytes(
  |     schema_version,source_family,source_event_ref,source_idempotency_key)
  | request_digest = digest_inbound_event_request(context, canonical_field_bytes)
  | CapabilityIdempotencyRepository::get_with_version(normalized key)
  |   -> established completed duplicate:typed replay before Clock / UoW
  | preflight absent -> ClockPort::now + tx begin + reserve_if_absent(..., tx.as_ref())
  |
  | completed duplicate -> rollback current tx;get_consumer_receipt(result_ref);return exact effect refs with response-only replay marker
  | conflict / unsafe -> rollback current tx;no original result leakage;quarantine surface
  | delayed before safe local completion -> rollback;no completed result so later retry remains possible
  | accepted / ignored / stable safe rejection/quarantine
  |   -> call only declared resolver / local repository methods
  |   -> save only declared ref/state or downstream summary effect
  |   -> capture ReferenceResolutionChanged only when an exact new state revision exists
  |   -> save_consumer_receipt(shell, surface, typed envelope, tx)
  |   -> complete reservation and commit
```

Consumer rules:

- noconsumer writesidentity、registry、descriptor、governance seam、method relation、formal exposure、derived material orexternal collaboration truth。
- established duplicate is classified by `get_with_version` before Clock / UoW。A preflight-absent concurrent insert may make the later atomic reserve return`Existing`;that race path performs no business-id generation、resolver、domain factory or effect write,and Step 13 owns its exact retry/conflict classification。
- accepted canonical effect andcomplete typed receipt must beatomic。Receipt effect / follow-up refs come fromthe actual local revision,notentry counters orpost-commit reads。
- resolver calls areexternal reads andcannot be rolled back;therefore concrete flow must distinguishresolver unavailable beforelocal write fromlocal persistence failure afterobservation。
- `Delayed` consumer processing disposition isdifferent froma successfully persisted downstream feedback state namedDelayed。

### 7.3 Operations Job shared guard

```text
[Jobs runner]
  | validate trigger == job_name == concrete input type, schema v1
  | build CapabilityOperationContext::from_job(...)
  | call exact CapabilityOperationsJobService method
  v
[Application Job service]
  | validate body-local scope shape before planning
  | canonical_field_bytes = concrete_input.canonical_request_field_bytes()
  | request_digest = digest_job_request(context,schema_version,canonical_field_bytes)
  | normalized_key = CapabilityOperationContext.idempotency_key
  | CapabilityIdempotencyRepository::get_with_version(normalized_key)
  |
  | Existing + same operation/digest + Completed
  |   -> StoredCapabilityResultRepository::get_job_report(result_ref)
  |   -> CapabilityStoredJobReportEnvelope::into_duplicate_response()
  |   -> return;no scan / resolver / rebuild / collaboration
  |
  | Existing + operation/digest mismatch
  |   -> preserve original reservation / report
  |   -> return conflict classification;exact public mapping remains Step 12/13
  |
  | Existing + same operation/digest + Reserved
  |   -> CapabilityJobExecutionRepository::get_with_version(normalized_key)
  |   -> require exact key / operation / Job / schema / run / digest symmetry
  |   -> resume from durable first Planned target,or final assembly when all terminal
  |
  | Absent preflight
  |   -> expand complete exact typed scope through Step 7 reads
  |   -> freeze deterministic body-free output inputs and stable ordinal target order
  |   -> complete zero-target scan => targets=[] / no stable-or-retryable run issue
  |   -> safely classified planning failure => targets=[] / typed StableFailure or RetryablePrerequisite run issue
  |   -> unsafe wiring / invariant / serialization failure => return error;no reservation / journal
  |   -> initial_tx = CapabilityUnitOfWorkManager::begin()
  |   -> CapabilityIdempotencyRepository::reserve_if_absent(reservation, initial_tx)
  |   -> fresh Reserved:CapabilityJobExecutionRecord::plan(...,targets,run_issues,...)
  |      + CapabilityJobExecutionRepository::create(...,initial_tx)
  |      + commit initial_tx;reservation and journal become visible together
  |   -> concurrent Existing:rollback initial_tx;discard local plan
  |      -> exact-load winner reservation once by the normalized key
  |      -> Completed exact identity + same run:validate and replay exact typed stored report
  |      -> Reserved exact identity + same run:exact-load and validate the matching journal,then resume it
  |      -> different channel / operation / digest / run:return conflict without winner mutation
  |      -> missing winner or reservation/journal asymmetry:return consistency defect
  |
  | Loaded planned execution
  |   -> process only execution.next_planned_target() in frozen ordinal order
  |        PreclassifiedFailure:
  |          no source read / resolver / id / factory / capture
  |          no-effect target_tx -> execution.record_failed(exact embedded failure)
  |          CapabilityJobExecutionRepository::save -> commit -> exact reload
  |        for each target:
  |          perform declared external resolver / collaboration call before target_tx,if any
  |          target_tx = CapabilityUnitOfWorkManager::begin()
  |          save only declared material / report / reference / capture binding effect
  |          if source changed:save matching snapshot + initial capture in target_tx
  |          execution.record_succeeded(...)
  |          CapabilityJobExecutionRepository::save(execution,loaded.expected_version,target_tx)
  |          commit target_tx,or rollback only this target_tx
  |          after proving no target effect committed:exact reload;optional no-effect UoW records typed Failed / Skipped
  |          exact reload before selecting the next Planned target
  |   -> final_tx = CapabilityUnitOfWorkManager::begin()
  |   -> exact-load journal and reservation by the same normalized key
  |   -> verify same identity/digest,Reserved,and all targets terminal
  |   -> matching pure assembler reads only journal outcomes / run issues
  |   -> save_job_report(shell,surface,typed envelope,final_tx)
  |   -> execution.finalize(same result ref) + execution repository save
  |   -> reservation.complete(same result ref) + idempotency repository save
  |   -> commit final_tx
```

Job rules:

- Job execution journal outcomes and run issues are the sole pre-final response-assembly truth;the immutable typed stored report is the completed duplicate truth。Runner does not scan repositories or parse adapter errors to fill counts / refs。
- no-op target is `Unchanged`,creates no new revision / event capture and does not call `IdGeneratorPort` / `ClockPort` for a fake change。
- all eight Jobs use stable per-target local UoW for target effects plus one final-report UoW;whole-run UoW is not an allowed per-flow choice。A changed material / reference revision and its snapshot / initial capture commit or rollback as one target-local atomic set。
- deterministic planning completes before the initial write UoW。The initial `Reserved` record and matching complete journal commit atomically before any target-local effect。Broad-scan failure before a complete plan becomes a typed failure/retryable empty journal;an unsafe untyped failure leaves neither record。A concurrent reserve collision discards the request-local plan and performs exactly one authoritative winner classification；it does not recurse into the Job entry or reuse request-local planning output。
- aftera reserve collision,thewinner classifier exact-loads the reservation once。A matching`Completed`winner validates andreplays the typed report；a matching`Reserved`winner withthe same run exact-loads andvalidates the journal,then resumes it；different channel / operation / digest / run returns conflict；missing winner orreservation/journal asymmetry isaconsistency defect。
- valid `targets=[] / no stable-or-retryable issue` means a complete zero-target scan and may become`Completed`;planning failure uses `targets=[]` plus durable typed impact and becomes`Failed / Retryable`。Reentry never rescans to distinguish them。
- each successful target transaction saves the exact business effect / snapshot / capture and `Succeeded` journal outcome together。A target failure records`Failed / Skipped` in a no-business-effect UoW only after proving no effect committed,including rollback completion when a target UoW had started;it does not roll back earlier committed targets。After optimistic conflict,the service exact-reloads first and must preserve a concurrently committed terminal outcome。
- a planning-time stable per-target failure with an established public target identity uses the frozen`PreclassifiedFailure` plan variant。Because no effect was attempted,the loop may immediately record its embedded failure in a no-business-effect UoW;it must not reload current source、fabricate frozen success input orcollapse the row into a run issue。
- `Succeeded / Failed / Skipped` are immutable。Reentry calls only`next_planned_target`;already terminal targets cannot regenerate ids、rederive summaries / findings、repeat revision / capture or call resolver / collaboration again。
- final typed report、stored shell / surface、journal Finalized and idempotency Completed are one final-report atomic set with the same result ref。The exact physical save order and isolation remain Step 11 decisions,but target / final visibility membership is closed here。A final-report failure cannot claim prior target commits rolled back;reserved reentry exact-loads the journal and retries final assembly only。
- no Job repairs identity、registry、descriptor、governance seam、method relation or formal exposure truth。Reconciliation only appends a report;material Jobs only write their declared derived material;reference refresh only writes canonical reference-state revisions;collaboration repair only binds / repairs stored event collaboration。
- duplicate never uses `CapabilityReconciliationReportRepository::find_by_job_run`、generic bytes decoder or current material / reference / capture reconstruction。

The Step 6 `CapabilityJobExecutionRecord` and Step 7 `CapabilityJobExecutionRepository` are the single product-neutral recovery source fixed by the controlled reopen。No second checkpoint repository、private adapter table、generic progress blob、request-local report accumulator、report-by-run reconstruction or current-truth rebuild is allowed。

## 8. Shared Query Resolver-first / No-write Guard

### 8.1 Fixed call order

The following is a structural template,not an additional public callable。Each Query flow in batches `9.4~9.7` must replace every bracketed position with the exact Step 8 handler / service and exact Step 7 resolver / repository method from its protocol card。

```text
[API query handler]
  | validate POST route == query_name == concrete body type, schema v1
  | build CapabilityOperationContext::from_query(...)
  | call exact Capability*QueryService method
  v
[Application query service]
  | CapabilityOperationContext::assert_query_no_write()
  | map validated selector / filter / public page to exact read subject / repository scope
  | call CapabilityReadVisibilityResolverPort exact single / collection method
  | CapabilityReadVisibilityResolution::assert_matches(subject, actor)
  | CapabilityReadVisibilityResolution::into_decision()
  | CapabilityReadVisibilityDecision::assert_query_no_write(context)
  |
  | NotVisible
  |   -> return Step 8 body-free not-visible surface
  |   -> do not load target body / page repository
  |
  | Degraded
  |   -> only when the exact protocol card declares a degraded partial body
  |   -> load only that card's allowed body-free partial fields
  |   -> preserve resolver reason / source versions
  |
  | Visible
  |   -> call exact repository get / find / search / list methods
  |   -> validate owner / ref / version symmetry
  |   -> map exact object(s) to the Step 8 response / public page
  v
[Return]
  | no UoW, no idempotency reservation, no stored result, no mutation
```

### 8.2 Rust-style schematic pseudocode

> This block is intentionally non-public schematic pseudocode。It defines required ordering but does not add a generic query function or a new helper API。Concrete flows must use their exact Step 8 signatures。

```rust
// [CapabilityOperationContext::assert_query_no_write(&self)]
context.assert_query_no_write()?;

// [CapabilityReadVisibilityResolverPort::<exact resolve method>(...)]
let resolution = visibility_resolver
    .<exact_resolver_method>(&context.actor_context, <exact_subject_or_scope>)
    .await?;

// [CapabilityReadVisibilityResolution::assert_matches(...)]
resolution.assert_matches(&<exact_read_subject>, &context.actor_context)?;

// [CapabilityReadVisibilityResolution::into_decision(self)]
let decision = resolution.into_decision()?;

// [CapabilityReadVisibilityDecision::assert_query_no_write(&self, ...)]
decision.assert_query_no_write(&context)?;

if decision.is_not_visible() {
    return Ok(<exact Step 8 body-free not-visible response>);
}

if decision.can_serve_degraded_surface() {
    return Ok(<protocol-card-declared degraded response, with only allowed reads>);
}

if !decision.can_serve_full_surface() {
    return Err(<existing ApplicationError classification; exact variant is Step 12-owned>);
}

// [Exact Step 7 repository get/find/search/list method]
let loaded = exact_repository.<exact_read_method>(<validated key/scope/page>).await?;
Ok(<exact Step 8 response mapped from loaded value(s) and decision>)
```

Angle-bracket expressions are obligations for each individual flow,not implementation helper names。A concrete flow fails review if any bracket cannot be replaced by one exact Step 6 / 7 / 8 contract。

### 8.3 Query branch and side-effect matrix

| Branch | Repository body read | Public surface | Local write / external call | Required distinction |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| route / schema / body mismatch | none | entry rejection | none | application service is not called |
| resolver unavailable / contract failure | none | application error;exact code Step 12 | none | must not fall back to body-first read |
| `NotVisible` | none | explicit body-free not-visible response | none | must not masquerade as visible missing |
| `Visible` + missing | exact get / find only | protocol-declared visible `None` / not-found surface | none | only after resolver permits absence disclosure |
| `Visible` + body / page | exact declared read methods | full typed response / page | none | repository order and public cursor mapping preserved |
| `Visible` + empty page | exact page read | visible empty items + no fabricated cursor | none | visibility seed comes from collection resolver,not first item |
| `Degraded` and card permits partial | only declared partial body reads | explicit degraded marker / reason / source versions | none | no hidden refresh or stale marking |
| `Degraded` and card has no partial body | none or minimum gate read only | body-free degraded / error surface per card | none | must not leak a full body |
| repository read / parity failure | attempted exact read | application error | none | no resolver retry by switching subject,no rebuild |

Query hard prohibitions:

- no Query calls `CapabilityUnitOfWorkManager`、`CapabilityIdempotencyRepository`、`StoredCapabilityResultRepository`、any repository `save / append`、external owner resolver、audit handoff or event collaboration。
- Query does not refresh a projection / reference,mark material stale,rebuild a consumer view,append trace,create a result shell or form an outbound capture。
- read visibility is an application read decision,not governance approval,runtime authorization,tools execution permission,SDK publication status or marketplace listing visibility。

## 9. Shared Outbound Capture / Post-commit Collaboration Guard

### 9.1 Three-phase boundary

Each of the ten Outbound flows must show all three phases even when its capture is invoked from a Command、Consumer or Job target flow。The Outbound flow does not create or mutate its semantic source;it accepts the exact source revision that the source-owning flow is about to commit。

```text
[Phase A: source-owning local UoW]
  | exact source object / append-only record is formed and validated
  | call exact CapabilityOutboundEventCaptureService::capture_* method
  |   -> call exact pure CapabilityEventCandidateMapper::map_* method
  |   -> serialize the complete Step 8 envelope
  |   -> IdGeneratorPort::new_event_payload_snapshot_id()
  |   -> CapabilityEventPayloadSnapshot::freeze(...)
  |   -> IdGeneratorPort::new_event_capture_id()
  |   -> CapabilityEventCaptureRecord::capture(...)
  |   -> CapabilityEventCaptureRepository::capture(snapshot, capture, source_uow)
  | commit source + exact snapshot + initial Captured record as one atomic set
  | any source / mapping / serialization / snapshot / capture failure -> rollback source_uow
  v
[Phase B: post-commit external collaboration]
  | CapabilityEventCaptureRepository::get_with_snapshot(capture_ref)
  | Captured -> CapabilityEventCollaborationCandidateSurface::try_from_stored_capture(...)
  |          -> CapabilityAccessEventCollaborationPort::collaborate(candidate)
  | IntentBound -> bound_intent_ref() -> CapabilityAccessEventCollaborationPort::get(intent)
  | validate candidate / item / outcome / capture / snapshot exact-source symmetry
  | external failure / unavailable outcome never rolls back committed source
  v
[Phase C: stable intent local binding]
  | only for a Captured record with a newly returned stable intent
  | validate returned stable intent and source / capture symmetry
  | ClockPort::now()
  | CapabilityEventCaptureRecord::bind_intent(intent_ref, now)
  | begin independent short local UoW
  | CapabilityEventCaptureRepository::bind_intent(record, expected_version, short_uow)
  | commit short_uow
  | bind failure -> rollback short_uow;original Captured record remains scan-visible
```

### 9.2 Rust-style capture schematic

> The mapper and capture method names are event-specific and already declared in Step 8。The concrete `9.9~9.10` flow must name them exactly;the schematic does not define a generic event builder。

```rust
// [CapabilityOutboundEventCaptureService::<exact capture_* method>(...)]
let capture_result = outbound_capture_service
    .<exact_capture_method>(&context, <exact committed source inputs>, source_uow.as_ref())
    .await;

let capture_ref = match capture_result {
    Ok(capture_ref) => capture_ref,
    Err(error) => {
        // [CapabilityUnitOfWorkManager::rollback(...)]
        uow_manager.rollback(source_uow).await?;
        return Err(error);
    }
};

// The exact capture service must internally call the Step 8 exact pure mapper,
// freeze the complete envelope snapshot, and persist snapshot + initial capture.

// [CapabilityUnitOfWorkManager::commit(Box<dyn CapabilityUnitOfWork>)]
uow_manager.commit(source_uow).await?;

// [CapabilityEventCaptureRepository::get_with_snapshot(CapabilityEventCaptureRef)]
let loaded = event_capture_repository
    .get_with_snapshot(capture_ref)
    .await?
    .ok_or(<existing consistency classification; exact variant is Step 12-owned>)?;

let outcome = if loaded.capture.value.is_ready_for_collaboration() {
    // [CapabilityEventCollaborationCandidateSurface::try_from_stored_capture(...)]
    let candidate = CapabilityEventCollaborationCandidateSurface::try_from_stored_capture(&loaded)?;
    let expected_source = candidate.source.clone();

    // [CapabilityAccessEventCollaborationPort::collaborate(...)]
    let outcome = event_collaboration_port.collaborate(candidate).await?;
    if outcome.source != expected_source
        || outcome.source != loaded.capture.value.source_ref
        || outcome.source != loaded.payload_snapshot.source_ref
    {
        return Err(/* existing consistency classification;Step 12 owns exact variant */);
    }
    outcome
} else {
    // IntentBound is read-only here:never collaborate or bind a second time.
    let intent_ref = loaded.capture.value.bound_intent_ref()?;
    let item = event_collaboration_port
        .get(intent_ref)
        .await?
        .ok_or(/* existing consistency classification */)?;
    if item.intent_ref != *intent_ref
        || item.source != loaded.capture.value.source_ref
        || item.source != loaded.payload_snapshot.source_ref
        || item.outcome.intent_ref != item.intent_ref
        || item.outcome.source != item.source
    {
        return Err(/* existing consistency classification */);
    }
    return Ok(item.outcome);
};

let expected_version = loaded.capture.expected_version;
let mut capture = loaded.capture.value;
let bind_time = clock.now();

// [CapabilityEventCaptureRecord::bind_intent(...)]
capture.bind_intent(outcome.intent_ref.clone(), bind_time)?;

// [CapabilityUnitOfWorkManager::begin()]
let bind_uow = uow_manager.begin().await?;

// [CapabilityEventCaptureRepository::bind_intent(...)]
let bind_result = event_capture_repository
    .bind_intent(capture, expected_version, bind_uow.as_ref())
    .await;

match bind_result {
    Ok(_) => {
        // [CapabilityUnitOfWorkManager::commit(...)]
        uow_manager.commit(bind_uow).await?;
    }
    Err(error) => {
        // [CapabilityUnitOfWorkManager::rollback(...)]
        uow_manager.rollback(bind_uow).await?;
        return Err(error);
    }
}
Ok(outcome)
```

Serialization and candidate-digest canonicalization are implementation obligations owned by Step 13 / 14;the concrete flow may identify their location and declared inputs but must not invent a public serializer / digest builder。

### 9.3 Outbound error / reentry matrix

| Failure / existing state | Source transaction | External call | Local capture result | Required recovery |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| source-to-event variant / version mismatch | rollback | none | none | fix caller / source contract;never map a neighboring source |
| pure mapper / complete serialization failure | rollback | none | none | explicit application failure;no payload fragment |
| snapshot / capture persistence failure | rollback | none | none | source is not committed without recoverable capture |
| source commit succeeds | committed | only after commit | `Captured + intent=None` | eligible for immediate collaboration or `AwaitingIntent` scan |
| stored capture / snapshot missing or asymmetric | already committed | none | invariant failure | do not read current source or rerun mapper |
| `collaborate` returns no typed outcome | already committed | attempted | remains `Captured` | later recovery reuses the same stored bytes |
| typed outcome returned,local bind fails | already committed | intent exists | remains `Captured` locally | repeat same capture candidate;external seam must return same stable intent |
| capture already `IntentBound` | already committed | no second `collaborate` from source flow | existing intent preserved | status / repair uses external `get / repair`,never new event |
| external status is pending / failed / unavailable | already committed | external owner state | local capture remains `IntentBound` | repair Job operates on the same intent;no local delivery-state copy |

### 9.4 Source and product-neutrality gate

| Event family | Only eligible exact source | Forbidden substitution |
|---|---|---|
| identity / registry / descriptor | matching append-only change record + matching accepted object revision | current object alone,DB changelog,reconciliation report |
| governance seam / method relation / formal exposure | matching relation / exposure change record + matching accepted relation / object revision | governance approval body,method body,runtime decision |
| controlled consumer view availability | exact changed `ControlledConsumerView` revision | exposure truth alone,runtime cache |
| impact identified | exact `CapabilityChangeImpactFact` in `Identified` state | downstream feedback or later impact revision |
| derived material refreshed | exact directory / audit-export / ecosystem / reconciliation-report revision | controlled view,registry truth,marketplace listing |
| reference resolution changed | exact canonical `ReferenceResolutionState` revision | resolver response,locator,current owner body |

No Outbound flow introduces an outbox / relay product,physical topic,consumer group,delivery attempt,retry counter,scheduler or second hidden queue。The application-owned snapshot / capture is only the durable local seam that closes the pre-intent crash window;external delivery truth stays in `CapabilityAccessEventCollaborationPort`。

## 10. Cross-family Transaction / State / Side-effect Baseline

### 10.1 Transaction matrix

| Flow phase | Local UoW | Atomic local members | External activity | Rollback meaning | Replay / reentry source |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Command pre-reserve validation | none | none | none | not applicable | none |
| Command accepted / stable stored rejection | one operation UoW | declared truth / relation / state、history / trace、snapshot / capture、command shell / surface、idempotency completion | resolver reads may precede writes;handoff / collaboration only after commit | all uncommitted local members roll back together;external reads do not | generic immutable command shell / surface |
| Query | none | none | read-visibility resolver + local repository reads only | not applicable | request is re-executed as a read;no stored replay |
| Inbound completed disposition | one operation UoW | declared ref/state or downstream summary、optional snapshot / capture、shell / surface / typed receipt、idempotency completion | body-free resolver read cannot be rolled back | accepted local set rolls back together | `get_consumer_receipt` only |
| Outbound source capture | caller's source / target UoW | exact source revision + complete envelope snapshot + initial capture | none before commit | source cannot commit without capture | official capture + immutable snapshot |
| Outbound collaboration | no source UoW | none | `collaborate` from stored snapshot only | external call cannot roll back source | same capture / snapshot / stable external intent |
| Outbound intent binding | independent short UoW | `Captured -> IntentBound` only | typed outcome already returned | bind rollback leaves `Captured` | awaiting-intent scan / exact capture read |
| Job initial reservation | one initial UoW after deterministic planning | fresh `Reserved` idempotency record + complete typed execution journal with initial run issues | planning uses only card-declared local / external body-free reads;no resolver mutation、collaborate or repair | both records roll back together;no target effect may start before commit | exact journal by normalized key;concurrent collision discards local plan |
| Job target | one local UoW per target | that target's declared material / report / reference / binding effect + matching snapshot / capture when changed + terminal journal outcome | resolver / collaboration only where the concrete Job declares it | only current target rolls back;failure / skip recorded after rollback;earlier commits remain | exact journal terminal / Planned outcomes |
| Job final report | one final-report UoW | typed report shell / surface / envelope + journal Finalized + reloaded original reservation Completed,same result ref | none | cannot claim prior target commits rolled back | all-terminal journal before commit;`get_job_report` after completed reservation |
| Job completed duplicate | none after collision check | none | none | not applicable | typed 8-variant stored report only |

### 10.2 State and side-effect ownership matrix

| Flow family | May read | May create / advance | May capture | Must never create / advance |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| identity / registry Command | exact prerequisites + loaded versions | only card-declared identity / review / registry truth,matching change / trace | matching identity / registry event | governance approval,runtime execution,marketplace listing |
| descriptor / relation Command | registry / identity / review + body-free ref/state/safe summary | only descriptor / safe summary / seam / method relation and matching histories | matching descriptor / relation event | secret / method / governance body or owner truth |
| exposure / trace / reference Command | exact accepted prerequisite chain + body-free refs | only exposure / visibility / impact / trace revision / canonical reference state declared by card | matching exposure / impact / reference event | runtime allow-deny,SDK artifact,raw audit evidence |
| Query | resolver authority + declared local reads | nothing | nothing | any truth / history / material / state / idempotency / capture |
| Inbound Consumer | trusted envelope + matching body-free resolver / local source | only declared external ref / canonical state or downstream impact summary | `ReferenceResolutionChanged` only on actual new state revision | identity / registry / descriptor / seam / method relation / exposure / derived truth |
| Outbound | exact source + official stored snapshot / capture | initial technical capture;later stable intent binding | exactly one source/schema capture | semantic source revision,external delivery state,second payload copy |
| Reconciliation Job | committed snapshots / materials | immutable reconciliation report only | `DerivedMaterialRefreshed` for an actual report revision | any core truth repair or command synthesis |
| Material Job | committed truth + current material | only declared controlled view / directory / audit-export / ecosystem revision | matching view / derived event on actual change | identity / registry / descriptor / seam / method / exposure truth |
| Reference refresh Job | typed ref/state + matching body-free resolver | canonical reference-state revision only | reference event on actual change | relation / exposure repair or initial-state fabrication |
| Collaboration repair Job | official capture / snapshot or external intent | local stable intent binding or external repair outcome only | no new outbound event | mapper rerun,current-truth reconstruction,local delivery-state copy |

### 10.3 Phase-boundary invariants

1. Entry validates closed protocol identity before application code;no generic execute / query / consume / publish / job dispatch is introduced。
2. Repository and external Port calls originate only from application services / internal application facade;`api`、`worker` and `jobs` entry layers do not hold them directly。
3. Expected version comes only from `Loaded<T>.expected_version`;no caller version,current time,cursor or event sequence substitutes for it。
4. Local rollback only describes writes registered in the current UoW;it never claims to undo resolver reads,audit handoff or external event collaboration。
5. A source-owning accepted response does not claim external delivery success。Event collaboration outcome is post-commit and does not overwrite the stored Command / Consumer / Job result。
6. Stable duplicate replay never calls Clock / Id generators,domain mutation,resolver,scan,handoff or collaboration,and never creates another capture。
7. No flow treats governance approval,method asset body,secret value,runtime / tools execution,SDK package,marketplace listing or raw audit material as capability-hub local truth。

### 13.2 Inline affected-material propagation algorithm

The following is mandatory inline application orchestration,not a new public helper or service callable。Every concrete flow below names its exact`subject`and`terminal_record`,then expands the same repository / object / capture calls in its Rust pseudocode。

```text
[Accepted terminal core change]
  | terminal_record.change_reason -> typed stale reasons
  | subject = exact CapabilityTraceSubjectRef
  v
[Controlled view affected pages]
  | ControlledConsumerViewRepository::list_affected_by_truth(subject, page)
  | already Stale -> no-op
  | otherwise mark_stale + save(loaded.expected_version)
  | capture_controlled_consumer_view_availability_changed(..., same uow)
  v
[Mutable derived material pages]
  | CapabilityDerivedMaterialRepository::list_material_refs(
  |   MutableAffectedByTruth(subject), page)
  | Directory / AuditExport / Ecosystem only
  | exact current load -> mark_stale -> save(loaded.expected_version)
  | capture_derived_material_refreshed(..., same uow)
  | ReconciliationReport / ControlledView here -> consistency error
  v
[Effect]
  | affected_material_refs = only successfully staged stale revisions
  | stable order: View -> Directory -> AuditExport -> Ecosystem
  | event names unique by first formation;capture remains per exact revision
```

Rust-style schematic expansion:

```rust
let mut affected_material_refs = Vec::<DerivedMaterialRef>::new();
let mut cursor = None;
loop {
    // [CapabilityRepositoryPageRequest::try_new(Option<CapabilityRepositoryCursor>, u32)]
    let page_request = CapabilityRepositoryPageRequest::try_new(cursor, internal_page_limit)?;
    // [ControlledConsumerViewRepository::list_affected_by_truth(CapabilityTraceSubjectRef, CapabilityRepositoryPageRequest)]
    let page = controlled_view_repo
        .list_affected_by_truth(subject.clone(), page_request)
        .await?;
    for loaded in page.items {
        let expected_version = loaded.expected_version;
        let mut view = loaded.value;
        if view.freshness_state == ConsumerViewFreshnessState::Stale {
            continue;
        }
        // [ControlledConsumerView::mark_stale(ChangeReason, Timestamp)]
        view.mark_stale(
            terminal_change_reason.to_consumer_view_stale_reason(),
            now,
        )?;
        // [CapabilityOutboundEventCaptureService::capture_controlled_consumer_view_availability_changed(...)]
        outbound_capture_service
            .capture_controlled_consumer_view_availability_changed(
                &context,
                &view,
                tx.as_ref(),
            )
            .await?;
        // [ControlledConsumerViewRepository::save(ControlledConsumerView, Option<Version>, &dyn CapabilityUnitOfWork)]
        let saved_ref = controlled_view_repo
            .save(view, Some(expected_version), tx.as_ref())
            .await?;
        affected_material_refs.push(DerivedMaterialRef::ControlledConsumerView(saved_ref.id));
    }
    cursor = page.next_cursor;
    if cursor.is_none() { break; }
}

let mut cursor = None;
loop {
    let page_request = CapabilityRepositoryPageRequest::try_new(cursor, internal_page_limit)?;

    let page = derived_material_repo
        .list_material_refs(
            CapabilityDerivedMaterialScanScope::MutableAffectedByTruth(subject.clone()),

        .await?;
```

Each concrete flow binds`subject`to its saved identity / registry id and binds`terminal_change_reason`to the exact terminal accepted record before executing this block textually inline。This block is normative pseudocode,not a callable、macro、generic material loader or new service。Capture is staged before the ownership-consuming repository save so both use the same in-memory new revision;both remain in the same UoW,save failure rolls the capture back,and Step 11 owns the physical persistence order。

Transaction discipline:

| branch | material behavior | transaction result |
|---|---|---|
| candidate selected + current non-stale | stage one new stale revision + exact availability capture;append ref to effect | commit only with core truth / change / trace / result / completion |
| candidate already stale | no write、no id、no capture、no effect ref | continue |
| candidate missing / wrong kind / wrong owner | consistency error | whole Command rollback |
| material expected-version conflict | persistence conflict | whole Command rollback;never core-only commit |
| immutable report returned by mutable scope | adapter contract defect | whole Command rollback |
| completed Command duplicate | no scan / load / mark / capture | stored surface replay only |

### 13.3 Stable post-reserve rejection completion

All eight flows use the same classification,while each flow lists its exact triggering branches:

- body-local missing / malformed / forbidden shape detectable without repository or resolver is rejected before`reserve_if_absent`;no local result is stored。
- deterministic policy rejection discovered after a fresh reservation is a replayable`CommandRejection`:construct exact Step 8`CapabilityProtocolRejection`,serialize the complete surface,call`StoredCapabilityResultRepository::save`,complete the returned loaded reservation with its result ref,save it with`loaded_reservation.expected_version`,then commit the rejection-only UoW。
- repository unavailable、resolver unavailable、serialization failure、capture failure、wiring / invariant defect and optimistic conflict are`ApplicationError`;rollback the fresh UoW and leave no completed reservation/result。
- same-key different operation / digest never overwrites or completes the original reservation。Step 13 fixes its exact zero-write winner-classification algorithm and forbids conflict persistence；the current request receives`DuplicateConflict`without original business result leakage。

```rust
        let candidate = ReferenceCandidate::body_free(
            ReferenceKind::ExternalCapabilitySource,
            ReferenceLocatorSummary::from_external_source(&external_locator),
            candidate_digest.clone(),
        );
        // [CapabilityExternalReferenceRepository::find_by_candidate_digest(ReferenceKind, &ReferenceCandidateDigest)]
        if external_ref_repo
            .find_by_candidate_digest(ReferenceKind::ExternalCapabilitySource, &candidate_digest)
            .await?
            .is_some()
        {
            return /* complete stable PolicyRejected; resolver is not called */;
        }
        // [ExternalCapabilitySourceReferencePort::resolve_source_reference(...)]
        let observation = source_resolver
            .resolve_source_reference(
                subject.clone(),
                source_kind.clone(),
                external_locator.clone(),
                candidate,
            )
            .await?;
        if observation.reference_subject != subject
            || observation.reference_kind != ReferenceKind::ExternalCapabilitySource
            || observation.candidate_digest != candidate_digest
        {
            return Err(/* consistency ApplicationError */);
        }
        let state_id = ids.new_reference_resolution_state_id();
        let reference_policy = ReferenceResolutionPolicy::default_for_capability_references();
        // [ReferenceResolutionState::from_initial_resolution(...)]
        let state = ReferenceResolutionState::from_initial_resolution(
            state_id.clone(),
            subject,
            observation.reference_kind,
            observation.resolution_value,
            observation.resolution_reason,
            context.actor_context.clone(),
            context.trace_id.clone(),
            &reference_policy,
            now,
        )?;
        // [ExternalCapabilitySourceRef::register(...)]
        let source_ref = ExternalCapabilitySourceRef::register(
            source_ref_id,
            source_kind,
            external_locator,
            candidate_digest,
            state_id,
            now,
        );
        (source_ref, state, true)
    }
};

if identity_repo.find_by_identity_key(&command.intake.identity_key).await?.is_some() {
    return /* complete stable PolicyRejected */;
}

// [CapabilityIdentity::create_from_intake(...)]

    identity_id.clone(),

if registered_source {
```

All direct struct literals above are mappings to already declared Step 7 / 8 carriers,not new public factories。`copy_validated()`is the exact Step 6 §7.6 callable and must not be replaced by`Clone`assumptions or string conversion。

#### 14.1.5 Transaction boundary

| Phase | Included | Failure handling |
|---|---|---|
| pre-reserve | route/schema/body shape;digest field selection | body rejection;no local write |
| external observation | Register resolver after fresh reserve / duplicate-source guard | unavailable -> rollback;observation itself cannot be rolled back |
| accepted UoW | optional source/state create；final identity；review；2 changes；trace；reference + 2 identity captures；actual material stale/captures；stored response；completion | any failure rolls back all local writes |
| Existing branch | no source/state write or reference capture | identity/review transaction continues |
| post-commit | none in Command；stored captures later enter outbound flows | external collaboration cannot alter response / rollback |

#### 14.1.6 Error / rejection mapping

| Branch | Classification | Persisted rejection? / effect |
|---|---|---|
| route/name/schema mismatch；missing source/intake；forbidden source body | pre-reserve `InvalidEnvelope / OperationMismatch / MissingRequiredField / BodyForbidden` | no |
| Register candidate already exists；identity key conflict；existing source missing/wrong union；invalid initial state | stable `PolicyRejected` | yes after fresh reserve；no resolver on duplicate candidate |
| existing source/state id mismatch；resolver subject/kind/digest mismatch；mutable scan returns forbidden kind | consistency `ApplicationError` | rollback;not protocol rejection |
| resolver unavailable；repository unavailable | technical `ApplicationError` | rollback;retry may use same key because no completion |
| completed same digest | `DuplicateReplayed` | read original shell/surface;no resolver / ids / scan / writes |
| same key different digest / operation | `DuplicateConflict` | preserve original reservation/result;no leakage |
| any identity/review/material expected-version or capture conflict | persistence / consistency `ApplicationError` | whole UoW rollback |

#### 14.1.7 State / change / trace / capture / side effects

| Axis | Exact accepted effect |
|---|---|
| source / reference | Existing: read only；Register: new source ref + canonical state revision and `ReferenceResolutionChanged` capture |
| identity / review | identity initial state is `Resolved -> Active`,`Stale -> Candidate`,`Unresolved / Unavailable -> Unresolved`;`Invalid / Forbidden / Expired` rejects before identity creation;then same-state `ReviewFactAttached`;review `Draft -> Recorded`,always `Separated` |
| changes | ordered `Created`,then`ReviewFactAttached`;both explain final identity state |
| trace | one new identity-subject trace containing both refs in order；reason from terminal record |
| core captures | Existing = 2 identity captures；Register = 1 reference + 2 identity captures |
| materials | actual non-stale affected view/directory/export/discovery -> stale；each revision captured；already-stale omitted |
| public effect | one changed identity；Register adds source subject/state；two change refs；one trace；actual stale refs；logical event names unique |
| explicitly absent | no registry / descriptor / seam / method / exposure creation；no impact；no governance approval；no runtime/tools execution；no marketplace listing |

#### 14.1.8 Test cuts

1. Existing resolved source -> Active identity + recorded review + two changes / one trace / two identity captures。
2. Register source with `Stale` resolution -> Candidate identity;`Unresolved / Unavailable` -> Unresolved identity;`Invalid / Forbidden / Expired` -> stable rejection;source/state save and reference capture occur only for an accepted non-terminal initial state。
3. duplicate candidate hit -> resolver invocation count `0`,stable rejection stored。
4. completed duplicate -> exact stored result/effect replay；all domain/repository write / resolver / material scan counts `0`。
5. identity key conflict and wrong external-reference union -> stable rejection;no truth/material effects。
6. source/state id mismatch or resolver subject/digest mismatch -> rollback consistency error。
7. one ready view + directory + already-stale export + immutable report indexed broadly -> only view/directory become stale and enter effect;report excluded;export no-op。
8. second material save or capture failure -> source/state/identity/review/change/trace/result/completion all absent after rollback。
9. assert review surface contains no approval / vote / Policy；source surface contains no MCP tool result、A2A message or API response body。

#### 14.1.9 Single-flow stop review

| Gate | Result |
|---|---|
| protocol / DTO / callable | pass；Step 8 §7.12.1 exact mapping |
| domain / Port / expected version | pass after controlled reopen；create writes use`None`,fresh reservation/material updates useown loaded versions |
| transaction / replay | pass；one local UoW,duplicate no resolver / scan / write |
| state / trace / event | pass；2 ordered changes / 1 trace；2 or 3 core captures；actual material captures |
| owner boundary | pass；no execution、listing、approval、method/secret/audit body |
| unresolved blocker | none |

Flow status: `completed_in_batch_9_1`。This single-flow record does not authorize entry into the next formal Step or batch by itself。

### 14.2 `command_correct_capability_identity_flow`

#### 14.2.1 Entry and target

| Item | Exact contract |
|---|---|
| protocol | `CapabilityCommandRequest<CorrectCapabilityIdentityCommand>` -> `CapabilityCommandOutcome<CorrectCapabilityIdentityResult>` |
| entry | `CapabilityCommandHandlers::correct_capability_identity(...)` |
| application | `CapabilityIdentityCommandService::correct_capability_identity(context, command)` |
| target | one existing identity final revision；2 ordered identity changes；1 identity trace；1 terminal identity capture；actual stale materials / captures；stored result / completion |
| read-only prerequisites | every exact related identity；current identity-key owner lookup |
| transaction | target identity saved once with original`Loaded.expected_version`;related identities never saved；all accepted effects one UoW |
| Step 10 handoff | target`Active -> CorrectionPending -> Active`;terminal kind exactly`Corrected / Merged / Split`;related states remain unchanged |

#### 14.2.2 DTO field sources

| Field | Source | Construction / validation |
|---|---|---|
| `identity_ref` | body exact ref | target`CapabilityIdentityRepository::get_with_version`;stale / missing / retired reject |
| `correction_kind` | closed body enum | 1:1 map to`CapabilityIdentityChangeKind::{Corrected,Merged,Split}`;never generic change kind |
| `new_identity_key` | body | `find_by_identity_key`;another current owner rejects；same target result remains domain-policy input |
| `related_identity_refs` | body stable-order vector | `Corrected`requires empty -> domain`None`;`Merged / Split`non-empty duplicate-free non-self -> `CapabilityIdentityRefSet` |
| `correction_reason` | body | `to_change_reason()`used by request + completion records；terminal record reason -> trace/material bridges |
| two change ids / trace id / result ids | `IdGeneratorPort` | no id derived from target / related refs |
| `previous_state` result | loaded target before first member call | never read from first record after mutation |
| `current_state` result | final target after`complete_correction` | must be`Active` |
| digest | Step 13 | exact five body fields；related refs use declared canonical ordered set |

#### 14.2.3 Function call graph

```text
[Handler]
  | validate exact route / name / schema / body
  v
[Identity service + idempotency]
  | body shape: correction-kind/cardinality/self/duplicate
  | digest -> tx begin -> reserve_if_absent
  | completed duplicate -> rollback + stored get;STOP
  v
[Exact reads]
  | target get_with_version(identity_ref)
  | each related get_with_version(exact ref),stable order
  | find_by_identity_key(new key)
  | validate_correction(target,kind,related,reason)
  v
[Domain mutation in memory]
  | target.request_correction -> CorrectionRequested
  | target.complete_correction -> terminal Corrected/Merged/Split
  | related identities unchanged
  v
[Same UoW]
  | target identity.save(final, original expected_version) ONCE
  | append request record -> append terminal record
  | record_for_changes(two ordered refs) -> trace append(None)
  | capture IdentityChanged(terminal record) only
  | inline affected-material stale + availability captures
  | stored result + idempotency completion -> commit
  v
[Post-commit]
  | return response;outbound collaboration reads durable captures later
```

#### 14.2.4 Rust-style pseudocode

```rust
context.assert_write_metadata_complete()?;
// Body-local validation occurs before reserve.
match command.correction_kind {
    CapabilityIdentityCorrectionKind::Corrected if !command.related_identity_refs.is_empty() =>
        return /* InvalidField, no reservation */,
    CapabilityIdentityCorrectionKind::Merged | CapabilityIdentityCorrectionKind::Split
        if command.related_identity_refs.is_empty() =>
        return /* InvalidField, no reservation */,
    _ => {}
}
// Reject duplicate refs and target self-ref before reserve;preserve caller stable order.
let request_digest: CapabilityRequestDigest =
    /* Step 13 digest(identity_ref,kind,new key,canonical related refs,reason) */;
let now = clock.now();
let tx = uow_manager.begin().await?;
let reservation = CapabilityIdempotencyRecord::reserve(&context, request_digest.clone(), now)?;
let mut loaded_reservation = match idempotency_repo
    .reserve_if_absent(reservation, tx.as_ref())
    .await?
{
    CapabilityIdempotencyReserveResult::Reserved(loaded) => loaded,
    CapabilityIdempotencyReserveResult::Existing(existing)
        if existing.value.matches(&context.channel, &context.operation_name, &request_digest)
            && existing.value.state == CapabilityIdempotencyState::Completed =>
    {
        let result_ref = existing.value.completed_result_ref()?.clone();
        uow_manager.rollback(tx).await?;
        let stored = stored_result_repo.get(&result_ref).await?;
        return /* exact CorrectCapabilityIdentity duplicate response from stored */;
    }
    CapabilityIdempotencyReserveResult::Existing(_) => {
        uow_manager.rollback(tx).await?;
        return /* DuplicateConflict / in-progress;no original result leakage */;
    }
};

// [CapabilityIdentityRepository::get_with_version(CapabilityIdentityRef)]
let mut loaded_target = match identity_repo
    .get_with_version(command.identity_ref.clone())
    .await?
{
    Some(loaded) => loaded,
    None => return /* complete replayable PolicyRejected per §13.3 */,
};
let previous_state = loaded_target.value.identity_state.clone();
if previous_state == CapabilityIdentityState::Retired {
    return /* complete replayable PolicyRejected */;
}

let domain_kind = match command.correction_kind {
    CapabilityIdentityCorrectionKind::Corrected => CapabilityIdentityChangeKind::Corrected,
    CapabilityIdentityCorrectionKind::Merged => CapabilityIdentityChangeKind::Merged,
    CapabilityIdentityCorrectionKind::Split => CapabilityIdentityChangeKind::Split,
};
let reason = command.correction_reason.to_change_reason();
let mut related_values = Vec::<CapabilityIdentity>::new();
let mut related_refs = Vec::<CapabilityIdentityRef>::new();
for related_ref in command.related_identity_refs {
    // [CapabilityIdentityRepository::get_with_version(CapabilityIdentityRef)]
    let loaded_related = match identity_repo.get_with_version(related_ref.clone()).await? {
        Some(loaded) => loaded,
        None => return /* complete replayable PolicyRejected */,
    };
    if loaded_related.value.capability_identity_id == loaded_target.value.capability_identity_id
        || loaded_related.value.identity_state == CapabilityIdentityState::Retired
    {
        return /* complete replayable PolicyRejected */;
    }
    related_refs.push(related_ref);
    related_values.push(loaded_related.value); // expected_version intentionally unused:read only
}
let related_set = match domain_kind {
    CapabilityIdentityChangeKind::Corrected => None,
    CapabilityIdentityChangeKind::Merged | CapabilityIdentityChangeKind::Split => {
        Some(CapabilityIdentityRefSet::try_from_values(related_refs.clone())?)
    }
    _ => return Err(/* impossible closed mapping consistency error */),
};

if let Some(key_owner) = identity_repo
    .find_by_identity_key(&command.new_identity_key)
    .await?
{
    if key_owner.value.capability_identity_id != loaded_target.value.capability_identity_id {
        return /* complete replayable PolicyRejected */;
    }
}
let identity_policy = CapabilityIdentityPolicy::default_for_capability_hub();
// [CapabilityIdentityPolicy::validate_correction(...)]
identity_policy.validate_correction(
    &loaded_target.value,
    &domain_kind,
    &related_values,
    &reason,
)?;
// [CapabilityIdentity::request_correction(...)]
let requested_record = loaded_target.value.request_correction(
    ids.new_identity_change_record_id(),
    &context.actor_context,
    reason.copy_validated(),
    context.trace_id.clone(),
    now,
)?;
// [CapabilityIdentity::complete_correction(...)]
let terminal_record = loaded_target.value.complete_correction(
```

The final `(shell,surface)`expression is a mapping obligation to the already declared`StoredCapabilityOperationResult::from_surface`and`CapabilityStoredResultSurface`,not an invented helper callable。Its field symmetry is identical to§14.1 and is audited per flow。

#### 14.2.5 Transaction boundary

| Phase | Boundary |
|---|---|
| pre-reserve | correction/cardinality/self/duplicate-ref body shape;invalid shape has no stored result |
| reads after reserve | target、all related exact revisions、new-key owner；stable policy rejections stored per§13.3 |
| accepted UoW | one final target save；2 change appends；1 trace；1 terminal identity capture；all actual stale material saves/captures；result/completion |
| forbidden writes | no intermediate identity save；no related identity save；no source/review/registry mutation |
| rollback | target or any material version conflict、capture / trace / result failure rolls back all staged effects |

#### 14.2.6 Error / rejection mapping

| Branch | Mapping | Side effect |
|---|---|---|
| empty/mismatched related vector；duplicate/self refs detectable from body | pre-reserve`InvalidField` | none |
| target/related missing or stale；target/related retired；key owned by other identity；domain lifecycle reject | post-reserve stable`PolicyRejected` | rejection-only stored completion |
| body rewrite attempt | `BodyForbidden` | pre-reserve when detectable；otherwise stable stored rejection |
| related load / key lookup unavailable | `ApplicationError` | rollback;no completion |
| terminal state not Active or record/final identity asymmetry | consistency`ApplicationError` | rollback;do not capture intermediate record |
| any target/material optimistic conflict | persistence conflict | whole UoW rollback |
| completed duplicate | `DuplicateReplayed` | stored read only；does not reopen correction |

#### 14.2.7 State / change / trace / capture / side effects

| Axis | Effect |
|---|---|
| target state | `Active -> CorrectionPending -> Active`in memory；one final version persisted |
| related identities | exact revisions retained only as evidence/result；zero mutation |
| changes | ordered`CorrectionRequested`,then exact terminal kind |
| trace | one target-subject revision covers both change refs；terminal reason |
| core capture | exactly one`CapabilityIdentityChanged`from terminal record |
| materials | once per target subject；actual stale only,with per-revision availability capture |
| explicitly absent | no redirect truth、implicit merge retirement、registry / descriptor / relation / exposure change、reference state change or impact |

#### 14.2.8 Test cuts

1. Corrected with empty related refs -> two records,one final save,one trace,one terminal capture。
2. Merged / Split with stable duplicate-free non-retired exact refs -> related order preserved in record/result；related save count `0`。
3. Corrected with related refs；Merged/Split empty；self or duplicate related refs -> pre-reserve rejection where body-visible。
4. retired related identity / stale exact ref / key owned by another identity -> replayable policy rejection,zero truth/material writes。
5. mapper is never called for`CorrectionRequested`;terminal mapper called once and passes final-state symmetry。
6. identity save count exactly`1`,using original target `Loaded.expected_version`。
7. ready / rebuilding affected materials become stale atomically；already stale no-op；one material conflict rolls back target and both records。
8. completed duplicate -> target/related/key/material repository call counts `0`after stored result load。

#### 14.2.9 Single-flow stop review

| Gate | Result |
|---|---|
| protocol / DTO | pass；all five fields and exact result mapped |
| domain / Port | pass；request + complete members,identity policy,existing repositories only |
| version / transaction | pass；target one save fromloaded version；related read-only；material atomic |
| trace / capture | pass after`CH-DDD-S9-TERMINAL-EVENT-001`;2 refs in trace,terminal capture only |
| owner boundary | pass；no canonical redirect or cascade invented |
| unresolved blocker | none |

Flow status: `completed_in_batch_9_1`。Stop-review continues at batch boundary,not the next flow boundary。

### 14.3 `command_retire_capability_identity_flow`

#### 14.3.1 Entry and target

| Item | Exact contract |
|---|---|
| protocol | `CapabilityCommandRequest<RetireCapabilityIdentityCommand>` -> `CapabilityCommandOutcome<RetireCapabilityIdentityResult>` |
| entry / application | `CapabilityCommandHandlers::retire_capability_identity` -> `CapabilityIdentityCommandService::retire_capability_identity` |
| target | one identity terminal revision；one Retired change / trace / identity capture；actual stale materials / captures；stored result / completion |
| guard read | `CapabilityRegistryRepository::find_current_by_identity(identity_id)`must be`None` |
| transaction | identity/change/trace/captures/materials/result/completion one UoW |
| Step 10 handoff | any allowed non-retired identity state ->`Retired`;terminal;no dependent truth cascade |

#### 14.3.2 DTO field sources

| Field | Source | Target |
|---|---|---|
| `identity_ref` | body exact ref | identity `get_with_version`;id feeds current registry guard and trace subject |
| `retirement_reason` | body `IdentityChangeReason` | `to_change_reason()` -> identity member / change；terminal record -> trace/material reasons |
| previous/current state | loaded target before / final object after member | response only;entry never infers |
| record / trace / result ids,now | IdGenerator / Clock | exact object factories / stored result |
| digest | Step 13 | identity ref + retirement reason only |

#### 14.3.3 Function call graph

```text
[Handler] validate -> context
  v
[Identity service] digest -> tx begin -> reserve
  | duplicate -> stored replay;STOP
  v
[Guards]
  | identity.get_with_version(exact)
  | registry.find_current_by_identity(identity id)
  | current registry exists -> replayable PolicyRejected;no cascade
  v
[Domain + same UoW]
  | identity.retire -> Retired record
  | identity.save(loaded.expected_version)
  | append identity change -> record_for_changes -> trace append
  | capture IdentityChanged
  | inline affected-material stale + captures
  | stored response + completion -> commit
  v
[After commit] no registry/descriptor/relation/exposure mutation;collaboration later
```

#### 14.3.5 Transaction boundary

| Boundary | Rule |
|---|---|
| pre-reserve | missing/empty fields reject without result |
| after reserve guard | target / current registry reads；stable guard rejection can complete rejection-only UoW |
| accepted atomic set | identity terminal save、change、trace、identity capture、material stale/captures、result、completion |
| forbidden cascade | registry、descriptor、review、seam、method relation、exposure and reference state are not written |
| post-commit | no external collaboration in Command；capture repair remains independent |

#### 14.3.6 Error / rejection mapping

| Branch | Mapping |
|---|---|
| missing ref/reason | pre-reserve`MissingRequiredField / InvalidField` |
| target missing/stale/already retired/illegal state | stored`PolicyRejected` |
| current registry exists | stored`PolicyRejected`;caller must retire dependency explicitly |
| caller requests cascade/deletion | `InvalidField`;no dependent write |
| repository unavailable / expected-version / capture / material conflict | `ApplicationError`;whole rollback |
| completed duplicate | stored replay;no target/registry/material reads |

#### 14.3.7 State / change / trace / capture / side effects

| Axis | Effect |
|---|---|
| identity | non-retired allowed state -> terminal`Retired` |
| change / trace | one`Retired`record；one identity trace |
| capture | one identity change capture + one per actual stale material revision |
| dependent truth | guard ensures no current registry；zero cascade mutation/deletion |
| public effect | one identity subject/change/trace；actual stale refs；unique logical event names |
| absent | no impact/reference state；no runtime / SDK / listing / governance mutation |

#### 14.3.8 Test cuts

1. active identity with no current registry -> terminal retirement and complete atomic effects。
2. candidate/unresolved/correction-pending retirement follows Step 10 allowed subset；illegal subset rejects。
3. current registry exists -> stable rejection；identity `retire` / save / material scan counts `0`。
4. already retired or stale exact identity ref -> stable rejection。
5. dependent descriptor/relation/exposure history is never deleted or retired by this flow。
6. actual stale material list excludes already-stale and report；material conflict rolls back identity retirement。
7. duplicate replay does not repeat guard or cascade decision and returns original effect refs。

#### 14.3.9 Single-flow stop review

| Gate | Result |
|---|---|
| protocol / fields | pass |
| dependent guard | pass after reopen；existing registry lookup is exact and read-only |
| member / Port / version | pass；`retire`,one loaded save,existing repositories |
| transaction / replay | pass；no partial retirement or duplicate rerun |
| owner boundary | pass；explicit non-cascade |
| unresolved blocker | none |

Flow status: `completed_in_batch_9_1`。

### 14.4 `command_record_capability_access_review_fact_flow`

#### 14.4.1 Entry and target

| Item | Exact contract |
|---|---|
| protocol | `CapabilityCommandRequest<RecordCapabilityAccessReviewFactCommand>` -> `CapabilityCommandOutcome<RecordCapabilityAccessReviewFactResult>` |
| entry / application | `CapabilityCommandHandlers::record_capability_access_review_fact` -> `CapabilityIdentityCommandService::record_capability_access_review_fact` |
| target | one new Recorded review；optional old current review -> Superseded；identity current-review link；one ReviewFactAttached change / trace / identity capture；actual stale materials / captures；stored result / completion |
| transaction | old review、new review、identity、change、trace、captures、materials、result、completion one UoW |
| Step 10 handoff | new`Draft -> Recorded`;old`Recorded -> Superseded`;identity state unchanged and non-retired |
| responsibility boundary | review always`AccessGovernanceSeparationMarker::Separated`;no governance approval / vote / Policy truth |

#### 14.4.2 DTO field sources

| Field | Source | Exact construction |
|---|---|---|
| `identity_ref` | body exact ref | identity loaded with version；id selects current review and trace subject |
| `review_context` | body safe value | `CapabilityAccessReviewFact::draft`;approval/policy shape rejected |
| `risk_summary` | body safe value | identity-level review fact only；not descriptor risk / governance result |
| separation marker | domain constant | `AccessGovernanceSeparationMarker::Separated`;caller cannot supply |
| attachment reason | Step 6 fixed factory | `ChangeReason::access_review_fact_recorded()`;no body text concatenation |
| review/change/trace/result ids + now | IdGenerator / Clock | replacement id passed to old review supersede；same operation time |
| digest | Step 13 | identity ref + review context + risk summary |

#### 14.4.3 Function call graph

```text
[Handler] exact route/name/schema/body -> command context
  v
[Identity service] local validation -> digest -> tx begin -> reserve
  | completed duplicate -> rollback + stored replay;STOP
  v
[Loads / domain]
  | identity.get_with_version(exact);non-retired/current guard
  | review.find_current_by_identity(identity id)
  | new review.draft(Separated) -> record
  | old current present -> old.supersede(new review id)
  | identity.attach_review_fact(fixed reason) -> ReviewFactAttached
  v
[Same UoW]
  | optional old review.save(old expected_version)
  | new review.save(None)
  | identity.save(identity expected_version)
  | append identity change -> record_for_changes -> trace append
  | capture IdentityChanged
  | inline affected-material stale + captures
  | stored result + completion -> commit
  v
[After commit] no governance call / approval mutation / external collaboration
```
