#### 14.4.5 Transaction boundary

| Boundary | Rule |
|---|---|
| pre-reserve | missing fields / approval-policy body shape reject without writes |
| accepted atomic set | optional old review supersede；new review create；identity link update；change/trace/captures/materials/result/completion |
| expected versions | old review from its `Loaded`;identity from its `Loaded`;new review `None`;every material from its own `Loaded` |
| rollback | current-review race,identity/material conflict,capture/result failure rolls back old/new/link together |
| post-commit | no governance system call and no external collaboration in this Command |

#### 14.4.6 Error / rejection mapping

| Branch | Mapping |
|---|---|
| missing identity/context/risk | pre-reserve`MissingRequiredField` |
| approval/vote/Policy/shared-rules material | `BodyForbidden`;no review truth |
| non-current/stale/retired identity；invalid review domain state | replayable`PolicyRejected` |
| identity current-review ref vs repository current mismatch | consistency`ApplicationError`;rollback |
| old review / identity / material expected-version race | persistence conflict；whole rollback |
| completed duplicate | stored response/effect replay；no new review id / load / scan |

#### 14.4.7 State / change / trace / capture / side effects

| Axis | Effect |
|---|---|
| new review | `Draft -> Recorded`;marker`Separated` |
| old review | optional current`Recorded -> Superseded`;historical only |
| identity | lifecycle unchanged；current review ref / identity version changes |
| change / trace | one`ReviewFactAttached`record；one identity trace |
| captures | one identity capture + actual material availability captures |
| absent | no governance seam、approval、Policy、descriptor risk、reference or impact mutation |

#### 14.4.8 Test cuts

1. no old review -> new Recorded review + identity link,one change/trace/capture。
2. old current review -> old Superseded + new Recorded + identity link atomically；three expected-version paths correct。
3. old review save succeeds but identity/material capture fails -> rollback preserves old Recorded/current link。
4. identity review ref/repository current mismatch -> consistency failure before any domain save。
5. retired/stale identity -> stable rejection；new id / material scan count `0`after rejection decision。
6. approval/vote/Policy payload category -> `BodyForbidden`;repository writes `0`。
7. marker always`Separated`in object/result/stored replay；never caller-controlled。
8. completed duplicate -> same review ref and effect refs；no second supersede/new fact。

#### 14.4.9 Single-flow stop review

| Gate | Result |
|---|---|
| protocol / DTO | pass；three body fields,exact result |
| object / Port | pass；draft/record/supersede/attach and existing repositories |
| version / transaction | pass；old/new/identity/material independent versions in one UoW |
| trace / capture | pass；one link record / trace / identity capture |
| separation boundary | pass；`Separated`,zero approval/policy truth |
| unresolved blocker | none |

The loaded identity expected version is intentionally unused because identity is read-only。Factory and policy run before any registry save;policy rejection cannot leave a draft row。

#### 15.1.5 Transaction boundary

| Boundary | Rule |
|---|---|
| pre-reserve | missing / invalid scope / forbidden runtime-listing material when body-visible |
| post-reserve reads | exact Active identity + current-registry uniqueness |
| accepted atomic set | new entry、Registered record、trace、registry capture、material stale/captures、result/completion |
| expected versions | new entry`None`;identity no save；material own loaded version；reservation returned loaded version |
| rollback | uniqueness race,policy,material/capture/result failure leaves no entry/change/trace |

#### 15.1.6 Error / rejection mapping

| Branch | Mapping |
|---|---|
| missing fields / invalid scope | pre-reserve`MissingRequiredField / InvalidScope` |
| runtime authorization / marketplace basis | `BodyForbidden` |
| identity missing/stale/non-Active；existing current entry；invalid basis/context/formal-visible claim | replayable`PolicyRejected` |
| current uniqueness race at save | optimistic/unique conflict`ApplicationError`;whole rollback |
| policy called after persistence or factory returns non-Registered | consistency defect；rollback |
| completed duplicate | original entry ref/effect replay；no identity/uniqueness/material reads |

#### 15.1.7 State / change / trace / capture / side effects

| Axis | Effect |
|---|---|
| identity | Active prerequisite,read-only |
| registry | new entry initial`Registered`;`Draft` is not formed or persisted in the current boundary;basis copied；context not stored |
| change / trace | one factory-returned`Registered`record；one registry trace |
| captures | one RegistryChanged + actual material availability captures |
| absent | no descriptor bind、FormalVisible、exposure、runtime allowlist、directory/listing creation or reference mutation |

#### 15.1.8 Test cuts

1. Active identity + no current entry + valid basis/context -> one entry/record/trace/capture。
2. factory initial state exactly Registered；`Draft` factory / save count `0`;`transition_lifecycle`call count `0`。
3. inactive / stale identity and duplicate current entry -> stored policy rejection；entry save/material scan `0`。
4. policy rejection after in-memory factory -> no entry/change row committed。
5. concurrent identity uniqueness violation -> whole rollback,not duplicate success reconstruction。
6. runtime / marketplace input rejected and never persisted in basis/context。
7. material conflict rolls back new entry and Registered record。
8. completed duplicate returns original entry ref and does not rerun policy or scan。

#### 15.1.9 Single-flow stop review

| Gate | Result |
|---|---|
| protocol / DTO | pass；four fields and exact result |
| factory / policy order | pass；factory in memory -> policy -> save |
| Port / version | pass；existing identity/uniqueness reads,new save None |
| trace / capture / material | pass；one each core + actual stale revisions |
| boundary | pass；no formal-visible/listing/runtime authority |
| unresolved blocker | none |

Flow status: `completed_in_batch_9_1`。


### 15.2 `command_update_registry_lifecycle_state_flow`

#### 15.2.1 Entry and target

| Item | Exact contract |
|---|---|
| protocol | `CapabilityCommandRequest<UpdateRegistryLifecycleStateCommand>` -> `CapabilityCommandOutcome<UpdateRegistryLifecycleStateResult>` |
| entry / application | `CapabilityCommandHandlers::update_registry_lifecycle_state` -> `CapabilityRegistryCommandService::update_registry_lifecycle_state` |
| target | one existing registry lifecycle revision；one LifecycleChanged record / trace / registry capture；actual stale materials / captures；stored result / completion |
| public target allowlist | only`Undescribed / Ungoverned / VisibilityPending` |
| required guards | target != current；`current.can_transition_to(target)`；`RegistryVisibilityPolicy::validate_transition(current,target)` |
| Step 10 handoff | exact full matrix remains Step 10,constrained here by public route allowlist and both guards；`Draft` is reserved and never current for this flow |

#### 15.2.2 DTO field sources

| Field | Source | Exact target |
|---|---|---|
| `registry_entry_ref` | body exact ref | `CapabilityRegistryRepository::get_with_version`;owner for trace/material subject |
| `target_state` | closed body enum | pre-reserve public allowlist；post-load no-op + object/policy guards；member target |
| `lifecycle_reason` | body `RegistryLifecycleReason` | `to_change_reason()`for transition record；record -> trace/material bridges |
| previous/current state | loaded before member / accepted object after member | exact result；never caller echo |
| change/trace/result ids + now | IdGenerator / Clock | exact members/factories |
| digest | Step 13 | ref + target + reason |

#### 15.2.3 Function call graph

```text
[Handler] validate exact command -> context
  v
[Registry service]
  | pre-reserve target allowlist / required fields
  | digest -> tx begin -> reserve
  | duplicate -> stored replay;STOP
  v
[Load + guards]
  | registry.get_with_version(exact)
  | target != current
  | current.can_transition_to(target)
  | visibility_policy.validate_transition(current,target)
  v
[Domain + same UoW]
  | entry.transition_lifecycle -> LifecycleChanged record
  | registry.save(entry,loaded.expected_version)
  | append record -> one trace -> RegistryChanged capture
  | inline affected-material stale + captures
  | stored result + completion -> commit
  v
[After commit] no FormalVisible/exposure/runtime mutation;collaboration later
```

#### 15.2.5 Transaction boundary

| Boundary | Rule |
|---|---|
| pre-reserve | required fields and route target allowlist |
| post-reserve stable guards | exact entry,non-no-op,object and policy transition checks |
| accepted atomic set | entry revision、one change/trace/capture、actual material revisions/captures、result/completion |
| expected versions | entry and each material from independent `Loaded`;reservation from Reserved loaded variant |
| post-commit | no external collaboration or prerequisite reevaluation in Command response |

#### 15.2.6 Error / rejection mapping

| Branch | Mapping |
|---|---|
| target Draft/Registered/FormalVisible/Retired | pre-reserve`PolicyRejected`for public route |
| target equals current；`can_transition_to=false`；policy rejects；entry missing/stale | replayable`PolicyRejected` |
| FormalVisible attempt | rejected here even if prerequisites appear satisfied；exposure service owns it |
| Retired attempt | rejected here；retirement flow owns it |
| repository/material/capture/version failure | `ApplicationError`;whole rollback |
| completed duplicate | stored original result/effect；does not re-evaluate current state |

#### 15.2.7 State / change / trace / capture / side effects

| Axis | Effect |
|---|---|
| registry | one allowed public maintenance transition to Undescribed/Ungoverned/VisibilityPending |
| record / trace | one`LifecycleChanged`record；one registry trace |
| capture / material | one RegistryChanged；actual material stale revisions each captured |
| absent | no descriptor/seam/exposure creation；no FormalVisible；no runtime/listing/reference/impact mutation |

#### 15.2.8 Test cuts

1. each of three public targets from an allowed current state -> accepted exact previous/current result。
2. all four forbidden target variants -> rejection before repository read/reserve where body validation occurs。
3. no-op -> stored policy rejection；transition/save/material calls `0`。
4. object allows but visibility policy rejects,or vice versa -> stable rejection；member not called。
5. FormalVisible never reaches`transition_lifecycle`;Retired never reaches member in this route。
6. entry version/material conflict -> all changes/captures/result rollback。
7. duplicate replay returns original transition result even if current entry later changed。

#### 15.2.9 Single-flow stop review

| Gate | Result |
|---|---|
| protocol / target route | pass；closed 3-target allowlist |
| domain guards | pass；object + policy before member |
| Port / version / UoW | pass |
| state / capture / material | pass；one core transition and actual stale revisions |
| owner boundary | pass；FormalVisible / retirement authority separated |
| unresolved blocker | none |

Flow status: `completed_in_batch_9_1`。


### 15.3 `command_update_registry_visibility_basis_flow`

#### 15.3.1 Entry and target

| Item | Exact contract |
|---|---|
| protocol | `CapabilityCommandRequest<UpdateRegistryVisibilityBasisCommand>` -> `CapabilityCommandOutcome<UpdateRegistryVisibilityBasisResult>` |
| entry / application | `CapabilityCommandHandlers::update_registry_visibility_basis` -> `CapabilityRegistryCommandService::update_registry_visibility_basis` |
| target | one existing registry basis/lifecycle revision；one VisibilityBasisChanged record / trace / registry capture；actual stale materials / captures；stored result / completion |
| prerequisite | exact non-retired entry；replacement basis differs from stored basis；body-free context passes policy |
| transaction | entry/change/trace/captures/materials/result/completion one UoW |
| Step 10 handoff | every accepted non-retired entry enters`VisibilityPending`;same-state Pending -> Pending is valid only when basis changes |

#### 15.3.2 DTO field sources

| Field | Source | Exact target |
|---|---|---|
| `registry_entry_ref` | body exact ref | registry `get_with_version`;trace/material subject |
| `visibility_basis` | body safe value | no-op comparison；policy validation；`apply_visibility_basis`persisted field |
| `visibility_context` | body safe value | policy-only input；not persisted and cannot make same-basis request a truth change |
| `change_reason` | body `RegistryLifecycleReason` | `to_change_reason()`for record；record reason -> trace/material bridges |
| prior/final state and basis | loaded entry before / accepted entry after member | result copied from object,not caller |
| change/trace/result ids + now | IdGenerator / Clock | exact factories / stored result |
| digest | Step 13 | all four body fields |

#### 15.3.3 Function call graph

```text
[Handler] exact route/name/schema/body -> context
  v
[Registry service]
  | body-local boundary validation + digest
  | tx begin -> reserve
  | completed duplicate -> stored replay;STOP
  v
[Load + guards]
  | registry.get_with_version(exact)
  | require non-Retired
  | replacement basis != stored basis
  | visibility_policy.validate_visibility_basis(entry,basis,context)
  v
[Domain + same UoW]
  | entry.apply_visibility_basis(...,policy,context,...)
  | assert final lifecycle == VisibilityPending
  | registry.save(entry,loaded.expected_version)
  | append VisibilityBasisChanged -> trace -> RegistryChanged capture
  | inline affected-material stale + captures
  | stored result + completion -> commit
  v
[After commit] no exposure evaluation / FormalVisible / runtime-listing mutation
```

#### 15.3.5 Transaction boundary

| Boundary | Rule |
|---|---|
| pre-reserve | missing / malformed / forbidden body shape |
| post-reserve stable guards | exact entry,non-retired,different basis,policy validity |
| accepted atomic set | entry revision、one change/trace/capture、actual stale materials/captures、result/completion |
| no-op | same stored basis never calls member,never increments version,never forms record/capture/material effect |
| post-commit | no formal prerequisite evaluation or collaboration in Command |

#### 15.3.6 Error / rejection mapping

| Branch | Mapping |
|---|---|
| missing fields / invalid context scope | pre-reserve`MissingRequiredField / InvalidScope`when body-local |
| runtime/search/marketplace authority | `BodyForbidden` |
| entry missing/stale/retired；same basis；policy reject | replayable`PolicyRejected` |
| member yields non-Pending or wrong change kind | consistency`ApplicationError`;rollback |
| entry/material/capture version or repository failure | `ApplicationError`;whole rollback |
| completed duplicate | stored original result/effect；does not compare current basis |

#### 15.3.7 State / change / trace / capture / side effects

| Axis | Effect |
|---|---|
| registry basis | replacement body-free basis persisted |
| lifecycle | every accepted non-retired source state ->`VisibilityPending`;Pending may remain Pending with changed basis |
| change / trace | one`VisibilityBasisChanged`record；one registry trace |
| capture / materials | one RegistryChanged；actual stale revisions each availability-captured |
| absent | no FormalVisible、formal exposure、runtime/search/listing truth、reference or impact mutation |

#### 15.3.8 Test cuts

1. Registered/FormalVisible/Undescribed/Ungoverned/Pending entry + different valid basis -> accepted final Pending,exact basis copied。
2. same basis with different context -> stable no-op rejection；entry/member/material/capture calls `0`after guard。
3. retired entry -> stable rejection；no mutation。
4. policy reject for invalid context/basis -> no member/save/material propagation。
5. assert accepted result can never be FormalVisible,regardless of caller context。
6. already-Pending + different basis -> version +1,record previous/next both Pending,valid capture。
7. material conflict -> basis/lifecycle/change/trace all rollback。
8. duplicate replay returns original basis/result even if entry later changed。

#### 15.3.9 Single-flow stop review

| Gate | Result |
|---|---|
| protocol / fields | pass；four exact fields |
| no-op / policy | pass；same basis rejected,context policy-only |
| member / state | pass；`apply_visibility_basis`,final Pending invariant |
| version / transaction / replay | pass |
| owner boundary | pass；FormalVisible and listing/runtime authority excluded |
| unresolved blocker | none |

```rust
    }
    cursor = page.next_cursor;
    if cursor.is_none() { break; }
}
```

No descriptor/seam/relation/exposure repository is injected into this flow for mutation。Their current or historical rows remain readable and become downstream recheck / maintenance concerns through the registry change and stale surfaces。

#### 15.4.5 Transaction boundary

| Boundary | Rule |
|---|---|
| pre-reserve | missing / empty ref/reason rejection |
| post-reserve | exact current entry + legal non-retired state guard |
| accepted atomic set | registry terminal revision、record、trace、registry capture、actual stale materials/captures、result/completion |
| forbidden writes | no identity/descriptor/seam/method/exposure/visibility save or delete |
| rollback | entry/material version conflict or any append/capture/result failure restores non-retired registry state |

#### 15.4.6 Error / rejection mapping

| Branch | Mapping |
|---|---|
| missing ref/reason；caller cascade/delete shape | pre-reserve`MissingRequiredField / InvalidField` |
| entry missing/stale/already retired/illegal current transition | replayable`PolicyRejected` |
| member output not Retired；record/entry mismatch | consistency`ApplicationError`;rollback |
| repository/material/capture/version failure | `ApplicationError`;whole rollback |
| completed duplicate | stored result/effect replay；no entry/material re-read |

#### 15.4.7 State / change / trace / capture / side effects

| Axis | Effect |
|---|---|
| registry | allowed non-retired state -> terminal`Retired`;history retained |
| change / trace | one`Retired`record；one registry trace |
| capture / material | one RegistryChanged；actual stale view/directory/export/discovery revisions each captured |
| identity/dependents | no mutation or deletion；their exact refs/history remain |
| absent | no visibility retirement,exposure retirement,listing delist,runtime disable,reference or impact mutation |

#### 15.4.8 Test cuts

1. each Step 10 allowed non-retired source state -> one terminal entry/record/trace/capture。
2. already retired / stale exact ref / illegal transition -> stored policy rejection。
3. assert identity、descriptor、seam、method、exposure、visibility save/delete call counts `0`。
4. ready/rebuilding/unavailable material transitions to stale；already stale no-op；report never returned by mutable scope。
5. one material/capture failure -> registry remains original state after rollback。
6. duplicate replay does not rerun retirement or infer cascade from current dependent truth。
7. public effect contains only registry subject/change/trace and actual stale refs；no fake dependent change refs。

#### 15.4.9 Single-flow stop review

| Gate | Result |
|---|---|
| protocol / DTO | pass；ref + reason exact |
| member / Port / version | pass；one loaded registry save,existing append/trace/capture/material ports |
| transaction / replay | pass；terminal atomic set,no duplicate rerun |
| non-cascade | pass；dependent owners untouched |
| event / effect | pass；one core record/capture,actual stale only |
| unresolved blocker | none |

#### 17.1.5 Transaction boundary

| Phase | Included | Failure handling |
|---|---|---|
| pre-reserve | route/schema/body shape,digest field selection | no local write |
| fresh reads | identity/registry/source/state/document/current-descriptor checks | stable rejection stored;consistency/technical error rolls back |
| accepted UoW | descriptor;optional registry/document;changes/traces;eligible captures;unioned material stale/captures;stored result;completion | any failure rolls back all local writes |
| duplicate | rollback current reservation UoW then exact stored result get | no truth/ref/material read or capture |
| post-commit | none in this Command | collaboration is handled from stored captures later |

#### 17.1.6 Error / rejection mapping

| Branch | Classification | Effect |
|---|---|---|
| missing/invalid field,forbidden boundary body | `MissingRequiredField / InvalidField / BodyForbidden` | no truth mutation |
| inactive identity,owner/kind mismatch,current descriptor,retired registry,invalid document binding | stable `PolicyRejected` | stored rejection only |
| recoverable unresolved source/document | accepted `Unresolved` | descriptor saved;registry only changes if entering`Undescribed` |
| wrong ref union,state-id/subject mismatch,material index asymmetry | consistency `ApplicationError` | whole rollback |
| expected-version/capture/stored-result failure | persistence/application error | whole rollback |
| completed duplicate | `DuplicateReplayed` | exact stored result;zero fresh calls |

#### 17.1.7 State / change / trace / capture / side effects

| Branch | Exact effect |
|---|---|
| accepted descriptor | descriptor`Draft -> Accepted`;one`Created`;registry descriptor ref + `VisibilityPending` atomically;one`DescriptorBound`;two traces;two core captures |
| unresolved + registry changes | descriptor`Draft -> Unresolved` + `MarkedUnresolved`;registry ->`Undescribed` + `LifecycleChanged` from `Registered / Ungoverned / FormalVisible` when the descriptor establishment flow proves the prerequisite unresolved;two traces / captures |
| unresolved + registry already Undescribed | descriptor only;one change / trace / capture |
| document | accepted branch may update binding with own expected version;no document change record / event is invented |
| materials | descriptor then optional registry scan;typed union;each actual non-stale material becomes stale once and is captured once |
| explicitly absent | no provider runtime、secret body、governance approval、method body、execution、SDK client or marketplace truth |

#### 17.1.8 Test cuts

1. Resolved source/no document -> Accepted descriptor + atomic DescriptorBound/VisibilityPending;exactly two core captures.
2. Resolved source + unbound resolved document -> binding saved with its loaded version;document body never read.
3. Recoverable unresolved source while registry FormalVisible -> Unresolved descriptor + one LifecycleChanged to Undescribed.
4. Recoverable unresolved source while registry already Undescribed -> no registry save/id/record/trace/capture.
5. Current descriptor exists、owner mismatch、retired registry or forbidden boundary -> stable rejection,no ids or material scan after rejection.
6. Completed duplicate -> stored result get once;identity/registry/source/document/current/material reads and writes all zero.
7. Same view and directory indexed by descriptor and registry -> each loads/saves/captures once;first descriptor reason wins;effect refs unique.
8. Duplicate candidate has asymmetric loaded view revision or derived wrong kind -> consistency error and whole rollback.
9. Assert there is no second LifecycleChanged after accepted bind and registry version increases only once.

### 17.2 `command_replace_adapter_descriptor_flow`

#### 17.2.1 Entry and target

| Item | Exact contract |
|---|---|
| protocol | `CapabilityCommandRequest<ReplaceAdapterDescriptorCommand>` -> `CapabilityCommandOutcome<ReplaceAdapterDescriptorResult>` |
| entry / service | `CapabilityCommandHandlers::replace_adapter_descriptor(...)` -> `CapabilityDescriptorCommandService::replace_adapter_descriptor(...)` |
| accepted target | old descriptor terminal Replaced;new distinct descriptor Accepted;registry atomically rebound / VisibilityPending;optional document rebound;three changes / three subject traces / three core captures;actual stale materials |
| read-only prerequisites | exact current descriptor、exact owning registry、exact source/state、optional exact document/state,current-by-entry parity |
| transaction | old save uses old loaded version;new create`None`;registry/document use own loaded versions;one UoW |
| hard guard | replacement must be Accepted before old descriptor or registry mutates;unresolved replacement is stable rejection,not accepted partial replacement |

#### 17.2.2 DTO field sources

| Field | Source | Construction / validation |
|---|---|---|
| current / registry refs | exact DTO refs | both versioned loads;descriptor registry id and current-by-entry id must match |
| source / kind / boundary | body-free DTO | exact source/state;policy + scanner;new descriptor id generated only on fresh accepted attempt |
| optional document | exact local id | resolved;unbound or bound to current;rebind only after old is Replaced and replacement Accepted |
| replacement reason | `DescriptorChangeReason` | one validated `ChangeReason` copied to old/new/registry records |
| result | saved final objects | old/new refs and states,registry ref/final state |

#### 17.2.3 ASCII call graph

```text
handler -> service -> reserve
  -> duplicate:stored replay only
  -> fresh:load old + current-by-entry + registry + source/state + optional document/state
     -> draft new -> require accept success

     -> save old/new/registry/document
     -> append old Replaced,new Created/Accepted,registry DescriptorBound
     -> three subject traces -> three final-symmetric captures

     -> each material stale/capture/save once
     -> stored result + completion -> commit
```

#### 17.4.5 Transaction boundary

| Phase | Included / behavior |
|---|---|
| resolver | external body-free observation after fresh reserve;cannot be rolled back,but no local truth is visible yet |
| accepted UoW | ref/state/summary/descriptor;2 changes;1 trace;3 core captures;material revisions/captures;result/completion |
| duplicate | stored replay only;resolver and all current/material reads zero |
| failure | any local failure rolls back all local writes;resolver response is never persisted raw |

#### 17.4.6 Error / rejection mapping

| Branch | Classification |
|---|---|
| credential/token/ciphertext/key material | `BodyForbidden` |
| terminal descriptor/existing secret relation/invalid scope | stable `PolicyRejected / InvalidScope` |
| resolver unavailable | technical `ApplicationError`;no completed reservation |
| observation subject/kind/digest mismatch | consistency error;rollback |
| Forbidden resolution/marker | `BodyForbidden`;no ref/state/summary |
| descriptor/material version or capture failure | whole rollback |

#### 17.4.7 State / change / trace / capture / side effects

| Axis | Exact effect |
|---|---|
| reference | one body-free Secret ref + canonical state;one reference capture |
| summary | Available for resolved,Unavailable for recoverable unresolved/stale/unavailable;Forbidden never saved |
| descriptor | secret ref id attached;state retained;version +1 |
| history | ordered SecretReferenceChanged,SafeSummaryChanged;one trace;both records explain final descriptor and each gets a capture |
| materials | one descriptor scan driven by terminal SafeSummaryChanged reason;actual non-stale only |
| absent | no secret value、provider policy、rotation state、KMS/Vault lifecycle or exposure activation |

#### 17.4.8 Test cuts

1. Resolved body-free observation -> Available summary,3 core captures,2 ordered change refs.
2. Recoverable unavailable observation -> Unavailable summary but accepted local ref/state;descriptor records remain two.
3. Forbidden marker or secret-looking input -> BodyForbidden,no local object or capture.
4. Observation subject/kind/digest mismatch -> consistency rollback.
5. Existing descriptor secret ref -> stable rejection;resolver count zero.
6. Both descriptor records must pass `explains_descriptor(final)` and each capture exactly once.
7. One ready view + each derived kind -> four stale saves/captures in stable order;already-stale omitted.
8. Second descriptor capture/material save/stored result failure -> ref/state/summary/descriptor/history all absent.
9. Completed duplicate -> stored replay,secret resolver/id generators/material scans all zero.

#### 17.4.9 Single-flow stop review

| Gate | Result |
|---|---|
| secret boundary | pass;only provider ref/safe scope/summary/marker |
| history cardinality | pass;2 descriptor records,1 trace,2 descriptor captures |
| reference symmetry | pass;subject/kind/digest/state id + capture exact |
| material exactness | pass;four concrete repository/capture paths expanded |

| governance ref/state | Register creates both;Existing only saves/captures actual state transition |

```rust
        let subject = ReferenceSubjectRef::GovernanceResult(ref_id.clone());
        let candidate_digest = /* canonical kind+source+scope digest */;
        let candidate = ReferenceCandidate::body_free(
            ReferenceKind::GovernanceResult,
            ReferenceLocatorSummary::from_governance_result(
                &governance_source, &result_scope_summary),
            candidate_digest.clone(),
        );
        if external_ref_repo.find_by_candidate_digest(
            ReferenceKind::GovernanceResult, &candidate_digest).await?.is_some()
        {
            return /* stable duplicate candidate rejection;use Existing */;
        }
        let observed = governance_reference_port.resolve_governance_result_reference(
            subject.clone(), governance_ref_kind.clone(), governance_source.clone(),
            result_scope_summary.clone(), candidate,
        ).await?;
        if observed.resolution.reference_subject != subject
            || observed.resolution.reference_kind != ReferenceKind::GovernanceResult
            || observed.resolution.candidate_digest != candidate_digest
        {
            return Err(/* resolver consistency error */);
        }
        if observed.resolution.resolution_value == ReferenceResolutionValue::Forbidden {
            return /* BodyForbidden;no local ref/state */;
        }
        let state = ReferenceResolutionState::from_initial_resolution(
            state_id.clone(), subject, ReferenceKind::GovernanceResult,
            observed.resolution.resolution_value,
            observed.resolution.resolution_reason,
            context.actor_context.clone(), context.trace_id.clone(),
            &reference_resolution_policy, now,
        )?;
        let governance_ref = GovernanceResultRef::register(
            ref_id, governance_ref_kind, governance_source, result_scope_summary,
            candidate_digest, state_id, now,
        );
        (governance_ref, state, None, true, true, observed.allowed_safe_summary)
    }
    GovernanceResultSelection::Existing { governance_result_ref_id } => {
        let loaded_ref = external_ref_repo
            .get_with_version(ReferenceSubjectRef::GovernanceResult(governance_result_ref_id))
            .await?.ok_or(/* stable PolicyRejected */)?;
        let governance_ref = match loaded_ref.value {
            CapabilityExternalReference::GovernanceResult(value) => value,
            _ => return Err(/* consistency error */),
        };
        let loaded_state = resolution_repo.find_current_by_subject(governance_ref.subject_ref()).await?
            .ok_or(/* consistency error */)?;
        if governance_ref.resolution_state_id != loaded_state.value.resolution_state_id
            || !loaded_state.value.matches_subject(
                &governance_ref.subject_ref(), &ReferenceKind::GovernanceResult)
        {
            return Err(/* consistency error */);
        }
        let candidate = ReferenceCandidate::body_free(
            ReferenceKind::GovernanceResult,
            ReferenceLocatorSummary::from_governance_result(
                &governance_ref.governance_source, &governance_ref.result_scope_summary),
            governance_ref.candidate_digest.clone(),
        );
        let observed = governance_reference_port.resolve_governance_result_reference(
            governance_ref.subject_ref(), governance_ref.governance_ref_kind.clone(),
            governance_ref.governance_source.clone(),
            governance_ref.result_scope_summary.clone(), candidate,
        ).await?;
        if observed.resolution.reference_subject != governance_ref.subject_ref()
            || observed.resolution.reference_kind != ReferenceKind::GovernanceResult
            || observed.resolution.candidate_digest != governance_ref.candidate_digest
        {
            return Err(/* resolver consistency error */);
        }
        if observed.resolution.resolution_value == ReferenceResolutionValue::Forbidden {
            return /* BodyForbidden */;
        }
        let Loaded { value: mut state, expected_version } = loaded_state;
        let changed = state.resolution_value != observed.resolution.resolution_value
            || state.resolution_reason != observed.resolution.resolution_reason;
        if changed {
            state.transition(
                observed.resolution.resolution_value,
                observed.resolution.resolution_reason,
                context.actor_context.clone(), context.trace_id.clone(),
                &reference_resolution_policy, now,
            )?;
        }
        (governance_ref, state, Some(expected_version),
         false, changed, observed.allowed_safe_summary)
    }
};
if !replacement_state.is_resolved()
    || replacement_ref.governance_result_ref_id == loaded_old.value.governance_result_ref_id
```

#### 17.6.5 Transaction boundary

| Phase | Rule |
|---|---|
| replacement observation | external read before old mutation;must resolve Active-capable |
| local UoW | optional ref/state + new/old seams + 2 changes/traces/captures + unioned materials + result/completion |
| rollback | any failure retains old as current and removes all new local artifacts |
| duplicate | exact stored replay;no resolver/new id/current/material reads |

#### 17.6.6 Error / rejection mapping

| Branch | Classification |
|---|---|
| old stale/not current/not replaceable,owner inactive,same endpoint | stable `PolicyRejected` |
| replacement unresolved/expired/forbidden/body-bearing | `PolicyRejected / BodyForbidden` |
| resolver/ref/state parity mismatch | consistency error |
| any new/old/ref/state/material conflict or capture failure | whole rollback |

#### 17.6.7 State / change / trace / capture / side effects

| Axis | Effect |
|---|---|
| new seam | Pending -> Active;Attached;own trace/capture |
| old seam | current -> Replaced;Replaced;own trace/capture |
| reference | Register/new state or Existing actual transition only;reference capture iff actual revision |
| materials | new then old subject collect/union;each material changes once |
| absent | no approval/Policy mutation;identity unchanged;old history retained |

#### 17.6.8 Test cuts

1. Register resolved replacement -> reference revision + new Active + old Replaced.
2. Existing resolved unchanged -> no ref/state save/capture but two seam revisions.
3. Existing re-observe unresolved/expired -> reject before old mutation.
4. Same governance endpoint or new id collision -> stable rejection/rollback.
5. New activation succeeds then old save conflict -> all new/ref/state/history/captures rollback.
6. Record order exactly new Attached then old Replaced;each explains its final relation.
7. Shared material hit by both seams -> one load/save/capture/effect ref,first new reason wins.
8. Completed duplicate -> no resolver,ids,current lookup or material scan.

#### 17.6.9 Single-flow stop review

| Gate | Result |
|---|---|
| replacement-before-old mutation | pass |
| two-subject history/capture | pass;separate traces and captures |
| reference actual-delta rule | pass |
| material union | pass;no read-your-writes |

#### 17.7.5 Transaction boundary

One UoW contains relation/change/trace/capture/material/result/completion. There is no resolver or post-commit governance write. Any failure rolls back expiry;completed duplicate reads only the stored result.

#### 17.7.6 Error / rejection mapping

| Branch | Classification |
|---|---|
| missing/stale/not current/non-Active/already expired | stable `PolicyRejected` |
| implicit request to expire external governance result | `InvalidField / PolicyRejected` |
| version/capture/material consistency failure | application error;whole rollback |
| duplicate same digest | exact stored replay |

#### 17.7.7 State / change / trace / capture / side effects

Active -> Expired only;one `Expired` record explains final seam;one trace and one seam capture. Governance ref/state,identity,registry,exposure and approval truth remain unchanged. Actual affected materials become stale and are captured in stable order.

#### 17.7.8 Test cuts

2. Pending/Unresolved/Forbidden/Expired/Replaced -> stable rejection.
3. Stale exact ref not equal current-by-identity -> rejection.
4. Governance resolver invocation count always zero.
5. Already-stale material no-op;ready material exact save/capture.
6. Material/capture/result failure -> relation remains Active after rollback.
7. Completed duplicate -> stored replay and all relation/material reads zero.

#### 17.7.9 Single-flow stop review

| Gate | Result |
|---|---|
| state/history | pass;Active -> Expired,one final-symmetric record |
| owner boundary | pass;seam only,no governance truth mutation |
| material exactness | pass;four concrete paths |
| replay | pass;stored result only |

### 17.8 `command_attach_capability_method_relation_flow`

#### 17.8.1 Entry and target

| Item | Exact contract |
|---|---|
| protocol | `CapabilityCommandRequest<AttachCapabilityMethodRelationCommand>` -> `CapabilityCommandOutcome<AttachCapabilityMethodRelationResult>` |
| entry / service | `CapabilityCommandHandlers::attach_capability_method_relation(...)` -> `CapabilityRelationCommandService::attach_capability_method_relation(...)` |
| accepted target | one new body-free method relation/change/trace/capture;Register creates method ref/state,Existing may update canonical state only on actual observation delta;actual stale materials |
| prerequisites | exact Active identity;no current active/pending relation;body-free valid relation scope |

| transaction | actual ref/state writes + new relation/history/captures/material/result/completion in one UoW |

#### 17.8.2 DTO field sources

| Field | Source | Construction / validation |
|---|---|---|
| identity ref | exact DTO | versioned load;must be Active |
| Register method asset | body-free kind + locator | generated ref/state ids,candidate/digest,resolver,ref/state factories |
| Existing method asset | exact local ref id | typed ref + linked current state;candidate reconstructed from stored kind/locator/digest for re-observe |
| relation scope | safe DTO | `MethodRelationBoundaryPolicy` and relation factory;never method definition/body |
| change reason | `MethodRelationChangeReason` | `to_change_reason()` once;feeds relation record/material reason |
| result | committed local refs | method ref id,state ref,relation ref/final state |

#### 17.8.3 ASCII call graph

```text
handler -> validate/digest -> begin UoW -> reserve
  -> completed duplicate:rollback -> stored result get -> replay

     -> Register:build candidate -> method resolver -> create ref/state
     -> Existing:load ref/state -> rebuild candidate -> resolver -> optional state transition
     -> reject forbidden/invalid body;create relation Pending
        -> resolved:activate(Attached)
        -> recoverable non-resolved:mark_unresolved
     -> save actual ref/state + relation -> append change -> trace
     -> capture actual state revision if any + relation revision
     -> exact relation subject material propagation
     -> stored result + completion -> commit
```

#### 17.8.5 Transaction boundary

| Phase | Rule |
|---|---|
| resolver | one body-free method reference observation after fresh reserve;external read cannot be rolled back |
| local UoW | actual ref/state revision + relation/change/trace/captures/material/result/completion atomic |
| Existing unchanged | no ref/state write/id/capture/effect state ref |
| duplicate | rollback then explicit`stored_result_repo.get`;no resolver/current/material calls |

#### 17.8.6 Error / rejection mapping

| Branch | Classification |
|---|---|
| inactive identity/current relation/invalid scope | stable `PolicyRejected / InvalidScope` |
| method body/definition/version/source code | `BodyForbidden` |
| Register digest already exists | stable rejection;use Existing |
| observation/ref/state subject-kind-digest mismatch | consistency error;rollback |
| resolver unavailable | technical error;no completed local result |
| relation/state/material conflict or capture failure | whole rollback |

#### 17.8.7 State / change / trace / capture / side effects

| Axis | Exact effect |
|---|---|
| method ref/state | Register creates both;Existing only actual canonical state change |
| relation | Pending -> Active with Attached,or Pending -> Unresolved with MarkedUnresolved |
| history | one relation record,one trace,one relation capture;optional one reference capture |
| materials | one method relation subject;actual non-stale only |
| absent | method asset/body/lifecycle unchanged externally;no Cargo path dependency or execution truth |

#### 17.8.8 Test cuts

1. Register resolved -> body-free ref/state + Active relation + reference/relation captures.
2. Register recoverable unresolved -> Unresolved relation accepted;explicit canonical state retained.
3. Existing resolved unchanged -> no state save/capture/effect state ref.
4. Existing re-observe Stale -> Resolved -> state own version save/capture + Active relation.
5. Existing wrong union/state id/digest or resolver mismatch -> consistency rollback.
6. Method body-like candidate -> BodyForbidden,repository body remains absent.
7. Current relation exists -> resolver/id generation zero.
8. Exact four material categories;already-stale no-op and capture failure rollback.
9. Completed duplicate -> explicit stored result get only.

#### 17.8.9 Single-flow stop review

| Gate | Result |
|---|---|
| method owner boundary | pass;body-free ref/scope only |
| Existing re-observe | pass;stored locator/digest,actual-state-delta-only |
| history/capture | pass;one final-symmetric relation record |
| material exactness | pass;all exact get/save/capture paths named |

One UoW contains relation/change/trace/capture/material/result/completion. There is no resolver、method-library call or reference mutation. Any accepted-effect failure rolls back removal;duplicate explicitly retrieves only the stored result.

| retained | method ref/state and external method asset remain unchanged/history-readable |
| absent | no method body delete、execution、governance、registry or exposure direct mutation |

7. Completed duplicate -> explicit stored result get;relation/material reads zero.
8. Reattach after remove is not this flow;must create a new relation through Attach.

All nine flows are independently implementable. No flow relies on a generic descriptor/relation command dispatcher、generic material loader、generic reference decoder or another flow's hidden helper. Shared contracts remain structural rules only;each flow names its exact Step 6 object calls、Step 7 repositories / resolver、Step 8 DTO / capture、transaction members、errors and test cuts.

### 18.2 Change / trace / capture quantity audit

| Flow | Canonical accepted changes | Trace revisions | Change-derived captures | Reference captures |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Establish Adapter Descriptor,Accepted branch | 2:descriptor + registry | 2 | 2 | 0 |
| Replace Adapter Descriptor | 3:old + new + registry | 3 | 3 | 0 |
| Record Risk Summary | 1 | 1 | 1 | 0 |
| Attach Secret Reference | 2:secret-ref + safe-summary descriptor records | 1 | 2 | 1 fixed new secret state |
| Attach Governance Seam | 1 | 1 | 1 | 0 or 1:only Register / actual Existing state transition |
| Replace Governance Seam | 2:new + old | 2 | 2 | 0 or 1:only Register / actual Existing state transition |
| Expire Governance Seam | 1 | 1 | 1 | 0 |
| Attach Method Relation | 1 | 1 | 1 | 0 or 1:only Register / actual Existing state transition |
| Remove Method Relation | 1 | 1 | 1 | 0 |
| primary accepted total | 14 | 13 | 14 | 1 fixed + 0~3 branch-dependent |

Establish unresolved remains an explicit accepted degraded branch:it always has one descriptor `MarkedUnresolved`;if registry must enter`Undescribed`,it also has one registry `LifecycleChanged`;if registry is already`Undescribed`,that second change / trace / capture is absent. Material capture count is intentionally not fixed:each actual view revision has one`ControlledConsumerViewAvailabilityChanged`;each actual directory / audit-export / ecosystem stale revision has one`DerivedMaterialRefreshed`;already-stale items contribute zero.

Every change-derived capture requires its append-only record to explain the final persisted subject revision. Secret attachment's two same-state descriptor records both explain the final descriptor and each owns one capture. Old/new descriptor and old/new seam replacements are separate subjects with separate trace and capture. No transaction-local intermediate record is published as committed final truth.

| Existing re-observe | pass | exact union/id/digest/state-id parity;state saved/captured only on actual transition;stored ref fields remain read-only |

### 19.1 `command_establish_formal_exposure_boundary_flow`

#### 19.1.1 Entry and target

| Item | Exact contract |
|---|---|
| protocol | `CapabilityCommandRequest<EstablishFormalExposureBoundaryCommand>` -> `CapabilityCommandOutcome<EstablishFormalExposureBoundaryResult>` |
| entry / service | `CapabilityCommandHandlers::establish_formal_exposure_boundary(...)` -> `CapabilityExposureCommandService::establish_formal_exposure_boundary(...)` |
| accepted target | one new exposure + one new visibility fact;zero or one actual registry transition;append-only exposure / optional registry history;one trace per changed subject;eligible captures;actual stale materials;stored result / completion |
| transaction | exposure and visibility create use expected `None`;registry save uses its own loaded expected version only when changed;all local accepted effects share one UoW |
| non-effect | no runtime/tools invocation、SDK publication、marketplace listing、governance approval or method body is created;external references remain read-only |

#### 19.1.2 DTO field sources

| Field | Source | Validation / use |
|---|---|---|
| registry / descriptor / seam refs | exact DTO refs | load current exact objects plus registry-linked current identity;identity Active、registry non-retired、descriptor Accepted、seam Active and all owner ids match |
| optional method relation ref | DTO `Option` | `Some` exact current active body-free relation for the same identity;required-by-policy absence is stable rejection |
| applicability scope / basis | typed non-empty consumer set + body-free basis | stable order / duplicate-free；RuntimeTools / SDK members require exact registered ref + canonical state,Ecosystem remains typed body-free context；membership never parses text；consumer cache、runtime allowlist、SDK client、search or listing source is forbidden |
| change reason | caller safe reason | copied into every accepted exposure / registry member call;trace and material reasons derive from persisted records |
| actor / trace / time / ids | operation context、Clock、IdGenerator | body cannot override;all records / traces / captures use the same operation metadata |

#### 19.1.3 ASCII call graph

```text
handler -> envelope/name/schema validation -> context + canonical digest
  -> begin UoW -> reserve_if_absent
     -> completed duplicate: rollback -> stored_result_repo.get -> exact replay
     -> fresh: load registry-linked Active identity + registry + descriptor + seam
               + optional method + exact prerequisite/scope canonical states
        -> reject current exposure / owner mismatch / forbidden prerequisite
        -> draft exposure -> policy readiness -> pending OR accept(identity,...)
        -> derive visibility from complete policy inputs -> if Visible activate exposure
           -> reevaluate visibility against final exposure;save only final fact
        -> derive registry target -> transition only on actual delta
        -> save exposure + visibility + optional registry
        -> append all exposure changes + optional registry change
        -> one trace per changed subject -> final-symmetric captures
        -> collect exposure then optional registry affected candidates
           -> typed union -> exact load/mark/capture/save each eligible material once
        -> store accepted response -> complete reservation with returned expected version
        -> commit
```

#### 19.1.5 Transaction boundary

The accepted UoW contains exposure、final visibility、optional actual registry delta、all history、one trace per changed subject、eligible final-symmetric captures、all actual material stale revisions、stored result and idempotency completion. Resolver calls are absent:prerequisite references are loaded locally. Any owner mismatch、capture failure、material conflict、result failure or completion conflict rolls back the entire local acceptance.

#### 19.1.6 Error / rejection mapping

| Branch | Classification |
|---|---|
| missing/stale exact owner、non-Active registry identity、duplicate current exposure、retired registry、terminal prerequisite or illegal transition | stable `PolicyRejected` |
| forbidden basis / external body / approval or method body substitution | `BodyForbidden` |
| recoverable unresolved prerequisite | accepted explicit pending/non-visible result,not fake active |
| visibility source version differs from final exposure | consistency error;whole rollback |
| repository expected-version、capture/material/result/completion failure | application error;whole rollback |
| completed duplicate | `DuplicateReplayed`;stored result only,zero prerequisite/material/domain writes |

#### 19.1.7 State / change / trace / capture / side effects

| Axis | Exact effect |
|---|---|
| exposure / visibility | draft -> Pending or Accepted;Visible may produce Accepted -> Active;one final source-version-symmetric visibility fact |
| registry | target FormalVisible or VisibilityPending;actual-delta-only |
| history / trace | all exposure member records in one exposure trace;optional one registry record / trace |
| event eligibility | only exposure records explaining final persisted exposure are captured;optional actual registry record captured |
| materials | exposure subject then optional registry subject,collect-before-mutate typed union;actual non-stale only |
| absent | no reference mutation、execution、SDK publication、listing or governance approval |

#### 19.1.8 Test cuts

1. Complete prerequisites + policy Visible -> Active exposure、final visibility source version equals final exposure version、registry FormalVisible only if actual delta.
2. Recoverable incomplete prerequisite -> explicit Pending/non-visible result;no activation.
3. Registry already at derived target -> registry save/record/trace/capture/material scan count zero.
4. Existing current exposure、non-Active identity or cross-owner descriptor/seam/method -> stable rejection before ids/history/material mutation.
5. Activation path saves visibility exactly once even though final in-memory reevaluation occurs.
6. Multiple exposure records append in member order;trace covers all;capture only final-symmetric sources.
7. Exposure + registry material candidates are collected before mutation,unioned once,and use first canonical subject reason.
8. Already-stale material and immutable report produce no effect ref/capture/save;material capture failure rolls back core truth.
9. Empty/duplicate applicability scope or missing/wrong RuntimeTools / SDK ref-state member rejects；Ecosystem exact typed context requires no repository text lookup.
10. Completed duplicate executes explicit `stored_result_repo.get(&result_ref)` and no prerequisite/material read or id generation after replay branch.

#### 19.1.9 Single-flow stop review

| Gate | Result |
|---|---|
| owner / authority | pass;Active identity + exact owner chain + typed scope,server exposure only,no runtime/SDK/listing rewrite |
| exposure / visibility symmetry | pass;post-activation reevaluation and one final save |
| registry delta | pass;same-state has no synthetic history/effect |
| replay / material / capture | pass;fresh expected version and exact multi-subject paths named |

Flow status: `completed_in_batch_9_3`。

### 19.2 `command_update_formal_visibility_applicability_flow`

#### 19.2.1 Entry and target

| Item | Exact contract |
|---|---|
| protocol | `CapabilityCommandRequest<UpdateFormalVisibilityApplicabilityCommand>` -> `CapabilityCommandOutcome<UpdateFormalVisibilityApplicabilityResult>` |
| entry / service | `CapabilityCommandHandlers::update_formal_visibility_applicability(...)` -> `CapabilityExposureCommandService::update_formal_visibility_applicability(...)` |
| accepted target | one current visibility revision;zero or more real exposure lifecycle records plus one direct applicability record;zero or one actual registry transition;traces/captures/materials/result/completion |
| transaction | visibility save always uses its own loaded expected version;exposure and registry save only on actual member mutation,using their own loaded versions |
| non-effect | caller intent never selects `Visible`;the flow does not mutate prerequisite refs、consumer views as truth、runtime authority or SDK/client state |

#### 19.2.2 DTO field sources

| Field | Source | Validation / use |
|---|---|---|
| exposure / registry refs | exact DTO pair | both current;exposure owner id equals registry id;registry-linked identity must exist andmatch owner（non-Active becomes readiness=false）；visibility must be non-retired、same exposure andsource-version-symmetric before any mutation |
| `Reevaluate` scope / basis | typed non-empty consumer set + body-free basis | reload exact prerequisites andvalidateevery typed member；policy insidevisibility derives target;forbidden source cannot become basis |
| `MarkPending` reason | typed safe pending reason | passed tovisibility andconverted through`to_change_reason()`for thedirect applicability record;does not force lifecycle target |
| change reason | caller safe reason | actual exposure lifecycle / registry records use copies；Reevaluate direct applicability record uses this reason |
| metadata | envelope -> operation context | actor / trace / time / idempotency are not accepted from the body |

#### 19.2.3 ASCII call graph

```text
handler -> validate/digest -> begin UoW -> reserve
  -> completed duplicate:rollback -> stored_result_repo.get -> replay
  -> fresh:load exact exposure + source-symmetric visibility + registry + Active identity
     -> Reevaluate:load prerequisite refs/states + validate typed scope members
          -> normalize:complete Pending/Unavailable accept;
                       incomplete Accepted/Active/Suspended unavailable
          -> visibility.reevaluate(policy-only target) -> if Visible Accepted/Suspended activate
          -> post-activation final visibility.reevaluate;one visibility save
     -> MarkPending:actual exposure pending/unavailable mutation when required
          -> visibility.mark_pending(final exposure version)
     -> append direct VisibilityApplicabilityChanged after lifecycle records
     -> derive registry target -> actual-delta-only mutation
     -> save actual truths -> append records -> per-subject trace -> captures
     -> exposure then optional registry material collect/typed-union/process
     -> store result -> complete using fresh persisted expected version -> commit
```

```rust
        let stored = stored_result_repo.get(&result_ref).await?
            .ok_or(/* Step 12 consistency error */)?;
        return /* exact typed DuplicateReplayed outcome */;
    }
    CapabilityIdempotencyReserveResult::Existing(_) => {
        uow_manager.rollback(tx).await?;
        return /* stable stored rejection or conflict */;
    }
    CapabilityIdempotencyReserveResult::Reserved(loaded) => loaded,
};

let loaded_exposure = exposure_repo.get_with_version(command.exposure_ref.clone()).await?
    .ok_or(/* stable PolicyRejected completion */)?;
let loaded_visibility = visibility_repo
    .find_current_by_exposure(loaded_exposure.value.formal_exposure_id.clone()).await?
    .ok_or(/* consistency rejection completion */)?;
let loaded_registry = registry_repo.get_with_version(command.registry_entry_ref.clone()).await?
    .ok_or(/* stable PolicyRejected completion */)?;
if loaded_exposure.value.registry_entry_id != loaded_registry.value.registry_entry_id
    || loaded_visibility.value.formal_exposure_id != loaded_exposure.value.formal_exposure_id
    || loaded_visibility.value.source_exposure_version != loaded_exposure.value.version
    || loaded_visibility.value.visibility_state == FormalVisibilityState::Retired
    || loaded_exposure.value.exposure_state == FormalExposureState::Draft
    || loaded_exposure.value.exposure_state == FormalExposureState::Retired
{
    return /* stable rejection completion */;
}
let loaded_identity = identity_repo
    .find_by_id(loaded_registry.value.capability_identity_id.clone()).await?
    .ok_or(/* owner-chain consistency rejection */)?;
if loaded_identity.value.capability_identity_id
    != loaded_registry.value.capability_identity_id
{
    return /* stable owner contradiction rejection */;
}

let policy = FormalExposurePolicy::default_for_formal_exposure();
let mut exposure = loaded_exposure.value;
let mut visibility = loaded_visibility.value;
let mut exposure_was_mutated = false;
let mut lifecycle_records = Vec::<CapabilityExposureChangeRecord>::new();
let applicability_reason;
match command.intent {
    FormalVisibilityUpdateIntent::Reevaluate { applicability_scope, basis_summary } => {
        let loaded_descriptor = descriptor_repo
            .get_with_version(exposure.descriptor_ref.clone()).await?
            .ok_or(/* consistency rejection */)?;
        let loaded_seam = governance_seam_repo
            .get_with_version(exposure.governance_seam_ref.clone()).await?
            .ok_or(/* consistency rejection */)?;
        let loaded_method = match exposure.method_relation_ref.clone() {
            Some(method_ref) => Some(method_relation_repo.get_with_version(method_ref).await?
                .ok_or(/* consistency rejection */)?),
            None => None,
        };
        /* Load and verify every prerequisite canonical reference state and each typed
           applicability member. RuntimeTools / Sdk require exact registered ref/state
           parity;Ecosystem remains a typed body-free context. No text parsing or resolver. */
        let prerequisites_complete = policy.prerequisites_are_complete(
            &exposure,
            &loaded_identity.value,
            &loaded_registry.value,
            &loaded_descriptor.value,
            &loaded_seam.value,
            loaded_method.as_ref().map(|loaded| &loaded.value),
        )?;
        if prerequisites_complete
            && matches!(exposure.exposure_state,
                FormalExposureState::Pending | FormalExposureState::Unavailable)
        {
            lifecycle_records.push(exposure.accept(
                ids.new_exposure_change_record_id(),
                &loaded_identity.value,
                &loaded_registry.value,
                &loaded_descriptor.value,
                &loaded_seam.value,
                loaded_method.as_ref().map(|loaded| &loaded.value),
                &policy,
                command.change_reason.copy_validated(),
                &context.actor_context,
                context.trace_id.clone(),
                now,
            )?);
            exposure_was_mutated = true;
        } else if !prerequisites_complete
            && matches!(exposure.exposure_state,
                FormalExposureState::Accepted
                | FormalExposureState::Active
                | FormalExposureState::Suspended)
        {
            lifecycle_records.push(exposure.mark_unavailable(
                ids.new_exposure_change_record_id(),
                &context.actor_context,
                command.change_reason.copy_validated(),
                context.trace_id.clone(),
                now,
            )?);
            exposure_was_mutated = true;
        }
        visibility.reevaluate(
            &exposure,
            &loaded_identity.value,
            &loaded_registry.value,
            &loaded_descriptor.value,
            &loaded_seam.value,
            loaded_method.as_ref().map(|loaded| &loaded.value),
            applicability_scope.clone(),
            basis_summary.clone(),
            &policy,
            now,
        )?;
        if visibility.visibility_state == FormalVisibilityState::Visible
            && matches!(exposure.exposure_state,
                FormalExposureState::Accepted | FormalExposureState::Suspended)
        {
            lifecycle_records.push(exposure.activate(
                ids.new_exposure_change_record_id(),
                &visibility,
                command.change_reason.copy_validated(),
                &context.actor_context,
                context.trace_id.clone(),
                now,
            )?);
            exposure_was_mutated = true;
            visibility.reevaluate(
                &exposure,
                &loaded_identity.value,
                &loaded_registry.value,
                &loaded_descriptor.value,
                &loaded_seam.value,
                loaded_method.as_ref().map(|loaded| &loaded.value),
                applicability_scope,
                basis_summary,
                &policy,
                now,
            )?; // only this final source-version-symmetric revision is saved
        }
        applicability_reason = command.change_reason.copy_validated();
    }
    FormalVisibilityUpdateIntent::MarkPending { pending_reason } => {
        match exposure.exposure_state {
            FormalExposureState::Unavailable => {
                lifecycle_records.push(exposure.mark_pending(
                    ids.new_exposure_change_record_id(),
                    &context.actor_context,
                    command.change_reason.copy_validated(),
                    context.trace_id.clone(),
                    now,
                )?);
                exposure_was_mutated = true;
            }
            FormalExposureState::Active => {
                lifecycle_records.push(exposure.mark_unavailable(
                    ids.new_exposure_change_record_id(),
                    &context.actor_context,
                    command.change_reason.copy_validated(),
                    context.trace_id.clone(),
                    now,
                )?);
                exposure_was_mutated = true;
            }
            FormalExposureState::Pending
            | FormalExposureState::Accepted
            | FormalExposureState::Suspended => {}
            FormalExposureState::Draft | FormalExposureState::Retired =>
                return /* stable rejection completion */,
        }
        applicability_reason = pending_reason.to_change_reason();
        visibility.mark_pending(pending_reason, exposure.version, now)?;
    }
}
if visibility.source_exposure_version != exposure.version {
    return /* consistency error;rollback */;
}
let applicability_record = CapabilityExposureChangeRecord::append(
    ids.new_exposure_change_record_id(),
    exposure.formal_exposure_id.clone(),
    ExposureChangeKind::VisibilityApplicabilityChanged,
    Some(exposure.exposure_state.clone()),
    exposure.exposure_state.clone(),
    applicability_reason,
    context.actor_context.clone(),
    context.trace_id.clone(),
    now,
)?;
let mut exposure_records = lifecycle_records;
exposure_records.push(applicability_record);

let registry_target = if exposure.exposure_state == FormalExposureState::Active
    && visibility.visibility_state == FormalVisibilityState::Visible
{
    RegistryLifecycleState::FormalVisible
} else {
    RegistryLifecycleState::VisibilityPending
};
let mut registry = loaded_registry.value;
let registry_record = if registry.lifecycle_state != registry_target {
    Some(registry.transition_lifecycle(
        ids.new_registry_change_record_id(), registry_target,
        command.change_reason.copy_validated(), &context.actor_context,
        context.trace_id.clone(), now,
    )?)
} else { None };

let exposure_ref = if exposure_was_mutated {
    exposure_repo.save(
        exposure.clone(), Some(loaded_exposure.expected_version), tx.as_ref()).await?
} else {
    FormalExposureBoundaryRef::exact(
        exposure.formal_exposure_id.clone(), exposure.version)
};
let visibility_id = visibility_repo.save(
    visibility.clone(), Some(loaded_visibility.expected_version), tx.as_ref()).await?;
if registry_record.is_some() {
    registry_repo.save(
        registry.clone(), Some(loaded_registry.expected_version), tx.as_ref()).await?;
}

let mut exposure_change_refs = Vec::new();
for record in &exposure_records {
    exposure_change_refs.push(change_repo
        .append_exposure_change(record.clone(), tx.as_ref()).await?);
}
let registry_change_ref = match registry_record.as_ref() {
    Some(record) => Some(change_repo.append_registry_change(record.clone(), tx.as_ref()).await?),
    None => None,
};
let exposure_subject = CapabilityTraceSubjectRef::FormalExposure(
    exposure.formal_exposure_id.clone());
let exposure_trace_ref = trace_repo.append_revision(
    CapabilityAccessTraceabilityRecord::record_for_changes(
        ids.new_traceability_record_id(), exposure_subject.clone(),
        CapabilityChangeRecordRefSet::try_from_values(exposure_change_refs.clone())?,
        exposure_records.last().unwrap().change_reason.to_traceability_reason(), None,
        context.actor_context.clone(), context.trace_id.clone(), now,
    )?, None, tx.as_ref()).await?;
let registry_subject = CapabilityTraceSubjectRef::RegistryEntry(
    registry.registry_entry_id.clone());
let registry_trace_ref = match (&registry_record, &registry_change_ref) {
    (Some(record), Some(change_ref)) => Some(trace_repo.append_revision(
        CapabilityAccessTraceabilityRecord::record_for_changes(
            ids.new_traceability_record_id(), registry_subject.clone(),
            CapabilityChangeRecordRefSet::try_from_values(vec![change_ref.clone()])?,
            record.change_reason.to_traceability_reason(), None,
            context.actor_context.clone(), context.trace_id.clone(), now,
        )?, None, tx.as_ref()).await?),
    _ => None,
};
for record in exposure_records.iter().filter(|record| record.explains_exposure(&exposure)) {
    outbound_capture_service.capture_formal_exposure_boundary_changed(
        &context, record, &exposure, tx.as_ref()).await?;
}
if let Some(record) = registry_record.as_ref() {
    outbound_capture_service.capture_capability_registry_changed(
        &context, record, &registry, tx.as_ref()).await?;
}

let terminal_exposure_reason = &exposure_records.last().unwrap().change_reason;
let mut affected_material_refs = Vec::new();
/* Collect list_affected_by_truth + MutableAffectedByTruth candidates for
   exposure_subject first and registry_subject only on actual registry delta.
   Union before mutation by typed DerivedMaterialRef;the direct applicability record is
   the terminal exposure reason. Process View/Directory/Audit/Ecosystem with exact current
   Loaded expected versions and corresponding capture methods;already stale is no-op,
   reconciliation report/wrong index/missing/conflict rolls back. */

let mut changed_subject_refs = vec![exposure_subject];
let mut change_record_refs = exposure_change_refs;
let mut traceability_refs = vec![exposure_trace_ref];
if let Some(change_ref) = registry_change_ref {
    changed_subject_refs.push(registry_subject);
    change_record_refs.push(change_ref);
}
if let Some(trace_ref) = registry_trace_ref { traceability_refs.push(trace_ref); }
let application_result_ref = CapabilityApplicationResultRef {
    operation_name: context.operation_name.clone(),
    result_id: ids.new_application_result_id(),
};
let accepted_response = CapabilityCommandResponse {
    command_name: /* exact closed UpdateFormalVisibilityApplicability name */,
    result_ref: application_result_ref.clone(),
    disposition: CapabilityCommandProtocolDisposition::Accepted,
    result: UpdateFormalVisibilityApplicabilityResult {
        exposure_ref,
        exposure_state: exposure.exposure_state,
        visibility_applicability_id: visibility_id,
        visibility_state: visibility.visibility_state,
        registry_lifecycle_state: registry.lifecycle_state,
    },
    effect: CapabilityCommandEffectSummary {
        changed_subject_refs,
        changed_reference_subject_refs: vec![],
        change_record_refs,
        traceability_refs,
        reference_state_refs: vec![],
        impact_ref: None,
        affected_material_refs,
        outbound_event_names: /* FormalExposureBoundaryChanged;
            optional CapabilityRegistryChanged;actual material names,stable unique */,
    },
};
let result_ref = accepted_response.result_ref.clone();
let stored_surface: CapabilityStoredResultSurface =
    /* serialize exact accepted_response once */;
let shell = StoredCapabilityOperationResult::from_surface(
    result_ref.clone(), StoredCapabilityResultKind::CommandResult,
    StoredCapabilityResultDisposition::Command(CapabilityCommandDisposition::Accepted),
    stored_surface.surface_ref.clone(), stored_surface.surface_digest.clone(),
    context.trace_id.clone(), now,
)?;
stored_result_repo.save(shell, stored_surface, tx.as_ref()).await?;
loaded_reservation.value.complete(result_ref, now)?;
idempotency_repo.save(
    loaded_reservation.value, loaded_reservation.expected_version, tx.as_ref()).await?;
uow_manager.commit(tx).await?;
Ok(CapabilityCommandOutcome::Accepted(accepted_response))
```

#### 19.2.5 Transaction boundary

One UoW contains the final visibility revision、only actual exposure / registry truth mutations、all append-only records、one trace per changed subject、eligible captures、actual material stale revisions、stored result and completion. Prerequisite repositories are read-only. No pre-activation visibility revision is persisted,and no same-state registry write is admitted.

#### 19.2.6 Error / rejection mapping

| Branch | Classification |
|---|---|
| missing/Retired/pre-mutation source-asymmetric visibility、Draft/retired/stale exposure、missing/cross-owner identity、owner mismatch、illegal intent/state | stable `PolicyRejected` / consistency rejection；same-owner non-Active identity enters readiness=false degradation |
| forbidden basis or body-bearing authority input | `BodyForbidden` |
| source exposure version mismatch after final mutation | consistency error;whole rollback |
| expected-version/capture/material/result/completion conflict | application error;whole rollback |
| completed duplicate | `DuplicateReplayed`;stored shell/surface only |

#### 19.2.7 State / change / trace / capture / side effects

| Axis | Exact effect |
|---|---|
| visibility | exactly one persisted current revision per fresh acceptance；target comes only from policy withtyped scope membership |
| exposure | complete Pending/Unavailable recovery、incomplete Accepted/Active/Suspended degradation、activation or explicit pending member mutations only |
| history | lifecycle records in call order,then one direct `VisibilityApplicabilityChanged` final-symmetric record；Reevaluate uses change reason,MarkPending uses typed pending reason bridge |
| registry | derived target,actual-delta-only |
| materials | exposure always scanned;registry only if changed;collect-before-mutate typed union |
| absent | no external resolver/handoff、runtime decision、consumer view truth rewrite or SDK state |

#### 19.2.8 Test cuts

1. Pending exposure + recovered prerequisites + Visible -> accept/activate,final visibility version marker equals final exposure version.
2. Incomplete Accepted / Active / Suspended（including same-owner non-Active identity）-> exposure unavailable before policy target derivation;none can reach activation.
3. MarkPending on Active -> one unavailable lifecycle record + one direct applicability record;visibility Pending.
4. MarkPending on already Pending/Accepted/Suspended -> exposure save zero;direct applicability record uses`pending_reason.to_change_reason()`,notgeneric change reason.
5. Registry already at derived target -> no registry write/history/trace/capture/material subject.
6. Direct applicability record is last and supplies exposure material reason;all exposure history refs remain in one trace.
7. Only final-symmetric exposure records form captures;capture failure rolls back visibility and any lifecycle change.
8. Multi-subject material duplicate appears once and uses its own expected version.
9. Empty/duplicate scope or missing/wrong RuntimeTools / SDK ref-state member rejects without parsing text or writing visibility.
10. Completed duplicate retrieves stored result explicitly and performs no prerequisite reevaluation or material scan.

#### 19.2.9 Single-flow stop review

| Gate | Result |
|---|---|
| caller target authority | pass;typed scope + complete prerequisites enter visibility member,policy alone derives target |
| source-version symmetry | pass;all final exposure mutations precede final visibility marker |
| direct history | pass;one mandatory final-symmetric applicability record |
| registry/replay/material | pass;actual-delta and exact stored/loaded versions |

Flow status: `completed_in_batch_9_3`。

### 19.3 `command_suspend_formal_exposure_boundary_flow`

#### 19.3.1 Entry and target

| Item | Exact contract |
|---|---|
| protocol | `CapabilityCommandRequest<SuspendFormalExposureBoundaryCommand>` -> `CapabilityCommandOutcome<SuspendFormalExposureBoundaryResult>` |
| entry / service | `CapabilityCommandHandlers::suspend_formal_exposure_boundary(...)` -> `CapabilityExposureCommandService::suspend_formal_exposure_boundary(...)` |
| accepted target | Active exposure -> Suspended;current visibility -> Unavailable;registry -> VisibilityPending only on actual delta;history/traces/captures/materials/result/completion |
| transaction | exposure and visibility use their own loaded expected versions;optional registry uses its own version;all accepted effects are atomic |
| non-effect | no consumer/runtime signal can invoke the domain mutation;registry is not retired and prerequisites/references are not changed |

#### 19.3.2 DTO field sources

| Field | Source | Validation / use |
|---|---|---|
| exposure / registry refs | exact DTO pair | exposure must be exact current Active;registry owner must match and be non-retired;current visibility must beVisible、same exposure andsource-version-symmetric before suspension |
| suspension reason | caller safe `ChangeReason` | copied to exposure suspension、visibility unavailable and optional registry pending transition |
| actor / trace / time | operation context / Clock | same metadata across record、trace and capture;not body-overridable |

#### 19.3.3 ASCII call graph

```text
handler -> validate/digest -> begin UoW -> reserve
  -> completed duplicate:rollback -> stored_result_repo.get -> replay
  -> fresh:load exact Active exposure + symmetric Visible fact + owner registry
     -> exposure.suspend -> visibility.mark_unavailable(final exposure version)
     -> registry transition only when current != VisibilityPending
     -> save exposure + visibility + optional registry
     -> append suspension + optional registry record
     -> one trace per changed subject -> captures
     -> collect exposure then optional registry affected materials -> typed union/process
     -> store accepted response -> complete with fresh expected version -> commit
```

#### 19.3.5 Transaction boundary

Exposure suspension、visibility unavailability、optional registry delta、history、traces、captures、actual material stale revisions、stored result and completion commit or roll back together. The flow performs no external handoff、resolver or event collaboration call.

#### 19.3.6 Error / rejection mapping

| Branch | Classification |
|---|---|

| completed duplicate | `DuplicateReplayed`;stored result only |

### 19.4 `command_retire_formal_exposure_boundary_flow`

#### 19.4.1 Entry and target
