let digest = /* Step 13 exact pair + typed retirement reason digest */;
let now = clock.now();
let reservation = CapabilityIdempotencyRecord::reserve(&context, digest.clone(), now)?;
let tx = uow_manager.begin().await?;
let loaded_reservation = match idempotency_repo.reserve_if_absent(reservation, tx.as_ref()).await? {
    CapabilityIdempotencyReserveResult::Existing(existing)
        if existing.value.matches(&context.channel, &context.operation_name, &digest)
            && existing.value.state == CapabilityIdempotencyState::Completed => {
        let result_ref = existing.value.completed_result_ref()?.clone();
        uow_manager.rollback(tx).await?;
        let stored = stored_result_repo.get(&result_ref).await?
            .ok_or(/* Step 12 consistency error */)?;
        return /* exact typed DuplicateReplayed outcome */;
    }
    CapabilityIdempotencyReserveResult::Existing(_) => {
        uow_manager.rollback(tx).await?;
        return /* stable stored rejection/conflict */;
    }
    CapabilityIdempotencyReserveResult::Reserved(loaded) => loaded,
};

let loaded_exposure = exposure_repo.get_with_version(command.exposure_ref.clone()).await?
    .ok_or(/* stable PolicyRejected completion */)?;
let loaded_visibility = visibility_repo
    .find_current_by_exposure(loaded_exposure.value.formal_exposure_id.clone()).await?
    .ok_or(/* consistency rejection completion */)?;
let loaded_registry = registry_repo.get_with_version(command.registry_entry_ref.clone()).await?
    .ok_or(/* stable PolicyRejected completion */)?;
if matches!(loaded_exposure.value.exposure_state,
        FormalExposureState::Draft | FormalExposureState::Retired)
    || loaded_exposure.value.registry_entry_id != loaded_registry.value.registry_entry_id
    || loaded_visibility.value.formal_exposure_id != loaded_exposure.value.formal_exposure_id
    || loaded_visibility.value.visibility_state == FormalVisibilityState::Retired
    || loaded_visibility.value.source_exposure_version != loaded_exposure.value.version
{
    return /* stable PolicyRejected completion */;
}

let previous_state = loaded_exposure.value.exposure_state.clone();
let change_reason = command.retirement_reason.to_change_reason();
let mut exposure = loaded_exposure.value;
let exposure_record = exposure.retire(
    ids.new_exposure_change_record_id(),
    &context.actor_context,
    change_reason.copy_validated(),
    context.trace_id.clone(),
    now,
)?;
let mut visibility = loaded_visibility.value;
visibility.retire(command.retirement_reason, exposure.version, now)?;
if visibility.source_exposure_version != exposure.version {
    return /* consistency error;rollback */;
}
let mut registry = loaded_registry.value;
let registry_record = if registry.lifecycle_state != RegistryLifecycleState::Retired
    && registry.lifecycle_state != RegistryLifecycleState::VisibilityPending
{
    Some(registry.transition_lifecycle(
        ids.new_registry_change_record_id(), RegistryLifecycleState::VisibilityPending,
        change_reason.copy_validated(), &context.actor_context,
        context.trace_id.clone(), now,
    )?)
} else { None };

let exposure_ref = exposure_repo.save(
    exposure.clone(), Some(loaded_exposure.expected_version), tx.as_ref()).await?;
let visibility_id = visibility_repo.save(
    visibility.clone(), Some(loaded_visibility.expected_version), tx.as_ref()).await?;
if registry_record.is_some() {
    registry_repo.save(
        registry.clone(), Some(loaded_registry.expected_version), tx.as_ref()).await?;
}
let exposure_change_ref = change_repo
    .append_exposure_change(exposure_record.clone(), tx.as_ref()).await?;
let registry_change_ref = match registry_record.as_ref() {
    Some(record) => Some(change_repo.append_registry_change(record.clone(), tx.as_ref()).await?),
    None => None,
};
let exposure_subject = CapabilityTraceSubjectRef::FormalExposure(
    exposure.formal_exposure_id.clone());
let exposure_trace_ref = trace_repo.append_revision(
    CapabilityAccessTraceabilityRecord::record_for_changes(
        ids.new_traceability_record_id(), exposure_subject.clone(),
        CapabilityChangeRecordRefSet::try_from_values(vec![exposure_change_ref.clone()])?,
        exposure_record.change_reason.to_traceability_reason(), None,
        context.actor_context.clone(), context.trace_id.clone(), now,
    )?, None, tx.as_ref()).await?;
let registry_subject = CapabilityTraceSubjectRef::RegistryEntry(
    registry.registry_entry_id.clone());
let registry_trace_ref = match (&registry_record, &registry_change_ref) {
    (Some(record), Some(change_ref)) => Some(trace_repo.append_revision(
        CapabilityAccessTraceabilityRecord::record_for_changes(
            ids.new_traceability_record_id(), registry_subject.clone(),
            CapabilityChangeRecordRefSet::try_from_values(vec![change_ref.clone()])?,
            record.change_reason.to_traceability_reason(), None,
            context.actor_context.clone(), context.trace_id.clone(), now,
        )?, None, tx.as_ref()).await?),
    _ => None,
};
outbound_capture_service.capture_formal_exposure_boundary_changed(
    &context, &exposure_record, &exposure, tx.as_ref()).await?;
if let Some(record) = registry_record.as_ref() {
    outbound_capture_service.capture_capability_registry_changed(
        &context, record, &registry, tx.as_ref()).await?;
}

let mut affected_material_refs = Vec::new();
/* Exact core-truth propagation:collect exposure subject candidates first and registry
   subject only for actual registry delta;typed-union before mutation;process each
   non-stale View/Directory/Audit/Ecosystem revision once with the first terminal record
   reason,its own expected version and its exact capture method. Already stale no-op;
   immutable report or index/version mismatch rolls back retirement. */

let mut changed_subject_refs = vec![exposure_subject];
let mut change_record_refs = vec![exposure_change_ref];
let mut traceability_refs = vec![exposure_trace_ref];
if let Some(change_ref) = registry_change_ref {
    changed_subject_refs.push(registry_subject);
    change_record_refs.push(change_ref);
}
if let Some(trace_ref) = registry_trace_ref { traceability_refs.push(trace_ref); }
let application_result_ref = CapabilityApplicationResultRef {
    operation_name: context.operation_name.clone(), result_id: ids.new_application_result_id(),
};
let accepted_response = CapabilityCommandResponse {
    command_name: /* exact closed RetireFormalExposureBoundary name */,
    result_ref: application_result_ref.clone(),
    disposition: CapabilityCommandProtocolDisposition::Accepted,
    result: RetireFormalExposureBoundaryResult {
        exposure_ref,
        previous_state,
        current_state: exposure.exposure_state,
        visibility_applicability_id: visibility_id,
        visibility_state: visibility.visibility_state,
        registry_lifecycle_state: registry.lifecycle_state,
    },
    effect: CapabilityCommandEffectSummary {
        changed_subject_refs,
        changed_reference_subject_refs: vec![],
        change_record_refs,
        traceability_refs,
        reference_state_refs: vec![],
        impact_ref: None,
        affected_material_refs,
        outbound_event_names: /* FormalExposureBoundaryChanged;
            optional CapabilityRegistryChanged;actual material names,stable unique */,
    },
};
let result_ref = accepted_response.result_ref.clone();
let stored_surface: CapabilityStoredResultSurface = /* exact serialization */;
let shell = StoredCapabilityOperationResult::from_surface(
    result_ref.clone(), StoredCapabilityResultKind::CommandResult,
    StoredCapabilityResultDisposition::Command(CapabilityCommandDisposition::Accepted),
    stored_surface.surface_ref.clone(), stored_surface.surface_digest.clone(),
    context.trace_id.clone(), now,
)?;
stored_result_repo.save(shell, stored_surface, tx.as_ref()).await?;
loaded_reservation.value.complete(result_ref, now)?;
idempotency_repo.save(
    loaded_reservation.value, loaded_reservation.expected_version, tx.as_ref()).await?;
uow_manager.commit(tx).await?;
Ok(CapabilityCommandOutcome::Accepted(accepted_response))

#### 19.4.5 Transaction boundary

Exposure / visibility terminal revisions、optional registry pending delta、records、traces、captures、actual material stale revisions、result and completion are one local atomic unit. No delete,external resolver,handoff or collaboration belongs to this transaction.

#### 19.4.6 Error / rejection mapping

| Branch | Classification |
|---|---|
| Draft/already retired/stale exposure、missing/Retired/pre-mutation source-asymmetric visibility、owner mismatch | stable `PolicyRejected` / consistency rejection |
| request implies registry/identity delete or exposure resurrection/replacement | `InvalidField / PolicyRejected` |
| source-version/index symmetry failure | consistency error |
| expected-version/capture/material/result/completion failure | application error;whole rollback |
| completed duplicate | `DuplicateReplayed`;stored result only |

#### 19.4.7 State / change / trace / capture / side effects

| Axis | Exact effect |
|---|---|
| exposure / visibility | both terminal Retired;visibility marker equals final exposure version |
| registry | retained;non-retired target VisibilityPending only on delta;already retired/pending no-op |
| history / trace | one retirement record/trace;optional registry record/trace |
| capture / material | retirement capture plus optional registry capture;actual non-stale materials only |
| retained | identity、registry history、descriptor、relations and external refs remain readable and unchanged |

#### 19.4.8 Test cuts

1. Active/Accepted/Pending/Suspended/Unavailable allowed by Step 10 -> terminal exposure/visibility retirement.
2. Transaction-local Draft or already retired exposure -> stable rejection;no retirement history.
3. Registry FormalVisible -> VisibilityPending with record/trace/capture;already pending -> all registry effect counts zero.
4. Registry already Retired remains Retired and is not saved or reactivated.
5. Pre-retire visibility matches loaded exposure version andisnon-retired;post-retire marker equals final retired exposure version.
6. Exposure and optional registry material candidates union once;already stale omitted.
7. Capture/material/result failure rolls back retirement.
8. Registry/identity delete methods and external resolver/handoff calls remain zero.
9. Completed duplicate retrieves exact stored result only.

#### 19.4.9 Single-flow stop review

| Gate | Result |
|---|---|
| terminal semantics | pass;no in-place resurrection |
| registry ownership | pass;retained and actual-delta-only |
| history/capture | pass;final-symmetric exact sources |
| replay/material | pass;own expected versions and typed union |

#### 19.5.5 Transaction boundary

The local UoW contains only the new impact fact、its immutable event snapshot/capture、stored accepted response and idempotency completion. Trace and consumer references are read-only. A capture or result failure rolls back impact creation;later delivery failure cannot alter the impact or source truth.

#### 19.5.6 Error / rejection mapping

| Branch | Classification |
|---|---|
| missing/stale/superseded trace、operation/source trace-id mismatch、impact already exists for exact trace | stable `PolicyRejected` / invalid metadata |
| empty/out-of-order/duplicate consumers、invalid scope or wrong consumer variant | `InvalidField / InvalidScope` |
| consumer ref/state missing、wrong state id/kind/subject | `PolicyRejected` or consistency error |
| execution/audit/provider body supplied as scope | `BodyForbidden` |
| impact save/capture/result/completion failure | application error;whole rollback |
| completed duplicate | `DuplicateReplayed`;stored result only,no consumer/trace reload |

#### 19.5.7 State / change / trace / capture / side effects

| Axis | Exact effect |
|---|---|
| impact | one new Identified fact derived from exact current trace subject |
| event | one `CapabilityChangeImpactIdentified` local capture |
| change / trace | no fabricated change record and no new trace revision |
| material | zero scan、stale transition、capture or effect ref |
| external | no downstream execution call and no delivery claim |

#### 19.5.8 Test cuts

1. Current trace + valid stable consumer set -> one Identified impact and one capture.
2. Existing impact for same trace -> stable rejection;new id/capture zero.
3. Stale/superseded revision or operation/source trace-id mismatch -> no fallback to current-by-subject guessing and no capture.
4. Empty、duplicate or unstable-order consumer vector -> input rejection.
5. Runtime-tools / SDK reference-state id or union mismatch -> rollback without impact.
6. Impact subject is copied only from trace;caller cannot supply another subject/change ref.
7. All change/trace/reference/material effect vectors remain empty;impact ref is exact.
8. Capture/result/completion failure rolls back impact.
9. Completed duplicate uses explicit stored result get and no source/consumer reads.

#### 19.5.9 Single-flow stop review

|---|---|
| source authority | pass;exact trace revision owns subject |
| consumer boundary | pass;typed registered refs only,no execution state |
| event / material | pass;one impact capture and explicit zero material path |
| replay / version | pass;create None and fresh reservation expected version |

     -> None:return accepted local result without Port call
```

let loaded_trace = trace_repo
    .get_current_with_version(command.traceability_ref.clone()).await?
    .ok_or(/* stable PolicyRejected completion */)?;
if command.traceability_ref.id != loaded_trace.value.traceability_record_id
    || command.traceability_ref.version != Some(loaded_trace.value.version)
    || loaded_trace.value.traceability_state == TraceabilityState::Superseded
{
    return /* stable stale/superseded rejection completion */;
}
let loaded_audit = match command.audit_ref_id.clone() {
    Some(audit_id) => {
        let subject = ReferenceSubjectRef::ObservabilityAudit(audit_id.clone());
        let loaded_ref = external_reference_repo.get_with_version(subject.clone()).await?
            .ok_or(/* stable PolicyRejected completion */)?;
        let audit_ref = match loaded_ref.value {
            CapabilityExternalReference::ObservabilityAudit(value) => value,
            _ => return /* consistency rejection completion */,
        };
        let loaded_state = reference_state_repo.find_current_by_subject(subject).await?
            .ok_or(/* consistency rejection completion */)?;
        if audit_ref.resolution_state_id != loaded_state.value.resolution_state_id
            || !loaded_state.value.is_resolved()
            || !audit_ref.supports_traceability(&loaded_trace.value, &loaded_state.value)
        {
            return /* stable PolicyRejected completion */;
        }
        Some((audit_ref, loaded_state.value))
    }
    None => None,
};

let mut trace = loaded_trace.value;
match loaded_audit.as_ref() {
    Some((audit_ref, state)) => trace.request_handoff(
        Some((audit_ref, state)), command.trace_reason,
        &context.actor_context, context.trace_id.clone(), now,
    )?,
    None => trace.request_handoff(
        None, command.trace_reason,
        &context.actor_context, context.trace_id.clone(), now,
    )?,
}; // exactly one member call;never attach_handoff_ref + mark_handoff_pending
if trace.traceability_state != TraceabilityState::HandoffPending
    || trace.gap_reason.is_some()
    || trace.superseded_by.is_some()
{
    return /* domain invariant error;rollback local revision/result/completion */;
}
let next_trace_ref = trace_repo.append_revision(
    trace.clone(), Some(loaded_trace.expected_version), tx.as_ref()).await?;

let handoff_requested = loaded_audit.is_some();
let audit_ref_id = loaded_audit.as_ref()
    .map(|(audit_ref, _)| audit_ref.observability_audit_ref_id.clone());
let application_result_ref = CapabilityApplicationResultRef {
    operation_name: context.operation_name.clone(), result_id: ids.new_application_result_id(),
};
let accepted_response = CapabilityCommandResponse {
    command_name: /* exact closed RecordTraceabilityHandoffSummary name */,
    result_ref: application_result_ref.clone(),
    disposition: CapabilityCommandProtocolDisposition::Accepted,
    result: RecordTraceabilityHandoffSummaryResult {
        traceability_ref: next_trace_ref.clone(),
        traceability_state: trace.traceability_state,
        audit_ref_id: audit_ref_id.clone(),
        handoff_requested,
    },
    effect: CapabilityCommandEffectSummary {
        changed_subject_refs: vec![],
        changed_reference_subject_refs: vec![],
        change_record_refs: vec![],
        traceability_refs: vec![next_trace_ref.clone()],
        reference_state_refs: vec![],
        impact_ref: None,
        affected_material_refs: vec![],
        outbound_event_names: vec![],
    },
};
let result_ref = accepted_response.result_ref.clone();
let stored_surface: CapabilityStoredResultSurface = /* exact serialization */;
let shell = StoredCapabilityOperationResult::from_surface(
    result_ref.clone(), StoredCapabilityResultKind::CommandResult,
    StoredCapabilityResultDisposition::Command(CapabilityCommandDisposition::Accepted),
    stored_surface.surface_ref.clone(), stored_surface.surface_digest.clone(),
    context.trace_id.clone(), now,
)?;
stored_result_repo.save(shell, stored_surface, tx.as_ref()).await?;
loaded_reservation.value.complete(result_ref, now)?;
idempotency_repo.save(
    loaded_reservation.value, loaded_reservation.expected_version, tx.as_ref()).await?;
uow_manager.commit(tx).await?;

if let Some(audit_id) = audit_ref_id {
    match audit_handoff_port.handoff_traceability(
        next_trace_ref,
        audit_id.clone(),
        handoff_scope,
    ).await {
        Ok(outcome) if outcome.audit_ref_id == audit_id => {
            /* Operational observation only;do not amend the stored response or trace. */
        }
        Ok(_) | Err(_) => {
            /* Accepted local pending revision remains authoritative.
               Query/repair surfaces expose follow-up;no receipt/evidence/acceptance is claimed. */
        }
    }
}
Ok(CapabilityCommandOutcome::Accepted(accepted_response))
```

#### 19.6.5 Transaction boundary

The local UoW contains one next trace revision、the exact accepted response and idempotency completion. No event/material capture belongs to it. Optional handoff starts only after successful commit and is non-transactional relative to local truth;its failure cannot produce a rollback or a replacement stored response.

#### 19.6.6 Error / rejection mapping

| Branch | Classification |
|---|---|
| stale/superseded trace、illegal trace state | stable `PolicyRejected` |
| optional audit missing/wrong variant/non-resolved/state-id mismatch | `PolicyRejected` or consistency error |
| invalid/body-bearing handoff scope or audit material | `InvalidScope / BodyForbidden` |
| append/result/completion failure before commit | application error;whole local rollback,no Port call |
| post-commit handoff failure/outcome mismatch | local result remains Accepted/HandoffPending;operational recovery surface,not a receipt |
| completed duplicate | `DuplicateReplayed`;stored result only and Port call count zero |

#### 19.6.7 State / change / trace / capture / side effects

| Axis | Exact effect |
|---|---|
| trace | exactly one next revision,version +1,state HandoffPending,`gap_reason=None`,`superseded_by=None`,optional audit ref attached atomically |
| change / impact / reference | no mutation or fabricated refs |
| capture / material | all capture/material paths are explicitly zero |
| external | `Some` only,post-commit body-free handoff;outcome not persisted as receipt/evidence |
| retry | same key only replays;explicit retry uses current trace ref + new idempotency key |

#### 19.6.8 Test cuts

1. `Some(resolved audit)` -> one `request_handoff` call、one appended revision、commit before Port call.
2. Partial + `None` -> one pending revision with no handoff ref、cleared gap and Port call zero.
3. Verify `attach_handoff_ref` and `mark_handoff_pending` are never called by this flow.
4. Audit state non-resolved / state-id mismatch / wrong union -> rejection before append.
5. Append/result/completion failure -> no post-commit Port call.
6. Port success/failure/outcome mismatch never changes stored accepted response and never creates evidence alias.
7. Same-key duplicate -> exact stored replay and no Port call.
8. Explicit retry requires new key and exact current HandoffPending ref;stale prior ref is rejected and`superseded_by`remainsNone.
9. All core/reference/change/impact/material/event effect fields remain empty except one traceability ref.

#### 19.6.9 Single-flow stop review

| Gate | Result |
|---|---|
| revision count | pass;one member mutation and one append |
| state-field invariant | pass;HandoffPending always clearsPartial gap andhas no superseded pointer |
| local/external phase | pass;accepted-local-result commits first |
| audit boundary | pass;refs/scope only,no body/evidence claim |
| replay/effect | pass;duplicate no-repeat and complete empty non-trace fields |

| reference subject / kind | exact typed DTO pair | load exact registered union;subject variant、kind and ref state id must match current canonical state |
| Transition target / reason | closed intent fields | Step 10 per-kind matrix validates actual state change;reason is body-free and becomes final state reason |

          + list_material_refs(MutableAffectedByReference(subject))
        -> typed union -> exact load/validate marker -> mark/capture/save once
     -> no core change or trace creation
     -> store accepted response -> complete fresh expected version -> commit
```

#### 19.7.5 Transaction boundary

The actual canonical state revision、its reference event capture、all actual reference-dependent material stale revisions/captures、stored response and idempotency completion are one UoW. External reference truth is only read. No resolver or post-commit collaboration call exists in this flow.

#### 19.7.6 Error / rejection mapping

| Branch | Classification |
|---|---|
| unknown subject、kind/union/state-id mismatch、illegal terminal transition | `PolicyRejected / InvalidField` or consistency error |
| same value + same reason | stable exact no-op rejection;no state save/capture/material scan |
| current `Invalid / Forbidden`,including changed reason | terminal rejection;no state save/capture/material scan |
| body-bearing reason / forbidden candidate body | `BodyForbidden`;only redacted marker may persist |
| affected index returns wrong/missing marker、immutable report or revision mismatch | consistency error;whole rollback |
| state/material expected-version、capture/result/completion failure | application error;whole rollback |
| completed duplicate | `DuplicateReplayed`;stored result only,no state/reference/material read |

#### 19.7.7 State / change / trace / capture / side effects

| Axis | Exact effect |
|---|---|
| canonical state | exactly one actual next revision with final state-owned body-free reason |
| reference object | unchanged;listed only as changed reference subject because its canonical state owner changed |
| change / trace | both vectors empty;no fabricated core change or trace subject |
| capture | one ReferenceResolutionChanged + one availability capture per actual material revision |
| material | exact reference marker lookup、typed union、actual non-stale only |
| external | no resolver/execution/SDK/listing/governance/audit body call |

#### 19.7.8 Test cuts

1. Legal Resolved -> Stale/Unavailable/Expired transition -> one state revision/capture plus exact dependent material stale revisions.
2. MarkForbidden -> final state reason bridge drives materials;forbidden body is never retained.
3. Same non-terminal value + changed safe reason -> one state revision/reference capture and exact dependent-material stale propagation;same value + same reason -> stable no-op with zero state/material/capture writes.
4. Subject/kind/ref state-id mismatch -> consistency rejection before mutation.
5. Reference-aware index returns only matching marker;wrong marker or immutable report rolls back.
6. Duplicate material candidates union once and use their own expected version.
7. Already-stale material produces no effect ref、capture or save.
8. Core change and trace repository append counts remain zero.
9. Completed duplicate explicitly gets stored result and performs no material scan.

#### 19.7.9 Single-flow stop review

| Gate | Result |
|---|---|
| canonical owner | pass;state repository is sole resolution truth |
| reason / body boundary | pass;final state reason only,no resolver/error/body text |
| material exactness | pass;reference index、marker validation and own versions named |
| fake history / replay | pass;no core change/trace and duplicate no rerun |

    loaded_reservation.value, loaded_reservation.expected_version, tx.as_ref()).await?;
uow_manager.commit(tx).await?;
Ok(CapabilityCommandOutcome::Accepted(accepted_response))
```

#### 19.8.5 Transaction boundary

The new body-free document ref、initial canonical state、reference event capture、stored response and idempotency completion form one local atomic UoW. The external resolver observation is non-transactional and contains no body;local rollback leaves no accepted local reference. Optional descriptor and all core truth remain read-only.

#### 19.8.6 Error / rejection mapping

| Branch | Classification |
|---|---|
| unsupported kind、invalid scope/descriptor target、duplicate candidate | `InvalidField / PolicyRejected` |
| body-like locator/document/schema/protocol or Forbidden observation | `BodyForbidden` |
| Invalid observation | stable `PolicyRejected`;no local ref/state |
| resolver subject/kind/digest mismatch、factory/save asymmetry | consistency/application error;rollback |
| recoverable Unresolved/Stale/Unavailable/Expired allowed as initial by Step 10 | accepted explicit non-resolved registration |
| completed duplicate | `DuplicateReplayed`;stored result only,resolver/id generation zero after branch |

#### 19.8.7 State / change / trace / capture / side effects

| Axis | Exact effect |
|---|---|
| reference / state | one new document ref and one owner-symmetric canonical initial state |
| capture | one `ReferenceResolutionChanged` local capture,not delivery proof |
| core change / trace / material | all explicitly empty;optional descriptor is not changed |
| body boundary | locator summary only;no OpenAPI/schema/protocol/guide content |
| external authority | resolved means pointer resolvable,not descriptor accepted or execution authorized |

#### 19.8.8 Test cuts

1. Resolved observation -> document ref/state + one capture and exact effect refs.
2. Recoverable unresolved observation -> accepted explicit non-resolved value.
3. Invalid/Forbidden observation -> no local ref/state/capture.
4. Existing candidate digest -> rejection before resolver.
5. Optional descriptor accepted/matching -> typed id stored;missing/terminal/wrong scope -> rejection.
6. Constructor uses `from_external_document`;private locator value/body is never accessed.
7. Reference save/state-id/subject mismatch -> whole rollback.
8. Material/change/trace repository calls remain zero.
9. Completed duplicate explicitly retrieves stored result and does not call resolver.

#### 21.1.3 ASCII call graph

```text
get_capability_identity handler
  -> validate route/query-name/body/schema -> from_query context
  -> identity query service -> assert_query_no_write
  -> subject = Identity(identity_ref.id)
  -> resolve_subject -> assert_matches -> into_decision -> decision no-write
     -> NotVisible:body None;identity/source/state/review reads zero
     -> resolver Degraded:body None;target reads zero
     -> Visible:identity.get_with_version
        -> missing:Visible body None
        -> loaded:external_reference.get_with_version(ExternalCapabilitySource)
           -> reference_state.find_current_by_subject
           -> review.find_current_by_identity
           -> loaded parity failure:technical ConsistencyDefect;no half body
           -> complete bundle:typed identity view;explicit reference freshness
```

#### 21.1.4 Rust-style function pseudocode

```rust
async fn get_capability_identity(
    &self,
    context: CapabilityOperationContext,
    query: GetCapabilityIdentityQuery,
) -> Result<CapabilityQueryResponse<CapabilityIdentityView>, ApplicationError> {
    context.assert_query_no_write()?;
    let subject = CapabilityReadSubjectRef::Identity(query.identity_ref.id.clone());
    let resolution = self.visibility_resolver
        .resolve_subject(&context.actor_context, subject.clone()).await?;
    resolution.assert_matches(&subject, &context.actor_context)?;
    let decision = resolution.into_decision()?;
    decision.assert_query_no_write(&context)?;

    if decision.is_not_visible() {
        return Ok(CapabilityQueryResponse {
            query_name: /* exact closed GetCapabilityIdentity name */,
            surface: CapabilityQuerySurface {
                visibility: CapabilityQueryVisibility::NotVisible,
                freshness: CapabilityQueryFreshness::NotApplicable,
                degraded: vec![],
                source_versions: decision.source_versions,
                evaluated_at: decision.evaluated_at,
            },
            body: None,
        });
    }
    if decision.can_serve_degraded_surface() {
        let degraded_reason = decision.degraded_reason.ok_or(
            ApplicationError::TechnicalInvariantViolation {
                object: ApplicationTechnicalObjectKind::ReadVisibilityDecision,
                invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::ReadVisibilityShape,
            },
        )?;
        let freshness = degraded_reason.as_kind().freshness();
        let degraded = vec![degraded_reason.into_public_marker()];
        return Ok(CapabilityQueryResponse {
            query_name: /* exact closed GetCapabilityIdentity name */,
            surface: CapabilityQuerySurface {
                visibility: CapabilityQueryVisibility::Degraded,
                freshness,
                degraded,
                source_versions: decision.source_versions,
                evaluated_at: decision.evaluated_at,
            },
            body: None,
        });
    }
    if !decision.can_serve_full_surface() {
        return Err(ApplicationError::TechnicalInvariantViolation {
            object: ApplicationTechnicalObjectKind::ReadVisibilityDecision,
            invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::ReadVisibilityShape,
        });
    }

    let loaded_identity = match self.identity_repo
        .get_with_version(query.identity_ref.clone()).await?
    {
        Some(loaded) => loaded,
        None => return Ok(CapabilityQueryResponse {
            query_name: /* exact closed GetCapabilityIdentity name */,
            surface: CapabilityQuerySurface {
                visibility: CapabilityQueryVisibility::Visible,
                freshness: CapabilityQueryFreshness::NotApplicable,
                degraded: vec![],
                source_versions: decision.source_versions,
                evaluated_at: decision.evaluated_at,
            },
            body: None,
        }),
    };
    if loaded_identity.value.capability_identity_id != query.identity_ref.id
        || query.identity_ref.version.as_ref().is_some_and(
            |version| version != &loaded_identity.value.version)
        || loaded_identity.expected_version != loaded_identity.value.version
    {
        return Err(ApplicationError::ConsistencyDefect {
            subject: ApplicationConsistencySubjectKind::DomainObject {
                object: DomainObjectKind::CapabilityIdentity,
            },
            invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::PersistedVersionSymmetry,
        });
    }

    let source_subject = ReferenceSubjectRef::ExternalCapabilitySource(
        loaded_identity.value.source_ref_id.clone(),
    );
    let loaded_source = self.external_reference_repo
        .get_with_version(source_subject.clone()).await?;
    let loaded_source = match loaded_source {
        Some(Loaded { value: CapabilityExternalReference::ExternalCapabilitySource(source), expected_version })
            if source.source_ref_id == loaded_identity.value.source_ref_id
                && expected_version == source.version => source,
        None => return Err(ApplicationError::ConsistencyDefect {
            subject: ApplicationConsistencySubjectKind::CrossStoreRelation,
            invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::RequiredSidecar,
        }),
        Some(_) => return Err(ApplicationError::ConsistencyDefect {
            subject: ApplicationConsistencySubjectKind::DomainObject {
                object: DomainObjectKind::ExternalCapabilitySourceReference,
            },
            invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::PersistedVariantShape,
        }),
    };
    let loaded_state = self.reference_state_repo
        .find_current_by_subject(source_subject.clone()).await?;
    let loaded_state = match loaded_state {
        Some(loaded)
            if loaded.value.reference_subject == source_subject
                && loaded.value.resolution_state_id == loaded_source.resolution_state_id
                && loaded.expected_version == loaded.value.version => loaded.value,
        None => return Err(ApplicationError::ConsistencyDefect {
            subject: ApplicationConsistencySubjectKind::CrossStoreRelation,
            invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::RequiredSidecar,
        }),
        Some(_) => return Err(ApplicationError::ConsistencyDefect {
            subject: ApplicationConsistencySubjectKind::CrossStoreRelation,
            invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::PersistedOwnerRelation,
        }),
    };

    let review_summary = match self.review_repo
        .find_current_by_identity(loaded_identity.value.capability_identity_id.clone()).await?
    {
        None if loaded_identity.value.review_fact_ref.is_none() => None,
        Some(loaded_review)
            if loaded_review.value.capability_identity_id
                == loaded_identity.value.capability_identity_id
                && loaded_review.expected_version == loaded_review.value.version
                && loaded_identity.value.review_fact_ref.as_ref().is_some_and(|review_ref| {
                    review_ref.id == loaded_review.value.review_fact_id
                        && review_ref.version.as_ref().is_some_and(
                            |version| version == &loaded_review.value.version)
                }) => Some(CapabilityAccessReviewSummaryView {
                    review_fact_ref: CapabilityAccessReviewFactRef::exact(
                        loaded_review.value.review_fact_id.clone(),
                        loaded_review.value.version.clone(),
                    ),
                    review_state: loaded_review.value.state,
                    risk_summary: loaded_review.value.risk_summary,
                    separation_marker: loaded_review.value.separation_marker,
                }),
        _ => return Err(ApplicationError::ConsistencyDefect {
            subject: ApplicationConsistencySubjectKind::CrossStoreRelation,
            invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::CurrentIndexShape,
        }),
    };

    let view = CapabilityIdentityView {
        identity_ref: CapabilityIdentityRef::exact(
            loaded_identity.value.capability_identity_id.clone(),
            loaded_identity.value.version.clone(),
        ),
        identity_key: loaded_identity.value.identity_key,
        source_ref_id: loaded_identity.value.source_ref_id,
        source_kind: loaded_source.source_kind,
        source_resolution_state_ref: ReferenceResolutionStateRef::exact(
            loaded_state.resolution_state_id.clone(), loaded_state.version.clone()),
        source_resolution_value: loaded_state.resolution_value.clone(),
        identity_state: loaded_identity.value.identity_state,
        review_summary,
        version: loaded_identity.value.version,
        created_at: loaded_identity.value.created_at,
        updated_at: loaded_identity.value.updated_at,
    };

    let (visibility, freshness, degraded, body) = match loaded_state.resolution_value {
        ReferenceResolutionValue::Resolved => (
            CapabilityQueryVisibility::Visible,
            CapabilityQueryFreshness::NotApplicable,
            vec![], Some(view),
        ),
        ReferenceResolutionValue::Unresolved => (
            CapabilityQueryVisibility::Degraded,
            CapabilityQueryFreshness::Unavailable,
            vec![/* ReferenceUnresolved marker + protocol-safe issue ref */], Some(view),
        ),
        ReferenceResolutionValue::Stale | ReferenceResolutionValue::Expired => (
            CapabilityQueryVisibility::Degraded,
            CapabilityQueryFreshness::StaleReadable,
            vec![/* StaleSource marker + protocol-safe issue ref */], Some(view),
        ),
        ReferenceResolutionValue::Unavailable => (
            CapabilityQueryVisibility::Degraded,
            CapabilityQueryFreshness::Unavailable,
            vec![/* ReferenceUnavailable marker + protocol-safe issue ref */], Some(view),
        ),
        ReferenceResolutionValue::Invalid | ReferenceResolutionValue::Forbidden => (
            CapabilityQueryVisibility::Degraded,
            CapabilityQueryFreshness::Unavailable,
            vec![/* Redacted marker + protocol-safe issue ref */], None,
        ),
    };
    Ok(CapabilityQueryResponse {
        query_name: /* exact closed GetCapabilityIdentity name */,
        surface: CapabilityQuerySurface {
            visibility,
            freshness,
            degraded,
            source_versions: decision.source_versions,
            evaluated_at: decision.evaluated_at,
        },
        body,
    })
}
```

`Option::is_none_or` above is schematic standard-library shorthand for an explicit `None | Some(equal)` match;it is not a repository or domain helper. Public degraded issue-ref formation remains the Step 12 mapper responsibility.

#### 21.1.5 Transaction / no-write boundary

No transaction is opened. All four repositories are read-only and are reached only after a full-surface visibility decision. No `save / append / reserve / complete / refresh / capture / handoff` callable is available to this service path.

#### 21.1.6 Error / rejection mapping

| Branch | Classification |
|---|---|
| route/name/body/schema mismatch | entry `OperationMismatch`;service not called |
| resolver failure or subject/actor mismatch | typed `ApplicationError`;no body-first fallback |
| resolver `NotVisible` | successful explicit not-visible response,not visible missing |
| visible identity miss | `Visible/NotApplicable` with `body=None` |
| loaded source missing/wrong union、state-id/owner/version or review-link mismatch | exact `ConsistencyDefect` with `RequiredSidecar / PersistedVariantShape / PersistedOwnerRelation / PersistedVersionSymmetry / CurrentIndexShape`;no half body |
| repository failure | typed `ApplicationError`;not converted to missing |

#### 21.1.7 Surface / effects

Resolved source truth returns the complete body-free identity view. Unresolved、stale、expired or unavailable canonical source state remains explicit in the view and degraded surface when safe;invalid/forbidden consistency returns no body. State writes、external source resolution and governance fallback are all zero.

#### 21.1.8 Test cuts

1. Resolver `NotVisible` -> identity/source/state/review repository call counts all zero.
2. Resolver degraded -> body-free response and all target repository call counts zero.
3. Visible exact identity miss -> `body=None`,no `Missing` masquerading as not-visible.
4. Resolved source + no current review on both identity/repository sides -> complete view with `review_summary=None`.
5. Unresolved/stale/unavailable source state -> explicit resolution value and matching degraded/freshness marker;external resolver zero.
6. Loaded source ref missing or wrong external-reference union、state subject/id or identity-review link -> exact consistency error and no partial body.
7. Exact ref version mismatch returns `ConsistencyDefect(PersistedVersionSymmetry)` and never becomes an expected write version.
8. Test doubles fail the test if any UoW、save、append、reserve、capture、handoff or external resolver is called.

#### 21.1.9 Single-flow stop review

| Gate | Result |
|---|---|
| resolver-first | pass;identity body cannot precede `resolve_subject(Identity)` |
| typed bundle | pass;identity/source/state/review parity is explicit |
| visibility distinction | pass;NotVisible、visible missing and reference degradation differ |
| owner boundary | pass;no governance/runtime/provider body or external refresh |
| struct comments | pass;no new struct;all instantiated Step 8 fields have upstream English Rustdoc |

Flow status: `completed_in_batch_9_4`.


### 21.2 `query_search_capability_identities_flow`

#### 21.2.1 Entry and target

| Item | Exact contract |
|---|---|
| protocol | `CapabilityQueryRequest<SearchCapabilityIdentitiesQuery>` -> `CapabilityPageResponse<CapabilityIdentitySearchItemView>` |
| entry / service | `CapabilityQueryHandlers::search_capability_identities(...)` -> `CapabilityIdentityQueryService::search_capability_identities(...)` |
| read subject | `CapabilityReadSubjectRef::IdentityCollection` from `resolve_identity_search(actor,&scope)` |
| target read | one `CapabilityIdentityRepository::search(scope,page)` call after page-level visibility |
| non-effect | no per-item source/review/registry/projection lookup;no search-index rebuild、external call or write |

#### 21.2.2 DTO field sources

| Field | Source | Validation / use |
|---|---|---|
| `identity_key` | optional exact query filter | validate stable key;copy to repository scope without text-search reinterpretation |
| `identity_states` | query vector | validate closed values、canonical order and duplicates;empty means all |
| `source_ref_id` / `source_kind` | optional typed filters | copy to scope;repository must not inspect locator/body text |
| page cursor / limit | public page request | verify query + exact four-filter scope binding;limit `>0` and within configured max;map once to repository page |
| item fields | each loaded `CapabilityIdentity` | copy only identity-owned fields;no optional body fan-out |

#### 21.2.3 ASCII call graph

```text
search_capability_identities handler -> validate envelope/body/page -> from_query
  -> service.assert_query_no_write
  -> validate filters -> CapabilityIdentityRepositorySearchScope
  -> validate same-query/same-scope cursor -> CapabilityRepositoryPageRequest
  -> resolve_identity_search(scope) -> assert IdentityCollection/actor -> decision
     -> NotVisible:canonical empty page;search count zero
     -> Degraded:empty degraded page;search count zero
     -> Visible:identity_repo.search(scope,page)
        -> validate item/version/filter parity -> map identity-only items
        -> wrap next cursor opaquely -> final count -> has_more from cursor only
```

#### 21.2.4 Rust-style function pseudocode

```rust
async fn search_capability_identities(
    &self,
    context: CapabilityOperationContext,
    query: SearchCapabilityIdentitiesQuery,
) -> Result<CapabilityPageResponse<CapabilityIdentitySearchItemView>, ApplicationError> {
    context.assert_query_no_write()?;
    /* Validate identity_states as closed,canonical and duplicate-free before copying. */
    let scope = CapabilityIdentityRepositorySearchScope {
        identity_key: query.identity_key.clone(),
        identity_states: query.identity_states.clone(),
        source_ref_id: query.source_ref_id.clone(),
        source_kind: query.source_kind.clone(),
    };
    /* Validate opaque cursor integrity and bind it to SearchCapabilityIdentities + scope. */
    let repository_page = CapabilityRepositoryPageRequest::try_new(
        /* validated application-local cursor from query.page.cursor */,
        query.page.limit,
    )?;
    let subject = CapabilityReadSubjectRef::IdentityCollection;
    let resolution = self.visibility_resolver
        .resolve_identity_search(&context.actor_context, &scope).await?;
    resolution.assert_matches(&subject, &context.actor_context)?;
    let decision = resolution.into_decision()?;
    decision.assert_query_no_write(&context)?;

    if decision.is_not_visible() || decision.can_serve_degraded_surface() {
        let is_not_visible = decision.is_not_visible();
        let (visibility, freshness, degraded) = if is_not_visible {
            (
                CapabilityQueryVisibility::NotVisible,
                CapabilityQueryFreshness::NotApplicable,
                vec![],
            )
        } else {
            let degraded_reason = decision.degraded_reason.ok_or(
                ApplicationError::TechnicalInvariantViolation {
                    object: ApplicationTechnicalObjectKind::ReadVisibilityDecision,
                    invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::ReadVisibilityShape,
                },
            )?;
            let freshness = degraded_reason.as_kind().freshness();
            (
                CapabilityQueryVisibility::Degraded,
                freshness,
                vec![degraded_reason.into_public_marker()],
            )
        };
        return Ok(CapabilityPageResponse {
            query_name: /* exact closed SearchCapabilityIdentities name */,
            surface: CapabilityQuerySurface {
                visibility,
                freshness,
                degraded,
                source_versions: decision.source_versions,
                evaluated_at: decision.evaluated_at,
            },
            items: vec![],
            page: CapabilityPublicPageInfo {
                next_cursor: None,
                returned_count: 0,
                has_more: false,
            },
        });
    }
    if !decision.can_serve_full_surface() {
        return Err(ApplicationError::TechnicalInvariantViolation {
            object: ApplicationTechnicalObjectKind::ReadVisibilityDecision,
            invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::ReadVisibilityShape,
        });
    }

    let page = self.identity_repo.search(scope, repository_page).await?;
    let mut items = Vec::with_capacity(page.items.len());
    for loaded in page.items {
        if loaded.expected_version != loaded.value.version {
            return Err(ApplicationError::ConsistencyDefect {
                subject: ApplicationConsistencySubjectKind::PortReturn {
                    port: ApplicationPortKind::CapabilityIdentityRepository,
                },
                invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::RepositoryAccessShape,
            });
        }
        /* Assert the adapter honored all supplied typed filters;do not silently filter a bad page. */
        items.push(CapabilityIdentitySearchItemView {
            identity_ref: CapabilityIdentityRef::exact(
                loaded.value.capability_identity_id.clone(), loaded.value.version.clone()),
            identity_key: loaded.value.identity_key,
            source_ref_id: loaded.value.source_ref_id,
            identity_state: loaded.value.identity_state,
            review_fact_ref: loaded.value.review_fact_ref,
            version: loaded.value.version,
            updated_at: loaded.value.updated_at,
        });
    }
    let next_cursor = match page.next_cursor {
        Some(cursor) => Some(/* opaque public cursor bound to this query + stable scope */),
        None => None,
    };
    let returned_count = u32::try_from(items.len())
        .map_err(|_| ApplicationError::ConsistencyDefect {
            subject: ApplicationConsistencySubjectKind::PortReturn {
                port: ApplicationPortKind::CapabilityIdentityRepository,
            },
            invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::RepositoryAccessShape,
        })?;
    let has_more = next_cursor.is_some();
    Ok(CapabilityPageResponse {
        query_name: /* exact closed SearchCapabilityIdentities name */,
        surface: CapabilityQuerySurface {
            visibility: CapabilityQueryVisibility::Visible,
            freshness: CapabilityQueryFreshness::NotApplicable,
            degraded: vec![],
            source_versions: decision.source_versions,
            evaluated_at: decision.evaluated_at,
        },
        items,
        page: CapabilityPublicPageInfo { next_cursor, returned_count, has_more },
    })
}
```

#### 21.2.5 Transaction / no-write boundary

There is no UoW and exactly one possible target repository read. Cursor validation and visibility resolution are pure/application-local. Empty and denied pages never create a projection or search material.

#### 21.2.6 Error / rejection mapping

| Branch | Classification |
|---|---|
| invalid state/filter/cursor/limit | `InvalidField / InvalidPage`;search not called |
| resolver failure / wrong collection subject | `ApplicationError`;no page fallback |
| `NotVisible` | successful canonical empty page,not visible empty |
| resolver degraded | explicit degraded empty page;no unapproved partial-item read |
| repository failure | `PortFailure`;not converted to empty |
| loaded item version/filter parity violation | `ConsistencyDefect(PortReturn(CapabilityIdentityRepository), RepositoryAccessShape)`;no partial prefix |

#### 21.2.7 Surface / effects

Visible empty is `Visible/NotApplicable`,empty items,no `Missing` marker and no cursor unless the repository actually returned one. `returned_count` is final item length and `has_more` is only `next_cursor.is_some()`. All write/external effects are zero.

#### 21.2.8 Test cuts

1. All filters absent/empty + valid first page -> stable identity-only item mapping.
2. Duplicate/noncanonical state filter or malformed typed filter -> reject before resolver/repository.
3. Cursor from another query or changed filter scope -> `InvalidPage`.
4. Resolver `NotVisible` and resolver degraded -> `search` call count zero,canonical empty page.
5. Visible repository empty -> `Visible`,no `Missing`,count `0`,has_more false.
6. Repository next cursor -> opaque same-scope cursor,count from final items,has_more true.
7. Search item mapping performs zero source、review body、registry or projection reads.
8. Repository error is not swallowed as empty;all write-port call counts remain zero.

#### 21.2.9 Single-flow stop review

| Gate | Result |
|---|---|
| page resolver | pass;IdentityCollection is established before search |
| cursor | pass;query + full stable scope binding is explicit |
| item source | pass;identity repository only,no fan-out |
| empty semantics | pass;NotVisible and visible empty differ by surface |
| no-write | pass;no UoW/idempotency/projection refresh/external call |

Flow status: `completed_in_batch_9_4`.


### 21.3 `query_get_capability_access_review_fact_flow`

#### 21.3.1 Entry and target

| Item | Exact contract |
|---|---|
| protocol | `CapabilityQueryRequest<GetCapabilityAccessReviewFactQuery>` -> `CapabilityQueryResponse<CapabilityAccessReviewFactView>` |
| entry / service | `CapabilityQueryHandlers::get_capability_access_review_fact(...)` -> `CapabilityIdentityQueryService::get_capability_access_review_fact(...)` |
| read subject | `Exact` -> `AccessReviewFact(review_ref.id)`;`CurrentByIdentity` -> `Identity(identity_ref.id)` |
| target reads | exact/current review plus current identity used only for owner ref and parity |
| non-effect | no review record/supersede/invalidate、governance lookup/approval、trace、audit handoff or write |

#### 21.3.2 DTO field sources

| Field | Source | Validation / use |
|---|---|---|
| selector tag | `CapabilityReviewFactQuerySelector` | sole branch authority;never infer from route or field presence |
| exact review ref | `Exact` payload | exact `get_with_version` key after review-subject resolution |
| identity ref | `CurrentByIdentity` payload | exact identity validation after identity-subject resolution,then current recorded fact lookup |
| response review fields | loaded `CapabilityAccessReviewFact` | copy safe context/risk/separation/state/actor/version/times exactly |
| response identity ref | current `CapabilityIdentityRepository::find_by_id(review.identity_id)` | require owner id and persisted version parity;never guess a ref string |

#### 21.3.3 ASCII call graph

```text
handler -> exact selector validation -> query context
  -> service.assert_query_no_write
  -> selector -> AccessReviewFact(id) OR Identity(id)
  -> resolve_subject -> assert_matches -> decision no-write
     -> NotVisible / resolver Degraded:body None;review/identity reads zero
     -> Visible:
        Exact -> review.get_with_version
        CurrentByIdentity -> identity.get_with_version -> review.find_current_by_identity
        -> missing review:Visible body None
        -> loaded review -> identity.find_by_id/reuse exact owner
           -> owner/link parity -> typed view OR technical ConsistencyDefect
```

#### 21.3.4 Rust-style function pseudocode

```rust
async fn get_capability_access_review_fact(
    &self,
    context: CapabilityOperationContext,
    query: GetCapabilityAccessReviewFactQuery,
) -> Result<CapabilityQueryResponse<CapabilityAccessReviewFactView>, ApplicationError> {
    context.assert_query_no_write()?;
    let subject = match &query.selector {
        CapabilityReviewFactQuerySelector::Exact(review_ref) =>
            CapabilityReadSubjectRef::AccessReviewFact(review_ref.id.clone()),
        CapabilityReviewFactQuerySelector::CurrentByIdentity(identity_ref) =>
            CapabilityReadSubjectRef::Identity(identity_ref.id.clone()),
    };
    let resolution = self.visibility_resolver
        .resolve_subject(&context.actor_context, subject.clone()).await?;
    resolution.assert_matches(&subject, &context.actor_context)?;
    let decision = resolution.into_decision()?;
    decision.assert_query_no_write(&context)?;
    if decision.is_not_visible() {
        return Ok(/* exact NotVisible response;body=None;no repository read */);
    }
    if decision.can_serve_degraded_surface() {
        return Ok(/* exact Degraded/Unavailable response;body=None;no repository read */);
    }
    if !decision.can_serve_full_surface() {
        return Err(ApplicationError::TechnicalInvariantViolation {
            object: ApplicationTechnicalObjectKind::ReadVisibilityDecision,
            invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::ReadVisibilityShape,
        });
    }

    let current_by_identity = matches!(
        &query.selector,
        CapabilityReviewFactQuerySelector::CurrentByIdentity(_),
    );
    let (loaded_review, selected_identity) = match query.selector {
        CapabilityReviewFactQuerySelector::Exact(review_ref) => (
            self.review_repo.get_with_version(review_ref).await?, None,
        ),
        CapabilityReviewFactQuerySelector::CurrentByIdentity(identity_ref) => {
            let loaded_identity = match self.identity_repo
                .get_with_version(identity_ref.clone()).await?
            {
                Some(loaded) if loaded.value.capability_identity_id == identity_ref.id
                    && loaded.expected_version == loaded.value.version => loaded,
                None => return Ok(/* Visible body=None:visible identity/review absence */),
                Some(_) => return Err(ApplicationError::ConsistencyDefect {
                    subject: ApplicationConsistencySubjectKind::DomainObject {
                        object: DomainObjectKind::CapabilityIdentity,
                    },
                    invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::PersistedVersionSymmetry,
                }),
            };
            let loaded_review = self.review_repo
                .find_current_by_identity(identity_ref.id.clone()).await?;
            (loaded_review, Some(loaded_identity))
        }
    };
    let loaded_review = match loaded_review {
        Some(loaded) if loaded.expected_version == loaded.value.version => loaded,
        None => return Ok(/* Visible/NotApplicable body=None */),
        Some(_) => return Err(ApplicationError::ConsistencyDefect {
            subject: ApplicationConsistencySubjectKind::DomainObject {
                object: DomainObjectKind::CapabilityAccessReviewFact,
            },
            invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::PersistedVersionSymmetry,
        }),
    };

    let loaded_identity = match selected_identity {
        Some(loaded) if loaded.value.capability_identity_id
            == loaded_review.value.capability_identity_id => loaded,
        Some(_) => return Err(ApplicationError::ConsistencyDefect {
            subject: ApplicationConsistencySubjectKind::CrossStoreRelation,
            invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::PersistedOwnerRelation,
        }),
        None => match self.identity_repo
            .find_by_id(loaded_review.value.capability_identity_id.clone()).await?
        {
            Some(loaded) if loaded.value.capability_identity_id
                == loaded_review.value.capability_identity_id
                && loaded.expected_version == loaded.value.version => loaded,
            None => return Err(ApplicationError::ConsistencyDefect {
                subject: ApplicationConsistencySubjectKind::CrossStoreRelation,
                invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::RequiredSidecar,
            }),
            Some(_) => return Err(ApplicationError::ConsistencyDefect {
                subject: ApplicationConsistencySubjectKind::CrossStoreRelation,
                invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::PersistedOwnerRelation,
            }),
        },
    };
    if current_by_identity
        && !loaded_identity.value.review_fact_ref.as_ref().is_some_and(|review_ref| {
            review_ref.id == loaded_review.value.review_fact_id
                && review_ref.version.as_ref().is_some_and(
                    |version| version == &loaded_review.value.version)
        })
    {
        return Err(ApplicationError::ConsistencyDefect {
            subject: ApplicationConsistencySubjectKind::CrossStoreRelation,
            invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::CurrentIndexShape,
        });
    }

    let body = CapabilityAccessReviewFactView {
        review_fact_ref: CapabilityAccessReviewFactRef::exact(
            loaded_review.value.review_fact_id.clone(), loaded_review.value.version.clone()),
        identity_ref: CapabilityIdentityRef::exact(
            loaded_identity.value.capability_identity_id.clone(),
            loaded_identity.value.version.clone(),
        ),
        review_context: loaded_review.value.review_context,
        risk_summary: loaded_review.value.risk_summary,
        separation_marker: loaded_review.value.separation_marker,
        review_state: loaded_review.value.state,
        recorded_by: loaded_review.value.recorded_by,
        version: loaded_review.value.version,
        recorded_at: loaded_review.value.recorded_at,
        updated_at: loaded_review.value.updated_at,
    };
    Ok(CapabilityQueryResponse {
        query_name: /* exact closed GetCapabilityAccessReviewFact name */,
        surface: CapabilityQuerySurface {
            visibility: CapabilityQueryVisibility::Visible,
            freshness: CapabilityQueryFreshness::NotApplicable,
            degraded: vec![],
            source_versions: decision.source_versions,
            evaluated_at: decision.evaluated_at,

}
```

#### 21.3.5 Transaction / no-write boundary

The flow has no transaction. Review and identity repositories are read-only;exact historical review facts remain readable when permitted,while current selection uses only `find_current_by_identity` and never changes the identity link.

#### 21.3.6 Error / rejection mapping

| Branch | Classification |
|---|---|
| malformed selector payload/ref | `MissingRequiredField / InvalidField` before resolver |
| `NotVisible` | successful body-free response;does not reveal current-review existence |
| visible exact/current review miss | `Visible/NotApplicable`,body `None` |
| loaded review/identity owner、current-link or version mismatch | exact `ConsistencyDefect(PersistedOwnerRelation / CurrentIndexShape / PersistedVersionSymmetry)` |
| repository/resolver failure | `ApplicationError`;no governance fallback |

#### 21.3.7 Surface / effects

The body contains access-review truth and the explicit separation marker only. It does not contain or resolve governance approval、Policy、shared rules or audit material. All mutation and external side effects are zero.

#### 21.3.8 Test cuts

1. Exact current、superseded and invalidated facts retain their stored explicit state when visible.
2. CurrentByIdentity validates the exact identity before current-review lookup.
3. No current recorded fact -> visible `body=None`,not governance fallback.
4. `NotVisible` -> review and identity repository calls zero.
5. Review owner id/current identity link mismatch -> exact consistency error.
6. Exact review owner identity missing -> `ConsistencyDefect(RequiredSidecar)`,never guessed ref.
7. Selector branch is controlled only by enum tag.
8. Every write/resolver/handoff/capture fake remains uncalled.

#### 21.3.9 Single-flow stop review

| Gate | Result |
|---|---|
| selector | pass;Exact and CurrentByIdentity remain independent |
| visibility | pass;resolver precedes both review and identity bodies |
| separation | pass;access review is never governance approval |
| historical read | pass;exact terminal fact is not hidden as current |

#### 21.4.4 Rust-style function pseudocode

```rust
async fn get_capability_registry_entry(
    &self,
    context: CapabilityOperationContext,
    query: GetCapabilityRegistryEntryQuery,
) -> Result<CapabilityQueryResponse<CapabilityRegistryEntryView>, ApplicationError> {
    context.assert_query_no_write()?;
    let subject = CapabilityReadSubjectRef::RegistryEntry(
        query.registry_entry_ref.id.clone(),
    );
    let resolution = self.visibility_resolver
        .resolve_subject(&context.actor_context, subject.clone()).await?;
    resolution.assert_matches(&subject, &context.actor_context)?;
    let decision = resolution.into_decision()?;
    decision.assert_query_no_write(&context)?;
    if decision.is_not_visible() {
        return Ok(/* exact NotVisible/NotApplicable response;body=None;zero target reads */);
    }
    if decision.can_serve_degraded_surface() {
        return Ok(/* exact Degraded/Unavailable response;body=None;zero target reads */);
    }
    if !decision.can_serve_full_surface() {
        return Err(ApplicationError::TechnicalInvariantViolation {
            object: ApplicationTechnicalObjectKind::ReadVisibilityDecision,
            invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::ReadVisibilityShape,
        });
    }

    let loaded_entry = match self.registry_repo
        .get_with_version(query.registry_entry_ref.clone()).await?
    {
        Some(loaded) if loaded.value.registry_entry_id == query.registry_entry_ref.id
            && query.registry_entry_ref.version.as_ref().is_none_or(
                |version| version == &loaded.value.version)
            && loaded.expected_version == loaded.value.version => loaded,
        None => return Ok(/* Visible/NotApplicable response;body=None */),
        Some(_) => return Err(ApplicationError::ConsistencyDefect {
            subject: ApplicationConsistencySubjectKind::DomainObject {
                object: DomainObjectKind::CapabilityRegistryEntry,
            },
            invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::PersistedVersionSymmetry,
        }),
    };
    let loaded_identity = match self.identity_repo
        .find_by_id(loaded_entry.value.capability_identity_id.clone()).await?
    {
        Some(loaded) if loaded.value.capability_identity_id
            == loaded_entry.value.capability_identity_id
            && loaded.expected_version == loaded.value.version => loaded,
        None => return Err(ApplicationError::ConsistencyDefect {
            subject: ApplicationConsistencySubjectKind::CrossStoreRelation,
            invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::RequiredSidecar,
        }),
        Some(_) => return Err(ApplicationError::ConsistencyDefect {
            subject: ApplicationConsistencySubjectKind::CrossStoreRelation,
            invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::PersistedOwnerRelation,
        }),
    };
    let body = CapabilityRegistryEntryView {
        registry_entry_ref: CapabilityRegistryEntryRef::exact(
            loaded_entry.value.registry_entry_id.clone(), loaded_entry.value.version.clone()),
        identity_ref: CapabilityIdentityRef::exact(
            loaded_identity.value.capability_identity_id.clone(),
            loaded_identity.value.version.clone(),
        ),
        lifecycle_state: loaded_entry.value.lifecycle_state,
        lifecycle_reason: loaded_entry.value.lifecycle_reason,
        lifecycle_effective_at: loaded_entry.value.lifecycle_effective_at,
        visibility_basis: loaded_entry.value.visibility_basis,
        descriptor_ref: loaded_entry.value.descriptor_ref,
        version: loaded_entry.value.version,
        created_at: loaded_entry.value.created_at,
        updated_at: loaded_entry.value.updated_at,
    };
    Ok(CapabilityQueryResponse {
        query_name: /* exact closed GetCapabilityRegistryEntry name */,
        surface: CapabilityQuerySurface {
            visibility: CapabilityQueryVisibility::Visible,
            freshness: CapabilityQueryFreshness::NotApplicable,
            degraded: vec![],
            source_versions: decision.source_versions,
            evaluated_at: decision.evaluated_at,
        },
        body: Some(body),
    })
}
```

#### 21.4.5 Transaction / no-write boundary

No transaction is opened. The optional descriptor ref is a stored registry field and never causes descriptor、source or runtime fan-out. Retired exact entries are ordinary historical truth when the resolver permits them.

#### 21.4.6 Error / rejection mapping

| Branch | Classification |
|---|---|
| malformed request ref | entry `MissingRequiredField / InvalidField`;service not called on malformed input |
| `NotVisible` | successful body-free response before registry read |
| visible registry miss | `Visible/NotApplicable`,body `None` |
| loaded entry id/version or owner identity missing/mismatch | exact `ConsistencyDefect(PersistedVersionSymmetry / RequiredSidecar / PersistedOwnerRelation)` |
| repository/resolver failure | `ApplicationError`;not hidden as missing |

#### 21.4.7 Surface / effects

The response exposes registry truth only. `descriptor_ref=None` is valid and does not degrade the body;`Some` is not dereferenced. Runtime allowlist、formal exposure、marketplace listing and directory projection are absent from both data and side effects.

#### 21.4.8 Test cuts

1. Visible active and retired exact entries map every field including reason/effective time.
2. `descriptor_ref=None` -> complete visible view and descriptor repository call zero.
3. Visible entry missing -> body none;identity lookup zero.
4. Resolver NotVisible/degraded -> entry and identity reads zero.
5. Owner identity missing or wrong id/version -> exact consistency error and no body.
6. Descriptor、exposure、directory、runtime and marketplace adapters remain uncalled.
7. Query exact version is never passed to a save or interpreted as write concurrency.

|---|---|
| resolver-first | pass;RegistryEntry subject precedes exact load |
| truth boundary | pass;registry view does not become exposure/directory/listing |
| owner parity | pass;identity ref comes from typed repository read |

### 21.5 `query_list_capability_registry_entries_flow`

#### 21.5.1 Entry and target

| Item | Exact contract |
|---|---|
| protocol | `CapabilityQueryRequest<ListCapabilityRegistryEntriesQuery>` -> `CapabilityPageResponse<CapabilityRegistryListItemView>` |
| entry / service | `CapabilityQueryHandlers::list_capability_registry_entries(...)` -> `CapabilityRegistryQueryService::list_capability_registry_entries(...)` |
| read subject | `CapabilityReadSubjectRef::RegistryCollection` from `resolve_registry_list(actor,&scope)` |
| target read | one `CapabilityRegistryRepository::list_matching(scope,page)` call |
| non-effect | no identity body、descriptor body、formal exposure、directory projection、runtime availability or marketplace read/write |

#### 21.5.2 DTO field sources

| Field | Source | Validation / use |
|---|---|---|
| optional identity ref | query filter | validate typed ref shape without body load;copy only id to `scope.identity_id` |
| lifecycle states | query vector | closed、canonical、duplicate-free;empty means all |
| visibility basis | optional body-free query filter | copy exact basis;reject runtime/listing/search predicates or forbidden body |
| page | public cursor/limit | bind cursor to exact query + identity/state/basis scope;map to repository page once |
| list item fields | each loaded registry entry | map only seven declared fields;no per-item lookup |

#### 21.5.3 ASCII call graph

```text
handler -> validate filters/page -> from_query
  -> service.assert_query_no_write
  -> CapabilityRegistryRepositoryListScope + repository page
  -> resolve_registry_list(scope) -> assert RegistryCollection/actor -> decision
     -> NotVisible:canonical empty/no cursor;list count zero
     -> Degraded:explicit degraded empty;list count zero
     -> Visible:registry.list_matching(scope,page)
        -> verify item/version/filter parity -> map registry-only items
        -> opaque next cursor -> final item count -> has_more from cursor
```

#### 21.5.4 Rust-style function pseudocode

```rust
async fn list_capability_registry_entries(
    &self,
    context: CapabilityOperationContext,
    query: ListCapabilityRegistryEntriesQuery,
) -> Result<CapabilityPageResponse<CapabilityRegistryListItemView>, ApplicationError> {
    context.assert_query_no_write()?;
    /* Validate lifecycle vector and visibility basis before scope construction. */
    let scope = CapabilityRegistryRepositoryListScope {
        identity_id: query.identity_ref.as_ref().map(|identity_ref| identity_ref.id.clone()),
        lifecycle_states: query.lifecycle_states.clone(),
        visibility_basis: query.visibility_basis.clone(),
    };
    /* Validate the public cursor against ListCapabilityRegistryEntries + full scope. */
    let repository_page = CapabilityRepositoryPageRequest::try_new(
        /* validated application-local cursor */, query.page.limit)?;
    let subject = CapabilityReadSubjectRef::RegistryCollection;
    let resolution = self.visibility_resolver
        .resolve_registry_list(&context.actor_context, &scope).await?;
    resolution.assert_matches(&subject, &context.actor_context)?;
    let decision = resolution.into_decision()?;
    decision.assert_query_no_write(&context)?;
    if decision.is_not_visible() || decision.can_serve_degraded_surface() {
        return Ok(CapabilityPageResponse {
            query_name: /* exact closed ListCapabilityRegistryEntries name */,
            surface: /* exact NotVisible or Degraded surface from decision */,
            items: vec![],
            page: CapabilityPublicPageInfo {
                next_cursor: None, returned_count: 0, has_more: false,
            },
        });
    }
    if !decision.can_serve_full_surface() {
        return Err(ApplicationError::TechnicalInvariantViolation {
            object: ApplicationTechnicalObjectKind::ReadVisibilityDecision,
            invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::ReadVisibilityShape,
        });
    }

    let page = self.registry_repo.list_matching(scope, repository_page).await?;
    let mut items = Vec::with_capacity(page.items.len());
    for loaded in page.items {
        if loaded.expected_version != loaded.value.version {
            return Err(ApplicationError::ConsistencyDefect {
                subject: ApplicationConsistencySubjectKind::PortReturn {
                    port: ApplicationPortKind::CapabilityRegistryRepository,
                },
                invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::RepositoryAccessShape,
            });
        }
        /* Assert identity/state/basis filter parity;bad adapter output is not silently dropped. */
        items.push(CapabilityRegistryListItemView {
            registry_entry_ref: CapabilityRegistryEntryRef::exact(
                loaded.value.registry_entry_id.clone(), loaded.value.version.clone()),
            capability_identity_id: loaded.value.capability_identity_id,
            lifecycle_state: loaded.value.lifecycle_state,
            visibility_basis: loaded.value.visibility_basis,
            descriptor_ref: loaded.value.descriptor_ref,
            version: loaded.value.version,
            updated_at: loaded.value.updated_at,
        });
    }
    let next_cursor = page.next_cursor
        .map(|cursor| /* opaque public cursor bound to query + full scope */);
    let returned_count = u32::try_from(items.len())
        .map_err(|_| ApplicationError::ConsistencyDefect {
            subject: ApplicationConsistencySubjectKind::PortReturn {
                port: ApplicationPortKind::CapabilityRegistryRepository,
            },
            invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::RepositoryAccessShape,
        })?;
    let has_more = next_cursor.is_some();
    Ok(CapabilityPageResponse {
        query_name: /* exact closed ListCapabilityRegistryEntries name */,
        surface: CapabilityQuerySurface {
            visibility: CapabilityQueryVisibility::Visible,
            freshness: CapabilityQueryFreshness::NotApplicable,
            degraded: vec![],
            source_versions: decision.source_versions,
            evaluated_at: decision.evaluated_at,
        },
        items,
        page: CapabilityPublicPageInfo { next_cursor, returned_count, has_more },
    })
}
```

#### 21.5.5 Transaction / no-write boundary

The flow has no transaction and only one possible repository page read. Page mapping does not create a directory projection or inspect current formal exposure/runtime status.

#### 21.5.6 Error / rejection mapping

| Branch | Classification |
|---|---|
| malformed optional ref/state set/basis/cursor/limit | `InvalidField / BodyForbidden / InvalidPage` before list |
| `NotVisible` | successful canonical empty page;list not called |
| resolver degraded | explicit degraded empty page;list not called |
| visible repository empty | normal visible empty;no `Missing` marker |
| repository failure | `PortFailure`;not silently converted to empty |
| loaded item filter/version parity failure | `ConsistencyDefect(PortReturn(CapabilityRegistryRepository), RepositoryAccessShape)`;no partial page |

#### 21.5.7 Surface / effects

The page reports registry truth and no derived/search/runtime semantics. Final item length and next cursor are the only count/continuation authorities. No item identity is emitted on a not-visible page,even if a cursor was supplied.

#### 21.5.8 Test cuts

1. Empty state vector and absent filters -> all visible registry truth in stable order.
2. Optional identity ref maps to id only;identity body repository call zero.
3. Duplicate/unknown states、forbidden runtime/listing basis or cross-scope cursor -> reject before resolver/list.
4. NotVisible/degraded -> list call zero and canonical empty page.
5. Visible empty -> visible/no Missing/count zero/no fabricated cursor.
6. Item mapping never reads descriptor/exposure/directory/runtime/listing stores.
7. Adapter returns an out-of-scope item -> application parity error,not hidden filtering.
8. `returned_count == items.len()` and `has_more == next_cursor.is_some()`.

#### 21.5.9 Single-flow stop review

| Gate | Result |
|---|---|
| collection subject | pass;RegistryCollection exists independently of page items |
| filter scope | pass;only typed registry truth filters enter repository |
| page semantics | pass;opaque same-scope continuation and final count |
| negative space | pass;no directory/runtime/marketplace semantics |
| no-write | pass;no rebuild/mutation/external call |
