#### 21.6.4 Rust-style function pseudocode

```rust
async fn get_registry_visibility_semantics(
    &self,
    context: CapabilityOperationContext,
    query: GetRegistryVisibilitySemanticsQuery,
) -> Result<CapabilityQueryResponse<RegistryVisibilitySemanticsView>, ApplicationError> {
    context.assert_query_no_write()?;
    let subject = match &query.selector {
        RegistryVisibilityQuerySelector::RegistryEntry(entry_ref) =>
            CapabilityReadSubjectRef::RegistryEntry(entry_ref.id.clone()),
        RegistryVisibilityQuerySelector::CurrentByIdentity(identity_ref) =>
            CapabilityReadSubjectRef::Identity(identity_ref.id.clone()),
    };
    let resolution = self.visibility_resolver
        .resolve_subject(&context.actor_context, subject.clone()).await?;
    resolution.assert_matches(&subject, &context.actor_context)?;
    let decision = resolution.into_decision()?;
    decision.assert_query_no_write(&context)?;
    if decision.is_not_visible() {
        return Ok(/* exact NotVisible response;body=None;zero target reads */);
    }
    if decision.can_serve_degraded_surface() {
        return Ok(/* exact resolver Degraded response;body=None;zero target reads */);
    }
    if !decision.can_serve_full_surface() {
        return Err(ApplicationError::TechnicalInvariantViolation {
            object: ApplicationTechnicalObjectKind::ReadVisibilityDecision,
            invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::ReadVisibilityShape,
        });
    }

    let (loaded_entry, selected_identity) = match query.selector {
        RegistryVisibilityQuerySelector::RegistryEntry(entry_ref) => (
            self.registry_repo.get_with_version(entry_ref).await?, None,
        ),
        RegistryVisibilityQuerySelector::CurrentByIdentity(identity_ref) => {
            let identity = match self.identity_repo
                .get_with_version(identity_ref.clone()).await?
            {
                Some(loaded) if loaded.value.capability_identity_id == identity_ref.id
                    && loaded.expected_version == loaded.value.version => loaded,
                None => return Ok(/* Visible body=None:selector identity absent */),
                Some(_) => return Err(ApplicationError::ConsistencyDefect {
                    subject: ApplicationConsistencySubjectKind::DomainObject {
                        object: DomainObjectKind::CapabilityIdentity,
                    },
                    invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::PersistedVersionSymmetry,
                }),
            };
            let entry = self.registry_repo
                .find_current_by_identity(identity_ref.id.clone()).await?;
            (entry, Some(identity))
        }
    };
    let loaded_entry = match loaded_entry {
        Some(loaded) if loaded.expected_version == loaded.value.version => loaded,
        None => return Ok(/* Visible/NotApplicable body=None */),
        Some(_) => return Err(ApplicationError::ConsistencyDefect {
            subject: ApplicationConsistencySubjectKind::DomainObject {
                object: DomainObjectKind::CapabilityRegistryEntry,
            },
            invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::PersistedVersionSymmetry,
        }),
    };
    if selected_identity.as_ref().is_some_and(|identity| {
        identity.value.capability_identity_id != loaded_entry.value.capability_identity_id
    }) {
        return Err(ApplicationError::ConsistencyDefect {
            subject: ApplicationConsistencySubjectKind::CrossStoreRelation,
            invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::PersistedOwnerRelation,
        });
    }
    let loaded_identity = match self.identity_repo
        .find_by_id(loaded_entry.value.capability_identity_id.clone()).await?
    {
        Some(loaded) if loaded.value.capability_identity_id
            == loaded_entry.value.capability_identity_id
            && loaded.expected_version == loaded.value.version => loaded,
        None => return Err(ApplicationError::ConsistencyDefect {
            subject: ApplicationConsistencySubjectKind::CrossStoreRelation,
            invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::RequiredSidecar,
        }),
        Some(_) => return Err(ApplicationError::ConsistencyDefect {
            subject: ApplicationConsistencySubjectKind::CrossStoreRelation,
            invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::PersistedOwnerRelation,
        }),
    };

    let loaded_exposure = self.exposure_repo
        .find_current_by_registry_entry(loaded_entry.value.registry_entry_id.clone()).await?;
    let (formal_exposure_ref, visibility_applicability_id, formal_visibility_state) =
        match loaded_exposure {
            None => {
                if /* Step 10 lifecycle matrix requires a current exposure */ {
                    return Err(ApplicationError::ConsistencyDefect {
                        subject: ApplicationConsistencySubjectKind::CrossStoreRelation,
                        invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::RequiredSidecar,
                    });
                }
                (None, None, None)
            }
            Some(exposure) if exposure.value.registry_entry_id
                == loaded_entry.value.registry_entry_id
                && exposure.expected_version == exposure.value.version => {
                let visibility = self.visibility_repo
                    .find_current_by_exposure(exposure.value.formal_exposure_id.clone()).await?;
                match visibility {
                    None => {
                        if /* Step 10 exposure-state matrix requires current visibility */ {
                            return Err(ApplicationError::ConsistencyDefect {
                                subject: ApplicationConsistencySubjectKind::CrossStoreRelation,
                                invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::RequiredSidecar,
                            });
                        }
                        (Some(FormalExposureBoundaryRef::exact(
                            exposure.value.formal_exposure_id,
                            exposure.value.version,
                        )), None, None)
                    }
                    Some(visibility) if visibility.value.formal_exposure_id
                        == exposure.value.formal_exposure_id
                        && visibility.value.source_exposure_version == exposure.value.version
                        && visibility.expected_version == visibility.value.version => (
                        Some(FormalExposureBoundaryRef::exact(
                            exposure.value.formal_exposure_id, exposure.value.version)),
                        Some(visibility.value.visibility_applicability_id),
                        Some(visibility.value.visibility_state),
                    ),
                    Some(_) => return Err(ApplicationError::ConsistencyDefect {
                        subject: ApplicationConsistencySubjectKind::CrossStoreRelation,
                        invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::PersistedVersionSymmetry,
                    }),
                }
            }
            Some(_) => return Err(ApplicationError::ConsistencyDefect {
                subject: ApplicationConsistencySubjectKind::CrossStoreRelation,
                invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::PersistedOwnerRelation,
            }),
        };

    let body = RegistryVisibilitySemanticsView {
        registry_entry_ref: CapabilityRegistryEntryRef::exact(
            loaded_entry.value.registry_entry_id.clone(), loaded_entry.value.version.clone()),
        identity_ref: CapabilityIdentityRef::exact(
            loaded_identity.value.capability_identity_id.clone(),
            loaded_identity.value.version.clone(),
        ),
        lifecycle_state: loaded_entry.value.lifecycle_state,
        visibility_basis: loaded_entry.value.visibility_basis,
        formal_exposure_ref,
        visibility_applicability_id,
        formal_visibility_state,
    };
    Ok(CapabilityQueryResponse {
        query_name: /* exact closed GetRegistryVisibilitySemantics name */,
        surface: CapabilityQuerySurface {
            visibility: CapabilityQueryVisibility::Visible,
            freshness: CapabilityQueryFreshness::NotApplicable,
            degraded: vec![],
            source_versions: decision.source_versions,
            evaluated_at: decision.evaluated_at,
        },
        body: Some(body),
    })
}
```

The two Step 10 matrix assertions are obligations to consume the later formal state matrix;they are not new object methods. If the matrix says absence contradicts the loaded lifecycle/exposure state,the branch returns exact `ConsistencyDefect(CrossStoreRelation, RequiredSidecar)` and performs no repair.

#### 21.6.5 Transaction / no-write boundary

No UoW is opened. Registry、identity、exposure and visibility repositories are read-only. Optional absence never invokes `FormalExposureBoundary::draft`、`FormalVisibilityApplicability::derive/reevaluate` or registry lifecycle mutation.

#### 21.6.6 Error / rejection mapping

| Branch | Classification |
|---|---|
| invalid selector/ref | `MissingRequiredField / InvalidField` before resolver |
| `NotVisible` | body-free success before owner-chain reads |
| visible selected/current entry miss | `Visible/NotApplicable`,body `None` |
| no exposure/visibility and matrix permits absence | visible body with explicit `None` fields |
| loaded owner/source-version contradiction | exact `ConsistencyDefect(PersistedOwnerRelation / PersistedVersionSymmetry)` |
| lifecycle matrix requires missing exposure/visibility | exact `ConsistencyDefect(CrossStoreRelation, RequiredSidecar)` |
| repository/resolver failure | `ApplicationError`;no runtime fallback |

#### 21.6.7 Surface / effects

This flow explains persisted server-side registry/exposure/visibility semantics only. Optional fields do not assert runtime allow/deny、SDK publication、marketplace listing or governance approval. It creates no exposure、visibility fact、history、trace、capture or derived material.

#### 21.6.8 Test cuts

1. Exact entry and current-by-identity branches resolve different exact subjects before reads.
2. Visible entry with no exposure in an allowed lifecycle -> complete view with all three optional fields `None`.
3. Exposure with allowed missing visibility -> exposure ref `Some`,visibility fields `None`.
4. Exposure + visibility owner/source-version match -> all composed fields and exact source versions.
5. Formal-visible lifecycle with forbidden absence -> `ConsistencyDefect(RequiredSidecar)`;source-version mismatch -> `ConsistencyDefect(PersistedVersionSymmetry)`;no repair.
6. NotVisible/degraded resolver -> registry/identity/exposure/visibility read counts zero.
7. Runtime authorization、governance、SDK、marketplace and external resolver ports remain uncalled.
8. Any mutation/UoW/capture call fails the no-write test.

#### 21.6.9 Single-flow stop review

| Gate | Result |
|---|---|
| selector/resolver | pass;entry and identity subjects remain exact |
| optional semantics | pass;absence is explicit and state-matrix guarded |
| source parity | pass;visibility source exposure version must match |
| authority | pass;formal semantics do not become runtime/listing/approval truth |
| no repair | pass;query never forms or reevaluates exposure/visibility |

#### 21.7.4 Rust-style function pseudocode

```rust
async fn get_adapter_descriptor(
    &self,
    context: CapabilityOperationContext,
    query: GetAdapterDescriptorQuery,
) -> Result<CapabilityQueryResponse<AdapterDescriptorView>, ApplicationError> {
    context.assert_query_no_write()?;
    let subject = match &query.selector {
        AdapterDescriptorQuerySelector::Exact(descriptor_ref) =>
            CapabilityReadSubjectRef::AdapterDescriptor(descriptor_ref.id.clone()),
        AdapterDescriptorQuerySelector::CurrentByIdentity(identity_ref) =>
            CapabilityReadSubjectRef::Identity(identity_ref.id.clone()),
    };
    let resolution = self.visibility_resolver
        .resolve_subject(&context.actor_context, subject.clone()).await?;
    resolution.assert_matches(&subject, &context.actor_context)?;
    let decision = resolution.into_decision()?;
    decision.assert_query_no_write(&context)?;
    if decision.is_not_visible() {
        return Ok(/* exact NotVisible response;body=None;zero target reads */);
    }
    if decision.can_serve_degraded_surface() {
        return Ok(/* exact resolver Degraded response;body=None;zero target reads */);
    }
    if !decision.can_serve_full_surface() {
        return Err(ApplicationError::TechnicalInvariantViolation {
            object: ApplicationTechnicalObjectKind::ReadVisibilityDecision,
            invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::ReadVisibilityShape,
        });
    }

    let (loaded_descriptor, selected_registry_id) = match query.selector {
        AdapterDescriptorQuerySelector::Exact(descriptor_ref) => (
            self.descriptor_repo.get_with_version(descriptor_ref).await?, None,
        ),
        AdapterDescriptorQuerySelector::CurrentByIdentity(identity_ref) => {
            let identity = match self.identity_repo
                .get_with_version(identity_ref.clone()).await?
            {
                Some(loaded) if loaded.value.capability_identity_id == identity_ref.id
                    && loaded.expected_version == loaded.value.version => loaded,
                None => return Ok(/* Visible body=None:selector identity absent */),
                Some(_) => return Err(ApplicationError::ConsistencyDefect {
                    subject: ApplicationConsistencySubjectKind::DomainObject {
                        object: DomainObjectKind::CapabilityIdentity,
                    },
                    invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::PersistedVersionSymmetry,
                }),
            };
            let registry = match self.registry_repo
                .find_current_by_identity(identity.value.capability_identity_id.clone()).await?
            {
                Some(loaded) if loaded.value.capability_identity_id
                    == identity.value.capability_identity_id
                    && loaded.expected_version == loaded.value.version => loaded,
                None => return Ok(/* Visible body=None:no current registry */),
                Some(_) => return Err(ApplicationError::ConsistencyDefect {
                    subject: ApplicationConsistencySubjectKind::CrossStoreRelation,
                    invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::PersistedOwnerRelation,
                }),
            };
            let descriptor = self.descriptor_repo
                .find_current_by_registry_entry(registry.value.registry_entry_id.clone()).await?;
            (descriptor, Some(registry.value.registry_entry_id))
        }
    };
    let loaded_descriptor = match loaded_descriptor {
        Some(loaded) if loaded.expected_version == loaded.value.version => loaded,
        None => return Ok(/* Visible/NotApplicable body=None */),
        Some(_) => return Err(ApplicationError::ConsistencyDefect {
            subject: ApplicationConsistencySubjectKind::DomainObject {
                object: DomainObjectKind::AdapterDescriptor,
            },
            invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::PersistedVersionSymmetry,
        }),
    };
    if selected_registry_id.as_ref().is_some_and(|registry_id| {
        registry_id != &loaded_descriptor.value.registry_entry_id
    }) {
        return Err(ApplicationError::ConsistencyDefect {
            subject: ApplicationConsistencySubjectKind::CrossStoreRelation,
            invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::PersistedOwnerRelation,
        });
    }

    let body = AdapterDescriptorView {
        descriptor_ref: AdapterDescriptorRef::exact(
            loaded_descriptor.value.adapter_descriptor_id.clone(),
            loaded_descriptor.value.version.clone(),
        ),
        registry_entry_id: loaded_descriptor.value.registry_entry_id,
        source_ref_id: loaded_descriptor.value.source_ref_id,
        descriptor_kind: loaded_descriptor.value.descriptor_kind,
        connection_boundary_summary: loaded_descriptor.value.connection_boundary_summary,
        risk_summary_id: loaded_descriptor.value.risk_summary_id,
        secret_ref_id: loaded_descriptor.value.secret_ref_id,
        descriptor_state: loaded_descriptor.value.state,
        version: loaded_descriptor.value.version,
        created_at: loaded_descriptor.value.created_at,
        updated_at: loaded_descriptor.value.updated_at,
    };
    Ok(CapabilityQueryResponse {
        query_name: /* exact closed GetAdapterDescriptor name */,
        surface: CapabilityQuerySurface {
            visibility: CapabilityQueryVisibility::Visible,
            freshness: CapabilityQueryFreshness::NotApplicable,
            degraded: vec![],
            source_versions: decision.source_versions,
            evaluated_at: decision.evaluated_at,
        },
        body: Some(body),
    })
}
```

#### 21.7.5 Transaction / no-write boundary

No transaction is opened. The exact branch reads only descriptor truth;the current branch performs the declared identity/registry/descriptor chain. Optional risk and secret references are copied but not dereferenced.

#### 21.7.6 Error / rejection mapping

| Branch | Classification |
|---|---|
| invalid selector/ref | `MissingRequiredField / InvalidField` before resolver |
| `NotVisible` | successful body-free response before any target read |
| visible exact miss/no current registry or descriptor | `Visible/NotApplicable`,body `None` |
| loaded current owner/version mismatch | exact `ConsistencyDefect(PersistedOwnerRelation / PersistedVersionSymmetry)` |
| repository/resolver failure | `ApplicationError`;no provider fallback |

#### 21.7.7 Surface / effects

The body is the eleven-field descriptor truth view. Descriptor lifecycle remains explicit and is never replaced by provider availability. No source、risk summary、secret safe summary、provider route or runtime state body is loaded.

#### 21.7.8 Test cuts

2. CurrentByIdentity with no current registry or descriptor -> visible body none.
3. Current descriptor registry id mismatch -> exact consistency error;no alternate lookup.
4. Optional risk/secret ids `Some` and `None` both perform zero summary/reference reads.
5. Resolver NotVisible/degraded -> identity/registry/descriptor reads zero.
6. External source/provider runtime and all write ports remain uncalled.
7. Exact selector never silently becomes current-by-identity.

| owner chain | pass;current descriptor must match current registry |
| response source | pass;all fields come from descriptor truth |

```rust
async fn get_descriptor_risk_constraint_summary(

    context.assert_query_no_write()?;

    let resolution = self.visibility_resolver
        .resolve_subject(&context.actor_context, subject.clone()).await?;
    resolution.assert_matches(&subject, &context.actor_context)?;
    let decision = resolution.into_decision()?;
    decision.assert_query_no_write(&context)?;
    if decision.is_not_visible() {
        return Ok(/* exact NotVisible response;body=None;zero target reads */);
    }
    if decision.can_serve_degraded_surface() {
        return Ok(/* exact resolver Degraded response;body=None;zero target reads */);
    }
    if !decision.can_serve_full_surface() {
        return Err(ApplicationError::TechnicalInvariantViolation {

            invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::ReadVisibilityShape,
        });
    }

    let (loaded_summary, selected_descriptor) = match query.selector {
        DescriptorRiskSummaryQuerySelector::Exact(summary_id) => (
            self.safe_summary_repo.get_risk_summary_with_version(summary_id).await?, None,
        ),
        DescriptorRiskSummaryQuerySelector::CurrentByDescriptor(descriptor_ref) => {
            let descriptor = match self.descriptor_repo
                .get_with_version(descriptor_ref.clone()).await?
            {

                    && loaded.expected_version == loaded.value.version => loaded,
                None => return Ok(/* Visible body=None:descriptor/summary absent */),
```

```rust
async fn get_descriptor_secret_safe_summary(
    &self,

                ReferenceSubjectRef::Secret(secret_ref_id.clone())),

        .resolve_subject(&context.actor_context, subject.clone()).await?;
    resolution.assert_matches(&subject, &context.actor_context)?;

    decision.assert_query_no_write(&context)?;
    if decision.is_not_visible() {
        return Ok(/* exact NotVisible response;body=None;all target reads zero */);
    }

        return Ok(/* exact resolver Degraded response;body=None;all target reads zero */);
    }

        return Err(ApplicationError::TechnicalInvariantViolation {
            object: ApplicationTechnicalObjectKind::ReadVisibilityDecision,
            invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::ReadVisibilityShape,
        });
    }

    let (loaded_summary, selected_secret_id) = match query.selector {
        DescriptorSecretSummaryQuerySelector::CurrentByDescriptor(descriptor_ref) => {
            let descriptor = match self.descriptor_repo
                .get_with_version(descriptor_ref.clone()).await?
            {
                Some(loaded) if loaded.value.adapter_descriptor_id == descriptor_ref.id
                    && loaded.expected_version == loaded.value.version => loaded,
                None => return Ok(/* Visible body=None:descriptor/summary absent */),
                Some(_) => return Err(ApplicationError::ConsistencyDefect {
                    subject: ApplicationConsistencySubjectKind::DomainObject {
                        object: DomainObjectKind::AdapterDescriptor,
                    },
                    invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::PersistedVersionSymmetry,
                }),
            };
            let summary = self.safe_summary_repo
                .find_current_secret_summary_by_descriptor(
                    descriptor.value.adapter_descriptor_id.clone()).await?;
            (summary, descriptor.value.secret_ref_id)
        }
        DescriptorSecretSummaryQuerySelector::CurrentBySecretRef(secret_ref_id) => (
            self.safe_summary_repo
                .find_current_secret_summary(secret_ref_id.clone()).await?,
            Some(secret_ref_id),
        ),
    };
    let loaded_summary = match loaded_summary {
        Some(loaded) if loaded.expected_version == loaded.value.version => loaded,
        None => return Ok(/* Visible body=None:no current safe summary */),
        Some(_) => return Err(ApplicationError::ConsistencyDefect {
            subject: ApplicationConsistencySubjectKind::DomainObject {
                object: DomainObjectKind::SecretHandlingSafeSummary,

        Some(_) => return Err(ApplicationError::ConsistencyDefect {
            subject: ApplicationConsistencySubjectKind::CrossStoreRelation,
            invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::PersistedOwnerRelation,
        }),
    };

    let view = DescriptorSecretSafeSummaryView {
        secret_ref_id: loaded_secret.secret_ref_id,
        secret_provider_ref: loaded_secret.secret_provider_ref,
        secret_usage_scope: loaded_secret.secret_usage_scope,
        resolution_state_ref: ReferenceResolutionStateRef::exact(
            loaded_state.resolution_state_id.clone(), loaded_state.version.clone()),
        resolution_value: loaded_state.resolution_value.clone(),
        safe_summary_id: loaded_summary.value.safe_summary_id,
        handling_boundary: loaded_summary.value.handling_boundary,
        exposure_safety_marker: loaded_summary.value.exposure_safety_marker,
        safe_summary_state: loaded_summary.value.state.clone(),
        version: loaded_summary.value.version,
        refreshed_at: loaded_summary.value.refreshed_at,
    };
    let (visibility, freshness, degraded, body) =
        match (&loaded_state.resolution_value, &loaded_summary.value.state) {
            (ReferenceResolutionValue::Resolved, SecretHandlingSafeSummaryState::Available) => (
                CapabilityQueryVisibility::Visible,
                CapabilityQueryFreshness::Fresh,
                vec![], Some(view),
            ),
            (_, SecretHandlingSafeSummaryState::Forbidden)
            | (ReferenceResolutionValue::Invalid, _)
            | (ReferenceResolutionValue::Forbidden, _) => (
                CapabilityQueryVisibility::Degraded,
                CapabilityQueryFreshness::Unavailable,
                vec![/* Redacted marker + protocol-safe issue ref */], None,
            ),
            (_, SecretHandlingSafeSummaryState::Stale)
            | (ReferenceResolutionValue::Stale, _)
            | (ReferenceResolutionValue::Expired, _) => (
                CapabilityQueryVisibility::Degraded,
                CapabilityQueryFreshness::StaleReadable,
                vec![/* StaleSource marker + protocol-safe issue ref */], Some(view),
            ),
            (ReferenceResolutionValue::Unresolved, _) => (
                CapabilityQueryVisibility::Degraded,
                CapabilityQueryFreshness::Unavailable,
                vec![/* ReferenceUnresolved marker + protocol-safe issue ref */], Some(view),
            ),
            (ReferenceResolutionValue::Unavailable, _)
            | (_, SecretHandlingSafeSummaryState::Unavailable) => (
                CapabilityQueryVisibility::Degraded,
                CapabilityQueryFreshness::Unavailable,
                vec![/* ReferenceUnavailable marker + protocol-safe issue ref */], Some(view),
            ),
        };
    Ok(CapabilityQueryResponse {
        query_name: /* exact closed GetDescriptorSecretSafeSummary name */,
        surface: CapabilityQuerySurface {
            visibility,
            freshness,
            degraded,
            source_versions: decision.source_versions,
            evaluated_at: decision.evaluated_at,
        },
        body,
    })
}
```

The match is intentionally safe-field-only. It never reads a secret path credential、token、ciphertext、value or provider receipt. Step 12 maps the typed branch to exact public issue refs;no private provider error participates.

#### 21.9.5 Transaction / no-write boundary

No transaction is opened. Descriptor、summary、external-reference and state repositories are read-only. The flow cannot call `SecretReferencePort`,safe-summary constructors/transitions or any external network/client boundary.

#### 21.9.6 Error / rejection mapping

| Branch | Classification |
|---|---|
| invalid selector/ref kind | `MissingRequiredField / InvalidField` before resolver |
| `NotVisible` | body-free success before descriptor/summary/ref/state read |
| visible no current summary | `Visible`,body `None`;does not imply no secret exists outside declared relation |
| loaded summary missing secret ref/state、or wrong union/ref/state/descriptor link | exact `ConsistencyDefect(RequiredSidecar / PersistedVariantShape / PersistedOwnerRelation / PersistedVersionSymmetry)` |
| unresolved/stale/expired/unavailable canonical state | explicit degraded/freshness with safe body only |
| invalid/forbidden state or forbidden summary | `Degraded/Unavailable + Redacted`,body `None` |
| repository failure | `ApplicationError`;never mapped from provider text |

#### 21.9.7 Surface / effects

The only possible body is the eleven-field body-free safe view. Non-resolved canonical state is visible as an explicit value and never silently refreshed. Forbidden branches return no body. Secret-value access、rotation、authorization and provider health remain outside capability-hub.

#### 21.9.8 Test cuts

1. Descriptor branch validates exact descriptor and descriptor-secret-summary link.
2. Secret-ref branch resolves `ExternalReference(Secret(id))` before summary/ref/state reads.
3. No current summary -> visible body none;external-reference/state reads zero.
4. Missing/wrong external-reference union or canonical state id -> exact consistency error.
5. Resolved + available -> full safe view and Fresh surface.
6. Unresolved/stale/expired/unavailable -> exact explicit state + corresponding degraded/freshness marker.
7. Invalid/forbidden reference or forbidden summary -> Redacted body none.
8. Resolver NotVisible/degraded -> every target repository call zero.
9. Secret resolver/manager/KMS/Vault/network and all write ports remain uncalled.

#### 21.9.9 Single-flow stop review

| Gate | Result |
|---|---|
| resolver-first | pass;descriptor/secret subject precedes all body reads |
| safe bundle | pass;summary/ref/state parity is exact |
| degraded mapping | pass;all non-resolved values explicit;forbidden body absent |
| secret boundary | pass;no value/provider response/network |
| no-write | pass;no refresh/create/state transition |

### 21.10 `query_list_descriptors_by_capability_flow`

#### 21.10.1 Entry and target

#### 21.10.2 DTO field sources

| Field | Source | Validation / use |
|---|---|---|
| `identity_ref` | exact typed query field | id forms collection subject before reads;exact ref validates only after visible decision |
| page cursor / limit | public page request | cursor bound to this query + exact identity id;map once to repository page |
| registry id | `CapabilityRegistryRepository::find_current_by_identity(identity_id)` | no current registry yields visible empty page |
| item fields | each `AdapterDescriptorRepository::list_by_registry_entry` result | same eleven-field mapper as §21.7;no summary/ref fan-out |

#### 21.10.3 ASCII call graph

```text
handler -> validate identity ref/page -> from_query
  -> service.assert_query_no_write
  -> repository page mapping + DescriptorCollection(identity_id)
  -> resolve_descriptor_history(identity_id) -> assert subject/actor -> decision
     -> NotVisible / resolver Degraded:canonical empty;all target reads zero
     -> Visible:identity.get_with_version(identity_ref)
        -> missing:visible empty;loaded parity failure:technical ConsistencyDefect
        -> registry.find_current_by_identity

```

#### 21.10.4 Rust-style function pseudocode

```rust
async fn list_descriptors_by_capability(
    &self,
    context: CapabilityOperationContext,
    query: ListDescriptorsByCapabilityQuery,
) -> Result<CapabilityPageResponse<AdapterDescriptorView>, ApplicationError> {
    context.assert_query_no_write()?;
    /* Validate cursor integrity and bind it to ListDescriptorsByCapability + identity id. */
    let repository_page = CapabilityRepositoryPageRequest::try_new(
        /* validated application-local cursor */, query.page.limit)?;
    let subject = CapabilityReadSubjectRef::DescriptorCollection(query.identity_ref.id.clone());
    let resolution = self.visibility_resolver
        .resolve_descriptor_history(
            &context.actor_context, query.identity_ref.id.clone()).await?;
    resolution.assert_matches(&subject, &context.actor_context)?;
    let decision = resolution.into_decision()?;
    decision.assert_query_no_write(&context)?;
    if decision.is_not_visible() || decision.can_serve_degraded_surface() {
        return Ok(CapabilityPageResponse {
            query_name: /* exact closed ListDescriptorsByCapability name */,
            surface: /* exact NotVisible or resolver Degraded surface */,
            items: vec![],
            page: CapabilityPublicPageInfo {
                next_cursor: None, returned_count: 0, has_more: false,
            },
        });
    }
    if !decision.can_serve_full_surface() {
        return Err(ApplicationError::TechnicalInvariantViolation {
            object: ApplicationTechnicalObjectKind::ReadVisibilityDecision,
            invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::ReadVisibilityShape,
        });
    }

    let loaded_identity = match self.identity_repo
        .get_with_version(query.identity_ref.clone()).await?
    {
        Some(loaded) if loaded.value.capability_identity_id == query.identity_ref.id
            && loaded.expected_version == loaded.value.version => loaded,
        None => return Ok(/* Visible empty page:exact identity absent */),
        Some(_) => return Err(ApplicationError::ConsistencyDefect {
            subject: ApplicationConsistencySubjectKind::DomainObject {
                object: DomainObjectKind::CapabilityIdentity,
            },
            invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::PersistedVersionSymmetry,
        }),
    };
    let loaded_registry = match self.registry_repo
        .find_current_by_identity(loaded_identity.value.capability_identity_id.clone()).await?
    {
        None => return Ok(CapabilityPageResponse {
            query_name: /* exact closed ListDescriptorsByCapability name */,
            surface: CapabilityQuerySurface {
                visibility: CapabilityQueryVisibility::Visible,
                freshness: CapabilityQueryFreshness::NotApplicable,
                degraded: vec![],
                source_versions: decision.source_versions,
                evaluated_at: decision.evaluated_at,
            },
            items: vec![],
            page: CapabilityPublicPageInfo {
                next_cursor: None, returned_count: 0, has_more: false,
            },
        }),
        Some(loaded) if loaded.value.capability_identity_id
            == loaded_identity.value.capability_identity_id
            && loaded.expected_version == loaded.value.version => loaded,
        Some(_) => return Err(ApplicationError::ConsistencyDefect {
            subject: ApplicationConsistencySubjectKind::CrossStoreRelation,
            invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::PersistedOwnerRelation,
        }),
    };

    let page = self.descriptor_repo.list_by_registry_entry(
        loaded_registry.value.registry_entry_id.clone(), repository_page).await?;
    let mut items = Vec::with_capacity(page.items.len());
    for loaded in page.items {
        if loaded.value.registry_entry_id != loaded_registry.value.registry_entry_id
            || loaded.expected_version != loaded.value.version
        {
            return Err(ApplicationError::ConsistencyDefect {
                subject: ApplicationConsistencySubjectKind::PortReturn {
                    port: ApplicationPortKind::AdapterDescriptorRepository,
                },
                invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::RepositoryAccessShape,
            });
        }
        items.push(AdapterDescriptorView {
            descriptor_ref: AdapterDescriptorRef::exact(
                loaded.value.adapter_descriptor_id.clone(), loaded.value.version.clone()),
            registry_entry_id: loaded.value.registry_entry_id,
            source_ref_id: loaded.value.source_ref_id,
            descriptor_kind: loaded.value.descriptor_kind,
            connection_boundary_summary: loaded.value.connection_boundary_summary,
            risk_summary_id: loaded.value.risk_summary_id,
            secret_ref_id: loaded.value.secret_ref_id,
            descriptor_state: loaded.value.state,
            version: loaded.value.version,
            created_at: loaded.value.created_at,
            updated_at: loaded.value.updated_at,
        });
    }
    let next_cursor = page.next_cursor
        .map(|cursor| /* opaque public cursor bound to query + identity scope */);
    let returned_count = u32::try_from(items.len())
        .map_err(|_| ApplicationError::ConsistencyDefect {
            subject: ApplicationConsistencySubjectKind::PortReturn {
                port: ApplicationPortKind::AdapterDescriptorRepository,
            },
            invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::RepositoryAccessShape,
        })?;
    let has_more = next_cursor.is_some();
    Ok(CapabilityPageResponse {
        query_name: /* exact closed ListDescriptorsByCapability name */,
        surface: CapabilityQuerySurface {
            visibility: CapabilityQueryVisibility::Visible,
            freshness: CapabilityQueryFreshness::NotApplicable,
            degraded: vec![],
            source_versions: decision.source_versions,
            evaluated_at: decision.evaluated_at,
        },
        items,
        page: CapabilityPublicPageInfo { next_cursor, returned_count, has_more },
    })
}
```

#### 21.10.5 Transaction / no-write boundary

No transaction is opened. Identity and registry are owner gates;descriptor history is a read-only stable page. Missing current registry returns an ordinary visible empty page and does not register one.

#### 21.10.6 Error / rejection mapping

| Branch | Classification |
|---|---|
| invalid identity ref/cursor/limit | `InvalidField / InvalidPage` before resolver/list |
| `NotVisible` | canonical empty page before all target reads |
| resolver degraded | explicit degraded empty page before all target reads |
| visible missing identity | normal visible empty;registry/list calls zero |
| loaded identity/registry owner/version mismatch | exact `ConsistencyDefect(PersistedOwnerRelation / PersistedVersionSymmetry)` |
| visible no current registry | normal visible empty with no `Missing` marker |
| descriptor page owner/version mismatch | `ConsistencyDefect(PortReturn(AdapterDescriptorRepository), RepositoryAccessShape)`;no partial mixed-owner page |
| repository failure | `ApplicationError`;not converted to empty |

#### 21.10.7 Surface / effects

The page preserves descriptor-history repository order and maps only descriptor truth. It does not load risk summary、secret safe summary、source body or provider runtime. Empty ownership and visibility branches retain distinct surfaces.

#### 21.10.8 Test cuts

1. Resolver receives `DescriptorCollection(identity_id)` before identity/registry/descriptor reads.
2. NotVisible/degraded -> all target read counts zero and canonical empty page.
3. Visible exact identity missing -> normal visible empty;no registry/list call.
4. No current registry -> visible empty/no Missing/list call zero.
5. Multi-version descriptor history preserves repository order and all eleven fields.
6. Wrong registry owner/version in any item -> exact consistency error and no partial items.
7. Cursor from another identity/query -> InvalidPage before resolver/list.
8. Count/cursor/has-more invariants hold;no per-item summary/ref/provider reads.
9. All write、external resolver and refresh call counts remain zero.

#### 21.10.9 Single-flow stop review

| Gate | Result |
|---|---|
| page resolver | pass;collection subject is identity-owned and empty-page capable |
| owner chain | pass;identity/current registry/item registry parity is explicit |
| empty semantics | pass;missing identity or no registry is visible empty;loaded owner inconsistency is technical error |
| item boundary | pass;descriptor truth only,no summary/provider fan-out |

The three page flows preserve repository stable order and wrap continuation cursors opaquely. A not-visible response always clears the caller cursor and returns `items=[]`,`next_cursor=None`,`returned_count=0`,`has_more=false`.

```rust
async fn get_governance_seam_relation(
    &self,
    context: CapabilityOperationContext,
    query: GetGovernanceSeamRelationQuery,
) -> Result<CapabilityQueryResponse<GovernanceSeamRelationView>, ApplicationError> {
    context.assert_query_no_write()?;
    let subject = match &query.selector {
        GovernanceSeamQuerySelector::Exact(seam_ref) =>
            CapabilityReadSubjectRef::GovernanceSeam(seam_ref.id.clone()),
        GovernanceSeamQuerySelector::CurrentByIdentity(identity_ref) =>
            CapabilityReadSubjectRef::Identity(identity_ref.id.clone()),
    };
    let resolution = self.visibility_resolver
        .resolve_subject(&context.actor_context, subject.clone()).await?;
    resolution.assert_matches(&subject, &context.actor_context)?;
    let decision = resolution.into_decision()?;
    decision.assert_query_no_write(&context)?;
    if decision.is_not_visible() {
        return Ok(/* exact NotVisible/NotApplicable response;body=None;zero target reads */);
    }
    if decision.can_serve_degraded_surface() {
        return Ok(/* exact card-permitted resolver-degraded response;body=None */);
    }
    if !decision.can_serve_full_surface() {
        return Err(ApplicationError::TechnicalInvariantViolation {
            object: ApplicationTechnicalObjectKind::ReadVisibilityDecision,
            invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::ReadVisibilityShape,
        });
    }

    let (loaded_seam, selected_identity_id) = match query.selector {
        GovernanceSeamQuerySelector::Exact(seam_ref) => (
            self.governance_seam_repo.get_with_version(seam_ref).await?, None,
        ),
        GovernanceSeamQuerySelector::CurrentByIdentity(identity_ref) => {
            let identity = match self.identity_repo
                .get_with_version(identity_ref.clone()).await?
            {
                Some(loaded) if loaded.value.capability_identity_id == identity_ref.id
                    && loaded.expected_version == loaded.value.version => loaded,
                None => return Ok(/* Visible body=None:identity/seam absent */),
                Some(_) => return Err(ApplicationError::ConsistencyDefect {
                    subject: ApplicationConsistencySubjectKind::DomainObject {
                        object: DomainObjectKind::CapabilityIdentity,
                    },
                    invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::PersistedVersionSymmetry,
                }),
            };
            let seam = self.governance_seam_repo
                .find_current_by_identity(identity.value.capability_identity_id.clone()).await?;
            (seam, Some(identity.value.capability_identity_id))
        }
    };
    let loaded_seam = match loaded_seam {
        Some(loaded) if loaded.expected_version == loaded.value.version => loaded,
        None => return Ok(/* Visible/NotApplicable body=None */),
        Some(_) => return Err(ApplicationError::ConsistencyDefect {
            subject: ApplicationConsistencySubjectKind::DomainObject {
                object: DomainObjectKind::GovernanceSeamRelation,
            },
            invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::PersistedVersionSymmetry,
        }),
    };
    if selected_identity_id.as_ref().is_some_and(|identity_id| {
        identity_id != &loaded_seam.value.capability_identity_id
    }) {
        return Err(ApplicationError::ConsistencyDefect {
            subject: ApplicationConsistencySubjectKind::CrossStoreRelation,
            invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::PersistedOwnerRelation,
        });
    }

    let reference_subject = ReferenceSubjectRef::GovernanceResult(
        loaded_seam.value.governance_result_ref_id.clone(),
    );
    let governance_ref = match self.external_reference_repo
        .get_with_version(reference_subject.clone()).await?
    {
        Some(Loaded {
            value: CapabilityExternalReference::GovernanceResult(reference),
            expected_version,
        }) if reference.governance_result_ref_id
            == loaded_seam.value.governance_result_ref_id
            && expected_version == reference.version => reference,
        None => return Err(ApplicationError::ConsistencyDefect {
            subject: ApplicationConsistencySubjectKind::CrossStoreRelation,
            invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::RequiredSidecar,
        }),
        Some(_) => return Err(ApplicationError::ConsistencyDefect {
            subject: ApplicationConsistencySubjectKind::DomainObject {
                object: DomainObjectKind::GovernanceResultReference,
            },
            invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::PersistedVariantShape,
        }),
    };
    let state = match self.reference_state_repo
        .find_current_by_subject(reference_subject.clone()).await?
    {
        Some(loaded) if loaded.value.reference_subject == reference_subject
            && loaded.value.resolution_state_id == governance_ref.resolution_state_id
            && loaded.expected_version == loaded.value.version => loaded.value,
        None => return Err(ApplicationError::ConsistencyDefect {
            subject: ApplicationConsistencySubjectKind::CrossStoreRelation,
            invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::RequiredSidecar,
        }),
        Some(_) => return Err(ApplicationError::ConsistencyDefect {
            subject: ApplicationConsistencySubjectKind::CrossStoreRelation,
            invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::PersistedOwnerRelation,
        }),
    };

    let view = GovernanceSeamRelationView {
        seam_relation_ref: GovernanceSeamRelationRef::exact(
            loaded_seam.value.governance_seam_relation_id.clone(),
            loaded_seam.value.version.clone(),
        ),
        capability_identity_id: loaded_seam.value.capability_identity_id,
        governance_result_ref_id: governance_ref.governance_result_ref_id,
        governance_ref_kind: governance_ref.governance_ref_kind,
        governance_source: governance_ref.governance_source,
        result_scope_summary: governance_ref.result_scope_summary,
        resolution_state_ref: ReferenceResolutionStateRef::exact(
            state.resolution_state_id.clone(), state.version.clone()),
        resolution_value: state.resolution_value.clone(),
        seam_state: loaded_seam.value.seam_state,
        allowed_safe_summary: loaded_seam.value.allowed_safe_summary,
        version: loaded_seam.value.version,
        created_at: loaded_seam.value.created_at,
        updated_at: loaded_seam.value.updated_at,
    };
    let (visibility, freshness, degraded, body) =
        /* Exact Step 8 canonical-state mapping:Resolved direct truth;
           Unresolved/Unavailable/Expired/Stale explicit degraded safe body;
           Invalid/Forbidden redacted no body. */;
    Ok(CapabilityQueryResponse {
        query_name: /* exact closed GetGovernanceSeamRelation name */,
        surface: CapabilityQuerySurface {
            visibility, freshness, degraded,
            source_versions: decision.source_versions,
            evaluated_at: decision.evaluated_at,
        },
        body,
    })
}
```

#### 23.1.5 Transaction / no-write boundary

No transaction is opened. Seam、identity、external-reference and state repositories are read-only. Canonical non-resolved states remain visible through typed safe markers and never trigger governance re-resolution or seam state mutation.

#### 23.1.6 Error / rejection mapping

| Branch | Classification |
|---|---|
| malformed selector/ref | `MissingRequiredField / InvalidField` before resolver |
| `NotVisible` | successful body-free response before target reads |
| visible relation miss | `Visible/NotApplicable`,body `None` |
| loaded identity/seam owner or version mismatch | exact `ConsistencyDefect(PersistedOwnerRelation / PersistedVersionSymmetry)` |
| missing/wrong governance ref or current state pair | exact `ConsistencyDefect(RequiredSidecar / PersistedVariantShape / PersistedOwnerRelation / PersistedVersionSymmetry)` |
| non-resolved canonical state | explicit card-safe degraded mapping;invalid/forbidden redacted |
| repository/resolver failure | typed `ApplicationError`;no governance-system fallback |

#### 23.1.7 Surface / effects

The body is entirely body-free relation/reference/state truth. It does not claim approval、Policy effectiveness、vote/workflow state or runtime authorization. Writes、external governance calls、handoff and event effects are zero.

#### 23.1.8 Test cuts

1. Exact and current-by-identity branches resolve their exact subject before reads.
2. Visible current seam missing -> body none;reference/state reads zero.
3. Missing/wrong governance ref union/id/state-id mismatch -> exact consistency error and no half body.
4. Resolved state -> complete eleven-field relation view;non-resolved values explicit.
5. Invalid/Forbidden -> redacted body none;safe summary cannot bypass redaction.
6. Resolver NotVisible/degraded -> identity/seam/ref/state call counts zero.
7. Approval/Policy/vote/workflow resolver and all write ports remain uncalled.

#### 23.1.9 Single-flow stop review

| Gate | Result |
|---|---|
| selector/resolver | pass;seam and identity subjects remain exact |
| pair parity | pass;relation/ref/state owner and version checks explicit |
| governance boundary | pass;no approval/Policy body or external resolver |
| missing/degraded | pass;visible miss、resolver degradation and complete non-resolved state differ from technical pair inconsistency |
| no-write | pass;zero mutation/UoW/handoff/capture |

```rust
async fn get_access_governance_separation(
    &self,
    context: CapabilityOperationContext,
    query: GetAccessGovernanceSeparationQuery,
) -> Result<CapabilityQueryResponse<AccessGovernanceSeparationView>, ApplicationError> {
    context.assert_query_no_write()?;
    let subject = match &query.selector {
        AccessGovernanceSeparationQuerySelector::Identity(identity_ref) =>
            CapabilityReadSubjectRef::Identity(identity_ref.id.clone()),
        AccessGovernanceSeparationQuerySelector::ReviewFact(review_ref) =>
            CapabilityReadSubjectRef::AccessReviewFact(review_ref.id.clone()),
    };
    let resolution = self.visibility_resolver
        .resolve_subject(&context.actor_context, subject.clone()).await?;
    resolution.assert_matches(&subject, &context.actor_context)?;
    let decision = resolution.into_decision()?;
    decision.assert_query_no_write(&context)?;
    if decision.is_not_visible() {
        return Ok(/* exact NotVisible response;body=None;zero target reads */);
    }
    if decision.can_serve_degraded_surface() {
        return Ok(/* exact resolver-degraded response;body=None;zero target reads */);
    }
    if !decision.can_serve_full_surface() {
        return Err(ApplicationError::TechnicalInvariantViolation {
            object: ApplicationTechnicalObjectKind::ReadVisibilityDecision,
            invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::ReadVisibilityShape,
        });
    }

    let (loaded_identity, loaded_review) = match query.selector {
        AccessGovernanceSeparationQuerySelector::Identity(identity_ref) => {
            let identity = match self.identity_repo
                .get_with_version(identity_ref.clone()).await?
            {
                Some(loaded) if loaded.value.capability_identity_id == identity_ref.id
                    && loaded.expected_version == loaded.value.version => loaded,
                None => return Ok(/* Visible body=None:identity/review absent */),
                Some(_) => return Err(ApplicationError::ConsistencyDefect {
                    subject: ApplicationConsistencySubjectKind::DomainObject {
                        object: DomainObjectKind::CapabilityIdentity,
                    },
                    invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::PersistedVersionSymmetry,
                }),
            };
            let review = self.review_repo
                .find_current_by_identity(identity.value.capability_identity_id.clone()).await?;
            let review = match review {
                Some(loaded) if loaded.expected_version == loaded.value.version
                    && identity.value.review_fact_ref.as_ref().is_some_and(|review_ref| {
                        review_ref.id == loaded.value.review_fact_id
                            && review_ref.version.as_ref().is_some_and(
                                |version| version == &loaded.value.version)
                    }) => loaded,
                None if identity.value.review_fact_ref.is_none() =>
                    return Ok(/* Visible body=None:no recorded review */),
                _ => return Err(ApplicationError::ConsistencyDefect {
                    subject: ApplicationConsistencySubjectKind::CrossStoreRelation,
                    invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::CurrentIndexShape,
                }),
            };
            (identity, review)
        }
        AccessGovernanceSeparationQuerySelector::ReviewFact(review_ref) => {
            let review = match self.review_repo.get_with_version(review_ref).await? {
                Some(loaded) if loaded.expected_version == loaded.value.version => loaded,
                None => return Ok(/* Visible body=None */),
                Some(_) => return Err(ApplicationError::ConsistencyDefect {
                    subject: ApplicationConsistencySubjectKind::DomainObject {
                        object: DomainObjectKind::CapabilityAccessReviewFact,
                    },
                    invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::PersistedVersionSymmetry,
                }),
            };
            let identity = match self.identity_repo
                .find_by_id(review.value.capability_identity_id.clone()).await?
            {
                Some(loaded) if loaded.value.capability_identity_id
                    == review.value.capability_identity_id
                    && loaded.expected_version == loaded.value.version => loaded,
                None => return Err(ApplicationError::ConsistencyDefect {
                    subject: ApplicationConsistencySubjectKind::CrossStoreRelation,
                    invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::RequiredSidecar,
                }),
                Some(_) => return Err(ApplicationError::ConsistencyDefect {
                    subject: ApplicationConsistencySubjectKind::CrossStoreRelation,
                    invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::PersistedOwnerRelation,
                }),
            };
            (identity, review)
        }
    };
    if loaded_review.value.capability_identity_id
        != loaded_identity.value.capability_identity_id
    {
        return Err(ApplicationError::ConsistencyDefect {
            subject: ApplicationConsistencySubjectKind::CrossStoreRelation,
            invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::PersistedOwnerRelation,
        });
    }
    let (seam_relation_ref, seam_state) = match self.governance_seam_repo
        .find_current_by_identity(loaded_identity.value.capability_identity_id.clone()).await?
    {
        None => (None, None),
        Some(loaded) if loaded.value.capability_identity_id
            == loaded_identity.value.capability_identity_id
            && loaded.expected_version == loaded.value.version => (
            Some(GovernanceSeamRelationRef::exact(
                loaded.value.governance_seam_relation_id,
                loaded.value.version,
            )),
            Some(loaded.value.seam_state),
        ),
        Some(_) => return Err(ApplicationError::ConsistencyDefect {
            subject: ApplicationConsistencySubjectKind::CrossStoreRelation,
            invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::PersistedOwnerRelation,
        }),
    };

    let body = AccessGovernanceSeparationView {
        identity_ref: CapabilityIdentityRef::exact(
            loaded_identity.value.capability_identity_id,
            loaded_identity.value.version,
        ),
        review_fact_ref: CapabilityAccessReviewFactRef::exact(
            loaded_review.value.review_fact_id,
            loaded_review.value.version,
        ),
        review_state: loaded_review.value.state,
        separation_marker: loaded_review.value.separation_marker,
        seam_relation_ref,
        seam_state,
    };
    Ok(CapabilityQueryResponse {
        query_name: /* exact closed GetAccessGovernanceSeparation name */,
        surface: CapabilityQuerySurface {
            visibility: CapabilityQueryVisibility::Visible,
            freshness: CapabilityQueryFreshness::NotApplicable,
            degraded: vec![],
            source_versions: decision.source_versions,
            evaluated_at: decision.evaluated_at,
        },
        body: Some(body),
    })
}
```

#### 23.2.5 Transaction / no-write boundary

No transaction is opened. Identity、review and seam reads are local truth reads. The optional seam is not dereferenced into governance reference/state/body because this Query explains separation,not seam validity or approval.

#### 23.2.6 Error / rejection mapping

The response proves only that an access-review fact carries `AccessGovernanceSeparationMarker` and whether a separate seam relation exists. It does not say the capability is approved、visible、authorized or executable. All write and external effects are zero.

```rust
        Some(loaded) if loaded.value.reference_subject == reference_subject
            && loaded.value.resolution_state_id == method_ref.resolution_state_id
            && loaded.expected_version == loaded.value.version => loaded.value,
        None => return Err(ApplicationError::ConsistencyDefect {
            subject: ApplicationConsistencySubjectKind::CrossStoreRelation,
            invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::RequiredSidecar,
        }),
        Some(_) => return Err(ApplicationError::ConsistencyDefect {
            subject: ApplicationConsistencySubjectKind::CrossStoreRelation,
            invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::PersistedOwnerRelation,
        }),
    };

    let view = CapabilityMethodRelationView {
        method_relation_ref: CapabilityMethodRelationRef::exact(
            loaded_relation.value.method_relation_id.clone(),
            loaded_relation.value.version.clone(),
        ),
        capability_identity_id: loaded_relation.value.capability_identity_id,
        method_asset_ref_id: method_ref.method_asset_ref_id,
        method_asset_kind: method_ref.method_asset_kind,
        method_library_locator: method_ref.method_library_locator,
        resolution_state_ref: ReferenceResolutionStateRef::exact(
            state.resolution_state_id.clone(), state.version.clone()),
        resolution_value: state.resolution_value.clone(),
        relation_scope: loaded_relation.value.relation_scope,
        relation_state: loaded_relation.value.relation_state,
        version: loaded_relation.value.version,
        created_at: loaded_relation.value.created_at,
        updated_at: loaded_relation.value.updated_at,
    };
    let (visibility, freshness, degraded, body) =
        /* Resolved direct truth;Unresolved/Stale/Unavailable/Expired explicit safe
           degraded body;Invalid/Forbidden redacted body=None. */;
    Ok(CapabilityQueryResponse {
        query_name: /* exact closed GetCapabilityMethodRelation name */,
        surface: CapabilityQuerySurface {
            visibility, freshness, degraded,
            source_versions: decision.source_versions,
            evaluated_at: decision.evaluated_at,
        },
        body,
    })
}
```

#### 23.3.5 Transaction / no-write boundary

No transaction is opened. The pair selector is resolved by identity-current relation equality only;it does not call `list_by_method_asset`,scan method text or query method-library. Canonical state is never refreshed.

#### 23.3.6 Error / rejection mapping

| Branch | Classification |
|---|---|
| malformed selector/ref | `MissingRequiredField / InvalidField` before resolver |
| `NotVisible` | body-free success before target reads |
| visible relation miss or identity-method pair mismatch | `Visible/NotApplicable`,body `None` |
| loaded identity/relation owner/version mismatch | exact `ConsistencyDefect(PersistedOwnerRelation / PersistedVersionSymmetry)` |
| missing/wrong method ref/state union/subject/id/version | exact `ConsistencyDefect(RequiredSidecar / PersistedVariantShape / PersistedOwnerRelation / PersistedVersionSymmetry)` |
| canonical non-resolved state | explicit safe degraded mapping;invalid/forbidden redacted |
| repository/resolver failure | `ApplicationError`;no method-library fallback |

#### 23.3.7 Surface / effects

The body contains only relation truth、body-free method kind/locator and canonical state. It never contains Method Content、TaskDefinition、AIPolicyDef、ProcessTemplateDef、method version body or execution result. All writes and external effects are zero.

#### 23.3.8 Test cuts

1. Exact/current/pair selectors preserve independent branch semantics.
2. Pair endpoint mismatch -> visible body none and no method-only repository search.
3. Missing/wrong method reference union/state id -> exact consistency error and no half body.
4. Resolved reference -> complete twelve-field view;safe non-resolved state remains explicit.
5. Invalid/Forbidden -> redacted body none.
6. Resolver NotVisible/degraded -> identity/relation/ref/state reads zero.
7. Method external resolver/body repository/execution and every write port remain uncalled.

#### 23.3.9 Single-flow stop review

| Gate | Result |
|---|---|
| selector | pass;three explicit branches,no method-only ambiguity |
| pair parity | pass;relation/ref/state exact checks |
| method boundary | pass;locator/kind only,no body/dependency/execution |
| missing/degraded | pass;pair miss remains visible None |
| no-write | pass;zero mutation/external resolver |

Flow status: `completed_in_batch_9_5`.

### 23.4 `query_list_capability_relations_flow`

#### 23.4.1 Entry and target

| Item | Exact contract |
|---|---|
| protocol | `CapabilityQueryRequest<ListCapabilityRelationsQuery>` -> `CapabilityPageResponse<CapabilityRelationView>` |
| entry / service | `CapabilityQueryHandlers::list_capability_relations(...)` -> `CapabilityRelationQueryService::list_capability_relations(...)` |
| read subject | `RelationCollection(identity_ref.id)` from `resolve_relation_history` |
| target reads | exact identity,exactly one selected relation history repository,and selected-family local ref/state pairs |
| non-effect | never calls both relation repositories,merges cursors,loads approval/method body or mutates relation/reference state |

#### 23.4.2 DTO field sources

| Field | Source | Validation / use |
|---|---|---|
| identity ref | exact query field | id forms collection subject;exact ref body validation only after visible decision |
| relation kind | closed `GovernanceSeam` or `MethodRelation` | selects one and only one repository + union variant |
| page cursor/limit | public page request | bind to query + identity + relation kind;one repository cursor only |
| relation item | selected history repository | require identity/version parity and stable repository order |
| ref/state item fields | local typed external-reference repository + current state | complete pair required;safe non-resolved may remain;missing/wrong pair is technical `ConsistencyDefect`;complete Invalid/Forbidden state yields redacted degraded empty/no cursor |

#### 23.4.3 ASCII call graph

```text
handler -> validate identity/kind/page -> from_query
  -> service.assert_query_no_write
  -> RelationCollection(identity.id)
  -> resolve_relation_history -> assert_matches -> decision no-write
     -> NotVisible / resolver Degraded:canonical empty;all target reads zero
     -> Visible:identity.get_with_version
        -> relation kind dispatch exactly once:
           GovernanceSeam -> seam.list_by_identity
           MethodRelation -> method_relation.list_by_identity
        -> preserve page order;for each selected item load matching local ref + state
           -> complete safe pair:exact union item
           -> missing/wrong pair:technical ConsistencyDefect;complete Invalid/Forbidden:redacted degraded empty/no cursor
           -> safe non-resolved:complete item + aggregate degraded surface
        -> wrap one next cursor;count final items;has_more from cursor
```

#### 23.4.4 Rust-style function pseudocode

```rust
async fn list_capability_relations(
    &self,
    context: CapabilityOperationContext,
    query: ListCapabilityRelationsQuery,
) -> Result<CapabilityPageResponse<CapabilityRelationView>, ApplicationError> {
    context.assert_query_no_write()?;
    /* Validate cursor against ListCapabilityRelations + identity id + relation kind. */
    let repository_page = CapabilityRepositoryPageRequest::try_new(
        /* validated application-local cursor */, query.page.limit)?;
    let subject = CapabilityReadSubjectRef::RelationCollection(query.identity_ref.id.clone());
    let resolution = self.visibility_resolver
        .resolve_relation_history(
            &context.actor_context, query.identity_ref.id.clone()).await?;
    resolution.assert_matches(&subject, &context.actor_context)?;
    let decision = resolution.into_decision()?;
    decision.assert_query_no_write(&context)?;
    if decision.is_not_visible() || decision.can_serve_degraded_surface() {
        return Ok(CapabilityPageResponse {
            query_name: /* exact closed ListCapabilityRelations name */,
            surface: /* exact NotVisible or resolver-degraded surface */,
            items: vec![],
            page: CapabilityPublicPageInfo {
                next_cursor: None, returned_count: 0, has_more: false,
            },
        });
    }
    if !decision.can_serve_full_surface() {
        return Err(ApplicationError::TechnicalInvariantViolation {
            object: ApplicationTechnicalObjectKind::ReadVisibilityDecision,
            invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::ReadVisibilityShape,
        });
    }

    let identity = match self.identity_repo
        .get_with_version(query.identity_ref.clone()).await?
    {
        Some(loaded) if loaded.value.capability_identity_id == query.identity_ref.id
            && loaded.expected_version == loaded.value.version => loaded,
        None => return Ok(/* Visible empty page:exact identity absent */),
        Some(_) => return Err(ApplicationError::ConsistencyDefect {
            subject: ApplicationConsistencySubjectKind::DomainObject {
                object: DomainObjectKind::CapabilityIdentity,
            },
            invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::PersistedVersionSymmetry,
        }),
    };
    let identity_id = identity.value.capability_identity_id.clone();

    let (items, next_repository_cursor, has_non_resolved) = match query.relation_kind {
        CapabilityRelationQueryKind::GovernanceSeam => {
            let page = self.governance_seam_repo
                .list_by_identity(identity_id.clone(), repository_page).await?;
            let mut mapped = Vec::with_capacity(page.items.len());
            let mut has_non_resolved = false;
            for loaded in page.items {
                if loaded.value.capability_identity_id != identity_id
                    || loaded.expected_version != loaded.value.version
                {
                    return Err(ApplicationError::ConsistencyDefect {
                        subject: ApplicationConsistencySubjectKind::PortReturn {
                            port: ApplicationPortKind::GovernanceSeamRepository,
                        },
                        invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::RepositoryAccessShape,
                    });
                }
                let subject = ReferenceSubjectRef::GovernanceResult(
                    loaded.value.governance_result_ref_id.clone());
                let reference = match self.external_reference_repo
                    .get_with_version(subject.clone()).await?
                {
                    Some(Loaded {
                        value: CapabilityExternalReference::GovernanceResult(reference),
                        expected_version,
                    }) if reference.governance_result_ref_id
                        == loaded.value.governance_result_ref_id
                        && expected_version == reference.version => reference,
                    None => return Err(ApplicationError::ConsistencyDefect {
                        subject: ApplicationConsistencySubjectKind::CrossStoreRelation,
                        invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::RequiredSidecar,
                    }),
                    Some(_) => return Err(ApplicationError::ConsistencyDefect {
                        subject: ApplicationConsistencySubjectKind::DomainObject {
                            object: DomainObjectKind::GovernanceResultReference,
                        },
                        invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::PersistedVariantShape,
                    }),
                };
                let state = match self.reference_state_repo
                    .find_current_by_subject(subject.clone()).await?
                {
                    Some(state) if state.value.reference_subject == subject
                        && state.value.resolution_state_id == reference.resolution_state_id
                        && state.expected_version == state.value.version => state.value,
                    None => return Err(ApplicationError::ConsistencyDefect {
                        subject: ApplicationConsistencySubjectKind::CrossStoreRelation,
                        invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::RequiredSidecar,
                    }),
                    Some(_) => return Err(ApplicationError::ConsistencyDefect {
                        subject: ApplicationConsistencySubjectKind::CrossStoreRelation,
                        invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::PersistedOwnerRelation,
                    }),
                };
                if matches!(state.resolution_value,
                    ReferenceResolutionValue::Invalid | ReferenceResolutionValue::Forbidden)
                {
                    return Ok(/* Degraded(Redacted) empty/no cursor */);
                }
                has_non_resolved |= state.resolution_value != ReferenceResolutionValue::Resolved;
                mapped.push(CapabilityRelationView::GovernanceSeam(
                    GovernanceSeamRelationView {
                        seam_relation_ref: GovernanceSeamRelationRef::exact(
                            loaded.value.governance_seam_relation_id,
                            loaded.value.version.clone(),
                        ),
                        capability_identity_id: loaded.value.capability_identity_id,
                        governance_result_ref_id: reference.governance_result_ref_id,
                        governance_ref_kind: reference.governance_ref_kind,
                        governance_source: reference.governance_source,
                        result_scope_summary: reference.result_scope_summary,
                        resolution_state_ref: ReferenceResolutionStateRef::exact(
                            state.resolution_state_id, state.version),
                        resolution_value: state.resolution_value,
                        seam_state: loaded.value.seam_state,
                        allowed_safe_summary: loaded.value.allowed_safe_summary,
                        version: loaded.value.version,
                        created_at: loaded.value.created_at,
                        updated_at: loaded.value.updated_at,
                    },
                ));
            }
            (mapped, page.next_cursor, has_non_resolved)
        }
        CapabilityRelationQueryKind::MethodRelation => {
            let page = self.method_relation_repo
                .list_by_identity(identity_id.clone(), repository_page).await?;
            let mut mapped = Vec::with_capacity(page.items.len());
            let mut has_non_resolved = false;
            for loaded in page.items {
                if loaded.value.capability_identity_id != identity_id
                    || loaded.expected_version != loaded.value.version
                {
                    return Err(ApplicationError::ConsistencyDefect {
                        subject: ApplicationConsistencySubjectKind::PortReturn {
                            port: ApplicationPortKind::CapabilityMethodRelationRepository,
                        },
                        invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::RepositoryAccessShape,
                    });
                }
                let subject = ReferenceSubjectRef::MethodAsset(
                    loaded.value.method_asset_ref_id.clone());
                let reference = match self.external_reference_repo
                    .get_with_version(subject.clone()).await?
                {
                    Some(Loaded {
                        value: CapabilityExternalReference::MethodAsset(reference),
                        expected_version,
                    }) if reference.method_asset_ref_id == loaded.value.method_asset_ref_id
                        && expected_version == reference.version => reference,
                    None => return Err(ApplicationError::ConsistencyDefect {
                        subject: ApplicationConsistencySubjectKind::CrossStoreRelation,
                        invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::RequiredSidecar,
                    }),
                    Some(_) => return Err(ApplicationError::ConsistencyDefect {
                        subject: ApplicationConsistencySubjectKind::DomainObject {
                            object: DomainObjectKind::MethodAssetReference,
                        },
                        invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::PersistedVariantShape,
                    }),
                };
                let state = match self.reference_state_repo
                    .find_current_by_subject(subject.clone()).await?
                {
                    Some(state) if state.value.reference_subject == subject
                        && state.value.resolution_state_id == reference.resolution_state_id
                        && state.expected_version == state.value.version => state.value,
                    None => return Err(ApplicationError::ConsistencyDefect {
                        subject: ApplicationConsistencySubjectKind::CrossStoreRelation,
                        invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::RequiredSidecar,
                    }),
                    Some(_) => return Err(ApplicationError::ConsistencyDefect {
                        subject: ApplicationConsistencySubjectKind::CrossStoreRelation,
                        invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::PersistedOwnerRelation,
                    }),
                };
                if matches!(state.resolution_value,
                    ReferenceResolutionValue::Invalid | ReferenceResolutionValue::Forbidden)
                {
                    return Ok(/* Degraded(Redacted) empty/no cursor */);
                }
                has_non_resolved |= state.resolution_value != ReferenceResolutionValue::Resolved;
                mapped.push(CapabilityRelationView::MethodRelation(
                    CapabilityMethodRelationView {
                        method_relation_ref: CapabilityMethodRelationRef::exact(
                            loaded.value.method_relation_id, loaded.value.version.clone()),
                        capability_identity_id: loaded.value.capability_identity_id,
                        method_asset_ref_id: reference.method_asset_ref_id,
                        method_asset_kind: reference.method_asset_kind,
                        method_library_locator: reference.method_library_locator,
                        resolution_state_ref: ReferenceResolutionStateRef::exact(
                            state.resolution_state_id, state.version),
                        resolution_value: state.resolution_value,
                        relation_scope: loaded.value.relation_scope,
                        relation_state: loaded.value.relation_state,
                        version: loaded.value.version,
                        created_at: loaded.value.created_at,
                        updated_at: loaded.value.updated_at,
                    },
                ));
            }
            (mapped, page.next_cursor, has_non_resolved)
        }
    };
    let next_cursor = next_repository_cursor
        .map(|cursor| /* opaque cursor bound to query + identity + relation kind */);
    let returned_count = u32::try_from(items.len())
        .map_err(|_| ApplicationError::ConsistencyDefect {
            subject: ApplicationConsistencySubjectKind::PortReturn {
                port: match query.relation_kind {
                    CapabilityRelationQueryKind::GovernanceSeam =>
                        ApplicationPortKind::GovernanceSeamRepository,
                    CapabilityRelationQueryKind::MethodRelation =>
                        ApplicationPortKind::CapabilityMethodRelationRepository,
                },
            },
            invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::RepositoryAccessShape,
        })?;
    let has_more = next_cursor.is_some();
    Ok(CapabilityPageResponse {
        query_name: /* exact closed ListCapabilityRelations name */,
        surface: if has_non_resolved {
            /* deterministic aggregate Degraded surface from item canonical states;
               Unavailable/Unresolved dominates Stale/Expired;stable first marker order */
        } else {
            CapabilityQuerySurface {
                visibility: CapabilityQueryVisibility::Visible,
                freshness: CapabilityQueryFreshness::NotApplicable,
                degraded: vec![],
                source_versions: decision.source_versions,
                evaluated_at: decision.evaluated_at,
            }
        },
        items,
        page: CapabilityPublicPageInfo { next_cursor, returned_count, has_more },
    })
}
```

The two repository branches are intentionally explicit. A production mapper may factor private pure field mapping inside the same application module,but it may not introduce a generic relation repository、cross-family cursor or partial public item type.

#### 23.4.5 Transaction / no-write boundary

No transaction is opened. Exactly one relation repository page is read. Local reference/state pair reads are sequential in repository order for deterministic failure/marker order and never call external resolvers or mutate stale relation state.

#### 23.4.6 Error / rejection mapping

| Branch | Classification |
|---|---|
| invalid identity/kind/cursor/limit | `InvalidField / InvalidPage` before resolver/list |
| `NotVisible` | canonical empty/no cursor before target reads |
| resolver degraded | explicit degraded empty/no cursor before target reads |
| visible repository empty | normal `Visible` empty,no `Missing` marker |
| loaded identity/item owner/version or family mismatch | exact `ConsistencyDefect(PortReturn, RepositoryAccessShape / PersistedVersionSymmetry)`;no silent drop |
| missing/wrong ref/state pair | exact `ConsistencyDefect(RequiredSidecar / PersistedVariantShape / PersistedOwnerRelation / PersistedVersionSymmetry)`;no half item |
| complete Invalid/Forbidden canonical state | redacted degraded empty/no cursor;this is persisted state,not pair corruption |
| safe non-resolved state | complete item retained;deterministic aggregate degraded surface |
| repository failure | `ApplicationError`;not converted to empty |

#### 23.4.7 Surface / effects

Every page contains one union family only. Cursor、count and order come from that family's repository page. No relation history、reference state、approval/method body or runtime surface is written or refreshed.

#### 23.4.8 Test cuts

1. RelationCollection resolver runs before identity and either list repository.
2. Governance kind calls seam list once and method list zero;method kind does the inverse.
3. Cursor from another identity/kind/query is rejected before list.
4. Visible empty -> visible/no Missing/no cursor/count zero.
5. Wrong owner/family or missing pair in any item -> exact consistency error,no partial prefix/cursor.
6. Safe non-resolved state keeps complete item and produces deterministic aggregate degradation.
7. Complete Invalid/Forbidden state -> redacted empty,no local locator/summary leakage.
8. `returned_count == items.len()` and `has_more == next_cursor.is_some()`.
9. External governance/method resolver、mutation、handoff and collaboration calls remain zero.

#### 23.4.9 Single-flow stop review

| Gate | Result |
|---|---|
| kind-bound repository | pass;exactly one family and one cursor |
| collection visibility | pass;RelationCollection precedes empty/non-empty page |
| complete item schema | pass;no half union item or silent row drop |
| page invariants | pass;stable order、opaque cursor、final count |
| no-write/body boundary | pass;local safe pair reads only |
