### 23.5 `query_get_formal_exposure_boundary_flow`

#### 23.5.1 Entry and target

| Item | Exact contract |
|---|---|
| protocol | `CapabilityQueryRequest<GetFormalExposureBoundaryQuery>` -> `CapabilityQueryResponse<FormalExposureBoundaryView>` |
| entry / service | `CapabilityQueryHandlers::get_formal_exposure_boundary(...)` -> `CapabilityExposureQueryService::get_formal_exposure_boundary(...)` |
| read subject | `Exact` -> `FormalExposure(id)`;registry selector -> `RegistryEntry(id)`;identity selector -> `Identity(id)` |
| target reads | exact/current exposure and optional current visibility;registry/identity exact owner gates only for current selectors |
| non-effect | no exposure establish/suspend/retire、visibility derive/reevaluate、controlled-view refresh、SDK/runtime/listing lookup or write |

#### 23.5.2 DTO field sources

| Field | Source | Validation / use |
|---|---|---|
| selector tag | `FormalExposureQuerySelector` | sole branch authority |
| exact exposure ref | `Exact` payload | exact exposure read after exposure-subject visibility |
| registry ref | `CurrentByRegistryEntry` payload | exact registry validation after registry-subject visibility,then current exposure lookup |
| identity ref | `CurrentByIdentity` payload | exact identity -> current registry -> current exposure,all same owner |
| exposure view fields | loaded `FormalExposureBoundary` | copy persisted snapshot descriptor/seam/method refs exactly;never replace with adjacent current refs |
| optional visibility fields | current `FormalVisibilityApplicability` | require exposure owner、version parity and `source_exposure_version == exposure.version`;Draft may validly have none |

#### 23.5.3 ASCII call graph

```text
handler -> validate selector -> from_query -> service.assert_query_no_write
  -> FormalExposure(id) OR RegistryEntry(id) OR Identity(id)
  -> resolve_subject -> assert_matches -> decision no-write
     -> NotVisible / resolver Degraded:body None;all target reads zero
     -> Visible:
        Exact -> exposure.get_with_version
        CurrentByRegistryEntry -> registry.get_with_version -> exposure.find_current_by_registry_entry
        CurrentByIdentity -> identity.get_with_version
          -> registry.find_current_by_identity -> exposure.find_current_by_registry_entry
        -> visible missing:body None
        -> owner/version parity -> visibility.find_current_by_exposure
          -> Draft + none:valid optional None
          -> non-Draft + none OR owner/source-version mismatch:technical ConsistencyDefect
          -> match:complete formal exposure view with persisted snapshot refs
```

#### 23.5.4 Rust-style function pseudocode

```rust
async fn get_formal_exposure_boundary(
    &self,
    context: CapabilityOperationContext,
    query: GetFormalExposureBoundaryQuery,
) -> Result<CapabilityQueryResponse<FormalExposureBoundaryView>, ApplicationError> {
    context.assert_query_no_write()?;
    let subject = match &query.selector {
        FormalExposureQuerySelector::Exact(exposure_ref) =>
            CapabilityReadSubjectRef::FormalExposure(exposure_ref.id.clone()),
        FormalExposureQuerySelector::CurrentByRegistryEntry(entry_ref) =>
            CapabilityReadSubjectRef::RegistryEntry(entry_ref.id.clone()),
        FormalExposureQuerySelector::CurrentByIdentity(identity_ref) =>
            CapabilityReadSubjectRef::Identity(identity_ref.id.clone()),
    };
    let resolution = self.visibility_resolver
        .resolve_subject(&context.actor_context, subject.clone()).await?;
    resolution.assert_matches(&subject, &context.actor_context)?;
    let decision = resolution.into_decision()?;
    decision.assert_query_no_write(&context)?;
    if decision.is_not_visible() {
        return Ok(/* exact NotVisible response;body=None;zero target reads */);
    }
    if decision.can_serve_degraded_surface() {
        return Ok(/* exact resolver-degraded response;body=None;zero target reads */);
    }
    if !decision.can_serve_full_surface() {
        return Err(ApplicationError::TechnicalInvariantViolation {
            object: ApplicationTechnicalObjectKind::ReadVisibilityDecision,
            invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::ReadVisibilityShape,
        });
    }

    let (loaded_exposure, selected_registry_id) = match query.selector {
        FormalExposureQuerySelector::Exact(exposure_ref) => (
            self.exposure_repo.get_with_version(exposure_ref).await?, None,
        ),
        FormalExposureQuerySelector::CurrentByRegistryEntry(entry_ref) => {
            let entry = match self.registry_repo.get_with_version(entry_ref.clone()).await? {
                Some(loaded) if loaded.value.registry_entry_id == entry_ref.id
                    && loaded.expected_version == loaded.value.version => loaded,
                None => return Ok(/* Visible body=None:entry/exposure absent */),
                Some(_) => return Err(ApplicationError::ConsistencyDefect {
                    subject: ApplicationConsistencySubjectKind::DomainObject {
                        object: DomainObjectKind::CapabilityRegistryEntry,
                    },
                    invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::PersistedVersionSymmetry,
                }),
            };
            let exposure = self.exposure_repo
                .find_current_by_registry_entry(entry.value.registry_entry_id.clone()).await?;
            (exposure, Some(entry.value.registry_entry_id))
        }
        FormalExposureQuerySelector::CurrentByIdentity(identity_ref) => {
            let identity = match self.identity_repo
                .get_with_version(identity_ref.clone()).await?
            {
                Some(loaded) if loaded.value.capability_identity_id == identity_ref.id
                    && loaded.expected_version == loaded.value.version => loaded,
                None => return Ok(/* Visible body=None:identity/exposure absent */),
                Some(_) => return Err(ApplicationError::ConsistencyDefect {
                    subject: ApplicationConsistencySubjectKind::DomainObject {
                        object: DomainObjectKind::CapabilityIdentity,
                    },
                    invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::PersistedVersionSymmetry,
                }),
            };
            let registry = match self.registry_repo
                .find_current_by_identity(identity.value.capability_identity_id.clone()).await?
            {
                Some(loaded) if loaded.value.capability_identity_id
                    == identity.value.capability_identity_id
                    && loaded.expected_version == loaded.value.version => loaded,
                None => return Ok(/* Visible body=None:no current registry/exposure */),
                Some(_) => return Err(ApplicationError::ConsistencyDefect {
                    subject: ApplicationConsistencySubjectKind::CrossStoreRelation,
                    invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::PersistedOwnerRelation,
                }),
            };
            let exposure = self.exposure_repo
                .find_current_by_registry_entry(registry.value.registry_entry_id.clone()).await?;
            (exposure, Some(registry.value.registry_entry_id))
        }
    };
    let exposure = match loaded_exposure {
        Some(loaded) if loaded.expected_version == loaded.value.version => loaded,
        None => return Ok(/* Visible/NotApplicable body=None */),
        Some(_) => return Err(ApplicationError::ConsistencyDefect {
            subject: ApplicationConsistencySubjectKind::DomainObject {
                object: DomainObjectKind::FormalExposureBoundary,
            },
            invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::PersistedVersionSymmetry,
        }),
    };
    if selected_registry_id.as_ref().is_some_and(|registry_id| {
        registry_id != &exposure.value.registry_entry_id
    }) {
        return Err(ApplicationError::ConsistencyDefect {
            subject: ApplicationConsistencySubjectKind::CrossStoreRelation,
            invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::PersistedOwnerRelation,
        });
    }

    let visibility = self.visibility_repo
        .find_current_by_exposure(exposure.value.formal_exposure_id.clone()).await?;
    let (visibility_applicability_id, visibility_state) = match visibility {
        None if exposure.value.exposure_state == FormalExposureState::Draft => (None, None),
        None => return Err(ApplicationError::ConsistencyDefect {
            subject: ApplicationConsistencySubjectKind::CrossStoreRelation,
            invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::RequiredSidecar,
        }),
        Some(loaded) if loaded.value.formal_exposure_id
            == exposure.value.formal_exposure_id
            && loaded.value.source_exposure_version == exposure.value.version
            && loaded.expected_version == loaded.value.version => (
            Some(loaded.value.visibility_applicability_id),
            Some(loaded.value.visibility_state),
        ),
        Some(_) => return Err(ApplicationError::ConsistencyDefect {
            subject: ApplicationConsistencySubjectKind::CrossStoreRelation,
            invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::PersistedVersionSymmetry,
        }),
    };
    let body = FormalExposureBoundaryView {
        exposure_ref: FormalExposureBoundaryRef::exact(
            exposure.value.formal_exposure_id,
            exposure.value.version.clone(),
        ),
        registry_entry_id: exposure.value.registry_entry_id,
        descriptor_ref: exposure.value.descriptor_ref,
        governance_seam_ref: exposure.value.governance_seam_ref,
        method_relation_ref: exposure.value.method_relation_ref,
        exposure_state: exposure.value.exposure_state,
        visibility_applicability_id,
        visibility_state,
        version: exposure.value.version,
        created_at: exposure.value.created_at,
        updated_at: exposure.value.updated_at,
    };
    Ok(CapabilityQueryResponse {
        query_name: /* exact closed GetFormalExposureBoundary name */,
        surface: CapabilityQuerySurface {
            visibility: CapabilityQueryVisibility::Visible,
            freshness: CapabilityQueryFreshness::NotApplicable,
            degraded: vec![],
            source_versions: decision.source_versions,
            evaluated_at: decision.evaluated_at,
        },
        body: Some(body),
    })
}
```

#### 23.5.5 Transaction / no-write boundary

No transaction is opened. Snapshot descriptor/seam/method refs are copied from the exposure revision and are never refreshed to adjacent current truth. A missing or stale visibility fact is reported,not rebuilt.

#### 23.5.6 Error / rejection mapping

| Branch | Classification |
|---|---|
| malformed selector/ref | `MissingRequiredField / InvalidField` before resolver |
| `NotVisible` | body-free success before target reads |
| visible exact/current exposure miss | `Visible/NotApplicable`,body `None` |
| loaded identity/registry/exposure owner or version mismatch | exact `ConsistencyDefect(PersistedOwnerRelation / PersistedVersionSymmetry)` |
| Draft without visibility | complete visible body with optional fields `None` |
| non-Draft missing visibility | exact `ConsistencyDefect(CrossStoreRelation, RequiredSidecar)` |
| loaded visibility owner/source-version mismatch | exact `ConsistencyDefect(CrossStoreRelation, PersistedOwnerRelation / PersistedVersionSymmetry)` |
| repository/resolver failure | `ApplicationError`;no SDK/runtime fallback |

#### 23.5.7 Surface / effects

The response is server-owned exposure truth with optional current visibility explanation. It is not runtime authorization、SDK publication/configuration or marketplace listing. No exposure/visibility/view/material state changes.

#### 23.5.8 Test cuts

1. Three selector branches resolve exact subjects and preserve owner-chain order.
2. Exposure snapshot refs remain stored revisions even when adjacent current objects differ.
3. Draft + no visibility -> visible complete body with two optional fields none.
4. Non-Draft + no visibility -> `ConsistencyDefect(RequiredSidecar)`;stale source exposure version -> `ConsistencyDefect(PersistedVersionSymmetry)`.
5. Current-by-identity with no current registry/exposure -> visible body none.
6. Resolver NotVisible/degraded -> all owner/exposure/visibility reads zero.
7. SDK/runtime/listing/view refresh and every write port remain uncalled.

#### 23.5.9 Single-flow stop review

| Gate | Result |
|---|---|
| selector/owner | pass;exact registry/identity chains explicit |
| snapshot truth | pass;adjacent refs are not silently replaced |
| visibility parity | pass;owner and source exposure version exact |
| authority | pass;formal exposure is not runtime/SDK/listing truth |
| no-write | pass;no derive/repair/refresh |

Flow status: `completed_in_batch_9_5`.

### 23.6 `query_get_formal_visibility_applicability_flow`

#### 23.6.1 Entry and target

| Item | Exact contract |
|---|---|
| protocol | `CapabilityQueryRequest<GetFormalVisibilityApplicabilityQuery>` -> `CapabilityQueryResponse<FormalVisibilityApplicabilityView>` |
| entry / service | `CapabilityQueryHandlers::get_formal_visibility_applicability(...)` -> `CapabilityExposureQueryService::get_formal_visibility_applicability(...)` |

#### 23.6.2 DTO field sources

| Field | Source | Validation / use |
|---|---|---|
| exposure ref | exact query field | resolver subject and exact exposure key;version is read selector only |
| optional consumer ref | closed `CapabilityConsumerRef` | RuntimeTools/SDK pair-read local ref/state;Ecosystem stays typed context ref;never external resolution |
| visibility fields | current `FormalVisibilityApplicability` | require owner and `source_exposure_version == selected exposure.version` |
| requested applicability | optional consumer + pure `visibility.is_consumable_by` | absent -> `NotEvaluated`;true -> `Applicable`;false -> `NotApplicable`,never execution denial |

#### 23.6.3 ASCII call graph

```text
handler -> validate exposure/optional consumer -> from_query
  -> service.assert_query_no_write
  -> resolve_subject(FormalExposure(id)) -> assert_matches -> decision no-write
     -> NotVisible / resolver Degraded:body None;all target reads zero
     -> Visible:exposure.get_with_version
        -> missing:Visible body None
        -> optional consumer:
           RuntimeTools/SDK -> local external ref + mandatory current state parity
           Ecosystem -> typed context only
        -> visibility.find_current_by_exposure
           -> Draft + none:Visible body None
           -> non-Draft + none or owner/source mismatch:technical ConsistencyDefect
           -> match:copy fact + pure consumer applicability explanation
```

#### 23.6.4 Rust-style function pseudocode

```rust
async fn get_formal_visibility_applicability(
    &self,
    context: CapabilityOperationContext,
    query: GetFormalVisibilityApplicabilityQuery,
) -> Result<CapabilityQueryResponse<FormalVisibilityApplicabilityView>, ApplicationError> {
    context.assert_query_no_write()?;
    let subject = CapabilityReadSubjectRef::FormalExposure(query.exposure_ref.id.clone());
    let resolution = self.visibility_resolver
        .resolve_subject(&context.actor_context, subject.clone()).await?;
    resolution.assert_matches(&subject, &context.actor_context)?;
    let decision = resolution.into_decision()?;
    decision.assert_query_no_write(&context)?;
    if decision.is_not_visible() {
        return Ok(/* exact NotVisible response;body=None;zero target reads */);
    }
    if decision.can_serve_degraded_surface() {
        return Ok(/* exact resolver-degraded response;body=None;zero target reads */);
    }
    if !decision.can_serve_full_surface() {
        return Err(ApplicationError::TechnicalInvariantViolation {
            object: ApplicationTechnicalObjectKind::ReadVisibilityDecision,
            invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::ReadVisibilityShape,
        });
    }

    let exposure = match self.exposure_repo
        .get_with_version(query.exposure_ref.clone()).await?
    {
        Some(loaded) if loaded.value.formal_exposure_id == query.exposure_ref.id
            && loaded.expected_version == loaded.value.version => loaded,
        None => return Ok(/* Visible/NotApplicable body=None */),
        Some(_) => return Err(ApplicationError::ConsistencyDefect {
            subject: ApplicationConsistencySubjectKind::DomainObject {
                object: DomainObjectKind::FormalExposureBoundary,
            },
            invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::PersistedVersionSymmetry,
        }),
    };

    let validated_consumer = match query.consumer_ref {
        None => None,
        Some(consumer @ CapabilityConsumerRef::Ecosystem(_)) => Some(consumer),
        Some(consumer @ CapabilityConsumerRef::RuntimeTools(ref_id)) => {
            let reference_subject = ReferenceSubjectRef::RuntimeToolsConsumer(ref_id.clone());
            let reference = match self.external_reference_repo
                .get_with_version(reference_subject.clone()).await?
            {
                Some(Loaded {
                    value: CapabilityExternalReference::RuntimeToolsConsumer(reference),
                    expected_version,
                }) if reference.runtime_tools_consumer_ref_id == ref_id
                    && expected_version == reference.version => reference,
                None => return Ok(/* body=None;typed ReferenceUnavailable:consumer unregistered */),
                Some(_) => return Err(ApplicationError::ConsistencyDefect {
                    subject: ApplicationConsistencySubjectKind::DomainObject {
                        object: DomainObjectKind::RuntimeToolsConsumerReference,
                    },
                    invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::PersistedVariantShape,
                }),
            };
            let state = self.reference_state_repo
                .find_current_by_subject(reference_subject.clone()).await?;
            match state {
                Some(loaded) if loaded.value.reference_subject == reference_subject
                    && loaded.value.resolution_state_id == reference.resolution_state_id
                    && loaded.expected_version == loaded.value.version
                    && loaded.value.resolution_value == ReferenceResolutionValue::Resolved =>
                    Some(consumer),
                Some(loaded) if loaded.value.reference_subject == reference_subject
                    && loaded.value.resolution_state_id == reference.resolution_state_id
                    && loaded.expected_version == loaded.value.version =>
                    return Ok(/* body=None;exact complete-state consumer degradation */),
                None => return Err(ApplicationError::ConsistencyDefect {
                    subject: ApplicationConsistencySubjectKind::CrossStoreRelation,
                    invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::RequiredSidecar,
                }),
                Some(_) => return Err(ApplicationError::ConsistencyDefect {
                    subject: ApplicationConsistencySubjectKind::CrossStoreRelation,
                    invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::PersistedOwnerRelation,
                }),
            }
        }
        Some(consumer @ CapabilityConsumerRef::Sdk(ref_id)) => {
            let reference_subject = ReferenceSubjectRef::SdkConsumer(ref_id.clone());
            let reference = match self.external_reference_repo
                .get_with_version(reference_subject.clone()).await?
            {
                Some(Loaded {
                    value: CapabilityExternalReference::SdkConsumer(reference),
                    expected_version,
                }) if reference.sdk_consumer_ref_id == ref_id
                    && expected_version == reference.version => reference,
                None => return Ok(/* body=None;typed ReferenceUnavailable:consumer unregistered */),
                Some(_) => return Err(ApplicationError::ConsistencyDefect {
                    subject: ApplicationConsistencySubjectKind::DomainObject {
                        object: DomainObjectKind::SdkConsumerReference,
                    },
                    invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::PersistedVariantShape,
                }),
            };
            let state = self.reference_state_repo
                .find_current_by_subject(reference_subject.clone()).await?;
            match state {
                Some(loaded) if loaded.value.reference_subject == reference_subject
                    && loaded.value.resolution_state_id == reference.resolution_state_id
                    && loaded.expected_version == loaded.value.version
                    && loaded.value.resolution_value == ReferenceResolutionValue::Resolved =>
                    Some(consumer),
                Some(loaded) if loaded.value.reference_subject == reference_subject
                    && loaded.value.resolution_state_id == reference.resolution_state_id
                    && loaded.expected_version == loaded.value.version =>
                    return Ok(/* body=None;exact complete-state consumer degradation */),
                None => return Err(ApplicationError::ConsistencyDefect {
                    subject: ApplicationConsistencySubjectKind::CrossStoreRelation,
                    invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::RequiredSidecar,
                }),
                Some(_) => return Err(ApplicationError::ConsistencyDefect {
                    subject: ApplicationConsistencySubjectKind::CrossStoreRelation,
                    invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::PersistedOwnerRelation,
                }),
            }
        }
    };

    let visibility = match self.visibility_repo
        .find_current_by_exposure(exposure.value.formal_exposure_id.clone()).await?
    {
        None if exposure.value.exposure_state == FormalExposureState::Draft =>
            return Ok(/* Visible/NotApplicable body=None */),
        None => return Err(ApplicationError::ConsistencyDefect {
            subject: ApplicationConsistencySubjectKind::CrossStoreRelation,
            invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::RequiredSidecar,
        }),
        Some(loaded) if loaded.value.formal_exposure_id
            == exposure.value.formal_exposure_id
            && loaded.value.source_exposure_version == exposure.value.version
            && loaded.expected_version == loaded.value.version => loaded,
        Some(_) => return Err(ApplicationError::ConsistencyDefect {
            subject: ApplicationConsistencySubjectKind::CrossStoreRelation,
            invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::PersistedVersionSymmetry,
        }),
    };
    let requested_consumer_applicability = match validated_consumer.as_ref() {
        None => CapabilityConsumerApplicabilityView::NotEvaluated,
        Some(consumer) if visibility.value.is_consumable_by(consumer) =>
            CapabilityConsumerApplicabilityView::Applicable,
        Some(_) => CapabilityConsumerApplicabilityView::NotApplicable,
    };
    let body = FormalVisibilityApplicabilityView {
        visibility_applicability_id: visibility.value.visibility_applicability_id,
        exposure_ref: FormalExposureBoundaryRef::exact(
            exposure.value.formal_exposure_id,
            exposure.value.version,
        ),
        visibility_state: visibility.value.visibility_state,
        applicability_scope: visibility.value.applicability_scope,
        basis_summary: visibility.value.basis_summary,
        source_exposure_version: visibility.value.source_exposure_version,
        requested_consumer_applicability,
        version: visibility.value.version,
        created_at: visibility.value.created_at,
        evaluated_at: visibility.value.evaluated_at,
    };
    Ok(CapabilityQueryResponse {
        query_name: /* exact closed GetFormalVisibilityApplicability name */,
        surface: CapabilityQuerySurface {
            visibility: CapabilityQueryVisibility::Visible,
            freshness: CapabilityQueryFreshness::NotApplicable,
            degraded: vec![],
            source_versions: decision.source_versions,
            evaluated_at: decision.evaluated_at,
        },
        body: Some(body),
    })
}
```

#### 23.6.5 Transaction / no-write boundary

No transaction is opened. `is_consumable_by` is a pure member and receives only a validated typed consumer. Local ref/state validation does not invoke external resolution or update canonical state.

#### 23.6.6 Error / rejection mapping

| Branch | Classification |
|---|---|
| malformed exposure/consumer ref | `MissingRequiredField / InvalidField` before or at typed validation |
| `NotVisible` | body-free success before target reads |
| visible exposure miss or Draft without fact | `Visible/NotApplicable`,body `None` |
| non-Draft missing fact | exact `ConsistencyDefect(CrossStoreRelation, RequiredSidecar)` |
| loaded fact owner/source-version mismatch | exact `ConsistencyDefect(CrossStoreRelation, PersistedOwnerRelation / PersistedVersionSymmetry)` |
| unregistered RuntimeTools/SDK ref or complete non-resolved state | typed reference-degraded explanation;no external resolver |
| loaded RuntimeTools/SDK wrong union or missing/mismatched current state | exact `ConsistencyDefect(PersistedVariantShape / RequiredSidecar / PersistedOwnerRelation / PersistedVersionSymmetry)` |
| consumer outside applicability scope | complete body with `NotApplicable`;not runtime denial |
| repository/resolver failure | `ApplicationError`;not business allow/deny |

#### 23.6.7 Surface / effects

The view explains persisted formal visibility and optional server-scope applicability only. `NotApplicable` says the typed consumer is outside the persisted scope;it does not deny a runtime invocation or mutate any allowlist/view/exposure.

#### 23.6.8 Test cuts

1. Resolver runs on FormalExposure before exposure/visibility/consumer ref reads.
2. No consumer -> `NotEvaluated`;inside/outside scope -> `Applicable/NotApplicable`.
3. Unregistered RuntimeTools/SDK ref or complete non-resolved state -> typed degraded;wrong union or state pair inconsistency -> exact consistency error;no external call.
4. Ecosystem typed context performs no external-reference repository read.
5. Draft + no fact -> visible body none;non-Draft + no fact -> `ConsistencyDefect(RequiredSidecar)`.
6. Fact source exposure version mismatch -> `ConsistencyDefect(PersistedVersionSymmetry)`,never reevaluate.
7. Runtime authorization、allowlist、view refresh and all write ports remain uncalled.

#### 23.6.9 Single-flow stop review

| Gate | Result |
|---|---|
| resolver-first | pass;formal exposure subject direct from request |
| fact parity | pass;owner/source exposure version exact |
| consumer validation | pass;local ref/state only for external consumer variants |
| authority | pass;applicability is not execution denial |
| no-write | pass;pure member only,no reevaluation/refresh |

Flow status: `completed_in_batch_9_5`.

### 23.7 `query_get_controlled_consumer_view_flow`

#### 23.7.1 Entry and target

| Item | Exact contract |
|---|---|
| protocol | `CapabilityQueryRequest<GetControlledConsumerViewQuery>` -> `CapabilityQueryResponse<ControlledConsumerViewView>` |

| non-effect | no view refresh、stale/rebuilding mutation、formal exposure mutation、runtime invocation、SDK generation or Job invocation |

#### 23.7.2 DTO field sources

| Field | Source | Validation / use |
|---|---|---|
| selector tag | closed `ControlledConsumerViewQuerySelector` | sole branch authority;route or nullable payload never reselects the branch |
| exact view ref | `Exact` payload | forms `ConsumerView(id)` and exact repository key;requested version,when present,must equal the loaded view revision |
| exposure ref | pair payload | forms `FormalExposure(id)`;after visibility,exact loaded id/version gates pair lookup |
| consumer ref | pair payload | RuntimeTools / SDK pair-read their local typed ref and canonical state;Ecosystem remains a typed body-free context ref |
| response fields | loaded `ControlledConsumerView` | copy all nine declared fields exactly after view id/exposure/consumer/version parity |
| surface freshness | persisted `view.freshness_state` only | never compare `created_at` / `refreshed_at` with request time and never recompute source versions |

#### 23.7.3 ASCII call graph

```text
handler -> validate route/name/schema/selector -> from_query
  -> exposure service.assert_query_no_write
  -> ConsumerView(id) OR FormalExposure(id)
  -> resolve_subject -> assert_matches -> into_decision -> decision no-write
     -> NotVisible:body None;all target reads zero
     -> resolver Degraded:body None;all target reads zero
     -> Visible:
        Exact -> controlled_view.get_with_version
        ExposureAndConsumer -> exposure.get_with_version
          -> validate RuntimeTools/SDK local ref + canonical state when applicable
          -> controlled_view.find_current_by_exposure_and_consumer
        -> missing:Visible body None
        -> owner/audience/version mismatch:technical ConsistencyDefect
        -> map persisted freshness:
           Ready -> Visible/Fresh + body
           Stale -> Degraded/StaleReadable + body
           Rebuilding -> Degraded/Rebuilding + no body
           Unavailable -> Degraded/Unavailable + no body
           Partial -> Degraded/StaleReadable + Partial + body
```

#### 23.7.4 Rust-style function pseudocode

```rust
async fn get_controlled_consumer_view(
    &self,
    context: CapabilityOperationContext,
    query: GetControlledConsumerViewQuery,
) -> Result<CapabilityQueryResponse<ControlledConsumerViewView>, ApplicationError> {
    context.assert_query_no_write()?;
    let subject = match &query.selector {
        ControlledConsumerViewQuerySelector::Exact(view_ref) =>
            CapabilityReadSubjectRef::ConsumerView(view_ref.id.clone()),
        ControlledConsumerViewQuerySelector::ExposureAndConsumer {
            exposure_ref, ..
        } => CapabilityReadSubjectRef::FormalExposure(exposure_ref.id.clone()),
    };
    let resolution = self.visibility_resolver
        .resolve_subject(&context.actor_context, subject.clone()).await?;
    resolution.assert_matches(&subject, &context.actor_context)?;
    let decision = resolution.into_decision()?;
    decision.assert_query_no_write(&context)?;
    if decision.is_not_visible() {
        return Ok(/* exact NotVisible response;body=None;zero target reads */);
    }
    if decision.can_serve_degraded_surface() {
        return Ok(/* exact resolver-degraded response;body=None;zero target reads */);
    }
    if !decision.can_serve_full_surface() {
        return Err(ApplicationError::TechnicalInvariantViolation {
            object: ApplicationTechnicalObjectKind::ReadVisibilityDecision,
            invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::ReadVisibilityShape,
        });
    }

    let loaded_view = match &query.selector {
        ControlledConsumerViewQuerySelector::Exact(view_ref) => {
            match self.controlled_view_repo.get_with_version(view_ref.clone()).await? {
                Some(loaded) if loaded.value.consumer_view_id == view_ref.id
                    && view_ref.version.as_ref().is_none_or(
                        |version| version == &loaded.value.version)
                    && loaded.expected_version == loaded.value.version => Some(loaded),
                None => None,
                Some(_) => return Err(ApplicationError::ConsistencyDefect {
                    subject: ApplicationConsistencySubjectKind::DomainObject {
                        object: DomainObjectKind::ControlledConsumerView,
                    },
                    invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::PersistedVersionSymmetry,
                }),
            }
        }
        ControlledConsumerViewQuerySelector::ExposureAndConsumer {
            exposure_ref,
            consumer_ref,
        } => {
            let exposure = match self.exposure_repo
                .get_with_version(exposure_ref.clone()).await?
            {
                Some(loaded) if loaded.value.formal_exposure_id == exposure_ref.id
                    && exposure_ref.version.as_ref().is_none_or(
                        |version| version == &loaded.value.version)
                    && loaded.expected_version == loaded.value.version => loaded,
                None => return Ok(/* Visible body=None:exposure/view absent */),
                Some(_) => return Err(ApplicationError::ConsistencyDefect {
                    subject: ApplicationConsistencySubjectKind::DomainObject {
                        object: DomainObjectKind::FormalExposureBoundary,
                    },
                    invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::PersistedVersionSymmetry,
                }),
            };

            match &consumer_ref {
                CapabilityConsumerRef::Ecosystem(_) => {}
                CapabilityConsumerRef::RuntimeTools(ref_id) => {
                    let reference_subject =
                        ReferenceSubjectRef::RuntimeToolsConsumer(ref_id.clone());
                    let reference = match self.external_reference_repo
                        .get_with_version(reference_subject.clone()).await?
                    {
                        Some(Loaded {
                            value: CapabilityExternalReference::RuntimeToolsConsumer(reference),
                            expected_version,
                        }) if &reference.runtime_tools_consumer_ref_id == ref_id
                            && expected_version == reference.version => reference,
                        None => return Ok(/* body=None;typed ReferenceUnavailable:consumer unregistered */),
                        Some(_) => return Err(ApplicationError::ConsistencyDefect {
                            subject: ApplicationConsistencySubjectKind::DomainObject {
                                object: DomainObjectKind::RuntimeToolsConsumerReference,
                            },
                            invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::PersistedVariantShape,
                        }),
                    };
                    match self.reference_state_repo
                        .find_current_by_subject(reference_subject.clone()).await?
                    {
                        Some(state) if state.value.reference_subject == reference_subject
                            && state.value.resolution_state_id == reference.resolution_state_id
                            && state.expected_version == state.value.version
                            && state.value.resolution_value
                                == ReferenceResolutionValue::Resolved => {}
                        Some(state) if state.value.reference_subject == reference_subject
                            && state.value.resolution_state_id == reference.resolution_state_id
                            && state.expected_version == state.value.version =>
                            return Ok(/* body=None;exact complete-state reference degradation */),
                        None => return Err(ApplicationError::ConsistencyDefect {
                            subject: ApplicationConsistencySubjectKind::CrossStoreRelation,
                            invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::RequiredSidecar,
                        }),
                        Some(_) => return Err(ApplicationError::ConsistencyDefect {
                            subject: ApplicationConsistencySubjectKind::CrossStoreRelation,
                            invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::PersistedOwnerRelation,
                        }),
                    }
                }
                CapabilityConsumerRef::Sdk(ref_id) => {
                    let reference_subject = ReferenceSubjectRef::SdkConsumer(ref_id.clone());
                    let reference = match self.external_reference_repo
                        .get_with_version(reference_subject.clone()).await?
                    {
                        Some(Loaded {
                            value: CapabilityExternalReference::SdkConsumer(reference),
                            expected_version,
                        }) if &reference.sdk_consumer_ref_id == ref_id
                            && expected_version == reference.version => reference,
                        None => return Ok(/* body=None;typed ReferenceUnavailable:consumer unregistered */),
                        Some(_) => return Err(ApplicationError::ConsistencyDefect {
                            subject: ApplicationConsistencySubjectKind::DomainObject {
                                object: DomainObjectKind::SdkConsumerReference,
                            },
                            invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::PersistedVariantShape,
                        }),
                    };
                    match self.reference_state_repo
                        .find_current_by_subject(reference_subject.clone()).await?
                    {
                        Some(state) if state.value.reference_subject == reference_subject
                            && state.value.resolution_state_id == reference.resolution_state_id
                            && state.expected_version == state.value.version
                            && state.value.resolution_value
                                == ReferenceResolutionValue::Resolved => {}
                        Some(state) if state.value.reference_subject == reference_subject
                            && state.value.resolution_state_id == reference.resolution_state_id
                            && state.expected_version == state.value.version =>
                            return Ok(/* body=None;exact complete-state reference degradation */),
                        None => return Err(ApplicationError::ConsistencyDefect {
                            subject: ApplicationConsistencySubjectKind::CrossStoreRelation,
                            invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::RequiredSidecar,
                        }),
                        Some(_) => return Err(ApplicationError::ConsistencyDefect {
                            subject: ApplicationConsistencySubjectKind::CrossStoreRelation,
                            invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::PersistedOwnerRelation,

                    }
                }
            }

            self.controlled_view_repo.find_current_by_exposure_and_consumer(
                exposure.value.formal_exposure_id,
                consumer_ref.clone(),
            ).await?
        }
    };
    let view = match loaded_view {
        None => return Ok(/* Visible body=None:no exact/current persisted view */),
        Some(loaded) if loaded.expected_version == loaded.value.version => loaded.value,
        Some(_) => return Err(ApplicationError::ConsistencyDefect {
            subject: ApplicationConsistencySubjectKind::DomainObject {
                object: DomainObjectKind::ControlledConsumerView,
            },
            invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::PersistedVersionSymmetry,
        }),
    };
    if let ControlledConsumerViewQuerySelector::ExposureAndConsumer {
        exposure_ref,
        consumer_ref,
    } = &query.selector
    {
        if view.formal_exposure_id != exposure_ref.id || &view.consumer_ref != consumer_ref {
            return Err(ApplicationError::ConsistencyDefect {
                subject: ApplicationConsistencySubjectKind::DomainObject {
                    object: DomainObjectKind::ControlledConsumerView,
                },
                invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::PersistedOwnerRelation,

    let body = ControlledConsumerViewView {
        consumer_view_ref: ControlledConsumerViewRef::exact(
            view.consumer_view_id, view.version.clone()),
        formal_exposure_id: view.formal_exposure_id,
        consumer_ref: view.consumer_ref,
        descriptor_summary: view.descriptor_summary,
        source_versions: view.source_versions,
        freshness_state: view.freshness_state.clone(),
        version: view.version,
        created_at: view.created_at,
        refreshed_at: view.refreshed_at,
    };
    let (visibility, freshness, degraded, body) = match body.freshness_state.clone() {
        ConsumerViewFreshnessState::Ready => (
            CapabilityQueryVisibility::Visible,
            CapabilityQueryFreshness::Fresh,
            vec![], Some(body),
        ),
        ConsumerViewFreshnessState::Stale => (
            CapabilityQueryVisibility::Degraded,
            CapabilityQueryFreshness::StaleReadable,
            vec![/* StaleSource marker + protocol-safe issue ref */], Some(body),
        ),
        ConsumerViewFreshnessState::Rebuilding => (
            CapabilityQueryVisibility::Degraded,
            CapabilityQueryFreshness::Rebuilding,
            vec![/* Rebuilding marker + protocol-safe issue ref */], None,
        ),
        ConsumerViewFreshnessState::Unavailable => (
            CapabilityQueryVisibility::Degraded,
            CapabilityQueryFreshness::Unavailable,
            vec![/* derived-view unavailable marker + protocol-safe issue ref */], None,
        ),
        ConsumerViewFreshnessState::Partial => (
            CapabilityQueryVisibility::Degraded,
            CapabilityQueryFreshness::StaleReadable,
            vec![/* Partial marker + protocol-safe issue ref */], Some(body),
        ),
    };
    Ok(CapabilityQueryResponse {
        query_name: /* exact closed GetControlledConsumerView name */,
        surface: CapabilityQuerySurface {
            visibility,
            freshness,
            degraded,
            source_versions: decision.source_versions,
            evaluated_at: decision.evaluated_at,
        },
        body,
    })
}
```

`Option::is_none_or` is schematic shorthand for an explicit optional-version equality match. It does not add a contract helper. The two local consumer branches may share a private application mapper,but they may not call an external resolver or hide union/state parity.

#### 23.7.5 Transaction / no-write boundary

No transaction is opened. Pair selection reads exact exposure and,for registered external consumer variants,local body-free ref/state before the current view. The service never calls `ConsumerViewFreshnessPolicy::evaluate_freshness`,because Query must expose the persisted freshness state rather than recalculate or persist it.

#### 23.7.6 Error / rejection mapping

| Branch | Classification |
|---|---|
| malformed selector/ref | `MissingRequiredField / InvalidField` before resolver |
| `NotVisible` | body-free success before all target reads |
| resolver degraded | body-free degraded success before all target reads |
| visible exact/exposure/view miss | `Visible` with `body=None` |
| loaded view id/version/exposure/audience mismatch | exact `ConsistencyDefect(DomainObject(ControlledConsumerView), PersistedOwnerRelation / PersistedVersionSymmetry)`;never return another consumer's view |
| unregistered RuntimeTools/SDK ref or complete non-resolved state | typed reference degradation,no external call |
| loaded consumer wrong union or missing/mismatched current state | exact `ConsistencyDefect(PersistedVariantShape / RequiredSidecar / PersistedOwnerRelation / PersistedVersionSymmetry)` |
| Ready / Stale / Rebuilding / Unavailable / Partial | exact persisted-state mapping shown above;timestamps ignored |
| repository/resolver failure | `ApplicationError`;not converted to missing or stale |

#### 23.7.7 Surface / effects

The response is a body-free server-side snapshot,not a runtime permission or SDK client cache. Stale and policy-allowed Partial snapshots remain explicitly readable;Rebuilding and Unavailable suppress the body. No branch changes the view、exposure、consumer reference or canonical state.

#### 23.7.8 Test cuts

1. Exact selector resolves `ConsumerView(id)` before view repository access.
2. Pair selector resolves `FormalExposure(id)` before exposure、consumer ref/state or view reads.
3. Visible exact/current miss returns `Visible body=None`;NotVisible and resolver-degraded remain distinct.
4. RuntimeTools/SDK unregistered or complete non-resolved state returns typed degraded;wrong union or state-pair inconsistency returns exact consistency error;no external resolver.
5. Pair lookup returning another exposure or consumer produces exact consistency error.
6. Five persisted freshness values map exactly to the five declared surface branches.
7. Changing only `created_at` / `refreshed_at` does not change freshness output.
8. Stale / Partial may carry only the declared body-free snapshot;Rebuilding / Unavailable carry no body.
9. UoW、save/append、freshness policy、view mutation、Job、runtime and SDK generation call counts remain zero.

| resolver-first | pass;no target repository precedes the decision |
| audience parity | pass;pair view and local external consumer variants are exact |
| freshness authority | pass;persisted enum only,no timestamp inference |
| struct comments | pass;no new struct/field;all instantiated view fields already have English Rustdoc |

### 23.8 `query_list_consumable_capabilities_for_runtime_tools_flow`

#### 23.8.1 Entry and target

| Item | Exact contract |
|---|---|
| protocol | `CapabilityQueryRequest<ListConsumableCapabilitiesForRuntimeToolsQuery>` -> `CapabilityPageResponse<ControlledConsumerViewView>` |
| entry / service | `CapabilityQueryHandlers::list_consumable_capabilities_for_runtime_tools(...)` -> `CapabilityExposureQueryService::list_consumable_capabilities_for_runtime_tools(...)` |
| read subject | `ConsumerViewCollection(CapabilityConsumerRef::RuntimeTools(id))` from `resolve_controlled_view_list(actor,&scope)` |
| target reads | local RuntimeTools ref/current state,optional exact exposure refs,and one controlled-view repository page |
| non-effect | no runtime/tools invocation、provider lookup、allowlist decision/mutation、view refresh、Job start or external resolver |

#### 23.8.2 DTO field sources

| Field | Source | Validation / use |
|---|---|---|
| runtime consumer id | typed query field | forms both `CapabilityConsumerRef::RuntimeTools(id)` and `ReferenceSubjectRef::RuntimeToolsConsumer(id)`;never parsed from locator text |
| exposure scope tag | `AllForConsumer` or `ExplicitExposures` | all -> `scope.exposure_ids=[]`;explicit -> non-empty stable duplicate-free ids;does not consult runtime allowlists |
| exact exposure versions | each explicit `FormalExposureBoundaryRef` | retained in cursor binding and exact-validated after page visibility;repository scope receives only the validated ids |
| freshness states | query vector | closed、canonical and duplicate-free;empty means all query-visible persisted states |
| page cursor/limit | public page request | bind to query + consumer + complete exposure refs + freshness vector;map once to repository page |
| page items | `ControlledConsumerViewRepository::list_matching` | require loaded version、exact RuntimeTools audience、exposure scope and freshness-filter parity before field mapping |
| aggregate surface | persisted item `freshness_state` values | `Unavailable > Rebuilding > Stale/Partial > Ready`;timestamps and repository latency never participate |

#### 23.8.3 ASCII call graph

```text
handler -> validate route/name/schema/scope/filter/page -> from_query
  -> exposure service.assert_query_no_write
  -> CapabilityControlledViewRepositoryListScope(RuntimeTools consumer,ids,states)
  -> resolve_controlled_view_list(scope)
     -> assert ConsumerViewCollection(consumer)/actor -> decision no-write
     -> NotVisible / resolver Degraded:canonical empty/no cursor;all target reads zero
     -> Visible:
        external_reference.get_with_version(RuntimeToolsConsumer(id))
        -> reference_state.find_current_by_subject
           -> unregistered/complete non-resolved:typed degraded empty/no cursor
           -> missing current state/wrong pair:technical ConsistencyDefect
        -> ExplicitExposures only:exposure.get_with_version for each ref in request order
           -> any missing:no-match visible empty;loaded id/version mismatch:technical ConsistencyDefect
        -> controlled_view.list_matching(scope,page)
           -> each item exact consumer/exposure/filter/version parity
           -> any bad item:technical ConsistencyDefect;no partial prefix
           -> map every complete body-free snapshot in repository order
        -> aggregate persisted states:
           any Unavailable -> Degraded/Unavailable
           else any Rebuilding -> Degraded/Rebuilding
           else any Stale/Partial -> Degraded/StaleReadable
           else Visible/Fresh
        -> opaque cursor;count final items;has_more from cursor
```

#### 23.8.4 Rust-style function pseudocode

```rust
async fn list_consumable_capabilities_for_runtime_tools(
    &self,
    context: CapabilityOperationContext,
    query: ListConsumableCapabilitiesForRuntimeToolsQuery,
) -> Result<CapabilityPageResponse<ControlledConsumerViewView>, ApplicationError> {
    context.assert_query_no_write()?;
    /* Validate freshness states as closed,canonical and duplicate-free. */
    let consumer_ref =
        CapabilityConsumerRef::RuntimeTools(query.runtime_tools_consumer_ref_id.clone());
    let explicit_exposure_refs = match &query.exposure_scope {
        CapabilityConsumerExposureQueryScope::AllForConsumer => vec![],
        CapabilityConsumerExposureQueryScope::ExplicitExposures(refs) => {
            if refs.is_empty() {
                return Err(/* InvalidField before resolver */);
            }
            for (index, exposure_ref) in refs.iter().enumerate() {
                /* Validate the typed ref shape at entry/application boundary. */
                if refs[..index].iter().any(
                    |seen| seen.id == exposure_ref.id)
                {
                    return Err(/* InvalidField:duplicate explicit exposure id */);
                }
            }
            refs.clone()
        }
    };
    let scope = CapabilityControlledViewRepositoryListScope {
        consumer_ref: consumer_ref.clone(),
        exposure_ids: explicit_exposure_refs.iter()
            .map(|exposure_ref| exposure_ref.id.clone())
            .collect(),
        freshness_states: query.freshness_states.clone(),
    };
    /* Bind cursor to this query,consumer,the complete exact exposure refs and states. */
    let repository_page = CapabilityRepositoryPageRequest::try_new(
        /* validated application-local cursor */, query.page.limit)?;
    let subject = CapabilityReadSubjectRef::ConsumerViewCollection(consumer_ref.clone());
    let resolution = self.visibility_resolver
        .resolve_controlled_view_list(&context.actor_context, &scope).await?;
    resolution.assert_matches(&subject, &context.actor_context)?;
    let decision = resolution.into_decision()?;
    decision.assert_query_no_write(&context)?;
    if decision.is_not_visible() || decision.can_serve_degraded_surface() {
        return Ok(CapabilityPageResponse {
            query_name: /* exact closed ListConsumableCapabilitiesForRuntimeTools name */,
            surface: /* exact NotVisible or resolver-degraded decision surface */,
            items: vec![],
            page: CapabilityPublicPageInfo {
                next_cursor: None, returned_count: 0, has_more: false,
            },
        });
    }
    if !decision.can_serve_full_surface() {
        return Err(ApplicationError::TechnicalInvariantViolation {
            object: ApplicationTechnicalObjectKind::ReadVisibilityDecision,
            invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::ReadVisibilityShape,
        });
    }

    let reference_subject = ReferenceSubjectRef::RuntimeToolsConsumer(
        query.runtime_tools_consumer_ref_id.clone());
    let runtime_consumer = match self.external_reference_repo
        .get_with_version(reference_subject.clone()).await?
    {
        Some(Loaded {
            value: CapabilityExternalReference::RuntimeToolsConsumer(reference),
            expected_version,
        }) if reference.runtime_tools_consumer_ref_id
                == query.runtime_tools_consumer_ref_id
            && expected_version == reference.version => reference,
        None => return Ok(/* exact ReferenceUnavailable empty/no cursor:consumer unregistered */),
        Some(_) => return Err(ApplicationError::ConsistencyDefect {
            subject: ApplicationConsistencySubjectKind::DomainObject {
                object: DomainObjectKind::RuntimeToolsConsumerReference,
            },
            invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::PersistedVariantShape,
        }),
    };
    let runtime_state = match self.reference_state_repo
        .find_current_by_subject(reference_subject.clone()).await?
    {
        Some(loaded) if loaded.value.reference_subject == reference_subject
            && loaded.value.resolution_state_id == runtime_consumer.resolution_state_id
            && loaded.expected_version == loaded.value.version => loaded.value,
        None => return Err(ApplicationError::ConsistencyDefect {
            subject: ApplicationConsistencySubjectKind::CrossStoreRelation,
            invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::RequiredSidecar,
        }),
        Some(_) => return Err(ApplicationError::ConsistencyDefect {
            subject: ApplicationConsistencySubjectKind::CrossStoreRelation,
            invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::PersistedOwnerRelation,
        }),
    };
    if runtime_state.resolution_value != ReferenceResolutionValue::Resolved {
        return Ok(/* exact state-mapped degraded empty/no cursor;no view list */);
    }

    for exposure_ref in &explicit_exposure_refs {
        match self.exposure_repo.get_with_version(exposure_ref.clone()).await? {
            Some(loaded) if loaded.value.formal_exposure_id == exposure_ref.id
                && exposure_ref.version.as_ref().is_none_or(
                    |version| version == &loaded.value.version)
                && loaded.expected_version == loaded.value.version => {}
            None => return Ok(/* Visible empty/no cursor:explicit exposure has no match */),
            Some(_) => return Err(ApplicationError::ConsistencyDefect {
                subject: ApplicationConsistencySubjectKind::DomainObject {
                    object: DomainObjectKind::FormalExposureBoundary,
                },
                invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::PersistedVersionSymmetry,
            }),
        }
    }

    let page = self.controlled_view_repo
        .list_matching(scope, repository_page).await?;
    let mut items = Vec::with_capacity(page.items.len());
    let mut has_stale = false;
    let mut has_partial = false;
    let mut has_rebuilding = false;
    let mut has_unavailable = false;
    for loaded in page.items {
        let view = loaded.value;
        let exposure_matches = explicit_exposure_refs.is_empty()
            || explicit_exposure_refs.iter().any(
                |exposure_ref| exposure_ref.id == view.formal_exposure_id);
        let freshness_matches = query.freshness_states.is_empty()
            || query.freshness_states.contains(&view.freshness_state);
        if loaded.expected_version != view.version
            || view.consumer_ref != consumer_ref
            || !exposure_matches
            || !freshness_matches
        {
            return Err(ApplicationError::ConsistencyDefect {
                subject: ApplicationConsistencySubjectKind::PortReturn {
                    port: ApplicationPortKind::ControlledConsumerViewRepository,
                },
                invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::RepositoryAccessShape,
            });
        }
        match view.freshness_state.clone() {
            ConsumerViewFreshnessState::Ready => {}
            ConsumerViewFreshnessState::Stale => has_stale = true,
            ConsumerViewFreshnessState::Partial => has_partial = true,
            ConsumerViewFreshnessState::Rebuilding => has_rebuilding = true,
            ConsumerViewFreshnessState::Unavailable => has_unavailable = true,
        }
        items.push(ControlledConsumerViewView {
            consumer_view_ref: ControlledConsumerViewRef::exact(
                view.consumer_view_id, view.version.clone()),
            formal_exposure_id: view.formal_exposure_id,
            consumer_ref: view.consumer_ref,
            descriptor_summary: view.descriptor_summary,
            source_versions: view.source_versions,
            freshness_state: view.freshness_state,
            version: view.version,
            created_at: view.created_at,
            refreshed_at: view.refreshed_at,
        });
    }
    let stale_partial_degraded = /* map categories that are present to
        StaleSource then Partial markers,each with a Step 12 issue ref */;
    let (visibility, freshness, degraded) = if has_unavailable {
        (CapabilityQueryVisibility::Degraded,
         CapabilityQueryFreshness::Unavailable,
         vec![/* exact Step 12 marker for persisted unavailable view state */])
    } else if has_rebuilding {
        (CapabilityQueryVisibility::Degraded,
         CapabilityQueryFreshness::Rebuilding,
         vec![/* Rebuilding marker + protocol-safe issue ref */])
    } else if has_stale || has_partial {
        (CapabilityQueryVisibility::Degraded,
         CapabilityQueryFreshness::StaleReadable,
         stale_partial_degraded)
    } else {
        (CapabilityQueryVisibility::Visible,
         CapabilityQueryFreshness::Fresh,
         vec![])
    };
    let next_cursor = page.next_cursor.map(
        |cursor| /* opaque cursor bound to query + complete stable scope */);
    let returned_count = u32::try_from(items.len())
        .map_err(|_| ApplicationError::ConsistencyDefect {
            subject: ApplicationConsistencySubjectKind::PortReturn {
                port: ApplicationPortKind::ControlledConsumerViewRepository,
            },
            invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::RepositoryAccessShape,
        })?;
    let has_more = next_cursor.is_some();
    Ok(CapabilityPageResponse {
        query_name: /* exact closed ListConsumableCapabilitiesForRuntimeTools name */,
        surface: CapabilityQuerySurface {
            visibility,
            freshness,
            degraded,
            source_versions: decision.source_versions,
            evaluated_at: decision.evaluated_at,
        },
        items,
        page: CapabilityPublicPageInfo { next_cursor, returned_count, has_more },
    })
}
```

`Option::is_none_or` is schematic optional-version matching,not a new helper. The final unavailable marker's exact issue-ref/category construction remains the Step 12 mapper responsibility;the branch and `Unavailable` freshness are already fixed here. Complete persisted items remain body-free diagnostic snapshots and never imply execution permission.

#### 23.8.5 Transaction / no-write boundary

No transaction is opened. Scope construction、cursor validation、state aggregation and field mapping are pure. The only page read is `list_matching`;consumer and explicit-exposure checks are local exact reads. No item is refreshed、marked or filtered by current time.

#### 23.8.6 Error / rejection mapping

| Branch | Classification |
|---|---|
| empty/duplicate explicit exposure refs、duplicate/unknown freshness、invalid page | `InvalidField / InvalidPage` before resolver |
| `NotVisible` | canonical empty/no cursor before consumer/exposure/view reads |
| resolver degraded | explicit degraded empty/no cursor before target reads |
| unregistered RuntimeTools ref or complete non-resolved state | state-mapped degraded empty/no cursor;no list |
| loaded RuntimeTools wrong union or missing/mismatched state | exact `ConsistencyDefect(PersistedVariantShape / RequiredSidecar / PersistedOwnerRelation / PersistedVersionSymmetry)` |
| missing exact explicit exposure ref | normal visible empty/no cursor;no list and no silent scope narrowing |
| loaded explicit exposure id/version mismatch | exact `ConsistencyDefect(DomainObject(FormalExposureBoundary), PersistedVersionSymmetry)` |
| visible repository empty | normal `Visible/Fresh` empty page |
| item audience/exposure/filter/version mismatch | exact `ConsistencyDefect(PortReturn(ControlledConsumerViewRepository), RepositoryAccessShape)`;no partial prefix or row drop |
| complete item non-Ready states | all complete items retained;page surface uses fixed persisted-state priority |
| repository/resolver failure | `ApplicationError`;not converted to empty |

#### 23.8.7 Surface / effects

The page reports stored controlled snapshots for one registered RuntimeTools boundary. `AllForConsumer` means all stored views for that consumer,not all capabilities the runtime may invoke. Explicit exposure scope is request-owned and exact-validated. Item state and page degradation explain material freshness only;they neither grant nor deny runtime/tools execution.

#### 23.8.8 Test cuts

1. `CapabilityControlledViewRepositoryListScope` is complete before resolver invocation.
2. `resolve_controlled_view_list` precedes every consumer ref/state、exposure and view repository call.
3. NotVisible/resolver-degraded -> all target call counts zero and canonical empty/no cursor.
4. Unregistered Runtime ref or complete non-resolved state -> typed degraded empty;wrong union or state-pair inconsistency -> exact consistency error;list count zero.
5. All-for-consumer maps to empty exposure-id scope without allowlist/provider reads.
6. Explicit refs preserve order,are duplicate-free and are exact-validated after resolver;missing ref returns normal empty while loaded mismatch returns exact consistency error.
7. Any bad item audience/exposure/filter/version returns exact consistency error;no partial prefix or silent drop.
8. Mixed complete items preserve repository order and aggregate `Unavailable > Rebuilding > Stale/Partial > Ready` from enums only.
9. `returned_count == items.len()` and `has_more == next_cursor.is_some()`;all write/runtime/external-resolver calls remain zero.

| Gate | Result |
|---|---|
| collection resolver | pass;scope exists before any body/page read |
| local consumer pair | pass;typed ref + canonical state,Resolved required |
| explicit scope | pass;exact refs validated without widening/narrowing |
| page integrity | pass;bad item clears page,complete items retain stable order |
| authority | pass;stored view page is not runtime allow/deny |
| struct comments | pass;no new struct/field;scope and public view fields have upstream English Rustdoc |

### 23.9 `query_get_sdk_exposure_boundary_flow`

#### 23.9.1 Entry and target

| Item | Exact contract |
|---|---|
| protocol | `CapabilityQueryRequest<GetSdkExposureBoundaryQuery>` -> `CapabilityQueryResponse<SdkExposureBoundaryView>` |
| entry / service | `CapabilityQueryHandlers::get_sdk_exposure_boundary(...)` -> `CapabilityExposureQueryService::get_sdk_exposure_boundary(...)` |
| read subjects | first `ExternalReference(SdkConsumer(id))`,then `FormalExposure(exposure_ref.id)`;both decisions precede every body repository read |

#### 23.9.2 DTO field sources

| Field | Source | Validation / use |
|---|---|---|
| SDK consumer id | typed query field | forms SDK reference subject、repository key and `CapabilityConsumerRef::Sdk(id)`;never parsed from locator |
| exposure ref | exact query field | forms second resolver subject and exact exposure key;optional version must match loaded revision |
| SDK boundary fields | typed `CapabilityExternalReference::SdkConsumer` | copy locator/surface/scope only after union/id/version parity |
| resolution fields | current `ReferenceResolutionState` for SDK subject | require subject/state-id/version parity;non-resolved value cannot authorize exposure composition |
| exposure fields | exact loaded `FormalExposureBoundary` | copy exact id/version/state;SDK scope support uses pure `supports_formal_exposure` only |
| optional visibility | current `FormalVisibilityApplicability` | Draft may validly have none;otherwise require exposure owner、source exposure version and loaded version parity |
| optional consumer view | current view by exposure + `CapabilityConsumerRef::Sdk(id)` | missing is valid `None`;present item requires exact audience/exposure/version and uses persisted freshness mapping |
| public decision basis | two `CapabilityReadVisibilityDecision`s | source versions union SDK-left then exposure-right;later authoritative evaluation time;`NotVisible > Degraded > Visible` |

#### 23.9.3 ASCII call graph

```text
handler -> validate route/name/schema/SDK id/exposure ref -> from_query
  -> exposure service.assert_query_no_write
  -> resolve_subject(ExternalReference(SdkConsumer(id)))
     -> assert SDK subject/actor -> SDK decision -> SDK decision no-write
  -> resolve_subject(FormalExposure(exposure.id))
     -> assert exposure subject/actor -> exposure decision -> exposure decision no-write
  -> union source versions SDK then exposure;conflict -> consistency error
  -> evaluated_at = later decision time
  -> either NotVisible:body None;all body reads zero
  -> else either resolver Degraded:body None;all body reads zero
  -> else both Visible:
     external_reference.get_with_version(SdkConsumer(id))
       -> reference_state.find_current_by_subject;require Resolved

       -> visibility.find_current_by_exposure
          -> Draft + none:optional None
          -> required missing/parity failure:technical ConsistencyDefect
       -> controlled_view.find_current_by_exposure_and_consumer(Sdk(id))
          -> missing:outer body + consumer_view None,Visible/NotApplicable
          -> Ready:outer body + view,Visible/Fresh
          -> Stale/Partial:outer body + safe view,explicit degraded readable
          -> Rebuilding/Unavailable:outer body + consumer_view None,explicit degraded state
```
