#### 23.9.4 Rust-style function pseudocode

```rust
async fn get_sdk_exposure_boundary(
    &self,
    context: CapabilityOperationContext,
    query: GetSdkExposureBoundaryQuery,
) -> Result<CapabilityQueryResponse<SdkExposureBoundaryView>, ApplicationError> {
    context.assert_query_no_write()?;
    let sdk_reference_subject =
        ReferenceSubjectRef::SdkConsumer(query.sdk_consumer_ref_id.clone());
    let sdk_read_subject =
        CapabilityReadSubjectRef::ExternalReference(sdk_reference_subject.clone());
    let sdk_resolution = self.visibility_resolver
        .resolve_subject(&context.actor_context, sdk_read_subject.clone()).await?;
    sdk_resolution.assert_matches(&sdk_read_subject, &context.actor_context)?;
    let mut sdk_decision = sdk_resolution.into_decision()?;
    sdk_decision.assert_query_no_write(&context)?;

    let exposure_read_subject =
        CapabilityReadSubjectRef::FormalExposure(query.exposure_ref.id.clone());
    let exposure_resolution = self.visibility_resolver
        .resolve_subject(&context.actor_context, exposure_read_subject.clone()).await?;
    exposure_resolution.assert_matches(&exposure_read_subject, &context.actor_context)?;
    let mut exposure_decision = exposure_resolution.into_decision()?;
    exposure_decision.assert_query_no_write(&context)?;

    let sdk_not_visible = sdk_decision.is_not_visible();
    let exposure_not_visible = exposure_decision.is_not_visible();
    let sdk_degraded = sdk_decision.can_serve_degraded_surface();
    let exposure_degraded = exposure_decision.can_serve_degraded_surface();
    if !(sdk_not_visible || sdk_degraded || sdk_decision.can_serve_full_surface())
        || !(exposure_not_visible
            || exposure_degraded
            || exposure_decision.can_serve_full_surface())
    {
        return Err(ApplicationError::TechnicalInvariantViolation {
            object: ApplicationTechnicalObjectKind::ReadVisibilityDecision,
            invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::ReadVisibilityShape,
        });
    }
    let mut resolver_degraded = Vec::new();
    if sdk_degraded {
        let reason = sdk_decision.degraded_reason.take().ok_or(
            ApplicationError::TechnicalInvariantViolation {
                object: ApplicationTechnicalObjectKind::ReadVisibilityDecision,
                invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::ReadVisibilityShape,
            },
        )?;
        resolver_degraded.push(reason.into_public_marker());
    }
    if exposure_degraded {
        let reason = exposure_decision.degraded_reason.take().ok_or(
            ApplicationError::TechnicalInvariantViolation {
                object: ApplicationTechnicalObjectKind::ReadVisibilityDecision,
                invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::ReadVisibilityShape,
            },
        )?;
        resolver_degraded.push(reason.into_public_marker());
    }
    let resolver_freshness = resolver_degraded.iter().fold(
        CapabilityQueryFreshness::StaleReadable,
        |aggregate, marker| match (aggregate, marker.kind.freshness()) {
            (_, CapabilityQueryFreshness::Unavailable) => CapabilityQueryFreshness::Unavailable,
            (CapabilityQueryFreshness::Unavailable, _) => CapabilityQueryFreshness::Unavailable,
            (_, CapabilityQueryFreshness::Rebuilding) => CapabilityQueryFreshness::Rebuilding,
            (CapabilityQueryFreshness::Rebuilding, _) => CapabilityQueryFreshness::Rebuilding,
            _ => CapabilityQueryFreshness::StaleReadable,
        },
    );
    let evaluated_at = if sdk_decision.evaluated_at >= exposure_decision.evaluated_at {
        sdk_decision.evaluated_at.clone()
    } else {
        exposure_decision.evaluated_at.clone()
    };
    let source_versions = sdk_decision.source_versions
        .try_union(exposure_decision.source_versions)
        .map_err(|_contract_error| {
            ApplicationError::ConsistencyDefect {
                subject: ApplicationConsistencySubjectKind::TechnicalObject {
                    object: ApplicationTechnicalObjectKind::ReadVisibilityDecision,
                },
                invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::ReadVisibilityShape,
            }
        })?;

    if sdk_not_visible || exposure_not_visible {
        return Ok(CapabilityQueryResponse {
            query_name: /* exact closed GetSdkExposureBoundary name */,
            surface: CapabilityQuerySurface {
                visibility: CapabilityQueryVisibility::NotVisible,
                freshness: CapabilityQueryFreshness::NotApplicable,
                degraded: vec![],
                source_versions,
                evaluated_at,
            },
            body: None,
        });
    }
    if sdk_degraded || exposure_degraded {
        return Ok(CapabilityQueryResponse {
            query_name: /* exact closed GetSdkExposureBoundary name */,
            surface: CapabilityQuerySurface {
                visibility: CapabilityQueryVisibility::Degraded,
                freshness: resolver_freshness,
                degraded: resolver_degraded,
                source_versions,
                evaluated_at,
            },
            body: None,
        });
    }

    let sdk_reference = match self.external_reference_repo
        .get_with_version(sdk_reference_subject.clone()).await?
    {
        Some(Loaded {
            value: CapabilityExternalReference::SdkConsumer(reference),
            expected_version,
        }) if reference.sdk_consumer_ref_id == query.sdk_consumer_ref_id
            && expected_version == reference.version => reference,
        None => return Ok(/* Visible/NotApplicable body=None:SDK boundary unregistered */),
        Some(_) => return Err(ApplicationError::ConsistencyDefect {
            subject: ApplicationConsistencySubjectKind::DomainObject {
                object: DomainObjectKind::SdkConsumerReference,
            },
            invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::PersistedVariantShape,
        }),
    };
    let sdk_state = match self.reference_state_repo
        .find_current_by_subject(sdk_reference_subject.clone()).await?
    {
        Some(loaded) if loaded.value.reference_subject == sdk_reference_subject
            && loaded.value.resolution_state_id == sdk_reference.resolution_state_id
            && loaded.expected_version == loaded.value.version => loaded.value,
        None => return Err(ApplicationError::ConsistencyDefect {
            subject: ApplicationConsistencySubjectKind::CrossStoreRelation,
            invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::RequiredSidecar,
        }),
        Some(_) => return Err(ApplicationError::ConsistencyDefect {
            subject: ApplicationConsistencySubjectKind::CrossStoreRelation,
            invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::PersistedOwnerRelation,
        }),
    };
    if sdk_state.resolution_value != ReferenceResolutionValue::Resolved {
        return Ok(/* body=None;exact state-mapped SDK reference degradation */);
    }

    let exposure = match self.exposure_repo
        .get_with_version(query.exposure_ref.clone()).await?
    {
        Some(loaded) if loaded.value.formal_exposure_id == query.exposure_ref.id
            && query.exposure_ref.version.as_ref().is_none_or(
                |version| version == &loaded.value.version)
            && loaded.expected_version == loaded.value.version => loaded.value,
        None => return Ok(/* Visible/NotApplicable body=None:formal exposure absent */),
        Some(_) => return Err(ApplicationError::ConsistencyDefect {
            subject: ApplicationConsistencySubjectKind::DomainObject {
                object: DomainObjectKind::FormalExposureBoundary,
            },
            invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::PersistedVersionSymmetry,
        }),
    };
    if !sdk_reference.supports_formal_exposure(&exposure, &sdk_state) {
        return Ok(/* body=None;typed SDK-scope degraded result;not execution denial */);
    }

    let visibility_state = match self.visibility_repo
        .find_current_by_exposure(exposure.formal_exposure_id.clone()).await?
    {
        None if exposure.exposure_state == FormalExposureState::Draft => None,
        None => return Err(ApplicationError::ConsistencyDefect {
            subject: ApplicationConsistencySubjectKind::CrossStoreRelation,
            invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::RequiredSidecar,
        }),
        Some(loaded) if loaded.value.formal_exposure_id == exposure.formal_exposure_id
            && loaded.value.source_exposure_version == exposure.version
            && loaded.expected_version == loaded.value.version =>
            Some(loaded.value.visibility_state),
        Some(_) => return Err(ApplicationError::ConsistencyDefect {
            subject: ApplicationConsistencySubjectKind::CrossStoreRelation,
            invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::PersistedVersionSymmetry,
        }),
    };

    let sdk_consumer_ref = CapabilityConsumerRef::Sdk(query.sdk_consumer_ref_id.clone());
    let loaded_view = self.controlled_view_repo
        .find_current_by_exposure_and_consumer(
            exposure.formal_exposure_id.clone(), sdk_consumer_ref.clone()).await?;
    let (consumer_view, visibility, freshness, degraded) = match loaded_view {
        None => (
            None,
            CapabilityQueryVisibility::Visible,
            CapabilityQueryFreshness::NotApplicable,
            vec![],
        ),
        Some(loaded) if loaded.expected_version == loaded.value.version
            && loaded.value.formal_exposure_id == exposure.formal_exposure_id
            && loaded.value.consumer_ref == sdk_consumer_ref => {
            let view = ControlledConsumerViewView {
                consumer_view_ref: ControlledConsumerViewRef::exact(
                    loaded.value.consumer_view_id, loaded.value.version.clone()),
                formal_exposure_id: loaded.value.formal_exposure_id,
                consumer_ref: loaded.value.consumer_ref,
                descriptor_summary: loaded.value.descriptor_summary,
                source_versions: loaded.value.source_versions,
                freshness_state: loaded.value.freshness_state.clone(),
                version: loaded.value.version,
                created_at: loaded.value.created_at,
                refreshed_at: loaded.value.refreshed_at,
            };
            match view.freshness_state.clone() {
                ConsumerViewFreshnessState::Ready => (
                    Some(view), CapabilityQueryVisibility::Visible,
                    CapabilityQueryFreshness::Fresh, vec![]),
                ConsumerViewFreshnessState::Stale => (
                    Some(view), CapabilityQueryVisibility::Degraded,
                    CapabilityQueryFreshness::StaleReadable,
                    vec![/* StaleSource marker + protocol-safe issue ref */]),
                ConsumerViewFreshnessState::Partial => (
                    Some(view), CapabilityQueryVisibility::Degraded,
                    CapabilityQueryFreshness::StaleReadable,
                    vec![/* Partial marker + protocol-safe issue ref */]),
                ConsumerViewFreshnessState::Rebuilding => (
                    None, CapabilityQueryVisibility::Degraded,
                    CapabilityQueryFreshness::Rebuilding,
                    vec![/* Rebuilding marker + protocol-safe issue ref */]),
                ConsumerViewFreshnessState::Unavailable => (
                    None, CapabilityQueryVisibility::Degraded,
                    CapabilityQueryFreshness::Unavailable,
                    vec![/* exact unavailable-state marker from Step 12 */]),
            }
        }
        Some(_) => return Err(ApplicationError::ConsistencyDefect {
            subject: ApplicationConsistencySubjectKind::DomainObject {
                object: DomainObjectKind::ControlledConsumerView,
            },
            invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::PersistedOwnerRelation,
        }),
    };
    let body = SdkExposureBoundaryView {
        sdk_consumer_ref_id: sdk_reference.sdk_consumer_ref_id,
        sdk_consumer_locator: sdk_reference.sdk_consumer_locator,
        sdk_surface_summary: sdk_reference.sdk_surface_summary,
        sdk_exposure_scope: sdk_reference.exposure_scope,
        resolution_state_ref: ReferenceResolutionStateRef::exact(
            sdk_state.resolution_state_id, sdk_state.version),
        resolution_value: sdk_state.resolution_value,
        exposure_ref: FormalExposureBoundaryRef::exact(
            exposure.formal_exposure_id, exposure.version),
        exposure_state: exposure.exposure_state,
        visibility_state,
        consumer_view,
    };
    Ok(CapabilityQueryResponse {
        query_name: /* exact closed GetSdkExposureBoundary name */,
        surface: CapabilityQuerySurface {
            visibility,
            freshness,
            degraded,
            source_versions,
            evaluated_at,
        },
        body: Some(body),
    })
}
```

`Option::is_none_or` is schematic optional-version matching. Timestamp comparison and Step 12 issue-ref mapping are application-level pure mapping,not new domain or Port callables. `try_union` is the Step 6 public helper added by the controlled reopen and is the only legal source-version composition path.

#### 23.9.5 Transaction / no-write boundary

No transaction is opened. Both read decisions and both no-write guards complete before the first repository read. The remaining calls are local exact/current reads plus pure SDK scope support and DTO mapping. No missing/stale view triggers construction or refresh.

#### 23.9.6 Error / rejection mapping

| Branch | Classification |
|---|---|
| malformed SDK id/exposure ref | `MissingRequiredField / InvalidField` before first resolver |
| either resolver subject/actor/no-write mismatch | `ApplicationError`;no body reads |
| source-version conflicting marker | `ConsistencyDefect(TechnicalObject(ReadVisibilityDecision), ReadVisibilityShape)` before body reads |
| either `NotVisible` | combined `NotVisible`,body `None`;takes precedence over resolver degradation |
| no NotVisible but either resolver degraded | stable SDK-then-exposure degraded markers,body `None`;zero body reads |
| visible missing SDK ref or exposure | `Visible/Fresh body=None` |
| wrong SDK union or missing/mismatched state pair | exact `ConsistencyDefect(PersistedVariantShape / RequiredSidecar / PersistedOwnerRelation / PersistedVersionSymmetry)` |
| complete SDK non-resolved state | typed reference degradation,body `None` |
| SDK scope does not support exposure | typed degraded body `None`;not runtime denial |
| loaded exposure mismatch、required visibility missing/stale or present view parity mismatch | exact `ConsistencyDefect(PersistedOwnerRelation / PersistedVersionSymmetry / RequiredSidecar)` |
| no stored SDK view | complete outer body with `consumer_view=None` and `Visible/NotApplicable` |
| complete view non-Ready | persisted-state surface;Stale/Partial retain safe nested view,Rebuilding/Unavailable omit it |

#### 23.9.7 Surface / effects

The body explains a capability-hub server exposure boundary for a registered SDK consumer. It never returns or inspects generated client code、binding、package、credential、publication/release/cache state or runtime execution. Formal exposure remains server truth;SDK scope and optional controlled view cannot mutate or replace it.

#### 23.9.8 Test cuts

1. SDK external-reference resolver is called first and exposure resolver second on every valid request.
2. Both subject/actor assertions and both decision no-write guards execute before any repository read.
3. Both decisions visible -> `try_union` preserves SDK markers before exposure markers and deduplicates same subject/version.
4. Same source subject with conflicting versions -> consistency error and all repository call counts zero.
5. One NotVisible plus one Degraded -> NotVisible body none;one Degraded plus one Visible -> degraded body none.
6. Combined evaluation time is the later authoritative decision time;no repository timestamp participates.
7. SDK union/state、exposure exact ref、visibility owner/source version and present optional-view audience/version mismatch each returns exact consistency error.
8. Missing view returns outer body with `consumer_view=None` and `Visible/NotApplicable`;stale/partial view maps explicit degraded readable surface.
9. Rebuilding/unavailable view omits only nested view and preserves explicit outer degraded surface;timestamps never select a branch.
10. SDK package/client/binding/cache/release、runtime execution、external resolver、UoW and every write callable remain zero.

### 25.1 `query_get_capability_access_trace_flow`

#### 25.1.1 Entry and target

| Item | Exact contract |
|---|---|
| protocol | `CapabilityQueryRequest<GetCapabilityAccessTraceQuery>` -> `CapabilityPageResponse<CapabilityAccessTraceView>` |
| entry / service | `CapabilityQueryHandlers::get_capability_access_trace(...)` -> `CapabilityTraceImpactQueryService::get_capability_access_trace(...)` |
| read subject | `CapabilityReadSubjectRef::TraceabilityCollection(query.trace_subject)` from `resolve_traceability_list(actor,trace_subject)` |
| target read | one `CapabilityTraceabilityRepository::list_by_subject(trace_subject,page)` call after a Visible decision |
| non-effect | no change-record body load、trace append/repair、audit-store read、handoff、impact creation、runtime execution or write channel |

#### 25.1.2 DTO field sources

| Field | Source | Validation / use |
|---|---|---|
| `trace_subject` | closed Query union | must be one of identity、registry、descriptor、governance seam、method relation or formal exposure;projection/job/provider/listing families reject before resolver |
| `page.cursor` | opaque public cursor | validate binding to this Query + exact trace subject;never parse record id/version from it |
| `page.limit` | public positive limit | map once through `CapabilityRepositoryPageRequest::try_new`;zero / configured-over-max rejects before repository list |
| item fields | each persisted `CapabilityAccessTraceabilityRecord` | exact 13-field copy;record subject must equal requested subject |
| outer state | persisted `TraceabilityState` values in the returned page | `Partial > HandoffPending > Recorded/Superseded`;order remains repository order |

#### 25.1.3 ASCII call graph

```text
handler -> validate route/name/schema/subject/page -> from_query
  -> service.assert_query_no_write
  -> TraceabilityCollection(trace_subject)
  -> resolve_traceability_list(actor,trace_subject)
     -> assert subject/actor -> decision no-write
     -> NotVisible:empty/no cursor;list count zero
     -> resolver Degraded:degraded empty/no cursor;list count zero
     -> Visible:traceability.list_by_subject(trace_subject,page)
        -> each record subject parity + exact field mapping
        -> aggregate persisted state only
        -> preserve repository order and opaque next cursor
        -> returned_count from final items;has_more from next cursor
```

#### 25.1.4 Rust-style function pseudocode

```rust
async fn get_capability_access_trace(
    &self,
    context: CapabilityOperationContext,
    query: GetCapabilityAccessTraceQuery,
) -> Result<CapabilityPageResponse<CapabilityAccessTraceView>, ApplicationError> {
    context.assert_query_no_write()?;
    /* Validate the closed trace subject and bind the cursor to this exact subject. */
    let trace_subject = query.trace_subject.clone();
    let repository_page = CapabilityRepositoryPageRequest::try_new(
        /* validated same-query/same-subject cursor */, query.page.limit)?;
    let subject = CapabilityReadSubjectRef::TraceabilityCollection(
        trace_subject.clone());
    let resolution = self.visibility_resolver
        .resolve_traceability_list(
            &context.actor_context, trace_subject.clone()).await?;
    resolution.assert_matches(&subject, &context.actor_context)?;
    let decision = resolution.into_decision()?;
    decision.assert_query_no_write(&context)?;
    if decision.is_not_visible() || decision.can_serve_degraded_surface() {
        return Ok(CapabilityPageResponse {
            query_name: /* exact closed GetCapabilityAccessTrace name */,
            surface: /* exact NotVisible or resolver-Degraded surface */,
            items: vec![],
            page: CapabilityPublicPageInfo {
                next_cursor: None, returned_count: 0, has_more: false,
            },
        });
    }
    if !decision.can_serve_full_surface() {
        return Err(ApplicationError::TechnicalInvariantViolation {
            object: ApplicationTechnicalObjectKind::ReadVisibilityDecision,
            invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::ReadVisibilityShape,
        });
    }

    let page = self.traceability_repo
        .list_by_subject(trace_subject.clone(), repository_page).await?;
    let mut items = Vec::with_capacity(page.items.len());
    let mut has_partial = false;
    let mut has_handoff_pending = false;
    for record in page.items {
        if record.trace_subject != trace_subject {
            return Err(ApplicationError::ConsistencyDefect {
                subject: ApplicationConsistencySubjectKind::PortReturn {
                    port: ApplicationPortKind::CapabilityTraceabilityRepository,
                },
                invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::RepositoryAccessShape,
            });
        }
        match record.traceability_state {
            TraceabilityState::Partial => has_partial = true,
            TraceabilityState::HandoffPending => has_handoff_pending = true,
            TraceabilityState::Recorded | TraceabilityState::Superseded => {}
        }
        items.push(CapabilityAccessTraceView {
            traceability_ref: CapabilityAccessTraceabilityRecordRef::exact(
                record.traceability_record_id, record.version.clone()),
            trace_subject: record.trace_subject,
            source_change_refs: record.source_change_refs,
            trace_reason: record.trace_reason,
            handoff_refs: record.handoff_refs,
            traceability_state: record.traceability_state,
            gap_reason: record.gap_reason,
            superseded_by: record.superseded_by,
            actor_context: record.actor_context,
            trace_id: record.trace_id,
            version: record.version,
            recorded_at: record.recorded_at,
            updated_at: record.updated_at,
        });
    }
    let (visibility, freshness, degraded) = if has_partial {
        (CapabilityQueryVisibility::Degraded,
         CapabilityQueryFreshness::StaleReadable,
         vec![/* Partial marker from persisted TraceabilityState */])
    } else if has_handoff_pending {
        (CapabilityQueryVisibility::Degraded,
         CapabilityQueryFreshness::StaleReadable,
         vec![/* Partial marker for persisted handoff pending */])
    } else {
        (CapabilityQueryVisibility::Visible,
         CapabilityQueryFreshness::NotApplicable, vec![])
    };
    let next_cursor = page.next_cursor
        .map(|cursor| /* opaque public cursor bound to query + trace subject */);
    let returned_count = u32::try_from(items.len())
        .map_err(|_| ApplicationError::ConsistencyDefect {
            subject: ApplicationConsistencySubjectKind::PortReturn {
                port: ApplicationPortKind::CapabilityTraceabilityRepository,
            },
            invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::RepositoryAccessShape,
        })?;
    let has_more = next_cursor.is_some();
    Ok(CapabilityPageResponse {
        query_name: /* exact closed GetCapabilityAccessTrace name */,
        surface: CapabilityQuerySurface {
            visibility, freshness, degraded,
            source_versions: decision.source_versions,
            evaluated_at: decision.evaluated_at,
        },
        items,
        page: CapabilityPublicPageInfo { next_cursor, returned_count, has_more },
    })
}
```

#### 25.1.5 Transaction / no-write boundary

No transaction is opened. The resolver and its no-write guard finish before the only possible history-page read. Partial、handoff-pending and superseded revisions are copied as persisted history;none triggers trace repair、handoff retry or a current-state rewrite.

#### 25.1.6 Error / rejection mapping

| Branch | Classification |
|---|---|
| malformed / forbidden trace subject、cursor or limit | `InvalidField / InvalidPage` before resolver/list |
| resolver `NotVisible` | successful canonical empty page;target list not called |
| resolver `Degraded` | degraded empty/no cursor;target list not called |
| visible repository empty | normal `Visible/NotApplicable` empty page |
| returned record has another subject | `ConsistencyDefect(PortReturn(CapabilityTraceabilityRepository), RepositoryAccessShape)`;never silently drop |
| repository failure | typed `ApplicationError`;not converted to empty or Partial |

#### 25.1.7 Surface / effects

The page exposes append-only capability access trace truth only. Partial and pending are stored trace states,not observability availability inferred from a trace id. Raw logs、spans、metrics、audit bodies、execution results、evidence aliases and acceptance signatures remain outside the response and all effects are zero.

#### 25.1.8 Test cuts

1. Every valid request calls `resolve_traceability_list` before `list_by_subject`.
2. NotVisible and resolver Degraded both produce empty/no-cursor pages and zero target-list calls.
3. Visible empty is not Missing or degraded and uses the resolver source marker.
4. Every field of Recorded、Partial、HandoffPending and Superseded revisions maps exactly.
5. Partial outranks HandoffPending;either can retain complete body-free items without reordering.
6. A wrong-subject repository row is an error,not a filtered row or empty page.
7. Public cursor remains bound to query + trace subject;count and has-more derive from mapped items/cursor.
8. Change body、audit store、handoff Port、impact service、UoW and all write call counts remain zero.

#### 25.1.9 Single-flow stop review

| Gate | Result |
|---|---|
| collection resolver | pass;TraceabilityCollection exists before any item |
| history mapping | pass;all persisted revisions remain explicit |
| state aggregation | pass;closed enum only,no timestamp / trace-id inference |
| owner boundary | pass;no observability or execution body |
| no-write | pass;one optional page read and zero effects |

### 25.2 `query_get_capability_change_impact_flow`

#### 25.2.1 Entry and target

| Item | Exact contract |
|---|---|
| protocol | `CapabilityQueryRequest<GetCapabilityChangeImpactQuery>` -> `CapabilityQueryResponse<CapabilityChangeImpactView>` |
| entry / service | `CapabilityQueryHandlers::get_capability_change_impact(...)` -> `CapabilityTraceImpactQueryService::get_capability_change_impact(...)` |
| read subject | `Exact` -> `ImpactFact(id)`;`ByChange` -> `ChangeRecord(change_ref)` |
| target reads | exact impact,or exact change -> current covering trace -> impact by exact trace revision |
| non-effect | no embedded downstream-summary page、impact mutation、consumer notification、runtime/tools/SDK read or outbound candidate |

#### 25.2.2 DTO field sources

| Field | Source | Validation / use |
|---|---|---|
| selector tag | `CapabilityImpactQuerySelector` | sole branch authority;route and field presence never reselect branch |
| exact impact ref | `Exact` payload | exact id + version required;load after impact-subject decision |
| change ref | `ByChange` payload | typed six-variant union;repository must return the same variant/id |
| trace subject | exact loaded change variant | map its owner id to the corresponding closed `CapabilityTraceSubjectRef`;never parse ref text |
| impact fields | loaded `CapabilityChangeImpactFact` | exact 12-field copy after impact id/version、trace ref and subject parity |
| downstream summaries | separate paged Query | not embedded;caller uses `GetDownstreamConsumptionImpactSummary { impact_fact_ref, page, ... }` |

#### 25.2.3 ASCII call graph

```text
handler -> validate selector/exact versions -> from_query
  -> service.assert_query_no_write
  -> ImpactFact(id) OR ChangeRecord(typed ref)
  -> resolve_subject -> assert subject/actor -> decision no-write
     -> NotVisible / resolver Degraded:body None;all target reads zero
     -> Visible:
        Exact -> impact.get_impact_with_version(exact ref)
        ByChange -> change.get(typed ref) -> variant/id symmetry
          -> map exact change owner subject
          -> trace.find_current_by_change(change ref)
          -> trace version + covers_change + subject parity
          -> impact.find_impact_by_traceability(exact trace ref)
        -> visible miss:body None
        -> impact version/id + exact trace + change-subject parity
        -> exact impact view;no downstream list
```

#### 25.2.4 Rust-style function pseudocode

```rust
async fn get_capability_change_impact(
    &self,
    context: CapabilityOperationContext,
    query: GetCapabilityChangeImpactQuery,
) -> Result<CapabilityQueryResponse<CapabilityChangeImpactView>, ApplicationError> {
    context.assert_query_no_write()?;
    let subject = match &query.selector {
        CapabilityImpactQuerySelector::Exact(impact_ref) => {
            if impact_ref.version.is_none() {
                return Err(/* InvalidField:exact impact version required */);
            }
            CapabilityReadSubjectRef::ImpactFact(impact_ref.id.clone())
        }
        CapabilityImpactQuerySelector::ByChange(change_ref) =>
            CapabilityReadSubjectRef::ChangeRecord(change_ref.clone()),
    };
    let resolution = self.visibility_resolver
        .resolve_subject(&context.actor_context, subject.clone()).await?;
    resolution.assert_matches(&subject, &context.actor_context)?;
    let decision = resolution.into_decision()?;
    decision.assert_query_no_write(&context)?;
    if decision.is_not_visible() {
        return Ok(/* exact NotVisible/Freshness response;body=None;zero reads */);
    }
    if decision.can_serve_degraded_surface() {
        return Ok(/* resolver-degraded body=None;zero target reads */);
    }
    if !decision.can_serve_full_surface() {
        return Err(ApplicationError::TechnicalInvariantViolation {
            object: ApplicationTechnicalObjectKind::ReadVisibilityDecision,
            invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::ReadVisibilityShape,
        });
    }

    let mut selected_exact_impact_ref = None;
    let loaded_impact = match query.selector {
        CapabilityImpactQuerySelector::Exact(impact_ref) => {
            selected_exact_impact_ref = Some(impact_ref.clone());
            self.impact_repo.get_impact_with_version(impact_ref).await?
        }
        CapabilityImpactQuerySelector::ByChange(change_ref) => {
            let change = match self.change_repo.get(change_ref.clone()).await? {
                Some(change) => change,
                None => return Ok(/* Visible/NotApplicable body=None */),
            };
            let change_subject = match (&change_ref, &change) {
                (CapabilityChangeRecordRef::Identity(id),
                 CapabilityChangeRecord::Identity(record))
                    if id == &record.change_record_id =>
                    CapabilityTraceSubjectRef::Identity(
                        record.capability_identity_id.clone()),
                (CapabilityChangeRecordRef::Registry(id),
                 CapabilityChangeRecord::Registry(record))
                    if id == &record.registry_change_record_id =>
                    CapabilityTraceSubjectRef::RegistryEntry(
                        record.registry_entry_id.clone()),
                (CapabilityChangeRecordRef::Descriptor(id),
                 CapabilityChangeRecord::Descriptor(record))
                    if id == &record.descriptor_change_record_id =>
                    CapabilityTraceSubjectRef::AdapterDescriptor(
                        record.adapter_descriptor_id.clone()),
                (CapabilityChangeRecordRef::GovernanceSeam(id),
                 CapabilityChangeRecord::GovernanceSeam(record))
                    if id == &record.seam_change_record_id =>
                    CapabilityTraceSubjectRef::GovernanceSeam(
                        record.governance_seam_relation_id.clone()),
                (CapabilityChangeRecordRef::MethodRelation(id),
                 CapabilityChangeRecord::MethodRelation(record))
                    if id == &record.method_relation_change_record_id =>
                    CapabilityTraceSubjectRef::MethodRelation(
                        record.method_relation_id.clone()),
                (CapabilityChangeRecordRef::Exposure(id),
                 CapabilityChangeRecord::Exposure(record))
                    if id == &record.exposure_change_record_id =>
                    CapabilityTraceSubjectRef::FormalExposure(
                        record.formal_exposure_id.clone()),
                _ => return Err(ApplicationError::ConsistencyDefect {
                    subject: ApplicationConsistencySubjectKind::PortReturn {
                        port: ApplicationPortKind::CapabilityChangeRecordRepository,
                    },
                    invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::PersistedVariantShape,
                }),
            };
            let trace = match self.traceability_repo
                .find_current_by_change(change_ref.clone()).await?
            {
                Some(loaded) if loaded.expected_version == loaded.value.version
                    && loaded.value.covers_change(&change_ref)
                    && loaded.value.trace_subject == change_subject => loaded,
                None => return Ok(/* Visible/NotApplicable body=None:no trace */),
                Some(_) => return Err(ApplicationError::ConsistencyDefect {
                    subject: ApplicationConsistencySubjectKind::CrossStoreRelation,
                    invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::PersistedOwnerRelation,
                }),
            };
            let trace_ref = CapabilityAccessTraceabilityRecordRef::exact(
                trace.value.traceability_record_id.clone(),
                trace.value.version.clone());
            let impact = self.impact_repo
                .find_impact_by_traceability(trace_ref.clone()).await?;
            match impact {
                Some(loaded) if loaded.value.traceability_record_ref == trace_ref
                    && loaded.value.change_subject == trace.value.trace_subject => Some(loaded),
                None => None,
                Some(_) => return Err(ApplicationError::ConsistencyDefect {
                    subject: ApplicationConsistencySubjectKind::CrossStoreRelation,
                    invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::PersistedOwnerRelation,
                }),
            }
        }
    };
    let impact = match loaded_impact {
        Some(loaded) if loaded.expected_version == loaded.value.version
            && selected_exact_impact_ref.as_ref().is_none_or(|impact_ref| {
                impact_ref.id == loaded.value.impact_fact_id
                    && impact_ref.version.as_ref() == Some(&loaded.value.version)
            }) => loaded,
        None => return Ok(/* Visible/NotApplicable body=None */),
        Some(_) => return Err(ApplicationError::ConsistencyDefect {
            subject: ApplicationConsistencySubjectKind::DomainObject {
                object: DomainObjectKind::CapabilityChangeImpactFact,
            },
            invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::PersistedVersionSymmetry,
        }),
    };
    let body = CapabilityChangeImpactView {
        impact_ref: CapabilityChangeImpactFactRef::exact(
            impact.value.impact_fact_id, impact.value.version.clone()),
        traceability_ref: impact.value.traceability_record_ref,
        change_subject: impact.value.change_subject,
        impact_scope: impact.value.impact_scope,
        affected_consumers: impact.value.affected_consumers,
        impact_state: impact.value.impact_state,
        state_reason: impact.value.state_reason,
        recorded_by: impact.value.recorded_by,
        trace_id: impact.value.trace_id,
        version: impact.value.version,
        created_at: impact.value.created_at,
        updated_at: impact.value.updated_at,
    };
    Ok(CapabilityQueryResponse {
        query_name: /* exact closed GetCapabilityChangeImpact name */,
        surface: CapabilityQuerySurface {
            visibility: CapabilityQueryVisibility::Visible,
            freshness: CapabilityQueryFreshness::NotApplicable,
            degraded: vec![],
            source_versions: decision.source_versions,
            evaluated_at: decision.evaluated_at,
        },
        body: Some(body),
    })
}
```

#### 25.2.5 Transaction / no-write boundary

No transaction is opened. The ByChange branch performs only typed local truth reads. It neither creates a missing trace/impact nor changes Delayed、Partial、Ignored or Resolved state. Downstream summary pagination remains a separate no-write Query.

#### 25.2.6 Error / rejection mapping

| Branch | Classification |
|---|---|
| malformed selector/ref or exact ref without version | `MissingRequiredField / InvalidField` before resolver/body read |
| `NotVisible` / resolver degraded | body `None`;all change/trace/impact reads zero |
| visible exact impact miss | `Visible/NotApplicable`,body `None` |
| ByChange change/trace/impact absent | visible body `None` at the absent link |
| change union/id mismatch | `ConsistencyDefect(PortReturn(CapabilityChangeRecordRepository), PersistedVariantShape)`;no alternate variant lookup |
| loaded trace coverage/subject or impact trace/subject mismatch | `ConsistencyDefect(CrossStoreRelation, PersistedOwnerRelation / PersistedVersionSymmetry)`;no inferred relationship |
| repository failure | `ApplicationError`;no runtime/consumer fallback |

#### 25.2.7 Surface / effects

The response explains the capability-hub impact fact and typed affected consumer boundaries. Impact state remains direct local truth,not runtime denial or acknowledgement inferred from consumer execution. Summary refs are intentionally not embedded;the exact-impact paged Query is the complete downstream read surface.

#### 25.2.8 Test cuts

1. Exact and ByChange resolve ImpactFact and ChangeRecord subjects respectively before target reads.
2. Exact selector requires and preserves exact version;wrong persisted version returns exact consistency error rather than current.
3. Each of six change variants maps to its exact trace subject and rejects wrong union/id.
4. ByChange requires `covers_change`、trace subject parity and exact impact trace/source parity.
5. Missing change、trace or impact yields visible body none at the matching stage.
6. Delayed / Partial / Ignored impact remains a body state with `Visible/NotApplicable`.
7. `list_downstream_summaries` call count is zero;complete summaries are requested separately with exact impact filter.
8. Runtime/tools/SDK execution、consumer notification、UoW、save and event capture calls remain zero.

#### 25.2.9 Single-flow stop review

| Gate | Result |
|---|---|
| selector authority | pass;enum tag alone chooses branch |
| change/trace/impact link | pass;variant、coverage、subject and exact ref parity |
| bounded response | pass;no hidden unpaged summary collection |
| authority | pass;impact explanation is not execution truth |
| no-write | pass;local exact/current reads only |

Flow status: `completed_in_batch_9_6`.

### 25.3 `query_get_downstream_consumption_impact_summary_flow`

#### 25.3.1 Entry and target

| Item | Exact contract |
|---|---|
| protocol | `CapabilityQueryRequest<GetDownstreamConsumptionImpactSummaryQuery>` -> `CapabilityPageResponse<DownstreamConsumptionImpactSummaryView>` |
| entry / service | `CapabilityQueryHandlers::get_downstream_consumption_impact_summary(...)` -> `CapabilityTraceImpactQueryService::get_downstream_consumption_impact_summary(...)` |
| read subject | `CapabilityReadSubjectRef::DownstreamSummaryCollection` from `resolve_downstream_summary_list(actor,&scope)` |
| target read | one `CapabilityImpactRepository::list_downstream_summaries(scope,page)` call after Visible |
| non-effect | no inbound replay/receipt、impact mutation、runtime/SDK call、source-event payload load or write |

#### 25.3.2 DTO field sources

| Field | Source | Validation / use |
|---|---|---|
| `impact_fact_ref` | optional exact impact selector | if present requires exact version;copied to repository/read-decision scope |
| `consumer_ref` | optional closed consumer union | RuntimeTools、Sdk or Ecosystem only;does not read execution/client/listing state |
| `change_subject` | optional closed core truth subject | cannot be projection/job/provider/listing subject |
| selector presence | three optional selectors | at least one required;multiple present selectors combine with AND semantics |
| time range | authoritative optional bounds | when both exist require `observed_from < observed_until`;no local-clock substitution |
| page | public cursor/limit | bind to exact impact/consumer/subject/time scope and this Query |
| item fields | each loaded `DownstreamConsumptionImpactSummary` | exact 13-field copy after version and directly representable filter parity |

#### 25.3.3 ASCII call graph

```text
handler -> validate selectors/range/page -> from_query
  -> service.assert_query_no_write
  -> CapabilityDownstreamSummaryRepositoryScope(all exact filters)
  -> DownstreamSummaryCollection
  -> resolve_downstream_summary_list(scope)
     -> assert subject/actor -> decision no-write
     -> NotVisible:empty/no cursor;list zero
     -> resolver Degraded:degraded empty/no cursor;list zero
     -> Visible:impact_repo.list_downstream_summaries(scope,page)
        -> each Loaded version + exact impact/consumer/time parity
        -> map every persisted feedback state without mutation
        -> stable order + opaque cursor + final count
```

#### 25.3.4 Rust-style function pseudocode

```rust
async fn get_downstream_consumption_impact_summary(
    &self,
    context: CapabilityOperationContext,
    query: GetDownstreamConsumptionImpactSummaryQuery,
) -> Result<CapabilityPageResponse<DownstreamConsumptionImpactSummaryView>, ApplicationError> {
    context.assert_query_no_write()?;
    if query.impact_fact_ref.is_none()
        && query.consumer_ref.is_none()
        && query.change_subject.is_none()
    {
        return Err(/* InvalidScope:at least one selector required */);
    }
    if query.impact_fact_ref.as_ref().is_some_and(|value| value.version.is_none()) {
        return Err(/* InvalidField:exact impact version required */);
    }
    if matches!((&query.observed_from, &query.observed_until),
        (Some(from), Some(until)) if from >= until)
    {
        return Err(/* InvalidField:invalid authoritative time range */);
    }
    let scope = CapabilityDownstreamSummaryRepositoryScope {
        impact_fact_ref: query.impact_fact_ref.clone(),
        consumer_ref: query.consumer_ref.clone(),
        change_subject: query.change_subject.clone(),
        observed_from: query.observed_from.clone(),
        observed_until: query.observed_until.clone(),
    };
    let repository_page = CapabilityRepositoryPageRequest::try_new(
        /* cursor validated against this exact full scope */, query.page.limit)?;
    let subject = CapabilityReadSubjectRef::DownstreamSummaryCollection;
    let resolution = self.visibility_resolver
        .resolve_downstream_summary_list(&context.actor_context, &scope).await?;
    resolution.assert_matches(&subject, &context.actor_context)?;
    let decision = resolution.into_decision()?;
    decision.assert_query_no_write(&context)?;
    if decision.is_not_visible() || decision.can_serve_degraded_surface() {
        return Ok(CapabilityPageResponse {
            query_name: /* exact closed GetDownstreamConsumptionImpactSummary name */,
            surface: /* exact NotVisible or resolver-Degraded surface */,
            items: vec![],
            page: CapabilityPublicPageInfo {
                next_cursor: None, returned_count: 0, has_more: false,
            },
        });
    }
    if !decision.can_serve_full_surface() {
        return Err(ApplicationError::TechnicalInvariantViolation {
            object: ApplicationTechnicalObjectKind::ReadVisibilityDecision,
            invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::ReadVisibilityShape,
        });
    }

    let page = self.impact_repo
        .list_downstream_summaries(scope.clone(), repository_page).await?;
    let mut items = Vec::with_capacity(page.items.len());
    for loaded in page.items {
        let summary = loaded.value;
        if loaded.expected_version != summary.version
            || scope.impact_fact_ref.as_ref().is_some_and(
                |impact_ref| impact_ref != &summary.impact_fact_ref)
            || scope.consumer_ref.as_ref().is_some_and(
                |consumer_ref| consumer_ref != &summary.consumer_ref)
            || scope.observed_from.as_ref().is_some_and(
                |from| &summary.observed_at < from)
            || scope.observed_until.as_ref().is_some_and(
                |until| &summary.observed_at >= until)
        {
            return Err(ApplicationError::ConsistencyDefect {
                subject: ApplicationConsistencySubjectKind::PortReturn {
                    port: ApplicationPortKind::CapabilityImpactRepository,
                },
                invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::RepositoryAccessShape,
            });
        }
        /* change_subject filtering is adapter-index conformance because the public
           summary carries only its exact impact ref;never N+1 load or parse text. */
        items.push(DownstreamConsumptionImpactSummaryView {
            impact_summary_ref: DownstreamConsumptionImpactSummaryRef::exact(
                summary.impact_summary_id, summary.version.clone()),
            impact_fact_ref: summary.impact_fact_ref,
            consumer_ref: summary.consumer_ref,
            source_feedback_ref: summary.source_feedback_ref,
            impact_observation: summary.impact_observation,
            feedback_state: summary.feedback_state,
            gap_reason: summary.gap_reason,
            state_reason: summary.state_reason,
            accepted_by: summary.accepted_by,
            trace_id: summary.trace_id,
            version: summary.version,
            observed_at: summary.observed_at,
            updated_at: summary.updated_at,
        });
    }
    let next_cursor = page.next_cursor
        .map(|cursor| /* opaque public cursor bound to exact full scope */);
    let returned_count = u32::try_from(items.len())
        .map_err(|_| ApplicationError::ConsistencyDefect {
            subject: ApplicationConsistencySubjectKind::PortReturn {
                port: ApplicationPortKind::CapabilityImpactRepository,
            },
            invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::RepositoryAccessShape,
        })?;
    let has_more = next_cursor.is_some();
    Ok(CapabilityPageResponse {
        query_name: /* exact closed GetDownstreamConsumptionImpactSummary name */,
        surface: CapabilityQuerySurface {
            visibility: CapabilityQueryVisibility::Visible,
            freshness: CapabilityQueryFreshness::NotApplicable,
            degraded: vec![],
            source_versions: decision.source_versions,
            evaluated_at: decision.evaluated_at,
        },
        items,
        page: CapabilityPublicPageInfo { next_cursor, returned_count, has_more },
    })
}
```

#### 25.3.5 Transaction / no-write boundary

No transaction is opened. The scope and page are fully validated before the resolver and list. Received、Partial、Delayed、Unavailable and Ignored are immutable/query-visible feedback states;the Query does not replay the source event、change impact state or contact a consumer.

#### 25.3.6 Error / rejection mapping

| Branch | Classification |
|---|---|
| all selectors absent | `InvalidScope` before resolver |
| exact impact without version、bad consumer/subject、time range or cursor | `InvalidField / InvalidPage` before list |
| NotVisible / resolver Degraded | canonical empty/no cursor;target list zero |
| visible no matches | normal `Visible/NotApplicable` empty page |
| directly representable filter/version mismatch | `ConsistencyDefect(PortReturn(CapabilityImpactRepository), RepositoryAccessShape)`;never drop row |
| change-subject index mismatch | same repository-return consistency error;not inferred from summary text |
| repository failure | typed `ApplicationError`;not converted to Unavailable feedback |

#### 25.3.7 Surface / effects

Every item is a body-free downstream feedback snapshot linked to one exact impact fact. Unavailable or Delayed reports downstream feedback availability only;Ignored requires explicit consumer feedback. None of these states grants/denies execution or changes formal exposure truth.

#### 25.3.8 Test cuts

1. Any one of impact、consumer or change subject is sufficient;zero selectors rejects.
2. Multiple selectors are ANDed and cursor scope includes all selectors plus time range.
3. Invalid time range rejects before resolver/list;no clock value replaces a missing bound.
4. NotVisible/resolver Degraded returns empty/no cursor with list count zero.
5. Exact impact filter returns only summaries whose stored exact impact ref matches,across multiple pages.
6. Consumer and observation bounds are checked per returned row;bad row is an error,not a silent drop.
7. All five feedback states map as direct truth with `Visible/NotApplicable`.
8. No source-event body、runtime/SDK execution、inbound replay、UoW、save or impact mutation occurs.

#### 25.3.9 Single-flow stop review

| Gate | Result |
|---|---|
| bounded exact-impact read | pass;existing page owns complete summary retrieval |
| resolver-first | pass;DownstreamSummaryCollection before list |
| filter semantics | pass;present selectors are conjunctive and cursor-bound |
| feedback authority | pass;no execution or exposure inference |
| no-write | pass;single page read and zero effects |

### 25.4 `query_get_audit_handoff_trace_summary_flow`

#### 25.4.1 Entry and target

| Item | Exact contract |
|---|---|
| protocol | `CapabilityQueryRequest<GetAuditHandoffTraceSummaryQuery>` -> `CapabilityQueryResponse<AuditHandoffTraceSummaryView>` |
| entry / service | `CapabilityQueryHandlers::get_audit_handoff_trace_summary(...)` -> `CapabilityTraceImpactQueryService::get_audit_handoff_trace_summary(...)` |
| read subject | `CapabilityReadSubjectRef::Traceability(traceability_ref.id)` |
| target reads | exact historical trace revision,then every stored attached audit ref and its current canonical state |
| non-effect | no handoff Port、audit-store fetch、reference refresh、trace append、evidence generation or acceptance signing |

#### 25.4.2 DTO field sources

| Field | Source | Validation / use |
|---|---|---|
| `traceability_ref` | caller exact versioned ref | version is required;`get_revision` must return the same id + version,never current/latest fallback |
| `handoff_scope` | validated public safe text | forbidden-body scan and one-way application scope mapping;echo original safe input;never parse as audit-ref selector |
| attached ids | exact trace `handoff_refs` | all ids in stored stable order;None becomes an empty vector |
| audit ref object | `CapabilityExternalReference::ObservabilityAudit` | subject union/id/version must match repository key |
| canonical state | `find_current_by_subject(ObservabilityAudit(id))` | state subject/kind/id/version parity required |
| outer state | trace state + complete pair resolution values | invalid/missing pair cannot form partial item;non-Resolved complete pairs use typed aggregate mapping |

#### 25.4.3 ASCII call graph

```text
handler -> validate exact trace ref + body-free scope -> from_query
  -> service.assert_query_no_write
  -> Traceability(trace id) -> resolve_subject
     -> assert subject/actor -> decision no-write
     -> NotVisible / resolver Degraded:body None;all body reads zero
     -> Visible:traceability.get_revision(exact ref)
        -> miss:Visible body None
        -> exact id/version parity
        -> for every attached id in stable order:
           external_reference.get_with_version(ObservabilityAudit(id))
           reference_state.find_current_by_subject(same subject)
           -> missing/wrong pair:technical ConsistencyDefect;no half vector
           -> complete pair:append item;aggregate canonical value
        -> no ids:complete body with empty vector
        -> trace state + ref states -> exact safe surface
```

#### 25.4.4 Rust-style function pseudocode

```rust
async fn get_audit_handoff_trace_summary(
    &self,
    context: CapabilityOperationContext,
    query: GetAuditHandoffTraceSummaryQuery,
) -> Result<CapabilityQueryResponse<AuditHandoffTraceSummaryView>, ApplicationError> {
    context.assert_query_no_write()?;
    if query.traceability_ref.version.is_none() {
        return Err(/* InvalidField:exact trace revision required */);
    }
    let public_scope = query.handoff_scope.clone();
    let _application_scope = CapabilityAuditHandoffScope::try_from_input(
        &query.handoff_scope)?;
    let subject = CapabilityReadSubjectRef::Traceability(
        query.traceability_ref.id.clone());
    let resolution = self.visibility_resolver
        .resolve_subject(&context.actor_context, subject.clone()).await?;
    resolution.assert_matches(&subject, &context.actor_context)?;
    let decision = resolution.into_decision()?;
    decision.assert_query_no_write(&context)?;
    if decision.is_not_visible() {
        return Ok(/* exact NotVisible response;body=None;zero body reads */);
    }
    if decision.can_serve_degraded_surface() {
        return Ok(/* resolver-Degraded response;body=None;zero body reads */);
    }
    if !decision.can_serve_full_surface() {
        return Err(ApplicationError::TechnicalInvariantViolation {
            object: ApplicationTechnicalObjectKind::ReadVisibilityDecision,
            invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::ReadVisibilityShape,
        });
    }

    let trace = match self.traceability_repo
        .get_revision(query.traceability_ref.clone()).await?
    {
        Some(record) if record.traceability_record_id == query.traceability_ref.id
            && query.traceability_ref.version.as_ref() == Some(&record.version) => record,
        None => return Ok(/* Visible/Fresh body=None */),
        Some(_) => return Err(ApplicationError::ConsistencyDefect {
            subject: ApplicationConsistencySubjectKind::DomainObject {
                object: DomainObjectKind::CapabilityAccessTraceabilityRecord,
            },
            invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::PersistedVersionSymmetry,
        }),
    };
    let mut audit_references = Vec::new();
    let mut has_stale = false;
    let mut has_unavailable = false;
    let mut must_redact = false;
    if let Some(attached) = &trace.handoff_refs {
        for audit_id in attached.iter() {
            let reference_subject = ReferenceSubjectRef::ObservabilityAudit(
                audit_id.clone());
            let audit_ref = match self.external_reference_repo
                .get_with_version(reference_subject.clone()).await?
            {
                Some(Loaded {
                    value: CapabilityExternalReference::ObservabilityAudit(reference),
                    expected_version,
                }) if reference.observability_audit_ref_id == *audit_id
                    && expected_version == reference.version => reference,
                None => return Err(ApplicationError::ConsistencyDefect {
                    subject: ApplicationConsistencySubjectKind::CrossStoreRelation,
                    invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::RequiredSidecar,
                }),
                Some(_) => return Err(ApplicationError::ConsistencyDefect {
                    subject: ApplicationConsistencySubjectKind::DomainObject {
                        object: DomainObjectKind::ObservabilityAuditReference,
                    },
                    invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::PersistedVariantShape,
                }),
            };
            let state = match self.reference_state_repo
                .find_current_by_subject(reference_subject.clone()).await?
            {
                Some(loaded) if loaded.value.reference_subject == reference_subject
                    && loaded.value.reference_kind == ReferenceKind::ObservabilityAudit
                    && loaded.value.resolution_state_id == audit_ref.resolution_state_id
                    && loaded.expected_version == loaded.value.version => loaded.value,
                None => return Err(ApplicationError::ConsistencyDefect {
                    subject: ApplicationConsistencySubjectKind::CrossStoreRelation,
                    invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::RequiredSidecar,
                }),
                Some(_) => return Err(ApplicationError::ConsistencyDefect {
                    subject: ApplicationConsistencySubjectKind::CrossStoreRelation,
                    invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::PersistedOwnerRelation,
                }),
            };
            match state.resolution_value {
                ReferenceResolutionValue::Resolved => {}
                ReferenceResolutionValue::Stale | ReferenceResolutionValue::Expired =>
                    has_stale = true,
                ReferenceResolutionValue::Unresolved
                | ReferenceResolutionValue::Unavailable => has_unavailable = true,
                ReferenceResolutionValue::Invalid
                | ReferenceResolutionValue::Forbidden => must_redact = true,
            }
            audit_references.push(AuditHandoffReferenceStateView {
                audit_ref_id: audit_ref.observability_audit_ref_id,
                resolution_state_ref: ReferenceResolutionStateRef::exact(
                    state.resolution_state_id, state.version.clone()),
                resolution_value: state.resolution_value,
            });
        }
    }
    if must_redact {
        return Ok(/* Degraded/Unavailable + Redacted;body=None */);
    }
    let trace_partial = trace.traceability_state == TraceabilityState::Partial;
    let trace_pending = trace.traceability_state == TraceabilityState::HandoffPending;
    let body = AuditHandoffTraceSummaryView {
        traceability_ref: CapabilityAccessTraceabilityRecordRef::exact(
            trace.traceability_record_id, trace.version),
        traceability_state: trace.traceability_state,
        handoff_scope: public_scope,
        audit_references,
        gap_reason: trace.gap_reason,
    };
    let (visibility, freshness, degraded) =
        if has_unavailable || trace_pending {
            (CapabilityQueryVisibility::Degraded,
             CapabilityQueryFreshness::Unavailable,
             vec![/* ReferenceUnavailable marker(s),stable trace-then-ref order */])
        } else if has_stale || trace_partial {
            (CapabilityQueryVisibility::Degraded,
             CapabilityQueryFreshness::StaleReadable,
             vec![/* StaleSource / Partial markers from persisted state */])
        } else {
            (CapabilityQueryVisibility::Visible,
             CapabilityQueryFreshness::Fresh, vec![])
        };
    Ok(CapabilityQueryResponse {
        query_name: /* exact closed GetAuditHandoffTraceSummary name */,
        surface: CapabilityQuerySurface {
            visibility, freshness, degraded,
            source_versions: decision.source_versions,
            evaluated_at: decision.evaluated_at,
        },
        body: Some(body),
    })
}
```

#### 25.4.5 Transaction / no-write boundary

No transaction is opened. Exact trace history and local body-free ref/state truth are read only after the visibility decision. Missing、stale or forbidden reference state never triggers `ObservabilityAuditHandoffPort`、canonical refresh or a new trace revision.

#### 25.4.6 Error / rejection mapping

| Branch | Classification |
|---|---|
| trace ref missing exact version、invalid/forbidden scope | `InvalidField / InvalidScope / BodyForbidden` before resolver/body reads |
| NotVisible / resolver Degraded | body `None`;trace/ref/state reads zero |
| visible exact trace miss | `Visible/Fresh`,body `None`;no current fallback |
| loaded trace id/version mismatch | `ConsistencyDefect(DomainObject(CapabilityAccessTraceabilityRecord), PersistedVersionSymmetry)` |
| no attached refs | complete body with empty vector;surface still follows persisted trace state |
| missing/wrong audit ref-state pair | exact `ConsistencyDefect(RequiredSidecar / PersistedVariantShape / PersistedOwnerRelation / PersistedVersionSymmetry)`;no half vector |
| complete Stale/Expired pair | degraded stale-readable safe body |
| complete Unresolved/Unavailable pair | degraded unavailable safe body |
| complete Invalid/Forbidden pair | degraded redacted,body None |
| repository failure | typed `ApplicationError`;no external audit fallback |

#### 25.4.7 Surface / effects

The body reports only the exact trace revision、validated inspection context and canonical state of all attached local audit refs. It does not report external delivery receipt、raw observability/audit content、test evidence、evidence alias or acceptance signature. Scope text never hides an attached id.

#### 25.4.8 Test cuts

1. Exact historical revision uses `get_revision`;current/latest fallback count is zero.
2. NotVisible/resolver Degraded calls no trace/ref/state repositories.
3. Scope passes forbidden-body validation,echoes exactly,and is never parsed to select ids.
4. None handoff refs returns an empty vector,not body none.
5. All attached refs preserve typed-set order and require exact ObservabilityAudit union + state parity.
6. Missing/wrong pair returns exact consistency error,no partial vector and never silently drops one item.
7. Stale/Expired、Unresolved/Unavailable and Invalid/Forbidden map to distinct safe surfaces.
8. Handoff Port、audit store、reference refresh、trace append、UoW and evidence generation calls remain zero.

#### 25.4.9 Single-flow stop review

| Gate | Result |
|---|---|
| exact revision | pass;historical read never upgrades to current |
| scope semantics | pass;inspection context,not string predicate |
| pair completeness | pass;all-or-no body construction,no half item |
| audit boundary | pass;ids + canonical states only |
| no-write | pass;local reads only,no handoff or refresh |

### 25.5 `query_search_capability_directory_flow`

#### 25.5.1 Entry and target

| protocol | `CapabilityQueryRequest<SearchCapabilityDirectoryQuery>` -> `CapabilityPageResponse<CapabilityDirectoryProjectionView>` |
| entry / service | `CapabilityQueryHandlers::search_capability_directory(...)` -> `CapabilityDerivedMaterialQueryService::search_capability_directory(...)` |
| read subject | `CapabilityReadSubjectRef::DirectorySearchCollection` from `resolve_directory_search(actor,&scope)` |
| target read | one `CapabilityDerivedMaterialRepository::search_directory_projections(scope,page)` call after Visible |
| non-effect | no registry/exposure fallback、projection rebuild/save、ranking mutation、runtime execution、marketplace listing or Job start |

#### 25.5.2 DTO field sources

| Field | Source | Validation / use |
|---|---|---|
| `query_text` | optional `CapabilitySafeText` | non-empty and forbidden-body checked by public/application validation;copied exactly,never interpreted as external query language |
| `facets` | optional `DirectorySearchFacetSet` | typed、non-empty when present、stable and duplicate-free;copied to scope |
| scope | validated text + facets | both absent means stable search-all projection order;does not switch to browse route or registry truth |
| page | public cursor/limit | cursor bound to Search operation + exact text/facet scope;Browse cursor is invalid |
| item fields | each loaded `DirectorySearchBrowseProjection` | exact 12-field copy after persisted version、source-ref shape and facet parity |
| state aggregate | each persisted `DirectoryProjectionState` | `Unavailable > Rebuilding > Stale > Ready`;timestamps、latency and private ranking score excluded |

#### 25.5.3 ASCII call graph

```text
handler -> validate route/name/schema/text/facets/page -> from_query
  -> service.assert_query_no_write
  -> CapabilityDirectoryRepositorySearchScope(query_text,facets)
  -> DirectorySearchCollection
  -> resolve_directory_search(actor,scope)
     -> assert subject/actor -> decision no-write
     -> NotVisible:empty/no cursor;search zero
     -> resolver Degraded:degraded empty/no cursor;search zero
     -> Visible:derived_repo.search_directory_projections(scope,page)
        -> each Loaded version + exact source refs + requested-facet parity
        -> query-text matching remains repository contract;no summary parsing
        -> map every complete persisted projection in repository order
        -> aggregate Unavailable > Rebuilding > Stale > Ready
        -> opaque Search cursor + final count + has_more
```

#### 25.5.4 Rust-style function pseudocode

```rust
async fn search_capability_directory(
    &self,
    context: CapabilityOperationContext,
    query: SearchCapabilityDirectoryQuery,
) -> Result<CapabilityPageResponse<CapabilityDirectoryProjectionView>, ApplicationError> {
    context.assert_query_no_write()?;
    /* Public decoding/factory validation rejects empty/forbidden text and invalid facets. */
    let scope = CapabilityDirectoryRepositorySearchScope {
        query_text: query.query_text.clone(),
        facets: query.facets.clone(),
    };
    let repository_page = CapabilityRepositoryPageRequest::try_new(
        /* cursor validated against Search + exact text/facets */, query.page.limit)?;
    let subject = CapabilityReadSubjectRef::DirectorySearchCollection;
    let resolution = self.visibility_resolver
        .resolve_directory_search(&context.actor_context, &scope).await?;
    resolution.assert_matches(&subject, &context.actor_context)?;
    let decision = resolution.into_decision()?;
    decision.assert_query_no_write(&context)?;
    if decision.is_not_visible() || decision.can_serve_degraded_surface() {
        return Ok(CapabilityPageResponse {
            query_name: /* exact closed SearchCapabilityDirectory name */,
            surface: /* exact NotVisible or resolver-Degraded surface */,
            items: vec![],
            page: CapabilityPublicPageInfo {
                next_cursor: None, returned_count: 0, has_more: false,
            },
        });
    }
    if !decision.can_serve_full_surface() {
        return Err(ApplicationError::TechnicalInvariantViolation {
            object: ApplicationTechnicalObjectKind::ReadVisibilityDecision,
            invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::ReadVisibilityShape,
        });
    }

    let page = self.derived_material_repo
        .search_directory_projections(scope.clone(), repository_page).await?;
    let mut items = Vec::with_capacity(page.items.len());
    let mut has_stale = false;
    let mut has_rebuilding = false;
    let mut has_unavailable = false;
    for loaded in page.items {
        let projection = loaded.value;
        let source_refs_are_exact =
            projection.source_registry_entry_ref.version.is_some()
            && projection.source_descriptor_ref.version.is_some()
            && projection.source_exposure_ref.version.is_some();
        let facets_match = scope.facets.as_ref().is_none_or(
            |required| projection.filter_facets.contains_all(required));
        if loaded.expected_version != projection.version
            || !source_refs_are_exact
            || !facets_match
            || !projection.is_read_only()
        {
            return Err(ApplicationError::ConsistencyDefect {
                subject: ApplicationConsistencySubjectKind::PortReturn {
                    port: ApplicationPortKind::CapabilityDerivedMaterialRepository,
                },
                invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::RepositoryAccessShape,
            });
        }
        /* Query-text matching is adapter conformance;application never parses
           display_summary or a private score to re-filter/rerank rows. */
        match projection.freshness_state {
            DirectoryProjectionState::Ready => {}
            DirectoryProjectionState::Stale => has_stale = true,
            DirectoryProjectionState::Rebuilding => has_rebuilding = true,
            DirectoryProjectionState::Unavailable => has_unavailable = true,
        }
        items.push(CapabilityDirectoryProjectionView {
            projection_ref: DirectorySearchBrowseProjectionRef::exact(
                projection.projection_id, projection.version.clone()),
            source_registry_entry_ref: projection.source_registry_entry_ref,
            source_descriptor_ref: projection.source_descriptor_ref,
            source_exposure_ref: projection.source_exposure_ref,
            display_summary: projection.display_summary,
            filter_facets: projection.filter_facets,
            source_versions: projection.source_versions,
            freshness_state: projection.freshness_state,
            state_reason: projection.state_reason,
            version: projection.version,
            created_at: projection.created_at,
            refreshed_at: projection.refreshed_at,
        });
    }
    let (visibility, freshness, degraded) = if has_unavailable {
        (CapabilityQueryVisibility::Degraded,
         CapabilityQueryFreshness::Unavailable,
         vec![/* MaterialUnavailable marker from persisted projection state */])
    } else if has_rebuilding {
        (CapabilityQueryVisibility::Degraded,
         CapabilityQueryFreshness::Rebuilding,
         vec![/* Rebuilding marker from persisted projection state */])
    } else if has_stale {
        (CapabilityQueryVisibility::Degraded,
         CapabilityQueryFreshness::StaleReadable,
         vec![/* StaleSource marker from persisted projection state */])
    } else {
        (CapabilityQueryVisibility::Visible,
         CapabilityQueryFreshness::Fresh, vec![])
    };
    let next_cursor = page.next_cursor
        .map(|cursor| /* opaque public Search cursor bound to exact scope */);
    let returned_count = u32::try_from(items.len())
        .map_err(|_| ApplicationError::ConsistencyDefect {
            subject: ApplicationConsistencySubjectKind::PortReturn {
                port: ApplicationPortKind::CapabilityDerivedMaterialRepository,
            },
            invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::RepositoryAccessShape,
        })?;
    let has_more = next_cursor.is_some();
    Ok(CapabilityPageResponse {
        query_name: /* exact closed SearchCapabilityDirectory name */,
        surface: CapabilityQuerySurface {
            visibility, freshness, degraded,
            source_versions: decision.source_versions,
            evaluated_at: decision.evaluated_at,
        },
        items,
        page: CapabilityPublicPageInfo { next_cursor, returned_count, has_more },
    })
}
```

#### 25.5.5 Transaction / no-write boundary

No transaction is opened. Scope construction、facet membership validation、state aggregation and public cursor mapping are pure. Search reads only persisted projections and cannot build missing material、mark stale/rebuilding or read registry/exposure as a fallback.

#### 25.5.6 Error / rejection mapping

| Branch | Classification |
|---|---|
| empty/forbidden query text、invalid/duplicate facets | `InvalidField / BodyForbidden` before resolver/search |
| Search cursor used with another operation/scope or invalid limit | `InvalidPage` before search |
| NotVisible / resolver Degraded | canonical empty/no cursor;search call zero |
| visible no match | normal `Visible/Fresh` empty page |
| item version/source-ref/facet/read-only mismatch | `ConsistencyDefect(PortReturn(CapabilityDerivedMaterialRepository), RepositoryAccessShape)`;no row drop or fallback |
| persisted Stale/Rebuilding/Unavailable | complete items retained;fixed outer degraded surface |
| repository failure | typed `ApplicationError`;not converted to empty/material unavailable |

#### 25.5.7 Surface / effects

The page is a read-only,body-free directory projection. It does not claim registry membership beyond the stored source refs,does not expose ranking/query-plan state and is not a marketplace listing or runtime capability search. Repository order is authoritative and application reranking is forbidden.

#### 25.5.8 Test cuts

1. Scope is complete before `resolve_directory_search`;resolver precedes search.
2. Text-only、facet-only、text+facet and both-absent scopes preserve distinct cursor bindings.
3. Browse cursor on Search route rejects before resolver/search.
4. NotVisible/resolver Degraded returns empty/no cursor and search count zero.
5. Every requested facet must be present through `contains_all`;wrong row causes an error,not silent filtering.
6. Query text is never matched by parsing `display_summary`;private score never reranks items.
7. Mixed persisted states retain order and aggregate `Unavailable > Rebuilding > Stale > Ready`.
8. Registry/exposure repositories、marketplace/runtime adapters、Job、UoW and all writes remain uncalled.

#### 25.5.9 Single-flow stop review

| Gate | Result |
|---|---|
| search scope | pass;text/facets are validated body-free inputs |
| resolver-first | pass;DirectorySearchCollection before search |
| item parity | pass;version、exact sources、facets and read-only guard |
| state/page | pass;persisted priority、stable order and opaque Search cursor |
| authority/no-write | pass;projection only,no registry/runtime/listing effect |

| `TraceabilityAndScope.traceability_ref` | caller exact historical trace ref | version required;`get_revision` must return that revision,never current/latest |
| `TraceabilityAndScope.export_scope` | caller body-free scope | validate before resolver;raw audit query、credential、evidence alias or acceptance material is forbidden |
| view fields | one persisted `AuditFriendlyExportSummary` | exact 11-field copy;trace/scope parity is mandatory and observability refs remain typed ids only |
| public state | persisted `AuditExportState` | `Ready/Fresh`;`Partial/StaleReadable`;`Stale/StaleReadable`;`Unavailable/Unavailable`;no synthetic `Rebuilding` branch |

#### 25.7.3 ASCII call graph

```text
handler -> validate selector + exact versions + body-free scope -> from_query
  -> service.assert_query_no_write
  -> Exact:AuditExport(id) OR TraceabilityAndScope:Traceability(id)
  -> resolve_subject -> assert subject/actor -> decision no-write

        TraceabilityAndScope
          -> traceability.get_revision(exact historical ref)
          -> exact trace id/version parity
          -> derived_material.find_audit_export_by_traceability(exact trace ref,scope)
        -> visible miss:body None
        -> export persisted-version + selector trace/scope parity
        -> map complete safe export view
        -> Ready / Partial / Stale / Unavailable persisted-state surface
```
