#### 25.7.4 Rust-style function pseudocode

```rust
async fn get_audit_friendly_export_summary(
    &self,
    context: CapabilityOperationContext,
    query: GetAuditFriendlyExportSummaryQuery,
) -> Result<CapabilityQueryResponse<AuditFriendlyExportSummaryView>, ApplicationError> {
    context.assert_query_no_write()?;
    let subject = match &query.selector {
        AuditExportQuerySelector::Exact(export_ref) => {
            if export_ref.version.is_none() {
                return Err(/* InvalidField:exact export version required */);
            }
            CapabilityReadSubjectRef::AuditExport(export_ref.id.clone())
        }
        AuditExportQuerySelector::TraceabilityAndScope {
            traceability_ref,
            export_scope,
        } => {
            if traceability_ref.version.is_none() {
                return Err(/* InvalidField:exact trace revision required */);
            }
            // The handler already constructed a validated body-free contract value.
            CapabilityReadSubjectRef::Traceability(traceability_ref.id.clone())
        }
    };
    let resolution = self.visibility_resolver
        .resolve_subject(&context.actor_context, subject.clone()).await?;
    resolution.assert_matches(&subject, &context.actor_context)?;
    let decision = resolution.into_decision()?;
    decision.assert_query_no_write(&context)?;
    if decision.is_not_visible() {
        return Ok(/* exact NotVisible response;body=None;zero target reads */);
    }
    if decision.can_serve_degraded_surface() {
        return Ok(/* resolver-Degraded response;body=None;zero target reads */);
    }
    if !decision.can_serve_full_surface() {
        return Err(ApplicationError::TechnicalInvariantViolation {
            object: ApplicationTechnicalObjectKind::ReadVisibilityDecision,
            invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::ReadVisibilityShape,
        });
    }

    let (loaded_export, selected_trace_ref, selected_scope) =
        match &query.selector {
            AuditExportQuerySelector::Exact(export_ref) => (
                self.derived_material_repo
                    .get_audit_export_with_version(export_ref.clone()).await?,
                None,
                None,
            ),
            AuditExportQuerySelector::TraceabilityAndScope {
                traceability_ref,
                export_scope,
            } => {
                let trace = match self.traceability_repo
                    .get_revision(traceability_ref.clone()).await?
                {
                    Some(trace) if trace.traceability_record_id == traceability_ref.id
                        && traceability_ref.version.as_ref() == Some(&trace.version) => trace,
                    None => return Ok(/* Visible/Fresh body=None:exact trace absent */),
                    Some(_) => return Err(ApplicationError::ConsistencyDefect {
                        subject: ApplicationConsistencySubjectKind::DomainObject {
                            object: DomainObjectKind::CapabilityAccessTraceabilityRecord,
                        },
                        invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::PersistedVersionSymmetry,
                    }),
                };
                let exact_trace_ref = CapabilityAccessTraceabilityRecordRef::exact(
                    trace.traceability_record_id,
                    trace.version,
                );
                let loaded = self.derived_material_repo
                    .find_audit_export_by_traceability(
                        exact_trace_ref.clone(), export_scope).await?;
                (loaded, Some(exact_trace_ref), Some(export_scope.clone()))
            }
        };
    let export = match loaded_export {
        None => return Ok(/* Visible/Fresh body=None:no exact/current export */),
        Some(loaded) if loaded.expected_version == loaded.value.version => loaded.value,
        Some(_) => return Err(ApplicationError::ConsistencyDefect {
            subject: ApplicationConsistencySubjectKind::DomainObject {
                object: DomainObjectKind::AuditExport,
            },
            invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::PersistedVersionSymmetry,
        }),
    };
    if let AuditExportQuerySelector::Exact(export_ref) = &query.selector {
        if export.export_summary_id != export_ref.id
            || export_ref.version.as_ref() != Some(&export.version)
        {
            return Err(ApplicationError::ConsistencyDefect {
                subject: ApplicationConsistencySubjectKind::DomainObject {
                    object: DomainObjectKind::AuditExport,
                },
                invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::PersistedVersionSymmetry,
            });
        }
    }
    if selected_trace_ref.as_ref().is_some_and(
        |trace_ref| trace_ref != &export.traceability_record_ref)
        || selected_scope.as_ref().is_some_and(
            |scope| scope != &export.export_scope)
        || export.traceability_record_ref.version.is_none()
    {
        return Err(ApplicationError::ConsistencyDefect {
            subject: ApplicationConsistencySubjectKind::CrossStoreRelation,
            invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::PersistedOwnerRelation,
        });
    }
    let reason_pair_is_valid = match &export.export_state {
        AuditExportState::Ready => export.state_reason.is_none(),
        AuditExportState::Partial
        | AuditExportState::Stale
        | AuditExportState::Unavailable => export.state_reason.is_some(),
    };
    if !reason_pair_is_valid {
        return Err(ApplicationError::DomainRejected(
            DomainError::InvariantViolation {
                object: DomainObjectKind::AuditExport,
                invariant: DomainInvariantKind::StateDependentFieldShape,
            },
        ));
    }

    let body = AuditFriendlyExportSummaryView {
        export_ref: AuditFriendlyExportSummaryRef::exact(
            export.export_summary_id, export.version.clone()),
        traceability_ref: export.traceability_record_ref,
        export_scope: export.export_scope,
        allowed_summary: export.allowed_summary,
        observability_refs: export.observability_refs,
        source_versions: export.source_versions,
        export_state: export.export_state.clone(),
        state_reason: export.state_reason,
        version: export.version,
        created_at: export.created_at,
        refreshed_at: export.refreshed_at,
    };
    let (visibility, freshness, degraded) = match &body.export_state {
        AuditExportState::Ready => (
            CapabilityQueryVisibility::Visible,
            CapabilityQueryFreshness::Fresh,
            vec![],
        ),
        AuditExportState::Partial => (
            CapabilityQueryVisibility::Degraded,
            CapabilityQueryFreshness::StaleReadable,
            vec![/* Partial marker from persisted state + safe issue ref */],
        ),
        AuditExportState::Stale => (
            CapabilityQueryVisibility::Degraded,
            CapabilityQueryFreshness::StaleReadable,
            vec![/* StaleSource marker from persisted state + safe issue ref */],
        ),
        AuditExportState::Unavailable => (
            CapabilityQueryVisibility::Degraded,
            CapabilityQueryFreshness::Unavailable,
            vec![/* MaterialUnavailable marker + safe issue ref */],
        ),
    };
    Ok(CapabilityQueryResponse {
        query_name: /* exact closed GetAuditFriendlyExportSummary name */,
        surface: CapabilityQuerySurface {
            visibility,
            freshness,
            degraded,
            source_versions: decision.source_versions,
            evaluated_at: decision.evaluated_at,
        },
        body: Some(body),
    })
}
```

The handler constructs `AuditExportScope` through the existing contract-value validation boundary before this service is called;the comment does not add a Port or public callable. Exact consistency variants are fixed in this flow by Step 12 batch `12.4`;safe issue-ref formation remains the shared Step 12 mapper responsibility.

#### 25.7.5 Transaction / no-write boundary

No transaction is opened. The exact branch performs one export read;the trace-and-scope branch performs one exact historical trace read and one export lookup. Neither branch calls export preparation/rebuild、audit handoff、raw audit storage、idempotency、stored-result or any save/append method.

#### 25.7.6 Error / rejection mapping

| Branch | Classification |
|---|---|
| malformed selector、missing exact version、invalid/forbidden scope | `MissingRequiredField / InvalidField / InvalidScope / BodyForbidden` before resolver |
| NotVisible / resolver Degraded | body `None`;trace/export repository calls zero |
| visible exact export or exact historical trace miss | `Visible/Fresh`,body `None`;no latest/current fallback |
| loaded trace id/version、export id/version or trace/scope mismatch | exact `ConsistencyDefect(PersistedOwnerRelation / PersistedVersionSymmetry)`;never return another export |
| invalid persisted state/reason pairing | `DomainRejected(InvariantViolation(AuditExport, StateDependentFieldShape))`;not raw error text |
| Ready / Partial / Stale / Unavailable | exact four-state mapping;safe export body retained in every persisted state |
| repository failure | typed `ApplicationError`;not converted to Unavailable and no audit-store fallback |

#### 25.7.7 Surface / effects

The response contains only the persisted redacted summary、typed observability refs and exact source markers. It does not expose raw audit logs/spans/metrics、create an evidence alias、prove acceptance or report external handoff delivery. A historical trace selector is never silently upgraded to current.

#### 25.7.8 Test cuts

1. Selector tag alone chooses exact versus trace-and-scope;cross-branch field inference is absent.
2. Both versioned selector forms require exact versions before resolver or repository access.
3. Trace-and-scope uses `get_revision`,then `find_audit_export_by_traceability` with that exact ref and scope.
4. NotVisible/resolver Degraded causes zero trace/export reads;visible miss remains distinct.
5. Exact export id/version and trace/scope ownership mismatches never return a body from another selector.
6. Four persisted states map without a `Rebuilding` branch;timestamps and errors do not choose state.
7. Partial、Stale and Unavailable retain only the declared safe view;observability ids cause no audit-body reads.
8. UoW、save/append、prepare/rebuild Job、handoff、event capture and evidence generation calls remain zero.

#### 25.7.9 Single-flow stop review

| Gate | Result |
|---|---|
| selector / exact revision | pass;exact and historical branches stay disjoint |
| resolver-first | pass;no trace/export body read precedes decision |
| export parity | pass;persisted version、trace and scope are exact |
| state / audit boundary | pass;actual four states and redacted material only |
| struct comments | pass;no new public struct/field/variant;all mapped view fields have upstream English Rustdoc |
| no-write | pass;local reads only,no rebuild/handoff/evidence effect |

```rust
    }
```

```rust
            invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::ReadVisibilityShape,
        });
    }

    match query.selector {
        CapabilityReconciliationReportQuerySelector::Exact(report_ref) => {
            let report = match self.reconciliation_report_repo
                .get(report_ref.clone()).await?
            {
                Some(report) if report.reconciliation_report_id == report_ref.id
                    && report_ref.version.as_ref() == Some(&report.version) => report,
                None => return Ok(/* Visible/Fresh body=None:exact report absent */),
                Some(_) => return Err(ApplicationError::ConsistencyDefect {
                    subject: ApplicationConsistencySubjectKind::DomainObject {
                        object: DomainObjectKind::ReconciliationReport,
                    },
                    invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::PersistedVersionSymmetry,
                }),
            };
            let failure_pair_is_valid = match &report.report_state {
                ReconciliationReportState::Failed => report.failure_reason.is_some(),
                ReconciliationReportState::Completed
                | ReconciliationReportState::Partial
                | ReconciliationReportState::Inconsistent
                | ReconciliationReportState::RebuildRequired =>
                    report.failure_reason.is_none(),
            };
            if !report.does_not_change_truth() || !failure_pair_is_valid {
                return Err(ApplicationError::DomainRejected(
                    DomainError::InvariantViolation {
                        object: DomainObjectKind::ReconciliationReport,
                        invariant: DomainInvariantKind::ReconciliationOutcomeShape,
                    },
                ));
            }
            let report_state = report.report_state.clone();
            let (visibility, freshness, degraded) = match &report_state {
                ReconciliationReportState::Completed => (
                    CapabilityQueryVisibility::Visible,
                    CapabilityQueryFreshness::Fresh,
                    vec![],
                ),
                ReconciliationReportState::Partial => (
                    CapabilityQueryVisibility::Degraded,
                    CapabilityQueryFreshness::StaleReadable,
                    vec![/* Partial marker */],
                ),
                ReconciliationReportState::Inconsistent
                | ReconciliationReportState::RebuildRequired => (
                    CapabilityQueryVisibility::Degraded,
                    CapabilityQueryFreshness::StaleReadable,
                    vec![/* StaleSource marker */],
                ),
                ReconciliationReportState::Failed => (
                    CapabilityQueryVisibility::Degraded,
                    CapabilityQueryFreshness::Unavailable,
                    vec![/* MaterialUnavailable marker */],
                ),
            };
            let body = CapabilityReconciliationReportQueryBody::Exact(
                CapabilityReconciliationReportView {
                    report_ref: CapabilityReconciliationReportRef::exact(
                        report.reconciliation_report_id, report.version.clone()),
                    reconciliation_scope: report.reconciliation_scope,
                    source_truth_refs: report.source_truth_refs,
                    inspected_material_refs: report.inspected_material_refs,
                    source_versions: report.source_versions,
                    finding_summary: report.finding_summary,
                    report_state: report.report_state,
                    failure_reason: report.failure_reason,
                    job_run_id: report.job_run_id,
                    generated_by: report.generated_by,
                    trace_id: report.trace_id,
                    version: report.version,
                    generated_at: report.generated_at,
                });
            Ok(CapabilityQueryResponse {
                query_name: /* exact closed GetCapabilityReconciliationReport name */,
                surface: CapabilityQuerySurface {
                    visibility, freshness, degraded,
                    source_versions: decision.source_versions,
                    evaluated_at: decision.evaluated_at,
                },
                body: Some(body),
            })
        }
        CapabilityReconciliationReportQuerySelector::Scope {
            reconciliation_scope,
            page: _,
        } => {
            let repository_page = match repository_page {
                Some(page) => page,
                None => return Err(ApplicationError::InvalidInput {
                    input: ApplicationInputKind::RepositoryPage,
                    invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::RepositoryAccessShape,
                }),
            };
            let page = self.reconciliation_report_repo.list_by_scope(
                &reconciliation_scope,
                repository_page,
            ).await?;
            let mut items = Vec::with_capacity(page.items.len());
            let mut has_partial = false;
            let mut has_inconsistent = false;
            let mut has_rebuild_required = false;
            let mut has_failed = false;
            for report in page.items {
                let failure_pair_is_valid = match &report.report_state {
                    ReconciliationReportState::Failed => report.failure_reason.is_some(),
                    ReconciliationReportState::Completed
                    | ReconciliationReportState::Partial
                    | ReconciliationReportState::Inconsistent
                    | ReconciliationReportState::RebuildRequired =>
                        report.failure_reason.is_none(),
                };
                if report.reconciliation_scope != reconciliation_scope {
                    return Err(ApplicationError::ConsistencyDefect {
                        subject: ApplicationConsistencySubjectKind::PortReturn {
                            port: ApplicationPortKind::CapabilityReconciliationReportRepository,
                        },
                        invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::RepositoryAccessShape,
                    });
                }
                if !report.does_not_change_truth() || !failure_pair_is_valid {
                    return Err(ApplicationError::DomainRejected(
                        DomainError::InvariantViolation {
                            object: DomainObjectKind::ReconciliationReport,
                            invariant: DomainInvariantKind::ReconciliationOutcomeShape,
                        },
                    ));
                }
                match &report.report_state {
                    ReconciliationReportState::Completed => {}
                    ReconciliationReportState::Partial => has_partial = true,
                    ReconciliationReportState::Inconsistent => has_inconsistent = true,
                    ReconciliationReportState::RebuildRequired =>
                        has_rebuild_required = true,
                    ReconciliationReportState::Failed => has_failed = true,
                }
                items.push(CapabilityReconciliationReportView {
                    report_ref: CapabilityReconciliationReportRef::exact(
                        report.reconciliation_report_id, report.version.clone()),
                    reconciliation_scope: report.reconciliation_scope,
                    source_truth_refs: report.source_truth_refs,
                    inspected_material_refs: report.inspected_material_refs,
                    source_versions: report.source_versions,
                    finding_summary: report.finding_summary,
                    report_state: report.report_state,
                    failure_reason: report.failure_reason,
                    job_run_id: report.job_run_id,
                    generated_by: report.generated_by,
                    trace_id: report.trace_id,
                    version: report.version,
                    generated_at: report.generated_at,
                });
            }
            let (visibility, freshness, degraded) = if has_failed {
                (CapabilityQueryVisibility::Degraded,
                 CapabilityQueryFreshness::Unavailable,
                 vec![/* MaterialUnavailable marker from persisted Failed */])
            } else if has_rebuild_required {
                (CapabilityQueryVisibility::Degraded,
                 CapabilityQueryFreshness::StaleReadable,
                 vec![/* StaleSource marker:RebuildRequired */])
            } else if has_inconsistent {
                (CapabilityQueryVisibility::Degraded,
                 CapabilityQueryFreshness::StaleReadable,
                 vec![/* StaleSource marker:Inconsistent */])
            } else if has_partial {
                (CapabilityQueryVisibility::Degraded,
                 CapabilityQueryFreshness::StaleReadable,
                 vec![/* Partial marker */])
            } else {
                (CapabilityQueryVisibility::Visible,
                 CapabilityQueryFreshness::Fresh, vec![])
            };
            let next_cursor = page.next_cursor.map(
                |cursor| /* opaque public cursor bound to Scope + exact scope */);
            let returned_count = u32::try_from(items.len())
                .map_err(|_| ApplicationError::ConsistencyDefect {
                    subject: ApplicationConsistencySubjectKind::PortReturn {
                        port: ApplicationPortKind::CapabilityReconciliationReportRepository,
                    },
                    invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::RepositoryAccessShape,
                })?;
            let has_more = next_cursor.is_some();
            Ok(CapabilityQueryResponse {
                query_name: /* exact closed GetCapabilityReconciliationReport name */,
                surface: CapabilityQuerySurface {
                    visibility, freshness, degraded,
                    source_versions: decision.source_versions,
                    evaluated_at: decision.evaluated_at,
                },
                body: Some(CapabilityReconciliationReportQueryBody::ScopePage(
                    CapabilityReconciliationReportPageView {
                        items,
                        page: CapabilityPublicPageInfo {
                            next_cursor, returned_count, has_more,
                        },
                    },
                )),
            })
        }
    }
}
```

The handler constructs `CapabilityReconciliationScope` through the existing contract-value validation boundary before this service is called. State/failure pairing and public state mapping are exhaustive inline matches;the scope branch converts an impossible missing repository page into a typed internal invariant rather than panicking or exposing text.

#### 25.9.5 Transaction / no-write boundary

No transaction is opened. Exact and scope branches read immutable reports only. The service does not call `CapabilityReconciliationReportRepository::append` or `find_by_job_run`,does not start reconciliation/rebuild work and cannot change any truth/material based on `requires_rebuild()` or a finding.

#### 25.9.6 Error / rejection mapping

| Branch | Classification |
|---|---|
| malformed selector/ref、missing exact version、invalid scope/page/cursor | `MissingRequiredField / InvalidField / InvalidScope / InvalidPage` before resolver/list |
| NotVisible / resolver Degraded | body `None`;exact get/list calls zero |
| visible exact report miss | `Visible/Fresh`,body `None` |
| visible scope with no reports | `Some(ScopePage(empty))`,`Visible/Fresh`,no cursor unless repository supplies one |
| exact report id/version mismatch | `ConsistencyDefect(DomainObject(ReconciliationReport), PersistedVersionSymmetry)` |
| Scope selector without repository page carrier | `InvalidInput(RepositoryPage, RepositoryAccessShape)` |
| scope-page item scope mismatch | `ConsistencyDefect(PortReturn(CapabilityReconciliationReportRepository), RepositoryAccessShape)`;no row drop or first-item shortcut |
| report no-truth-write or state/failure-pair mismatch | `DomainRejected(InvariantViolation(ReconciliationReport, ReconciliationOutcomeShape))` |
| persisted Failed report | degraded unavailable safe body retained;not a repository failure、test result or fresh execution claim |
| repository failure | typed `ApplicationError`;never fabricated as a Failed report |

#### 25.9.7 Surface / effects

The response exposes immutable stored comparison reports only. `job_run_id` and `trace_id` are copied correlation fields;they do not prove a real execution outside the stored report、a test run、an evidence alias、acceptance sign-off or governance approval. `RebuildRequired` is informative and never invokes repair/rebuild from this Query.

#### 25.9.8 Test cuts

1. Exact and Scope selectors use different resolver methods/subjects and cannot replay each other's cursor or body shape.
2. Exact ref requires id/version parity;visible missing remains body none.
3. Scope resolution precedes `list_by_scope`;NotVisible/resolver Degraded list count is zero.
4. Visible empty scope returns `Some(ScopePage(empty))`,not outer none or an Exact body.
5. Every page item matches exact scope and valid `Failed <=> failure_reason` pairing;no row is silently dropped.
6. Mixed page state priority is exactly `Failed > RebuildRequired > Inconsistent > Partial > Completed`,without reordering items.
7. Failed body is retained and repository failure remains `ApplicationError`;neither fabricates run/test evidence.
8. `does_not_change_truth()` remains true;append、repair、rebuild Job、UoW、idempotency、handoff and event calls remain zero.

#### 25.9.9 Single-flow stop review

| Gate | Result |
|---|---|
| selector / body union | pass;Exact and ScopePage remain closed distinct branches |
| resolver-first | pass;single and collection decisions precede target reads |
| immutable parity | pass;exact version、scope and state/reason pairing |
| empty/page aggregation | pass;explicit empty ScopePage and deterministic priority |
| fabrication boundary | pass;stored correlation fields are not execution/test/evidence claims |
| struct comments | pass;no new public struct/field/variant;all report/page/union fields have upstream English Rustdoc |
| no-write | pass;immutable reads only,no append/repair/rebuild effect |

### 27.1 `query_get_reference_resolution_state_flow`

#### 27.1.1 Entry and target

| Item | Exact contract |
|---|---|
| protocol | `CapabilityQueryRequest<GetReferenceResolutionStateQuery>` -> `CapabilityQueryResponse<ReferenceResolutionStateView>` |
| entry / service | `CapabilityQueryHandlers::get_reference_resolution_state(...)` -> `CapabilityReferenceQueryService::get_reference_resolution_state(...)` |
| read subject | `CapabilityReadSubjectRef::ExternalReference(query.reference_subject)` after pure subject-kind validation |
| target reads | registered eight-kind local reference union,then the single current canonical state for the same exact subject |
| non-effect | no external resolver/network、reference registration/replacement、state refresh/transition、Job、UoW、idempotency、stored result or event effect |

#### 27.1.2 DTO field sources

| Field | Source | Validation / use |
|---|---|---|
| `reference_subject` | caller closed eight-variant union | sole local identity source;never parsed from locator、kind text or route |
| `reference_kind` | caller closed eight-value enum | `ReferenceResolutionPolicy::validate_subject_kind` must pass before resolver/repository |
| registered ref/state link | exact `CapabilityExternalReference` variant | eight-way variant/id/kind match yields the stored `resolution_state_id`;wrong branch never retries another family |
| persisted ref version | `Loaded<CapabilityExternalReference>` | `expected_version` must equal the matched reference object's `version` |
| response fields | current `ReferenceResolutionState` | exact 10-field copy after state id、subject、kind and persisted-version parity |
| public state | persisted `ReferenceResolutionValue` | all seven values retain `Some(body)`;only visible unregistered-ref absence returns `None`;a registered ref without current state is a consistency defect |

#### 27.1.3 ASCII call graph

```text
handler -> validate route/name/schema + typed subject/kind -> from_query
  -> service.assert_query_no_write
  -> default reference policy.validate_subject_kind(subject,kind)
  -> ExternalReference(subject) -> resolve_subject
     -> assert subject/actor -> decision no-write
     -> NotVisible / resolver Degraded:body None;ref/state reads zero
     -> Visible:external_reference.get_with_version(subject)
        -> absent:Visible/NotApplicable body None
        -> explicit 8-way union -> registered subject/kind/state-id/version
        -> exact request + persisted-version parity
        -> reference_state.find_current_by_subject(subject)
        -> absent:technical ConsistencyDefect(RequiredSidecar)
        -> state id/subject/kind/persisted-version parity
        -> map exact ReferenceResolutionStateView
        -> seven-value surface;Invalid/Forbidden keep safe body + Redacted
```

#### 27.1.4 Rust-style function pseudocode

```rust
async fn get_reference_resolution_state(
    &self,
    context: CapabilityOperationContext,
    query: GetReferenceResolutionStateQuery,
) -> Result<CapabilityQueryResponse<ReferenceResolutionStateView>, ApplicationError> {
    context.assert_query_no_write()?;
    let policy = ReferenceResolutionPolicy::default_for_capability_references();
    policy.validate_subject_kind(
        &query.reference_subject, &query.reference_kind)?;

    let subject = CapabilityReadSubjectRef::ExternalReference(
        query.reference_subject.clone());
    let resolution = self.visibility_resolver
        .resolve_subject(&context.actor_context, subject.clone()).await?;
    resolution.assert_matches(&subject, &context.actor_context)?;
    let decision = resolution.into_decision()?;
    decision.assert_query_no_write(&context)?;
    if decision.is_not_visible() {
        return Ok(/* exact NotVisible response;body=None;zero target reads */);
    }
    if decision.can_serve_degraded_surface() {
        return Ok(/* resolver-Degraded response;body=None;zero target reads */);
    }
    if !decision.can_serve_full_surface() {
        return Err(ApplicationError::TechnicalInvariantViolation {
            object: ApplicationTechnicalObjectKind::ReadVisibilityDecision,
            invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::ReadVisibilityShape,
        });
    }

    let loaded_reference = match self.external_reference_repo
        .get_with_version(query.reference_subject.clone()).await?
    {
        Some(loaded) => loaded,
        None => return Ok(/* Visible/NotApplicable body=None:unregistered subject */),
    };
    let (registered_subject, registered_kind, linked_state_id, ref_version) =
        match loaded_reference.value {
            CapabilityExternalReference::ExternalCapabilitySource(reference) => (
                ReferenceSubjectRef::ExternalCapabilitySource(
                    reference.source_ref_id),
                ReferenceKind::ExternalCapabilitySource,
                reference.resolution_state_id,
                reference.version,
            ),
            CapabilityExternalReference::GovernanceResult(reference) => (
                ReferenceSubjectRef::GovernanceResult(
                    reference.governance_result_ref_id),
                ReferenceKind::GovernanceResult,
                reference.resolution_state_id,
                reference.version,
            ),
            CapabilityExternalReference::MethodAsset(reference) => (
                ReferenceSubjectRef::MethodAsset(reference.method_asset_ref_id),
                ReferenceKind::MethodAsset,
                reference.resolution_state_id,
                reference.version,
            ),
            CapabilityExternalReference::Secret(reference) => (
                ReferenceSubjectRef::Secret(reference.secret_ref_id),
                ReferenceKind::Secret,
                reference.resolution_state_id,
                reference.version,
            ),
            CapabilityExternalReference::ExternalDocument(reference) => (
                ReferenceSubjectRef::ExternalDocument(
                    reference.external_document_ref_id),
                ReferenceKind::ExternalDocument,
                reference.resolution_state_id,
                reference.version,
            ),
            CapabilityExternalReference::RuntimeToolsConsumer(reference) => (
                ReferenceSubjectRef::RuntimeToolsConsumer(
                    reference.runtime_tools_consumer_ref_id),
                ReferenceKind::RuntimeToolsConsumer,
                reference.resolution_state_id,
                reference.version,
            ),
            CapabilityExternalReference::SdkConsumer(reference) => (
                ReferenceSubjectRef::SdkConsumer(reference.sdk_consumer_ref_id),
                ReferenceKind::SdkConsumer,
                reference.resolution_state_id,
                reference.version,
            ),
            CapabilityExternalReference::ObservabilityAudit(reference) => (
                ReferenceSubjectRef::ObservabilityAudit(
                    reference.observability_audit_ref_id),
                ReferenceKind::ObservabilityAudit,
                reference.resolution_state_id,
                reference.version,
            ),
        };
    if registered_subject != query.reference_subject
        || registered_kind != query.reference_kind
    {
        return Err(ApplicationError::ConsistencyDefect {
            subject: ApplicationConsistencySubjectKind::CrossStoreRelation,
            invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::PersistedVariantShape,
        });
    }
    if loaded_reference.expected_version != ref_version {
```

```rust
        query.external_document_ref_id.clone());

        .resolve_subject(&context.actor_context, read_subject.clone()).await?;

    }

        return Err(ApplicationError::TechnicalInvariantViolation {
            object: ApplicationTechnicalObjectKind::ReadVisibilityDecision,
            invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::ReadVisibilityShape,
        });
    }

    let loaded_reference = match self.external_reference_repo
        .get_with_version(subject.clone()).await?
    {
        Some(loaded) => loaded,
        None => return Ok(/* Visible/NotApplicable body=None:unregistered document */),
    };
    let Loaded { value: registered, expected_version: ref_expected_version } =
        loaded_reference;

            if reference.external_document_ref_id == query.external_document_ref_id
                && reference.subject_ref() == subject

        CapabilityExternalReference::ExternalDocument(_) => {

        .find_current_by_subject(subject.clone()).await?
    {
        Some(loaded) => loaded,

                subject: ApplicationConsistencySubjectKind::CrossStoreRelation,
                invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::RequiredSidecar,
            });

    };

            state.resolution_state_id.clone(), state.version.clone()),
        reference_subject: state.reference_subject,
        reference_kind: state.reference_kind,
        resolution_value: state.resolution_value,
        resolution_reason: state.resolution_reason,
        checked_by: state.checked_by,

        created_at: state.created_at,
        last_checked_at: state.last_checked_at,
```

#### 27.4.4 Rust-style function pseudocode

```rust
async fn get_sdk_exposure_consumer_reference(
    &self,
    context: CapabilityOperationContext,
    query: GetSdkExposureConsumerReferenceQuery,
) -> Result<CapabilityQueryResponse<SdkExposureConsumerReferenceView>, ApplicationError> {
    context.assert_query_no_write()?;
    let subject = ReferenceSubjectRef::SdkConsumer(query.sdk_consumer_ref_id.clone());
    let reference_kind = ReferenceKind::SdkConsumer;
    let read_subject = CapabilityReadSubjectRef::ExternalReference(subject.clone());
    let resolution = self.visibility_resolver
        .resolve_subject(&context.actor_context, read_subject.clone()).await?;
    resolution.assert_matches(&read_subject, &context.actor_context)?;
    let decision = resolution.into_decision()?;
    decision.assert_query_no_write(&context)?;
    if decision.is_not_visible() {
        return Ok(/* exact NotVisible response;body=None;zero target reads */);
    }
    if decision.can_serve_degraded_surface() {
        return Ok(/* resolver-Degraded response;body=None;zero target reads */);
    }
    if !decision.can_serve_full_surface() {
        return Err(ApplicationError::TechnicalInvariantViolation {
            object: ApplicationTechnicalObjectKind::ReadVisibilityDecision,
            invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::ReadVisibilityShape,
        });
    }

    let loaded_reference = match self.external_reference_repo
        .get_with_version(subject.clone()).await?
    {
        Some(loaded) => loaded,
        None => return Ok(/* Visible/NotApplicable body=None:unregistered SDK ref */),
    };
    let Loaded { value: registered, expected_version: ref_expected_version } =
        loaded_reference;
    let reference = match registered {
        CapabilityExternalReference::SdkConsumer(reference)
            if reference.sdk_consumer_ref_id == query.sdk_consumer_ref_id
                && reference.subject_ref() == subject
                && ref_expected_version == reference.version => reference,
        CapabilityExternalReference::SdkConsumer(_) => {
            return Err(ApplicationError::ConsistencyDefect {
                subject: ApplicationConsistencySubjectKind::DomainObject {
                    object: DomainObjectKind::SdkConsumerReference,
                },
                invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::PersistedVersionSymmetry,
            });
        }
        _ => {
            return Err(ApplicationError::ConsistencyDefect {
                subject: ApplicationConsistencySubjectKind::DomainObject {
                    object: DomainObjectKind::SdkConsumerReference,
                },
                invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::PersistedVariantShape,
            });
        }
    };

    let loaded_state = match self.reference_state_repo
        .find_current_by_subject(subject.clone()).await?
    {
        Some(loaded) => loaded,
        None => {
            return Err(ApplicationError::ConsistencyDefect {
                subject: ApplicationConsistencySubjectKind::CrossStoreRelation,
                invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::RequiredSidecar,
            });
        }
    };
    let Loaded { value: state, expected_version: state_expected_version } = loaded_state;
    if state_expected_version != state.version
        || state.resolution_state_id != reference.resolution_state_id
        || !state.matches_subject(&subject, &reference_kind)
    {
        return Err(ApplicationError::ConsistencyDefect {
            subject: ApplicationConsistencySubjectKind::CrossStoreRelation,
            invariant: if state_expected_version != state.version {
                ApplicationInvariantKind::PersistedVersionSymmetry
            } else {
                ApplicationInvariantKind::PersistedOwnerRelation
            },
        });
    }

    let state_value = state.resolution_value.clone();
    let resolution_view = ReferenceResolutionStateView {
        resolution_state_ref: ReferenceResolutionStateRef::exact(
            state.resolution_state_id.clone(), state.version.clone()),
        reference_subject: state.reference_subject,
        reference_kind: state.reference_kind,
        resolution_value: state.resolution_value,
        resolution_reason: state.resolution_reason,
        checked_by: state.checked_by,
        trace_id: state.trace_id,
        version: state.version,
        created_at: state.created_at,
        last_checked_at: state.last_checked_at,
    };
    let body = SdkExposureConsumerReferenceView {
        sdk_consumer_ref_id: reference.sdk_consumer_ref_id,
        sdk_consumer_locator: reference.sdk_consumer_locator,
        sdk_surface_summary: reference.sdk_surface_summary,
        exposure_scope: reference.exposure_scope,
        resolution: resolution_view,
        version: reference.version,
        created_at: reference.created_at,
        updated_at: reference.updated_at,
    };
    let (visibility, freshness, degraded) = match state_value {
        ReferenceResolutionValue::Resolved => (
            CapabilityQueryVisibility::Visible,
            CapabilityQueryFreshness::NotApplicable,
            vec![],
        ),
        ReferenceResolutionValue::Unresolved => (
            CapabilityQueryVisibility::Degraded,
            CapabilityQueryFreshness::Unavailable,
            vec![/* ReferenceUnresolved marker + protocol-safe issue ref */],
        ),
        ReferenceResolutionValue::Stale | ReferenceResolutionValue::Expired => (
            CapabilityQueryVisibility::Degraded,
            CapabilityQueryFreshness::StaleReadable,
            vec![/* StaleSource marker + protocol-safe issue ref */],
        ),
        ReferenceResolutionValue::Unavailable => (
            CapabilityQueryVisibility::Degraded,
            CapabilityQueryFreshness::Unavailable,
            vec![/* ReferenceUnavailable marker + protocol-safe issue ref */],
        ),
        ReferenceResolutionValue::Invalid | ReferenceResolutionValue::Forbidden => (
            CapabilityQueryVisibility::Degraded,
            CapabilityQueryFreshness::Unavailable,
            vec![/* Redacted marker + protocol-safe issue ref */],
        ),
    };
    Ok(CapabilityQueryResponse {
        query_name: /* exact closed GetSdkExposureConsumerReference name */,
        surface: CapabilityQuerySurface {
            visibility,
            freshness,
            degraded,
            source_versions: decision.source_versions,
            evaluated_at: decision.evaluated_at,
        },
        body: Some(body),
    })
}
```

The exact `SdkConsumer` union branch and fixed reference kind prevent an SDK package/client identifier from becoming a local reference selector. The response's `sdk_surface_summary` and `exposure_scope` remain server-boundary summaries;Step 12 batch `12.4` fixes concrete consistency variants while the shared mapper owns issue-ref construction.

Once that ref exists,the linked current canonical state is mandatory:absence returns exact `ConsistencyDefect(CrossStoreRelation, RequiredSidecar)`,while wrong union、wrong id/kind、ref persisted-version mismatch、state-link mismatch and state persisted-version mismatch remain separate technical consistency branches. None can be represented as an `Invalid / Forbidden` body or degraded success;only a complete canonical `Invalid / Forbidden` state uses the redacted typed surface.

### 29.1 `inbound_consume_governance_result_reference_changed_flow`

#### 29.1.1 Entry and target

| Item | Exact contract |
|---|---|
| logical event | `capability-hub.inbound.governance-result-reference-changed.v1`;schema version `1`;source family `Governance` |
| worker / service | `CapabilityInboundEventHandlers::consume_governance_result_reference_changed(...)` -> `CapabilityInboundConsumerService::consume_governance_result_reference_changed(context,payload)` |
| trusted producer | configured L1-governance integration / system actor;not a capability-hub approval participant |
| local target | one `GovernanceResultRef` and its single canonical `ReferenceResolutionState`;new subject、ref-only revision、state-only revision、both revisions or strict no-op |
| completed result | exact `CapabilityInboundEventReceipt` + serialized surface + `CapabilityConsumerReceiptEnvelope` + immutable shell + idempotency completion |
| non-effect | no governance seam mutation/change record、approval、vote、Policy/shared_rules/workflow body、formal exposure、affected material or automatic follow-up Command |

#### 29.1.2 Envelope / DTO field sources

| Field / derived value | Authoritative source | Validation and use |
|---|---|---|
| consumer/source/schema/actor | envelope header | worker checks exact consumer、`Governance` family、configured actor and schema before typed decode;unsupported schema stops before payload decode/reserve |
| public source event / source key | envelope header -> `CapabilityOperationContext` | public ref enters receipt and request digest;source-provided key enters digest only;neither is reconstructed from topic or payload |
| local source event | worker one-way mapping -> context `source_event_ref` | retained for channel symmetry;not substituted for the public receipt identity |
| `target` | typed payload | `Existing` must be `ReferenceSubjectRef::GovernanceResult`;`ResolveOrRegister` permits digest reuse/new id only |
| kind/source/scope | typed payload | exact candidate fields and persisted ref fields;governance kind/source are immutable on an existing subject;scope is the only replaceable ref field |
| `declared_safe_summary` | typed payload | required body-free declaration;must equal resolver-owned `allowed_safe_summary`;never stored in ref or seam |
| request digest | application canonical input set | source family + public source event + source key + target variant + kind + source + scope + declared safe summary;excludes actor display、trace、occurred/local time、generated ids and resolver observation |
| candidate digest / locator | application from typed candidate fields | kind + source + scope;locator uses `ReferenceLocatorSummary::from_governance_result(&source,&scope)`;no approval/Policy text |
| local ids/time | `IdGeneratorPort` / `ClockPort` | new ref/state/result/surface ids only after the relevant branch;`occurred_at` never becomes local mutation time |

#### 29.1.3 ASCII call graph

```text
worker ingress
  -> validate header consumer/family/actor/source refs/key/trace/schema
     -> unsupported schema:return UnsupportedSchema;no typed decode/reserve/UoW
  -> decode exact payload;validate Existing target variant
  -> map public source ref -> local inbound ref + derived application key
  -> CapabilityOperationContext::from_inbound_event(...)
  -> exact worker handler -> exact application service
     -> assert_write_metadata_complete + body-free/forbidden scan + request digest
     -> idempotency.get_with_version(application key)
        -> completed same request:get_consumer_receipt -> response-only DuplicateReplayed;STOP
        -> mismatch/in-progress:quarantine/retry classification;no original result leakage;STOP
        -> absent:Clock.now -> begin UoW -> reserve_if_absent
           -> race Existing:rollback;no business ids/resolver/factory/effect write;STOP
           -> Reserved:continue
     -> candidate digest + governance locator constructor + ReferenceCandidate::body_free
     -> find_by_candidate_digest(GovernanceResult,digest)
        -> target collision with another subject:Quarantined;no effect
        -> ResolveOrRegister hit:reuse exact subject
        -> ResolveOrRegister miss:generate governance ref id + state id
        -> Existing hit/miss:retain declared subject;load exact union/current state
     -> GovernanceResultReferencePort::resolve_governance_result_reference
        -> unavailable:rollback -> Delayed,no completed receipt
        -> subject/kind/digest mismatch:technical ConsistencyDefect;rollback
        -> declared/allowed safe-summary mismatch:quarantine;no ref/state write
     -> new:from_initial_resolution + GovernanceResultRef::register
     -> existing:validate immutable fields/state link;replace_scope only if changed;
                  transition state only if value/reason changed
     -> save actual ref/state revisions;capture ReferenceResolutionChanged only for state revision
     -> build Accepted or Ignored receipt;affected/downstream refs empty;review marker only
     -> save_consumer_receipt + reservation.complete/save -> commit
```

```rust
    context.assert_write_metadata_complete()?;

        .ok_or(/* context consistency ApplicationError */)?;

        }

       Approval,Policy,shared_rules,vote or workflow material returns a body-free
       Quarantined surface and the offending bytes are never retained. */
    let request_digest: CapabilityRequestDigest =
        /* Step 13 canonical(source family + public source event + source key
           + target tag/subject + every concrete payload field) */;

    if let Some(existing) = self.idempotency_repo
        .get_with_version(&application_key).await?

                .get_consumer_receipt(&result_ref).await?
                .ok_or(/* missing typed receipt consistency error */)?;
            /* Validate operation/result/surface/public source-event symmetry. */
            return Ok(/* copy original receipt/effects/follow-ups;replace disposition with
                         DuplicateReplayed;append StoredReplay in stable order */);
        }
        return Ok(/* Quarantined or retry surface with empty effects;do not expose stored receipt */);
    }

    let now = self.clock.now();
    let reservation = CapabilityIdempotencyRecord::reserve(
        &context, request_digest.clone(), now.clone())?;
    let tx = self.uow_manager.begin().await?;
    let mut loaded_reservation = match self.idempotency_repo
        .reserve_if_absent(reservation, tx.as_ref()).await?
    {

        CapabilityIdempotencyReserveResult::Existing(existing) => {

            return /* classify atomic-reserve race from existing operation/digest/state;
                      no business IdGenerator/resolver/factory/effect call */;
        }
    };

    let reference_kind = ReferenceKind::GovernanceResult;
    let candidate_digest: ReferenceCandidateDigest =
        /* canonical governance kind + source + scope only */;
    let candidate = ReferenceCandidate::body_free(
        reference_kind.clone(),

            &payload.governance_source, &payload.result_scope_summary),

    let policy = ReferenceResolutionPolicy::default_for_capability_references();
    policy.validate_candidate(&candidate)?;
    let digest_owner = self.external_reference_repo
        .find_by_candidate_digest(reference_kind.clone(), &candidate_digest).await?;

    let (subject, loaded_reference, loaded_state, new_ids) = match target {
        Some((declared_id, declared_subject)) => {
            if digest_owner.as_ref().is_some_and(|loaded| match &loaded.value {

                        || loaded.expected_version != value.version
                }
                _ => true,

            {

            }

            let governance_ref = match &loaded_ref.value {

                    if value.governance_result_ref_id == declared_id

            };
            if governance_ref.governance_ref_kind != payload.governance_ref_kind
                || governance_ref.governance_source != payload.governance_source
            {

            }

    {

    }

    let mut ref_changed = false;
    let mut state_changed = false;
    let (reference_to_save, reference_expected, state_to_save, state_expected,

        match (loaded_reference, loaded_state, new_ids) {

                let state = ReferenceResolutionState::from_initial_resolution(
                    state_id.clone(), subject.clone(), reference_kind.clone(),

                    resolved.resolution.resolution_reason,

                    &policy, now.clone(),
                )?;

                    payload.result_scope_summary, candidate_digest,

        application_result_ref.clone(), StoredCapabilityResultKind::ConsumerReceipt,
```

The `then_some` expressions are schematic branch assembly,not new public helpers. Stable post-reserve rejection/quarantine uses the same exact consumer name、public source event、typed shell/surface/envelope symmetry and original disposition,with empty effect vectors;offending source/scope/summary values are never serialized. Concrete error variants and canonical codecs remain Step 12 / 13 responsibilities.

#### 29.1.5 Transaction boundary

The fresh reservation、actual reference revision、actual canonical state revision、state capture when present、typed receipt、serialized surface、immutable shell and idempotency completion use one local UoW. Resolver reads occur after reservation but outside transactional rollback semantics. `Delayed` rolls back the reservation UoW and stores no completed receipt;`Ignored` commits a replayable no-op receipt. Ref-only change commits no state capture;state-only and both changes commit exactly one state capture.

#### 29.1.6 Error / disposition mapping

| Branch | Disposition / handling |
|---|---|
| unsupported schema header | `UnsupportedSchema`;no typed decode、Clock、reserve、UoW or resolver |
| wrong source family/actor or Existing target variant | stable `Rejected` or `Quarantined` per source-isolation rule;empty effects |
| completed same request | `DuplicateReplayed + StoredReplay`;typed receipt only |
| key operation/digest conflict | `Quarantined + BoundaryQuarantined + NoLocalEffect`;no original result/effect leakage |
| resolver temporarily unavailable before write | `Delayed + RetryRequired + NoLocalEffect`;`result_ref=None`;rollback/no completion |
| declared/resolver-owned safe-summary mismatch、approval/Policy body、cross-subject digest owner、immutable kind/source contradiction或new-subject typed Forbidden | `Quarantined`;no ref/state/capture |
| resolver-return subject/kind/digest mismatch | exact `ConsistencyDefect(PortReturn(GovernanceResultReference), ReferenceObservationShape)`;whole local rollback,no receipt fabrication |
| missing Existing target or stable invalid typed field | `Rejected + NoLocalEffect`;safe replayable receipt only when reservation was safely completed |
| ref and/or state actual revision | `Accepted`;effect vectors list only actual subject/state writes |
| candidate and canonical value/reason both unchanged | `Ignored + NoLocalEffect`;stored no-op receipt;review marker may remain |
| existing terminal candidate receives changed value/reason | replayable `Rejected`;new candidate must use`ResolveOrRegister` |
| repository/capture/result/completion/version failure | `ApplicationError`;whole local UoW rollback |

#### 29.1.7 State / receipt / capture / effects

| Case | Reference save | State save / capture | Receipt effects |
|---|---|---|---|
| new subject | create expected `None` | create expected `None` + one `ReferenceResolutionChanged` capture | subject + exact state ref |
| scope/digest only | one existing ref revision using loaded expected version | none | subject only |
| observation value/reason only | none | one existing state revision + one capture | subject + exact state ref |
| both | one ref revision | one state revision + one capture | subject + exact state ref |
| exact no-op | none | none | empty effects + `NoLocalEffect` |

`downstream_summary_refs` and `affected_material_refs` are always empty. The only follow-up is `GovernanceSeamReview`;it is not a seam change、approval or queued Command. No core change record、traceability revision、seam record、formal exposure revision or external collaboration intent is produced.

#### 29.1.8 Test cuts

1. Unsupported schema proves payload decoder、application service、Clock、idempotency and resolver call counts are all zero.
2. Established duplicate returns the original result/effect/follow-up refs with response-only replay markers and zero Clock/IdGenerator/resolver/repository writes.
3. ResolveOrRegister digest hit reuses the exact subject;miss generates one ref id and one state id;another-subject ownership quarantines.
4. Existing wrong variant rejects before repository/resolver;kind/source contradiction quarantines without `replace_scope`.
5. Resolver subject/kind/digest mismatch is exact technical consistency error;allowed-safe-summary mismatch is typed quarantine;both produce no local effect.
6. New、ref-only、state-only、both and strict no-op paths produce the exact 2/1/1/2/0 write-vector symmetry described above.
7. Same value + changed safe reason creates one state revision/capture;same value + same reason creates none;terminal candidate cannot recover in place.
8. Every accepted/ignored receipt has empty downstream/material vectors and contains no approval、Policy、vote or workflow data.
9. Any ref/state/capture/typed-result/completion failure rolls back the whole local set;resolver observation is not claimed to roll back.

#### 29.1.9 Single-flow stop review

| Gate | Result |
|---|---|
| header/context authority | pass;public/local refs and source/application keys remain distinct |
| candidate ownership | pass;Existing and ResolveOrRegister both perform exact digest-owner guard |
| four-way delta | pass;ref-only、state-only、both and no-op are physically distinct |
| governance boundary | pass;ref/state + explicit review marker only,no seam/approval/Policy write |
| receipt/capture symmetry | pass;state capture only for actual state revision;all other effect vectors exact |
| structure comments | pass;no new declaration;all reused payload/context/receipt/object fields have English Rustdoc |

#### 29.2.5 Transaction boundary

The actual method ref/state revisions、optional state capture、typed receipt/surface/envelope/shell and completion are one UoW. Resolver unavailability rolls back the uncompleted reservation and returns `Delayed`;exact no-op commits `Ignored`. No relation repository、derived-material repository or Cargo/method-library runtime dependency participates.

#### 29.2.6 Error / disposition mapping

| Branch | Disposition / handling |
|---|---|
| unsupported schema | header-only `UnsupportedSchema`;no decode/reserve/UoW |
| wrong family/actor/target variant、empty safe field | `Rejected` or source-isolation quarantine;no resolver effect |
| completed duplicate | typed `DuplicateReplayed`;no Clock/ids/resolver/current ref read |
| key/digest conflict or cross-subject candidate | `Quarantined`;empty effects/no original result leakage |
| resolver temporary unavailable | `Delayed`;rollback and no completed receipt |
| method body/source code/definition/version material、request contradiction或new-subject typed Forbidden | `Quarantined`;offending content not stored |
| resolver-return subject/kind/digest mismatch | exact `ConsistencyDefect(PortReturn(MethodAssetReference), ReferenceObservationShape)`;whole local rollback |
| actual ref/state revision | `Accepted` with exact vector symmetry |
| exact candidate + exact value/reason | stored `Ignored + NoLocalEffect` |
| existing terminal candidate receives changed value/reason | replayable `Rejected`;requiresdifferent candidate/new subject |
| persistence/capture/result/completion failure | `ApplicationError`;whole local rollback |

#### 29.2.7 State / receipt / capture / effects

The five change shapes are identical in cardinality to §29.1 but target `MethodAsset`:new writes ref+state and captures state;locator-only writes ref only;observation-only writes/captures state only;both writes both;no-op writes neither. `changed_reference_subject_refs` names the subject for any actual ref or state revision;`reference_state_refs` names only an actual state revision. Downstream/material vectors are always empty. `MethodRelationReview` is only an explicit next-action hint and cannot create、remove、reactivate or stale a method relation.

1. Header-first unsupported schema performs no typed payload decode or application call.
2. Existing non-MethodAsset target rejects before every repository/resolver.
3. ResolveOrRegister exact digest hit reuses the ref;miss generates exactly one ref/state id;collision quarantines.
4. Immutable asset-kind mismatch quarantines,while resolver subject/kind/digest mismatch is technical consistency error;both save nothing.
5. Changed locator with unchanged observation returns subject only and emits no capture.
6. Same-value changed reason returns state ref + one capture;complete no-op returns neither.
7. Received method content、definition、version body or source code is never serialized into receipt/stored surface.
8. Method relation、exposure、derived-material and outbound collaboration repository call counts remain zero.
9. Typed replay returns original refs/marker and never reloads current method ref/state.
