| consumer/family/actor/schema | envelope header | worker enforces DownstreamConsumer family and actor-to-declared-consumer binding before typed dispatch |
| public source event / source key | envelope -> context | request digest and public receipt only |
| local source feedback ref | worker one-way mapping -> context `source_event_ref` | sole `DownstreamConsumptionImpactSummary.source_feedback_ref` and formal source-level dedup key;never parsed back to public ref |
| `impact_fact_ref` | typed payload exact ref | version required;`get_impact_with_version` must return same id/version and persisted expected-version parity |
| `consumer_ref` | closed payload union | maps only RuntimeTools -> `CapabilityConsumerRef::RuntimeTools` or Sdk -> `CapabilityConsumerRef::Sdk`;ecosystem/marketplace refs impossible |
| `feedback` | closed payload union | exact five-way factory mapping;empty safe text or illegal observation/gap/reason pairing is rejected before factory |
| request digest | application | family + public source event + source key + exact impact ref + consumer variant/id + feedback variant and all present fields |
| summary id/time/actor/trace | IdGenerator、Clock、context | id/time generated only after exact impact/consumer/source-dedup validation;actor/trace propagated,not supplied by payload |

#### 29.3.3 ASCII call graph

```text
worker header gate
  -> unsupported schema:UnsupportedSchema;no payload decode/reserve/UoW
  -> decode exact impact/consumer/feedback payload
  -> verify source actor is configured for declared RuntimeTools or SDK family
  -> from_inbound_event(public/local source refs,source/application keys)
  -> downstream inbound service
     -> context/variant/body scan + stable request digest
     -> idempotency.get_with_version
        -> completed:get_consumer_receipt -> DuplicateReplayed;STOP
        -> conflict/in-progress:quarantine/retry surface;STOP
        -> absent:Clock -> begin -> reserve_if_absent
           -> race Existing:rollback before summary id/factory/effect;STOP
     -> impact_repo.get_impact_with_version(exact impact ref)
        -> exact id/version/expected-version + affects_consumer guard
     -> external_reference_repo.get_with_version(RuntimeToolsConsumer|SdkConsumer subject)
        -> exact union/id/version/registration guard;no execution-state lookup
     -> impact_repo.find_downstream_summary_by_source_feedback(local inbound ref)
        -> existing summary:consistency/quarantine;never append a second summary
     -> generate summary id
     -> feedback match:
        Received -> from_consumer_feedback
        Partial/Delayed/Unavailable/Ignored -> from_reported_state exact field tuple
     -> save_downstream_summary(expected None)
     -> Accepted receipt:downstream ref only + CapabilityImpactReview
     -> save_consumer_receipt + complete/save reservation -> commit
```

#### 29.3.4 Rust-style function pseudocode

```rust
async fn consume_downstream_consumption_impact_reported(
    &self,
    context: CapabilityOperationContext,
    payload: ConsumeDownstreamConsumptionImpactReportedPayload,
) -> Result<CapabilityInboundEventReceipt, ApplicationError> {
    context.assert_write_metadata_complete()?;
    if context.inbound_source_family != Some(CapabilityInboundSourceFamily::DownstreamConsumer) {
        return /* stable source-isolation outcome;no reserve */;
    }
    let public_source_ref = context.inbound_protocol_source_event_ref.clone()
        .ok_or(/* context consistency error */)?;
    let source_feedback_ref = context.source_event_ref.clone()
        .ok_or(/* context consistency error */)?;
    let source_key = context.inbound_source_idempotency_key.as_ref()
        .ok_or(/* context consistency error */)?;
    let key = context.idempotency_key()?.clone();
    if payload.impact_fact_ref.version.is_none() {
        return /* Rejected + NoLocalEffect before reserve */;
    }
    let (consumer_ref, consumer_subject) = match &payload.consumer_ref {
        CapabilityInboundDownstreamConsumerRef::RuntimeTools(id) => (
            CapabilityConsumerRef::RuntimeTools(id.clone()),
            ReferenceSubjectRef::RuntimeToolsConsumer(id.clone()),
        ),
        CapabilityInboundDownstreamConsumerRef::Sdk(id) => (
            CapabilityConsumerRef::Sdk(id.clone()),
            ReferenceSubjectRef::SdkConsumer(id.clone()),
        ),
    };
    /* Worker/config binding must prove context.actor_context is authorized for the exact
       declared consumer family/id. Validate feedback safe carriers and reject execution
       request/response,tool result,runtime auth/cache or SDK client/package material. */
    let request_digest: CapabilityRequestDigest =
        /* canonical source family + public event + source key + exact impact ref
           + consumer union + feedback union and all state-specific fields */;

    if let Some(existing) = self.idempotency_repo.get_with_version(&key).await? {
        if existing.value.matches(
            &context.channel, &context.operation_name, &request_digest)
            && existing.value.state == CapabilityIdempotencyState::Completed
        {
            let stored = self.stored_result_repo.get_consumer_receipt(
                existing.value.completed_result_ref()?).await?
                .ok_or(/* typed receipt consistency error */)?;
            return Ok(/* validate downstream operation/source/result/surface and replay
                         original downstream summary ref with DuplicateReplayed+StoredReplay */);
        }
        return Ok(/* Quarantined/retry surface;all effect refs empty;no original leakage */);
    }

    let now = self.clock.now();
    let tx = self.uow_manager.begin().await?;
    let reservation = CapabilityIdempotencyRecord::reserve(
        &context, request_digest.clone(), now.clone())?;
    let mut loaded_reservation = match self.idempotency_repo
        .reserve_if_absent(reservation, tx.as_ref()).await?
    {
        CapabilityIdempotencyReserveResult::Reserved(loaded) => loaded,
        CapabilityIdempotencyReserveResult::Existing(existing) => {
            self.uow_manager.rollback(tx).await?;
            return /* Step 13 race classification;no summary id/factory/repository write */;
        }
    };

    let loaded_impact = match self.impact_repo
        .get_impact_with_version(payload.impact_fact_ref.clone()).await
    {
        Ok(Some(loaded)) => loaded,
        Ok(None) => return /* complete stable Rejected receipt:exact impact absent */,
        Err(error) if /* typed temporarily unavailable read */ => {
            self.uow_manager.rollback(tx).await?;
            return Ok(/* processing Delayed,result None,RetryRequired+NoLocalEffect */);
        }
        Err(error) => {
            self.uow_manager.rollback(tx).await?;
            return Err(error);
        }
    };
    let impact = loaded_impact.value;
    if impact.impact_fact_id != payload.impact_fact_ref.id
        || payload.impact_fact_ref.version.as_ref() != Some(&impact.version)
        || loaded_impact.expected_version != impact.version
        || !impact.affects_consumer(&consumer_ref)
    {
        return /* stable Rejected exact-revision/consumer-membership receipt */;
    }

    let loaded_consumer = match self.external_reference_repo
        .get_with_version(consumer_subject.clone()).await
    {
        Ok(Some(loaded)) => loaded,
        Ok(None) => {
            self.uow_manager.rollback(tx).await?;
            return Ok(/* Delayed:declared local prerequisite not yet registered */);
        }
        Err(error) if /* typed temporarily unavailable read */ => {
            self.uow_manager.rollback(tx).await?;
            return Ok(/* Delayed;no completed receipt */);
        }
        Err(error) => {
            self.uow_manager.rollback(tx).await?;
            return Err(error);
        }
    };
    let consumer_registered = match (&payload.consumer_ref, &loaded_consumer.value) {
        (CapabilityInboundDownstreamConsumerRef::RuntimeTools(id),
         CapabilityExternalReference::RuntimeToolsConsumer(reference)) => {
            reference.runtime_tools_consumer_ref_id == *id
                && reference.subject_ref() == consumer_subject
                && loaded_consumer.expected_version == reference.version
        }
        (CapabilityInboundDownstreamConsumerRef::Sdk(id),
         CapabilityExternalReference::SdkConsumer(reference)) => {
            reference.sdk_consumer_ref_id == *id
                && reference.subject_ref() == consumer_subject
                && loaded_consumer.expected_version == reference.version
        }
        _ => false,
    };
    if !consumer_registered {
        return /* stable Rejected or Quarantined wrong-family/registration receipt */;
    }

    if self.impact_repo.find_downstream_summary_by_source_feedback(
        &source_feedback_ref).await?.is_some()
    {
        return /* consistency/quarantine:source summary exists without replayable
                  completed reservation;do not reconstruct receipt or append another */;
    }

    let summary_id = self.ids.new_downstream_impact_summary_id();
    let summary = match payload.feedback {
        CapabilityDownstreamImpactFeedback::Received { observation } => {
            DownstreamConsumptionImpactSummary::from_consumer_feedback(
                summary_id, &impact, consumer_ref.clone(), source_feedback_ref,
                observation, context.actor_context.clone(), context.trace_id.clone(),
                now.clone(),
            )?
        }
        CapabilityDownstreamImpactFeedback::Partial { observation, gap_reason } => {
            DownstreamConsumptionImpactSummary::from_reported_state(
                summary_id, &impact, consumer_ref.clone(), source_feedback_ref,
                DownstreamImpactSummaryState::Partial,
                Some(observation), Some(gap_reason), None,
                context.actor_context.clone(), context.trace_id.clone(), now.clone(),
            )?
        }
        CapabilityDownstreamImpactFeedback::Delayed { observation, reason } => {
            DownstreamConsumptionImpactSummary::from_reported_state(
                summary_id, &impact, consumer_ref.clone(), source_feedback_ref,
                DownstreamImpactSummaryState::Delayed,
                observation, None, Some(reason),
                context.actor_context.clone(), context.trace_id.clone(), now.clone(),
            )?
        }
        CapabilityDownstreamImpactFeedback::Unavailable { reason } => {
            DownstreamConsumptionImpactSummary::from_reported_state(
                summary_id, &impact, consumer_ref.clone(), source_feedback_ref,
                DownstreamImpactSummaryState::Unavailable,
                None, None, Some(reason),
                context.actor_context.clone(), context.trace_id.clone(), now.clone(),
            )?
        }
        CapabilityDownstreamImpactFeedback::Ignored { reason } => {
            DownstreamConsumptionImpactSummary::from_reported_state(
                summary_id, &impact, consumer_ref, source_feedback_ref,
                DownstreamImpactSummaryState::Ignored,
                None, None, Some(reason),
                context.actor_context.clone(), context.trace_id.clone(), now.clone(),
            )?
        }
    };
    if summary.impact_fact_ref != payload.impact_fact_ref
        || summary.source_feedback_ref != context.source_event_ref.clone()
            .ok_or(/* context consistency error */)?
    {
        return /* factory/output consistency error;rollback */;
    }
    let summary_ref = self.impact_repo
        .save_downstream_summary(summary, None, tx.as_ref()).await?;

    let application_result_ref = CapabilityApplicationResultRef {
        operation_name: context.operation_name.clone(),
        result_id: self.ids.new_application_result_id(),
    };
    let receipt = CapabilityInboundEventReceipt {
        consumer_name: /* exact ConsumeDownstreamConsumptionImpactReported name */,
        source_event_ref: public_source_ref,
        result_ref: Some(/* exact application-to-protocol result mapping */),
        disposition: CapabilityInboundReceiptDisposition::Accepted,
        markers: vec![],
        changed_reference_subject_refs: vec![],
        reference_state_refs: vec![],
        downstream_summary_refs: vec![summary_ref],
        affected_material_refs: vec![],
        follow_up_markers: vec![CapabilityInboundFollowUpMarker::CapabilityImpactReview(
            payload.impact_fact_ref)],
        issue_refs: /* stable empty set */,
    };
    let surface: CapabilityStoredResultSurface = /* exact receipt serialization */;
    let shell = StoredCapabilityOperationResult::from_surface(
        application_result_ref.clone(), StoredCapabilityResultKind::ConsumerReceipt,
        StoredCapabilityResultDisposition::InboundEvent(
            CapabilityInboundDisposition::Accepted),
        surface.surface_ref.clone(), surface.surface_digest.clone(),
        context.trace_id.clone(), now.clone())?;
    let stored = CapabilityConsumerReceiptEnvelope {
        result_ref: application_result_ref.clone(),
        operation_name: context.operation_name.clone(),
        surface_ref: surface.surface_ref.clone(),
        receipt: receipt.clone(),
    };
    self.stored_result_repo.save_consumer_receipt(
        shell, surface, stored, tx.as_ref()).await?;
    loaded_reservation.value.complete(application_result_ref, now)?;
    self.idempotency_repo.save(
        loaded_reservation.value, loaded_reservation.expected_version, tx.as_ref()).await?;
    self.uow_manager.commit(tx).await?;
    Ok(receipt)
}
```

The repeated read of `context.source_event_ref` in the consistency assertion is schematic ownership handling,not a second mapping or lookup. An implementation may retain the validated clone locally. It must not derive the local ref from the public ref or vice versa.

#### 29.3.5 Transaction boundary

One fresh UoW contains the reservation、single new summary、typed receipt/surface/envelope/shell and completion. The impact and consumer references are read-only. There is no event capture because downstream feedback is not one of the ten outbound source protocols. A processing `Delayed` branch rolls back and completes nothing;a payload feedback state named `Delayed` is saved and commits an `Accepted` receipt.

#### 29.3.6 Error / disposition mapping

| Branch | Disposition / handling |
|---|---|
| unsupported schema | header-only `UnsupportedSchema`;no decode/reserve/UoW |
| wrong source actor/consumer-family binding or forbidden execution/SDK material | `Rejected` or `Quarantined`;empty effects |
| completed duplicate | `DuplicateReplayed`;original summary ref only;no impact/consumer/current-summary read |
| key/digest conflict | `Quarantined`;original summary/receipt hidden |
| exact impact absent/stale version or does not affect consumer | stable `Rejected + NoLocalEffect` |
| required registered consumer absent/temporarily unreadable | processing `Delayed`;no completed receipt |
| wrong reference union/id/version | stable `Rejected` or source contradiction quarantine |
| source-feedback summary already exists without completed replay record | consistency/quarantine;never create second summary or reconstruct receipt |
| any valid Received/Partial/Delayed/Unavailable/Ignored feedback saved | processing `Accepted`;one exact downstream summary ref |
| summary/result/completion/version failure | `ApplicationError`;whole local rollback |

#### 29.3.7 State / receipt / capture / effects

| Payload feedback | Factory | Persisted summary state | Processing receipt |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Received` | `from_consumer_feedback` | `Received`,observation only | `Accepted` |
| `Partial` | `from_reported_state` | `Partial`,observation + gap | `Accepted` |
| `Delayed` | `from_reported_state` | `Delayed`,optional observation + reason | `Accepted` |
| `Unavailable` | `from_reported_state` | `Unavailable`,reason only | `Accepted` |
| `Ignored` | `from_reported_state` | `Ignored`,reason only | `Accepted` |

The receipt has exactly one `downstream_summary_ref`;all reference/state/material vectors are empty. `CapabilityImpactReview` is an explicit follow-up only. No impact fact、trace、exposure、consumer ref/state、controlled view、runtime/tools execution state or SDK client/package state changes.

#### 29.3.8 Test cuts

1. Unsupported schema stops before payload variant decode and all application ports.
2. Completed duplicate replays the original exact summary ref and performs zero Clock/id/factory/effect calls.
3. RuntimeTools and SDK variants map to their exact consumer union/subject;wrong union or ecosystem/marketplace substitution fails.
4. Exact impact id/version/expected-version and `affects_consumer` are all required before factory call.
5. Local source-feedback ref,not public source event text,is persisted and deduplicated.
6. Each of five feedback variants calls exactly its declared factory tuple and yields processing `Accepted` after save.
7. Payload `Delayed` does not produce processing `Delayed`;repository/prerequisite temporary unavailability does.
8. Receipt vectors are exactly `0 reference + 0 state + 1 summary + 0 material`;capture calls remain zero.
9. Execution/tool result/runtime policy/cache/SDK client/package/raw error content is quarantined and never stored.

#### 29.3.9 Single-flow stop review

| Gate | Result |
|---|---|
| source identity | pass;public receipt identity and local feedback dedup identity are distinct |
| exact impact/consumer | pass;version/membership and registered two-family union are explicit |
| five feedback variants | pass;factory tuples and processing disposition are complete |
| effect symmetry | pass;one summary ref only,no reference/state/capture/material effect |
| execution boundary | pass;no runtime/tools/SDK execution or exposure mutation |
| structure comments | pass;no new declaration;feedback variants and payload fields retain English Rustdoc |

Flow status: `completed_in_batch_9_8`.

### 29.4 `inbound_consume_external_capability_source_reference_changed_flow`

#### 29.4.1 Entry and target

| Item | Exact contract |
|---|---|
| logical event | `capability-hub.inbound.external-capability-source-reference-changed.v1`;schema `1`;source family `ExternalCapabilitySource` |
| worker / service | `CapabilityInboundEventHandlers::consume_external_capability_source_reference_changed(...)` -> `CapabilityInboundConsumerService::consume_external_capability_source_reference_changed(context,payload)` |
| trusted producer | configured MCP、A2A or external API discovery/source-reference integration actor allowed for the declared `source_kind` |
| local target | one `ExternalCapabilitySourceRef` plus its canonical state;new/ref-only/state-only/both/no-op |
| completed result | exact typed receipt storage and idempotency completion |
| non-effect | no `CapabilityIdentity::create_from_intake`、review fact、registry、descriptor、formal exposure、provider route/health or MCP/A2A/API invocation |

#### 29.4.2 Envelope / DTO field sources

| Field / derived value | Source | Validation / use |
|---|---|---|
| consumer/family/actor/schema | header | exact source family and actor-to-MCP/A2A/API-kind binding before typed decode |
| public/local event refs and keys | envelope -> context | public event/key enter request digest and receipt;local ref remains channel metadata;derived application key addresses reservation |
| `target` | payload | Existing must be `ExternalCapabilitySource`;ResolveOrRegister uses exact candidate ownership |
| `source_kind` | payload closed enum | MCP/A2A/external API;immutable on existing subject;must match trusted source binding |
| `external_locator` | payload safe newtype | persisted pointer and candidate via `ReferenceLocatorSummary::from_external_source`;no request/response/schema/message/credential body |
| request digest | application | source authority + target variant + source kind + locator |
| candidate digest | application | source kind + locator only;no actor/trace/time/generated id/resolver/provider state |
| ids/time | IdGenerator/Clock | new source/state ids only after digest miss;local object time from Clock |

#### 29.4.3 ASCII call graph

```text
header-first worker gate -> unsupported:UnsupportedSchema/no decode/no reserve
  -> source kind/actor + target variant validation
  -> from_inbound_event -> exact source-reference application service
     -> context/body scan/request digest
     -> preflight idempotency get
        -> completed typed replay;STOP
        -> conflict/in-progress body-free outcome;STOP
        -> absent:Clock + begin + atomic reserve
           -> race Existing:rollback before business ids/resolver;STOP
     -> candidate locator/digest/policy -> find_by_candidate_digest
     -> select declared/reused/new ExternalCapabilitySource subject
     -> existing:exact union/version + immutable source-kind + linked-state parity
     -> ExternalCapabilitySourceReferencePort::resolve_source_reference
        -> temporary unavailable:Delayed + rollback
        -> subject/kind/digest mismatch:technical ConsistencyDefect;rollback
        -> caller contradiction/forbidden provider body:Quarantined
     -> new:from_initial_resolution + ExternalCapabilitySourceRef::register
     -> existing:replace_locator only for locator/digest delta;
                  transition only for observation value/reason delta
     -> save actual ref/state;capture only actual state revision
     -> Accepted/Ignored typed receipt + CapabilityIdentityIntakeReview marker
     -> save_consumer_receipt + complete/save reservation -> commit
```

#### 29.4.4 Rust-style function pseudocode

```rust
async fn consume_external_capability_source_reference_changed(
    &self,
    context: CapabilityOperationContext,
    payload: ConsumeExternalCapabilitySourceReferenceChangedPayload,
) -> Result<CapabilityInboundEventReceipt, ApplicationError> {
    context.assert_write_metadata_complete()?;
    if context.inbound_source_family
        != Some(CapabilityInboundSourceFamily::ExternalCapabilitySource)
    {
        return /* stable source-isolation outcome */;
    }
    let public_source_ref = context.inbound_protocol_source_event_ref.clone()
        .ok_or(/* context consistency error */)?;
    let source_key = context.inbound_source_idempotency_key.as_ref()
        .ok_or(/* context consistency error */)?;
    let key = context.idempotency_key()?.clone();
    let target = match &payload.target {
        CapabilityInboundReferenceTarget::Existing {
            reference_subject: ReferenceSubjectRef::ExternalCapabilitySource(id),
        } => Some((id.clone(),
                   ReferenceSubjectRef::ExternalCapabilitySource(id.clone()))),
        CapabilityInboundReferenceTarget::Existing { .. } => {
            return /* Rejected + NoLocalEffect before repository/resolver */;
        }
        CapabilityInboundReferenceTarget::ResolveOrRegister => None,
    };
    /* Validate configured actor/source-kind binding and scan locator for invocation,
       MCP tool schema,A2A message,API payload,credential or provider-state material. */
    let request_digest: CapabilityRequestDigest =
        /* canonical family + public event + source key + target + source kind + locator */;
    if let Some(existing) = self.idempotency_repo.get_with_version(&key).await? {
        if existing.value.matches(
            &context.channel, &context.operation_name, &request_digest)
            && existing.value.state == CapabilityIdempotencyState::Completed
        {
            let stored = self.stored_result_repo.get_consumer_receipt(
                existing.value.completed_result_ref()?).await?
                .ok_or(/* typed replay consistency error */)?;
            return Ok(/* exact source consumer receipt replay;
                         DuplicateReplayed+StoredReplay;no current ref/state read */);
        }
        return Ok(/* conflict/quarantine surface;empty effects */);
    }

    let now = self.clock.now();
    let tx = self.uow_manager.begin().await?;
    let reservation = CapabilityIdempotencyRecord::reserve(
        &context, request_digest.clone(), now.clone())?;
    let mut loaded_reservation = match self.idempotency_repo
        .reserve_if_absent(reservation, tx.as_ref()).await?
    {
        CapabilityIdempotencyReserveResult::Reserved(loaded) => loaded,
        CapabilityIdempotencyReserveResult::Existing(existing) => {
            self.uow_manager.rollback(tx).await?;
            return /* exact race classification;no source/state/result ids or resolver */;
        }
    };

    let kind = ReferenceKind::ExternalCapabilitySource;
    let candidate_digest: ReferenceCandidateDigest =
        /* canonical source kind + body-free external locator */;
    let candidate = ReferenceCandidate::body_free(
        kind.clone(),
        ReferenceLocatorSummary::from_external_source(&payload.external_locator),
        candidate_digest.clone());
    let policy = ReferenceResolutionPolicy::default_for_capability_references();
    policy.validate_candidate(&candidate)?;
    let digest_owner = self.external_reference_repo
        .find_by_candidate_digest(kind.clone(), &candidate_digest).await?;

    let (subject, loaded_ref, loaded_state, generated) = match target {
        Some((id, subject)) => {
            if digest_owner.as_ref().is_some_and(|owner| match &owner.value {
                CapabilityExternalReference::ExternalCapabilitySource(value) => {
                    value.subject_ref() != subject || owner.expected_version != value.version
                }
                _ => true,
            }) {
                return /* Quarantined cross-subject candidate ownership */;
            }
            let loaded = self.external_reference_repo.get_with_version(subject.clone()).await?
                .ok_or(/* stable Rejected missing target */)?;
            let source_ref = match &loaded.value {
                CapabilityExternalReference::ExternalCapabilitySource(value)
                    if value.source_ref_id == id
                        && value.subject_ref() == subject
                        && loaded.expected_version == value.version => value,
                _ => return /* union/id/version consistency outcome */,
            };
            if source_ref.source_kind != payload.source_kind {
                return /* Quarantined immutable source-kind contradiction */;
            }
            let state = self.reference_state_repo.find_current_by_subject(subject.clone()).await?
                .ok_or(/* consistency error */)?;
            if state.value.resolution_state_id != source_ref.resolution_state_id
                || state.expected_version != state.value.version
                || !state.value.matches_subject(&subject, &kind)
            {
                return /* consistency ApplicationError */;
            }
            (subject, Some(loaded), Some(state), None)
        }
        None => match digest_owner {
            Some(loaded) => {
                let source_ref = match &loaded.value {
                    CapabilityExternalReference::ExternalCapabilitySource(value)
                        if value.source_kind == payload.source_kind
                            && value.external_locator == payload.external_locator
                            && value.candidate_digest == candidate_digest
                            && loaded.expected_version == value.version => value,
                    _ => return /* Quarantined digest-owner asymmetry */,
                };
                let subject = source_ref.subject_ref();
                let state = self.reference_state_repo.find_current_by_subject(subject.clone()).await?
                    .ok_or(/* consistency error */)?;
                if state.value.resolution_state_id != source_ref.resolution_state_id
                    || state.expected_version != state.value.version
                    || !state.value.matches_subject(&subject, &kind)
                {
                    return /* consistency error */;
                }
                (subject, Some(loaded), Some(state), None)
            }
            None => {
                let ref_id = self.ids.new_external_capability_source_ref_id();
                let state_id = self.ids.new_reference_resolution_state_id();
                (ReferenceSubjectRef::ExternalCapabilitySource(ref_id.clone()),
                 None, None, Some((ref_id, state_id)))
            }
        },
    };

    let observation = match self.external_source_reference_port.resolve_source_reference(
        subject.clone(), payload.source_kind.clone(), payload.external_locator.clone(),
        candidate.clone()).await
    {
        Ok(value) => value,
        Err(error) if /* typed temporary unavailable */ => {
            self.uow_manager.rollback(tx).await?;
            return Ok(/* Delayed,None result,RetryRequired+NoLocalEffect */);
        }
        Err(error) => {
            self.uow_manager.rollback(tx).await?;
            return Err(error);
        }
    };
    if observation.reference_subject != subject
        || observation.reference_kind != kind
        || observation.candidate_digest != candidate_digest
    {
        self.uow_manager.rollback(tx).await?;
        return Err(ApplicationError::ConsistencyDefect {
            subject: ApplicationConsistencySubjectKind::PortReturn {
                port: ApplicationPortKind::ExternalCapabilitySourceReference,
            },
            invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::ReferenceObservationShape,
        });
    }
    if observation.resolution_value == ReferenceResolutionValue::Forbidden
        && generated.is_some()
    {
        return /* new-subject Forbidden cannot form initial state;redacted Quarantined */;
    }

    let mut ref_changed = false;
    let mut state_changed = false;
    let (ref_write, ref_expected, state_write, state_expected, selected_id) =
        match (loaded_ref, loaded_state, generated) {
            (None, None, Some((ref_id, state_id))) => {
                let state = ReferenceResolutionState::from_initial_resolution(
                    state_id.clone(), subject.clone(), kind.clone(),
                    observation.resolution_value, observation.resolution_reason,
                    context.actor_context.clone(), context.trace_id.clone(),
                    &policy, now.clone())?;
                let reference = ExternalCapabilitySourceRef::register(
                    ref_id.clone(), payload.source_kind, payload.external_locator,
                    candidate_digest, state_id, now.clone());
                ref_changed = true;
                state_changed = true;
                (Some(CapabilityExternalReference::ExternalCapabilitySource(reference)),
                 None, Some(state), None, ref_id)
            }
            (Some(loaded), Some(loaded_state), None) => {
                let mut reference = match loaded.value {
                    CapabilityExternalReference::ExternalCapabilitySource(value) => value,
                    _ => return /* consistency error */,
                };
                let selected_id = reference.source_ref_id.clone();
                let mut state = loaded_state.value;
                if reference.external_locator == payload.external_locator
                    && reference.candidate_digest != candidate_digest
                {
                    return /* persisted candidate-digest consistency error;do not self-repair */;
                }
                if reference.external_locator != payload.external_locator {
                    reference.replace_locator(
                        payload.external_locator, candidate_digest,
                        state.resolution_state_id.clone(), now.clone())?;
                    ref_changed = true;
                }
                if matches!(state.resolution_value,
                    ReferenceResolutionValue::Invalid | ReferenceResolutionValue::Forbidden)
                    && (state.resolution_value != observation.resolution_value
                        || state.resolution_reason != observation.resolution_reason)
                {
                    return /* replayable Rejected:terminal candidate requires new subject */;
                }
                if state.resolution_value != observation.resolution_value
                    || state.resolution_reason != observation.resolution_reason
                {
                    state.transition(
                        observation.resolution_value, observation.resolution_reason,
                        context.actor_context.clone(), context.trace_id.clone(),
                        &policy, now.clone())?;
                    state_changed = true;
                }
                (ref_changed.then_some(
                    CapabilityExternalReference::ExternalCapabilitySource(reference)),
                 ref_changed.then_some(loaded.expected_version),
                 state_changed.then_some(state),
                 state_changed.then_some(loaded_state.expected_version), selected_id)
            }
            _ => return /* impossible tuple consistency error */,
        };

    if let Some(reference) = ref_write {
        let saved = self.external_reference_repo
            .save(reference, ref_expected, tx.as_ref()).await?;
        if saved != subject { return /* consistency error */; }
    }
    let state_ref = if let Some(state) = state_write.as_ref() {
        let exact = self.reference_state_repo
            .save(state.clone(), state_expected, tx.as_ref()).await?;
        self.outbound_capture_service.capture_reference_resolution_changed(
            &context, state, tx.as_ref()).await?;
        Some(exact)
    } else { None };
    let changed = ref_changed || state_changed;

    let application_result_ref = CapabilityApplicationResultRef {
        operation_name: context.operation_name.clone(),
        result_id: self.ids.new_application_result_id(),
    };
    let receipt = CapabilityInboundEventReceipt {
        consumer_name: /* exact ConsumeExternalCapabilitySourceReferenceChanged name */,
        source_event_ref: public_source_ref,
        result_ref: Some(/* exact application-to-protocol ref mapping */),
        disposition: if changed { CapabilityInboundReceiptDisposition::Accepted }
            else { CapabilityInboundReceiptDisposition::Ignored },
        markers: if changed { vec![] }
            else { vec![CapabilityInboundReceiptMarker::NoLocalEffect] },
        changed_reference_subject_refs: if changed { vec![subject] } else { vec![] },
        reference_state_refs: state_ref.into_iter().collect(),
        downstream_summary_refs: vec![],
        affected_material_refs: vec![],
        follow_up_markers: vec![
            CapabilityInboundFollowUpMarker::CapabilityIdentityIntakeReview(selected_id)],
        issue_refs: /* stable empty/redacted set */,
    };
    let surface: CapabilityStoredResultSurface = /* exact receipt serialization */;
    let shell = StoredCapabilityOperationResult::from_surface(
        application_result_ref.clone(), StoredCapabilityResultKind::ConsumerReceipt,
        StoredCapabilityResultDisposition::InboundEvent(
            if changed { CapabilityInboundDisposition::Accepted }
            else { CapabilityInboundDisposition::Ignored }),
        surface.surface_ref.clone(), surface.surface_digest.clone(),
        context.trace_id.clone(), now.clone())?;
    let stored = CapabilityConsumerReceiptEnvelope {
        result_ref: application_result_ref.clone(),
        operation_name: context.operation_name.clone(),
        surface_ref: surface.surface_ref.clone(),
        receipt: receipt.clone(),
    };
    self.stored_result_repo.save_consumer_receipt(
        shell, surface, stored, tx.as_ref()).await?;
    loaded_reservation.value.complete(application_result_ref, now)?;
    self.idempotency_repo.save(
        loaded_reservation.value, loaded_reservation.expected_version, tx.as_ref()).await?;
    self.uow_manager.commit(tx).await?;
    Ok(receipt)
}
```

#### 29.4.5 Transaction boundary

The actual source ref/state revisions、state capture when present、typed receipt storage and completion are atomic in one local UoW. Resolver reads cannot be rolled back. Delayed processing leaves no committed reservation/effect;no-op stores an `Ignored` receipt. Identity/registry/descriptor/exposure/derived repositories and runtime execution Ports are excluded.

#### 29.4.6 Error / disposition mapping

| Branch | Disposition / handling |
|---|---|
| unsupported schema | header-only `UnsupportedSchema` |
| actor/source-kind mismatch、wrong target variant、invalid safe locator | stable `Rejected` or `Quarantined`;no effect |
| completed duplicate | typed `DuplicateReplayed`;no Clock/id/resolver/current read |
| cross-subject digest/immutable source-kind contradiction、forbidden body或new-subject typed Forbidden | `Quarantined`;empty effects |
| resolver-return subject/kind/digest mismatch | exact `ConsistencyDefect(PortReturn(ExternalCapabilitySourceReference), ReferenceObservationShape)`;whole local rollback |
| resolver temporary unavailable | processing `Delayed`;rollback/no result completion |
| actual ref/state delta | `Accepted` with exact subject/state vectors |
| exact candidate + value/reason no-op | stored `Ignored + NoLocalEffect` |
| existing terminal candidate receives changed value/reason | replayable `Rejected`;requiresdifferent candidate/new subject |
| resolver contract/persistence/capture/result failure | typed error or safe quarantine as classified;no partial local commit |

#### 29.4.7 State / receipt / capture / effects

New/ref-only/state-only/both/no-op shapes preserve the 2/1/1/2/0 write symmetry established in §29.1. A state revision alone still lists the source subject because canonical state belongs to that subject. Only state revisions produce a `ReferenceResolutionChanged` capture. `CapabilityIdentityIntakeReview` does not create an identity、review fact or registry entry. Downstream/material refs remain empty.

#### 29.4.8 Test cuts

1. MCP/A2A/API actor binding must match `source_kind`;mismatch stops before resolver/effect.
2. Existing wrong reference variant rejects before repository/resolver.
3. Candidate digest hit/miss/collision follows reuse/new/quarantine with exact id-generation counts.
4. Existing source-kind mutation is prohibited;locator-only update is allowed and emits no state capture.
5. Resolver observation subject/kind/digest mismatch is technical consistency error;invocation/provider body is quarantined;both write nothing.
6. Same-value changed safe reason creates one state revision/capture;strict no-op creates none.
7. Receipt never contains provider health/route/quota/cost/failover or execution result.
8. Identity/registry/descriptor/exposure/derived/runtime Port call counts remain zero.
9. Duplicate replay performs only idempotency preflight + typed stored receipt read.

#### 29.4.9 Single-flow stop review

| Gate | Result |
|---|---|
| source family isolation | pass;kind-specific trusted actor and exact header authority |
| locator/body boundary | pass;one-way safe locator,zero invocation/provider state |
| candidate/state parity | pass;digest owner、union/version/state link and four deltas explicit |
| identity boundary | pass;review marker only,no identity creation or intake execution |
| receipt/capture | pass;actual revisions only,material/downstream empty |
| structure comments | pass;no new declaration;all reused fields/callables retain English Rustdoc |

Flow status: `completed_in_batch_9_8`.

### 29.5 `inbound_consume_audit_material_reference_changed_flow`

#### 29.5.1 Entry and target

| Item | Exact contract |
|---|---|
| logical event | `capability-hub.inbound.audit-material-reference-changed.v1`;schema `1`;source family `ObservabilityAudit` |
| worker / service | `CapabilityInboundEventHandlers::consume_audit_material_reference_changed(...)` -> `CapabilityInboundConsumerService::consume_audit_material_reference_changed(context,payload)` |
| trusted producer | configured observability/audit reference integration actor;not an evidence or acceptance authority |
| local target | one body-free `ObservabilityAuditRef` plus canonical state;new/ref-only/state-only/both/no-op |
| required external seam | inbound-only `ObservabilityAuditReferencePort`;explicitly not `ObservabilityAuditHandoffPort` |
| non-effect | no raw log/span/trace/metric/alert/audit/GRC body、traceability revision、audit export mutation、handoff receipt、evidence alias or acceptance signature |

#### 29.5.2 Envelope / DTO field sources

| Field / derived value | Source | Validation / use |
|---|---|---|
| consumer/family/actor/schema | header | exact ObservabilityAudit family and configured source binding before typed payload decode |
| source refs/keys | envelope -> context | public ref/key drive request digest/receipt;local ref remains distinct;application key addresses reservation |
| `target` | payload | Existing only accepts `ObservabilityAudit`;ResolveOrRegister follows exact digest ownership |
| `audit_material_kind` | payload closed enum | external reference category and immutable existing field;`Trace` is not `context.trace_id` |
| `audit_locator` | payload body-free locator | persisted pointer and generic candidate input;never raw material/evidence |
| `change_summary` | payload safe newtype | forbidden-body scan + request digest + review diagnostic only;not persisted audit content |
| generic locator | exact Step 6 constructor | `ReferenceLocatorSummary::from_observability_audit(&kind,&locator)`;typed length-delimited composition,no enum display/debug/private value access |
| request/candidate digests | application | request includes all authority/target/payload fields;candidate includes audit kind + locator only |
| ids/time | IdGenerator/Clock | new audit/state ids only on candidate miss;result id on completed receipt;local time never uses occurrence/trace timestamp |

#### 29.5.3 ASCII call graph

```text
worker header-first gate -> unsupported:UnsupportedSchema/no decode/no reserve
  -> actor + ObservabilityAudit target/payload validation
  -> from_inbound_event -> exact audit-reference application service
     -> context/body scan/request digest
     -> idempotency preflight get
        -> completed:get_consumer_receipt -> DuplicateReplayed;STOP
        -> conflict/in-progress:body-free outcome;STOP
        -> absent:Clock -> begin -> reserve_if_absent
           -> race Existing:rollback before audit/state/result ids or resolver;STOP
     -> from_observability_audit(kind,locator) -> candidate/digest/policy
     -> find_by_candidate_digest -> declared/reused/new exact audit subject
     -> existing:exact audit union/version + immutable kind + state-link parity
     -> ObservabilityAuditReferencePort::resolve_observability_audit_reference
        -> unavailable:Delayed + rollback
        -> subject/kind/digest mismatch:technical ConsistencyDefect;rollback
        -> caller contradiction/raw audit material:Quarantined
     -> new:from_initial_resolution + ObservabilityAuditRef::register
     -> existing:replace_locator(same kind,new locator/digest,same state id) only if changed;
                  transition state only if observation value/reason changed
     -> save actual ref/state;capture only actual canonical state revision
     -> Accepted/Ignored receipt + AuditHandoffReview marker
     -> typed receipt/shell/completion -> commit
     -> ObservabilityAuditHandoffPort call count remains zero
```

No pseudocode branch calls `ObservabilityAuditHandoffPort`. The follow-up marker is visible output only;an explicit traceability/handoff flow must later load exact refs/state and invoke that separate seam.

#### 29.5.5 Transaction boundary

The actual audit ref/state revisions、state capture、typed receipt storage and completion are one local UoW. Resolver read is external and non-transactional. `Delayed` rolls back/no completion;`Ignored` stores a replayable no-op. No traceability/audit-export/handoff/evidence write is in this transaction.

#### 29.5.6 Error / disposition mapping

| Branch | Disposition / handling |
|---|---|
| unsupported schema | header-only `UnsupportedSchema`;no typed decode/reserve |
| wrong actor/family/target or invalid safe carrier | stable `Rejected`/`Quarantined`;empty effects |
| completed duplicate | typed `DuplicateReplayed`;no Clock/id/resolver/handoff/current read |
| raw material/evidence/credential、kind contradiction、cross-subject digest或new-subject typed Forbidden | `Quarantined`;offending content not stored |
| resolver-return subject/kind/digest mismatch | exact `ConsistencyDefect(PortReturn(ObservabilityAuditReference), ReferenceObservationShape)`;whole local rollback |
| resolver temporary unavailable | processing `Delayed`;rollback/no completed result |
| actual ref/state revision | `Accepted`;exact subject and optional state ref |
| exact candidate/value/reason no-op | stored `Ignored + NoLocalEffect` |
| existing terminal candidate receives changed value/reason | replayable `Rejected`;requiresdifferent candidate/new subject |
| state terminal recovery attempt or persistence/capture/result defect | stable quarantine/rejection or `ApplicationError` per Step 10/12;no partial commit |

#### 29.5.7 State / receipt / capture / effects

The reference delta matrix remains new/ref-only/state-only/both/no-op. `audit_material_kind` cannot change on an existing subject;`replace_locator` receives the already-validated same kind. State revision alone or with ref change produces one reference capture;ref-only produces none. Receipt downstream/material vectors are empty. `AuditHandoffReview` is not a handoff receipt、evidence alias、test result or acceptance fact.

#### 29.5.8 Test cuts

1. Header schema is checked before typed audit payload decode.
2. `from_observability_audit` uses typed kind+locator composition;enum display/debug and raw/private field access are absent.

```rust
async fn consume_external_document_reference_changed(
    &self,
    context: CapabilityOperationContext,
    payload: ConsumeExternalDocumentReferenceChangedPayload,

    context.assert_write_metadata_complete()?;
    if context.inbound_source_family != Some(CapabilityInboundSourceFamily::ExternalDocument) {
        return /* stable source-isolation outcome */;
    }
    let public_source_ref = context.inbound_protocol_source_event_ref.clone()
        .ok_or(/* context consistency error */)?;
    let source_key = context.inbound_source_idempotency_key.as_ref()
        .ok_or(/* context consistency error */)?;
    let key = context.idempotency_key()?.clone();
    let target = match &payload.target {
        CapabilityInboundReferenceTarget::Existing {
            reference_subject: ReferenceSubjectRef::ExternalDocument(id),
        } => Some((id.clone(), ReferenceSubjectRef::ExternalDocument(id.clone()))),
        CapabilityInboundReferenceTarget::Existing { .. } => {
            return /* Rejected + NoLocalEffect before repository/resolver */;
        }
        CapabilityInboundReferenceTarget::ResolveOrRegister => None,
    };
    /* Validate named/Other document kind and scan locator/change summary. OpenAPI,
       protocol/schema/guide/provider-contract body or credential quarantines. */
    let request_digest: CapabilityRequestDigest =
        /* canonical family + public event + source key + target + kind + locator + summary */;
    if let Some(existing) = self.idempotency_repo.get_with_version(&key).await? {
        if existing.value.matches(
            &context.channel, &context.operation_name, &request_digest)
            && existing.value.state == CapabilityIdempotencyState::Completed
        {
            let stored = self.stored_result_repo.get_consumer_receipt(
                existing.value.completed_result_ref()?).await?
                .ok_or(/* typed replay consistency error */)?;
            return Ok(/* exact document consumer replay;DuplicateReplayed+StoredReplay;
                         no Clock/id/reference/state/resolver/descriptor call */);
        }
        return Ok(/* conflict/quarantine surface;empty effects/no original leakage */);
    }

    let now = self.clock.now();
    let tx = self.uow_manager.begin().await?;
    let reservation = CapabilityIdempotencyRecord::reserve(
        &context, request_digest.clone(), now.clone())?;
    let mut loaded_reservation = match self.idempotency_repo
        .reserve_if_absent(reservation, tx.as_ref()).await?
    {
        CapabilityIdempotencyReserveResult::Reserved(loaded) => loaded,
        CapabilityIdempotencyReserveResult::Existing(existing) => {
            self.uow_manager.rollback(tx).await?;
            return /* exact race outcome;no business ids/resolver/effect */;
        }
    };

    let kind = ReferenceKind::ExternalDocument;
    let candidate_digest: ReferenceCandidateDigest =
        /* canonical document kind + body-free locator */;
    let candidate = ReferenceCandidate::body_free(
        kind.clone(),
        ReferenceLocatorSummary::from_external_document(&payload.document_locator),
        candidate_digest.clone());
    let policy = ReferenceResolutionPolicy::default_for_capability_references();
    policy.validate_candidate(&candidate)?;
    let digest_owner = self.external_reference_repo
        .find_by_candidate_digest(kind.clone(), &candidate_digest).await?;

    let (subject, loaded_ref, loaded_state, generated) = match target {
        Some((id, subject)) => {
            if digest_owner.as_ref().is_some_and(|owner| match &owner.value {
                CapabilityExternalReference::ExternalDocument(value) => {
                    value.subject_ref() != subject || owner.expected_version != value.version
                }
                _ => true,
            }) {
                return /* Quarantined cross-subject candidate ownership */;
            }
            let loaded = self.external_reference_repo.get_with_version(subject.clone()).await?
                .ok_or(/* stable Rejected missing target */)?;
            let document_ref = match &loaded.value {
                CapabilityExternalReference::ExternalDocument(value)
                    if value.external_document_ref_id == id
                        && value.subject_ref() == subject
                        && loaded.expected_version == value.version => value,
                _ => return /* union/id/version consistency outcome */,
            };
            if document_ref.document_kind != payload.document_kind {
                return /* Quarantined immutable document-kind contradiction */;
            }
            let state = self.reference_state_repo.find_current_by_subject(subject.clone()).await?
                .ok_or(/* consistency error */)?;
            if state.value.resolution_state_id != document_ref.resolution_state_id
                || state.expected_version != state.value.version
                || !state.value.matches_subject(&subject, &kind)
            {
                return /* consistency ApplicationError */;
            }
            (subject, Some(loaded), Some(state), None)
        }
        None => match digest_owner {
            Some(loaded) => {
                let document_ref = match &loaded.value {
                    CapabilityExternalReference::ExternalDocument(value)
                        if value.document_kind == payload.document_kind
                            && value.document_locator == payload.document_locator
                            && value.candidate_digest == candidate_digest
                            && loaded.expected_version == value.version => value,
                    _ => return /* Quarantined digest-owner asymmetry */,
                };
                let subject = document_ref.subject_ref();
                let state = self.reference_state_repo.find_current_by_subject(subject.clone()).await?
                    .ok_or(/* consistency error */)?;

                    || state.expected_version != state.value.version
                    || !state.value.matches_subject(&subject, &kind)
                {
                    return /* consistency error */;
                }
                (subject, Some(loaded), Some(state), None)
            }
            None => {
                let ref_id = self.ids.new_external_document_ref_id();
                let state_id = self.ids.new_reference_resolution_state_id();
                (ReferenceSubjectRef::ExternalDocument(ref_id.clone()),
                 None, None, Some((ref_id, state_id)))
            }
        },
    };

    let observation = match self.external_document_reference_port
        .resolve_external_document_reference(
            subject.clone(), payload.document_kind.clone(),
            payload.document_locator.clone(), candidate.clone()).await
    {
        Ok(value) => value,
        Err(error) if /* typed temporary unavailable */ => {
            self.uow_manager.rollback(tx).await?;
            return Ok(/* Delayed,None result,RetryRequired+NoLocalEffect */);
        }
        Err(error) => {
            self.uow_manager.rollback(tx).await?;
            return Err(error);
        }
    };

        || observation.reference_kind != kind
        || observation.candidate_digest != candidate_digest
    {
        self.uow_manager.rollback(tx).await?;
        return Err(ApplicationError::ConsistencyDefect {
            subject: ApplicationConsistencySubjectKind::PortReturn {
                port: ApplicationPortKind::ExternalDocumentReference,
            },
            invariant: ApplicationInvariantKind::ReferenceObservationShape,
        });
    }
    if observation.resolution_value == ReferenceResolutionValue::Forbidden
        && generated.is_some()
    {
        return /* new-subject Forbidden cannot form initial state;redacted Quarantined */;
    }

    let mut ref_changed = false;
    let mut state_changed = false;
    let (ref_write, ref_expected, state_write, state_expected, selected_id) =
        match (loaded_ref, loaded_state, generated) {
            (None, None, Some((ref_id, state_id))) => {
                let state = ReferenceResolutionState::from_initial_resolution(
                    state_id.clone(), subject.clone(), kind.clone(),
                    observation.resolution_value, observation.resolution_reason,
                    context.actor_context.clone(), context.trace_id.clone(),
                    &policy, now.clone())?;
                let reference = ExternalDocumentRef::register(
                    ref_id.clone(), payload.document_kind, payload.document_locator,
                    None, &candidate, state_id, &policy, now.clone())?;
                ref_changed = true;
                state_changed = true;
                (Some(CapabilityExternalReference::ExternalDocument(reference)),
                 None, Some(state), None, ref_id)
            }
            (Some(loaded), Some(loaded_state), None) => {
                let mut reference = match loaded.value {
                    CapabilityExternalReference::ExternalDocument(value) => value,
                    _ => return /* consistency error */,
                };
                let selected_id = reference.external_document_ref_id.clone();
                let preserved_descriptor_id = reference.supported_descriptor_id.clone();
                let mut state = loaded_state.value;
                if reference.document_locator == payload.document_locator
                    && reference.candidate_digest != candidate_digest
                {
                    return /* persisted candidate-digest consistency error;do not self-repair */;
                }
                if reference.document_locator != payload.document_locator {
                    reference.replace_locator(
                        payload.document_locator, candidate_digest,
                        state.resolution_state_id.clone(), now.clone())?;
                    ref_changed = true;
                }
                if reference.supported_descriptor_id != preserved_descriptor_id {
                    return /* consistency error:consumer must not bind/rebind descriptor */;
                }
                if matches!(state.resolution_value,
                    ReferenceResolutionValue::Invalid | ReferenceResolutionValue::Forbidden)
                    && (state.resolution_value != observation.resolution_value
                        || state.resolution_reason != observation.resolution_reason)
                {
                    return /* replayable Rejected:terminal candidate requires new subject */;
                }
                if state.resolution_value != observation.resolution_value
                    || state.resolution_reason != observation.resolution_reason
                {
                    state.transition(
                        observation.resolution_value, observation.resolution_reason,
                        context.actor_context.clone(), context.trace_id.clone(),
                        &policy, now.clone())?;
                    state_changed = true;
                }
                (ref_changed.then_some(
                    CapabilityExternalReference::ExternalDocument(reference)),
                 ref_changed.then_some(loaded.expected_version),
                 state_changed.then_some(state),
                 state_changed.then_some(loaded_state.expected_version), selected_id)
            }
            _ => return /* impossible tuple consistency error */,
        };

    if let Some(reference) = ref_write {
        let saved = self.external_reference_repo
            .save(reference, ref_expected, tx.as_ref()).await?;
        if saved != subject { return /* consistency error */; }
    }
    let state_ref = if let Some(state) = state_write.as_ref() {
        let exact = self.reference_state_repo
            .save(state.clone(), state_expected, tx.as_ref()).await?;
        self.outbound_capture_service.capture_reference_resolution_changed(
            &context, state, tx.as_ref()).await?;
        Some(exact)
    } else { None };
    let changed = ref_changed || state_changed;

    let application_result_ref = CapabilityApplicationResultRef {
        operation_name: context.operation_name.clone(),
        result_id: self.ids.new_application_result_id(),
    };
    let receipt = CapabilityInboundEventReceipt {
        consumer_name: /* exact ConsumeExternalDocumentReferenceChanged name */,
        source_event_ref: public_source_ref,
        result_ref: Some(/* exact application-to-protocol ref mapping */),
        disposition: if changed { CapabilityInboundReceiptDisposition::Accepted }
            else { CapabilityInboundReceiptDisposition::Ignored },
        markers: if changed { vec![] }
            else { vec![CapabilityInboundReceiptMarker::NoLocalEffect] },
        changed_reference_subject_refs: if changed { vec![subject] } else { vec![] },
        reference_state_refs: state_ref.into_iter().collect(),
        downstream_summary_refs: vec![],
        affected_material_refs: vec![],
        follow_up_markers: vec![CapabilityInboundFollowUpMarker::DescriptorSupportReview(
            selected_id)],
        issue_refs: /* stable empty/redacted set */,
    };
    let surface: CapabilityStoredResultSurface = /* exact receipt serialization */;
    let shell = StoredCapabilityOperationResult::from_surface(
        application_result_ref.clone(), StoredCapabilityResultKind::ConsumerReceipt,
        StoredCapabilityResultDisposition::InboundEvent(
            if changed { CapabilityInboundDisposition::Accepted }
            else { CapabilityInboundDisposition::Ignored }),
        surface.surface_ref.clone(), surface.surface_digest.clone(),
        context.trace_id.clone(), now.clone())?;
    let stored = CapabilityConsumerReceiptEnvelope {
        result_ref: application_result_ref.clone(),
        operation_name: context.operation_name.clone(),
        surface_ref: surface.surface_ref.clone(),
        receipt: receipt.clone(),
    };
    self.stored_result_repo.save_consumer_receipt(
        shell, surface, stored, tx.as_ref()).await?;
    loaded_reservation.value.complete(application_result_ref, now)?;
    self.idempotency_repo.save(
        loaded_reservation.value, loaded_reservation.expected_version, tx.as_ref()).await?;
    self.uow_manager.commit(tx).await?;
    Ok(receipt)
}
```

`Other` document kind follows the same candidate policy、forbidden-body scan and state rules;it does not open an arbitrary document-body carrier. The preserved binding assertion documents an invariant,not a second descriptor lookup.

#### 29.6.5 Transaction boundary

The actual document ref/state revisions、state capture、typed receipt storage and completion are one local UoW. Resolver reads are non-transactional. `Delayed` rolls back/no completion;`Ignored` commits a replayable no-op. Descriptor/registry/exposure/derived repositories are absent;existing descriptor binding is carried through the ref object unchanged.

#### 29.6.6 Error / disposition mapping

| Branch | Disposition / handling |
|---|---|
| unsupported schema | header-only `UnsupportedSchema` |
| wrong actor/family/target、invalid safe field | stable `Rejected`/`Quarantined`;empty effects |
| completed duplicate | typed `DuplicateReplayed`;no current document/descriptor lookup |
| document/schema/protocol/guide/OpenAPI body、kind contradiction、cross-subject digest或new-subject typed Forbidden | `Quarantined`;offending material not stored |
| resolver-return subject/kind/digest mismatch | exact `ConsistencyDefect(PortReturn(ExternalDocumentReference), ReferenceObservationShape)`;whole local rollback |
| resolver temporary unavailable | processing `Delayed`;rollback/no completion |
| actual ref/state delta | `Accepted`;exact subject and optional state ref |
| exact candidate/value/reason no-op | stored `Ignored + NoLocalEffect` |
| existing terminal candidate receives changed value/reason | replayable `Rejected`;requiresdifferent candidate/new subject |
| attempted descriptor binding change or persistence/capture/result defect | consistency/ApplicationError;whole local rollback |

#### 29.6.7 State / receipt / capture / effects

New subject creates `supported_descriptor_id=None`;existing ref retains its current optional id through locator changes. The common new/ref-only/state-only/both/no-op matrix applies,with capture only for actual state revision. `DescriptorSupportReview` is a hint to a later explicit descriptor Command;it cannot bind/rebind a descriptor or establish provider runtime support. Downstream/material vectors and all core change/trace vectors are empty.

1. Unsupported schema has zero typed decode/application/Clock/reserve/resolver calls.
2. Existing wrong reference variant rejects before repository/resolver.
3. ResolveOrRegister hit/miss/collision proves exact reuse/new/quarantine and id counts.
4. New document ref always stores `supported_descriptor_id=None`.
5. Existing locator-only update preserves a Some/None descriptor binding bit-for-bit and emits no state capture.
6. Document-kind mutation/body quarantines,while resolver subject/kind/digest mismatch is technical consistency error;all write nothing.
7. Same-value changed reason is one state revision/capture;strict no-op is stored Ignored with no effect.
8. Descriptor/registry/exposure/derived/runtime-provider call counts remain zero.
9. Completed duplicate replays original vectors and never reads current document or descriptor truth.

### 30.2 Header-first, context authority, and replay-order audit

| Gate | Required order / authority | Result |

| schema | validate header version before typed payload decode | pass in all six flows;unsupported has no reserve/UoW |
| source family / actor | one closed family and configured integration/system actor per consumer | pass;downstream additionally binds actor to RuntimeTools/SDK family |

| request digest | source family + public source event + source key + target/consumer variant + all concrete payload fields | pass;actor display、trace、occurred/local time、generated ids、resolver/current state excluded |

Established completed duplicates do not call Clock、IdGenerator、resolver、domain factory、reference/impact repository or outbound capture service. A same application key with a changed source-provided key or payload therefore reaches the existing reservation and is classified as a digest conflict;it cannot create a second local effect. Missing/corrupt typed receipt is a consistency error and never falls back to current ref/state/summary reconstruction.

### 30.3 Reference target, candidate, state, and capture parity audit

| Consumer | Existing target variant | Candidate fields / locator constructor | Immutable existing fields | Replaceable ref field | Resolver |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| governance | `GovernanceResult` | kind + source + scope / `from_governance_result` | kind + source | scope/digest | `resolve_governance_result_reference` |
| method | `MethodAsset` | asset kind + locator / `from_method_asset` | asset kind | locator/digest | `resolve_method_asset_reference` |
| external source | `ExternalCapabilitySource` | source kind + locator / `from_external_source` | source kind | locator/digest | `resolve_source_reference` |
| audit | `ObservabilityAudit` | audit kind + locator / `from_observability_audit` | audit kind | locator/digest | `resolve_observability_audit_reference` |
| document | `ExternalDocument` | document kind + locator / `from_external_document` | document kind + descriptor binding | locator/digest | `resolve_external_document_reference` |

All five flows enforce the same ownership algorithm without erasing family-specific rules:

1. Existing wrong variant stops before repository/resolver;ids are never parsed across variants.
2. Both Existing and ResolveOrRegister call `find_by_candidate_digest` for the new candidate. Same subject is legal;no hit permits an Existing update or new ResolveOrRegister subject;another subject is quarantined.
3. ResolveOrRegister hit reuses that exact subject. Only a miss generates a new typed ref id and state id.
4. Existing ref update reuses its original canonical state id. New subject alone creates a new state id.
5. If the replaceable locator/scope is unchanged but the stored candidate digest differs from the recomputed digest,the flow returns a consistency error;no consumer self-repairs persisted digest corruption.
6. Existing union/id/object version、state expected version、linked state id、subject and `ReferenceKind` must all match before resolver-driven mutation.
7. Resolver subject、kind and candidate digest must match；a successful return mismatch is exact `ConsistencyDefect(PortReturn(matching resolver), ReferenceObservationShape)`,never a quarantine receipt. Governance additionally requires resolver-owned safe summary equality；that caller/resolver safe-summary contradiction is quarantined. A new subject with typed `Forbidden` is quarantined without ref/state persistence.
8. Existing non-terminal value or safe-reason delta,including a transition into body-free `Forbidden`,calls `transition`;same value + changed reason is a revision;same value + same reason is strict no-op. Existing terminal `Invalid / Forbidden` with the exact same value + reason is `Ignored`;any terminal delta is replayable `Rejected` and requires a different candidate/new subject.

| Delta shape | Ref save | State save | Reference capture | Receipt reference vectors |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---|
| new subject | 1 create | 1 create | 1 | subject + state ref |
| ref-only | 1 revision | 0 | 0 | subject only |
| state-only | 0 | 1 revision | 1 | subject + state ref |
| both | 1 revision | 1 revision | 1 | subject + state ref |
| exact no-op | 0 | 0 | 0 | both empty;`Ignored + NoLocalEffect` |

No reference flow scans or marks affected material. A canonical state revision may be announced through `ReferenceResolutionChanged`,but this batch does not run the separate post-commit collaboration flow;batch `9.9/9.10` owns that event path.

### 30.4 Downstream five-feedback and source-dedup audit

| Feedback variant | Exact factory input | Persisted state | Processing disposition after save | Result |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Received` | `from_consumer_feedback(observation)` | Received | Accepted | pass |
| `Partial` | `from_reported_state(Partial,Some(observation),Some(gap),None)` | Partial | Accepted | pass |
| `Delayed` | `from_reported_state(Delayed,observation,None,Some(reason))` | Delayed | Accepted | pass |
| `Unavailable` | `from_reported_state(Unavailable,None,None,Some(reason))` | Unavailable | Accepted | pass |
| `Ignored` | `from_reported_state(Ignored,None,None,Some(reason))` | Ignored | Accepted | pass |

The exact impact ref must match id、version and loaded expected version,and the fact must `affects_consumer` for the mapped RuntimeTools/SDK consumer. The external reference must be the exact registered RuntimeTools or SDK union;no ecosystem/marketplace or runtime execution state is consulted. `CapabilityInboundEventRef` from context is the sole persisted source-feedback dedup ref. An already stored source summary without a completed typed replay record is a consistency/quarantine condition,not permission to append another summary or reconstruct a receipt.

Payload feedback state `Delayed / Unavailable / Ignored` never changes the consumer-processing disposition:successful summary persistence is `Accepted`. Only a temporary processing prerequisite/resolver/repository condition returns processing `Delayed`,rolls back and leaves no completed receipt.

### 30.5 Receipt vector, UoW, and follow-up audit

| governance reference | actual subject delta only | actual state revision only | empty | empty | `GovernanceSeamReview` |
| method reference | actual subject delta only | actual state revision only | empty | empty | `MethodRelationReview` |

| document reference | actual subject delta only | actual state revision only | empty | empty | `DescriptorSupportReview` |

All vectors are constructed by the application flow from actual writes,then stored in the typed receipt. Worker code cannot query repositories or adapter counters to supplement or reorder them. Follow-up markers are stable body-free hints only;none invokes a Command、Job、handoff or queue implicitly.

| unsupported schema | no UoW | no reserve/receipt storage |

### 31.1 `outbound_capability_identity_changed_capture_and_collaborate_flow`

| local target | one immutable complete-envelope snapshot + one initial `Captured` record;later only `Captured -> IntentBound` |

#### 31.1.2 Source / payload field provenance

| Envelope / payload field | Exact source and gate |
|---|---|
| `event_name` / `schema_version` | fixed `CapabilityIdentityChanged` / `1`;select schema ref `capability-hub.outbound/CapabilityIdentityChanged@1` |
| `routing_key` | fixed `capability-hub.identity.changed.v1`;logical only,never a physical topic |
| `source_ref` | only `Change(Identity(record.change_record_id))`;the final identity ref cannot replace it |

| `payload.change_kind` / `next_state` | `record.change_kind` / `record.next_state`;`record.explains_identity(identity)` and final state equality required |

#### 31.1.3 ASCII call graph

```text
[Identity source-owning application service;current accepted UoW]
  | mutate/finalize CapabilityIdentity through Step 6 member
  | CapabilityIdentityRepository.save(final identity,source expected version,uow)
  | CapabilityChangeRecordRepository.append_identity_change(record,uow)
  | require record.explains_identity(identity) + trace equality + event eligibility
  | CapabilityOutboundEventCaptureService.capture_capability_identity_changed(context,record,identity,uow)
  |   -> CapabilityEventCandidateMapper.map_capability_identity_changed(record,identity)
  |   -> serialize complete v1 envelope;fixed schema ref;digest exact bytes
  |   -> new_event_payload_snapshot_id -> CapabilityEventPayloadSnapshot.freeze(...)
  |   -> new_event_capture_id -> CapabilityEventCaptureRecord.capture(...)
  |   -> CapabilityEventCaptureRepository.capture(snapshot,capture,uow)
  | retain exact capture_ref;commit source UoW

  v
[Post-commit application continuation]
  | CapabilityEventCollaborationService.collaborate_captured_event(capture_ref)
  |   -> get_with_snapshot;Captured -> stored candidate -> collaborate
  |   -> validate exact source;Clock.now;bind_intent;short UoW bind/commit
```

#### 31.1.4 Rust-style function pseudocode

```rust
async fn outbound_capability_identity_changed_capture_and_collaborate_flow(
    &self,
    context: &CapabilityOperationContext,
    record: &CapabilityIdentityChangeRecord,
    identity: &CapabilityIdentity,
    source_uow: &dyn CapabilityUnitOfWork,
) -> Result<CapabilityEventCaptureRef, ApplicationError> {
    context.assert_write_metadata_complete()?;
    if record.trace_id != context.trace_id || !record.explains_identity(identity) {
        return Err(/* source/object/trace consistency classification */);
    }
    if record.change_kind == CapabilityIdentityChangeKind::CorrectionRequested
        || record.next_state != identity.identity_state
    {
        return Err(/* ineligible intermediate source classification */);
    }

    // Called only after the source flow has staged identity.save and append_identity_change
    // against this exact source_uow.
    let capture_ref = self.outbound_capture_service
        .capture_capability_identity_changed(context, record, identity, source_uow)
        .await?;
    Ok(capture_ref)
}

// The source-owning service retains the returned ref before commit.
let capture_ref = outbound_capability_identity_changed_capture_and_collaborate_flow(
    &context, &record, &identity, source_uow.as_ref()).await?;
capture_refs.push(capture_ref.clone());
uow_manager.commit(source_uow).await?;

// Exact callable owns get_with_snapshot -> candidate/get -> source check -> short-UoW bind.
let outcome = event_collaboration_service
    .collaborate_captured_event(capture_ref)
    .await?;
Ok(outcome)
```

`capture_refs` is operation-local schematic storage,not a declared public helper. The application capture callable internally performs the exact mapper、complete serialization、schema/digest、snapshot/capture factories and repository `capture`;no generic serializer or builder API is introduced here.

#### 31.1.5 Phase / transaction boundary

| Phase | Atomic / external boundary |
|---|---|
| source UoW | final identity save + identity record append + any source-flow trace/material/result/completion + this snapshot/capture are one local transaction |
| rollback | mapper、serialization、id/snapshot/capture repository or source commit failure rolls back all local members |
| post-commit | only exact capture ref enters collaboration facade;outcome cannot alter stored source response |
| bind | stable intent binding uses a separate short UoW and loaded expected version;bind failure leaves original `Captured` |
| reentry | `IntentBound` uses existing intent `get`;completed source duplicate replays stored result and never reaches this flow |

#### 31.1.6 Error / reentry mapping

| Branch | Required result |
|---|---|
| wrong source variant、record/object id/state/version or trace mismatch | source UoW consistency failure;no snapshot/capture commit |
| intermediate `CorrectionRequested` | ineligible event source;trace may remain part of source flow,publication is forbidden |
| same `(source,schema)` with different digest/snapshot | collision;rollback,never overwrite |
| committed capture/snapshot missing or asymmetric | post-commit invariant error;never load current identity or rerun mapper |
| typed `Failed / HandoffUnavailable` outcome | valid external outcome with stable intent;bind intent;do not retire/correct identity |
| external `ApplicationError` or local bind failure | source remains committed;pre-bind capture remains `Captured` and scan-visible |
| already `IntentBound` | external `get` only;item/outcome/source symmetry required;no second intent |

#### 31.1.7 Payload / snapshot / capture / collaboration effects

| Axis | Exact effect |
|---|---|
| semantic source | unchanged by this flow;append-only record remains authority |
| envelope | complete seven-field v1 envelope;body-free identity payload only |
| local durability | exactly one immutable snapshot and one canonical capture per `(Identity change source,schema)` |
| local state | initial `Captured + None + version 1`;optional later `IntentBound + Some(intent)` |
| external state | external owner may report Candidate / PendingDelivery / Delivered / Failed / HandoffUnavailable;not copied locally |
| absent | no second identity/change/trace、no source/review body、no delivery proof in Command response |

#### 31.1.8 Test cuts

1. Eligible terminal identity record forms exact identity source、full payload、fixed schema/routing and one same-UoW capture.
2. `CorrectionRequested` against final Active identity fails before serialization/capture;terminal correction succeeds once.
3. Establish flow may return two distinct captures only when Created and ReviewFactAttached both explain the same final identity revision.
4. Trace、id、state or exact-version mismatch rolls back source transaction.
5. Snapshot/capture persistence failure proves identity/change/result are not committed.
6. Collaboration receives stored bytes exactly;missing snapshot never triggers identity repository read or mapper call.
7. Outcome source mismatch never binds;typed unavailable outcome may bind a stable intent without changing identity.
8. Existing IntentBound calls `get` once and `collaborate/bind_intent` zero times.
9. Forbidden source/review/runtime/governance body and physical topic fields never enter serialized bytes.

#### 31.1.9 Single-flow stop review

| Gate | Result |
|---|---|
| exact protocol/source | pass;Identity variant only,final-object symmetry explicit |
| callable closure | pass;identity save/append、exact mapper/capture and shared facade all declared |
| transaction/reentry | pass;same-UoW source capture、stored-only collaboration、IntentBound no-repeat |

The vector preserves the already fixed append order. It cannot collapse dual descriptor records,continue after a failed source commit,or become a public delivery result.

#### 31.3.5 Phase / transaction boundary

| Phase | Exact boundary |
|---|---|
| source | descriptor revision + every eligible append-only record + one snapshot/capture per record + source-flow trace/material/result/completion are atomic |
| dual records | both capture writes succeed or the descriptor source UoW rolls back;no merged source or partial descriptor commit |
| post-commit | collaboration iterates exact retained refs;external outcomes do not alter descriptor state |
| binding | each capture has its own loaded version and short bind UoW;one bind failure does not erase committed captures |

#### 31.3.6 Error / reentry mapping

| Branch | Required result |
|---|---|
| descriptor id/state/version or trace mismatch | rollback source UoW |
| boundary marker/body scan contradiction | mapper/domain rejection;forbidden body never serialized |
| second record capture failure | whole descriptor operation rollback,including first staged capture |
| post-commit first/second collaboration failure | descriptor and both captures remain committed;unbound captures remain recoverable |
| missing/asymmetric snapshot | no descriptor/current summary/ref lookup;explicit invariant error |
| external failed/unavailable | no `mark_unresolved` / retire / secret-ref change |
| IntentBound | get original intent only |
