| Axis | Exact effect |
|---|---|
| payload | exact descriptor ref、registry owner、change kind、state、safe boundary marker |
| dual history | SecretReferenceChanged / SafeSummaryChanged stay two audit sources and two captures when both eligible |
| capture | immutable complete bytes;one source/schema uniqueness key per record |
| local lifecycle | only capture intent binding after commit |
| absent | no secret value、provider runtime、API schema/document body、resolver call、descriptor mutation from delivery |

Cumulative Step 9 coverage is now 26 Command + 33 Query + 6 Inbound Event Consumer + 6 Outbound Event = 71 / 83 independent flows. Batch `9.10` still owns four remaining Outbound flows;eight Job flows remain in `9.11~9.12`.

### 32.2 Schema, routing, payload, source, and time parity audit

| Event | Schema ref | Routing key | Source | Occurrence / trace | Result |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Identity | `capability-hub.outbound/CapabilityIdentityChanged@1` | `capability-hub.identity.changed.v1` | `Change(Identity(id))` | record time;record=context trace | pass |
| Registry | `capability-hub.outbound/CapabilityRegistryChanged@1` | `capability-hub.registry.changed.v1` | `Change(Registry(id))` | same | pass |
| Descriptor | `capability-hub.outbound/AdapterDescriptorChanged@1` | `capability-hub.adapter-descriptor.changed.v1` | `Change(Descriptor(id))` | same | pass |
| Governance seam | `capability-hub.outbound/GovernanceSeamRelationChanged@1` | `capability-hub.governance-seam-relation.changed.v1` | `Change(GovernanceSeam(id))` | same | pass |
| Method relation | `capability-hub.outbound/CapabilityMethodRelationChanged@1` | `capability-hub.capability-method-relation.changed.v1` | `Change(MethodRelation(id))` | same | pass |
| Formal exposure | `capability-hub.outbound/FormalExposureBoundaryChanged@1` | `capability-hub.formal-exposure-boundary.changed.v1` | `Change(Exposure(id))` | same | pass |

Every mapper serializes the complete §6.7 envelope: event name、schema version、tagged source、occurrence time、trace、logical routing key and concrete payload. Capture id、snapshot id、external intent and delivery status remain outside public bytes. All payload fields have a single record or final-object source;no repository lookup、external body or post-commit time supplies a missing field.

Special source audits pass:

- identity intermediate `CorrectionRequested` is trace-only;only final-symmetric records capture.
- registry reconciliation report/finding/projection cannot form a Registry source.
- descriptor dual records retain two sources/captures rather than one merged event.
- governance seam does not export allowed summary or claim approval.
- method record endpoint must equal relation method endpoint.
- exposure refresh hint comes only from the record helper;`ConsumerViewMarkedStale` is excluded from formal exposure event eligibility.

### 32.3 Three-phase, stored-snapshot-only, and reentry audit

| Gate | Required behavior | Result |
|---|---|---|
| source atomicity | source object/record + full snapshot + initial capture use one caller-owned UoW | pass in 6 / 6 |
| nested transaction | capture callable opens/commits none | pass |
| collaboration timing | source commit must succeed before facade call | pass |
| candidate authority | `get_with_snapshot` + `try_from_stored_capture` only | pass |
| current truth / mapper rerun | zero in post-commit and repair path | pass |
| source symmetry | candidate/capture/snapshot/outcome equal before bind | pass |
| stable bind | Clock + object `bind_intent` + independent short UoW + loaded expected version | pass |
| IntentBound reentry | bound intent -> external `get`;no second collaborate/bind | pass |
| missing/asymmetric snapshot | explicit consistency failure;no reconstruction | pass |
| external typed failure/unavailable | source remains committed;stable intent may bind | pass |
| external `ApplicationError` / bind failure | pre-bind record remains `Captured`;later recovery uses same bytes | pass |

Immediate continuation uses an operation-local stable-order capture-ref vector returned by exact capture callables. It is neither persisted nor public. Deferred/crash recovery is owned by the later collaboration-repair application Job through `list(AwaitingIntent)`;worker entry never owns repository scan or publisher adapter calls.

### 32.4 Source-write callable and effect audit

| Source family | Exact truth write | Exact change append | Event source count per eligible record | Forbidden side effect |
|---|---|---|---:|---|
| identity | `CapabilityIdentityRepository::save` | `append_identity_change` | 1 | correction/review/source body mutation |
| registry | `CapabilityRegistryRepository::save` | `append_registry_change` | 1 | reconciliation truth repair、allowlist/listing |
| descriptor | `AdapterDescriptorRepository::save` | `append_descriptor_change` | 1;dual history remains 2 | secret/provider/document resolution or body |
| governance seam | `GovernanceSeamRepository::save` | `append_governance_seam_change` | 1 | approval/Policy/workflow mutation |
| method relation | `CapabilityMethodRelationRepository::save` | `append_method_relation_change` | 1 | method body/lifecycle/source dependency |
| formal exposure | `FormalExposureRepository::save` when actual object mutation exists | `append_exposure_change` | 1 per eligible formal record | runtime/SDK execution or automatic view Job |

The Outbound flow does not independently create or mutate any semantic source. These write methods appear only to prove that Phase A is attached to the exact source-owning UoW. The source Command/Consumer/Job retains its already designed idempotency and stored result semantics;collaboration outcome never overwrites those results.

```rust
    &self,
    context: &CapabilityOperationContext,

    source_uow: &dyn CapabilityUnitOfWork,

    context.assert_write_metadata_complete()?;

       and unchanged exposure/consumer audience. Any violation is a source
       consistency error;do not introduce an ad hoc value-object helper here. */

    self.outbound_capture_service
        .capture_controlled_consumer_view_availability_changed(
            context, view, source_uow,
        )
        .await
}

    &context, &view, source_uow.as_ref()).await?;

uow_manager.commit(source_uow).await?;
let outcome = event_collaboration_service
    .collaborate_captured_event(capture_ref).await?;
Ok(outcome)
```

```rust
        .await
}
```

#### 33.3.4 Rust-style function pseudocode

```rust
async fn outbound_derived_material_refreshed_capture_and_collaborate_flow(
    &self,
    context: &CapabilityOperationContext,
    source: CapabilityDerivedMaterialRefreshSource<'_>,
    source_uow: &dyn CapabilityUnitOfWork,
) -> Result<CapabilityEventCaptureRef, ApplicationError> {
    context.assert_write_metadata_complete()?;
    let policy = DerivedMaterialPolicy::default_for_derived_material();
    match &source {
        CapabilityDerivedMaterialRefreshSource::DirectoryProjection(value) => {
            policy.validate_directory_projection(value)?;
            /* Step 6 construction already requires a positive exact version and
               non-empty source-version set;mapper reasserts source symmetry. */
        }
        CapabilityDerivedMaterialRefreshSource::AuditExport(value) => {
            policy.validate_export(value)?;
            /* Reassert the existing positive-version and source-version invariants. */
        }
        CapabilityDerivedMaterialRefreshSource::EcosystemDiscovery(value) => {
            policy.validate_discovery(value)?;
            if value.is_listing_truth() {
                return Err(/* ecosystem source/boundary classification */);
            }
            /* Reassert the existing positive-version and source-version invariants. */
        }
        CapabilityDerivedMaterialRefreshSource::ReconciliationReport(value) => {
            policy.validate_reconciliation(value)?;
            if value.trace_id != context.trace_id
                || !value.does_not_change_truth()
            {
                return Err(/* report source/no-truth-write classification */);
            }
            /* Reassert the immutable positive-version and source-version invariants. */
        }
    }
    self.outbound_capture_service
        .capture_derived_material_refreshed(context, source, source_uow)
        .await
}

let capture_ref = outbound_derived_material_refreshed_capture_and_collaborate_flow(
    &context, exact_source, source_uow.as_ref()).await?;
capture_refs.push(capture_ref.clone());
uow_manager.commit(source_uow).await?;
let outcome = event_collaboration_service
    .collaborate_captured_event(capture_ref).await?;
Ok(outcome)
```

The match consumes one borrowed source variant for one capture. It is not a generic repository dispatcher and introduces no new public type or helper. The source-owning service,not this local fragment,selects and stages the exact repository write.

#### 33.3.5 Phase / transaction boundary

| Phase | Exact boundary |
|---|---|
| Phase A mutable material | one exact changed directory/export/discovery save + its complete snapshot/capture share that target/source UoW |
| Phase A report | one immutable report append + its complete snapshot/capture share the report UoW |
| multi-target Job | each actual changed target has its own atomic source/capture UoW;batch `9.11` owns Job-level partial/reentry/report ordering |
| Phase B | successful local commit precedes collaboration;only exact capture ref and stored bytes cross the boundary |
| Phase C | source-validated intent binding alone uses independent short UoW |
| failure | external failure does not mark material state、invoke rebuild、change report outcome or repair core truth |

#### 33.3.6 Error / reentry mapping

| Branch | Required result |
|---|---|
| unsupported/controlled-view source | closed-union/source-family rejection;no generic fallback |
| material kind/id/version、availability variant or source-version mismatch | mapper/source consistency failure;source UoW rollback |
| missing source versions or zero/current-only version | invalid exact source;rollback |
| report/context trace mismatch or report fails no-truth-write policy | report capture rejected;no RegistryChanged or truth mutation |
| selected material save/report append/snapshot/capture failure | current local source UoW rolls back atomically |
| source commit failure | no collaboration call |
| stored snapshot missing/asymmetric | consistency error;no repository reload or mapper rerun |
| external typed failure/unavailable | stable intent may bind;material/report unchanged |
| external `ApplicationError` / bind failure | source result stays accepted;capture remains recoverable where applicable |
| IntentBound reentry | external get only;no second capture、collaborate、bind or rebuild |

#### 33.3.7 Payload / snapshot / capture / collaboration effects

| Axis | Exact effect |
|---|---|
| payload | one exact material identity/version、same-kind availability and exact source-version set |
| local durability | one immutable complete snapshot/capture per exact material revision/schema |
| report | announces persisted report outcome only;does not claim repair、test result、evidence or acceptance |
| external | body-free notification intent/status;delivery does not trigger rebuild |
| absent | no controlled-view duplicate event、registry/exposure/identity/descriptor/relation write、raw index/audit/listing/row diff、real evidence alias |

#### 33.3.8 Test cuts

1. Four allowed variants each map exact kind/id/version、occurrence time、availability state and source versions.
2. Cross-kind availability mapping、wrong id/version and empty source versions are rejected.
3. ControlledConsumerView cannot be constructed as a source and emits only its dedicated event.
4. Directory/export/discovery save and report append each commit atomically with full snapshot/capture.
5. Reconciliation report trace equals context and `does_not_change_truth`;it forms zero RegistryChanged captures and zero core writes.
6. Audit export emits no raw audit/evidence;ecosystem emits no marketplace listing;directory emits no index body.
7. Post-commit failure neither rebuilds material nor changes report/core truth.
8. Missing snapshot never reloads material/report;IntentBound uses external get only.

|---|---|

### 33.4 `outbound_reference_resolution_changed_capture_and_collaborate_flow`

#### 33.4.1 Entry and target

| Item | Exact contract |
|---|---|
| protocol | `CapabilityOutboundEventEnvelope<ReferenceResolutionChangedPayload>`;logical event `ReferenceResolutionChanged`;schema `1` |
| source owner / application | reference Command / Inbound Consumer / refresh Job -> `capture_reference_resolution_changed`;post-commit shared facade |
| exact source | `CapabilityEventCaptureSourceRef::ReferenceResolution(ReferenceResolutionStateRef::exact(state.resolution_state_id, state.version))` |
| accepted object | one newly created or actually transitioned canonical `ReferenceResolutionState` revision |
| local target | complete immutable envelope snapshot + initial capture;later stable intent binding only |
| required Ports | `ReferenceResolutionStateRepository::save`;capture repository;IdGenerator、Clock、UoW;matching resolver only before accepted state construction,never in mapper/collaboration |
| non-effect | no external owner body、locator body、resolver response、secret/governance/method/runtime body or core truth creation/repair |

#### 33.4.2 Source / payload field provenance

| Envelope / payload field | Exact source and gate |
|---|---|
| event/schema/routing | `ReferenceResolutionChanged`;`1`;`capability-hub.outbound/ReferenceResolutionChanged@1`;`capability-hub.reference-resolution.changed.v1` |
| `source_ref` | exact versioned canonical state ref;external ref id、candidate digest、locator or resolver observation cannot replace it |
| `occurred_at` | exact `state.last_checked_at`;collaboration/capture clock cannot replace accepted check time |
| `trace_id` | exact `state.trace_id`,which must equal current accepted context trace |
| `payload.resolution_state_ref` | exact state id/version and equal to source ref |
| `payload.reference_subject` / `reference_kind` | copied from state and must pass `state.matches_subject(subject,kind)` / subject-kind policy parity |
| `payload.resolution_value` | exact canonical value in the persisted revision;no silent non-resolved-to-resolved mapping |
| eligibility | actual new revision only;same value + same reason no-op creates no save/capture;valid same-value reason change is a new exact revision and is eligible |

#### 33.4.3 ASCII call graph

```text
[Reference source-owning accepted UoW]
  | optional matching resolver call occurs before this boundary
  | validate body-free observation/candidate/subject-kind in application/domain policy
  | construct initial state or transition/mark_forbidden exact current state
  | require actual revision + context/state trace equality
  | ReferenceResolutionStateRepository.save(state,expected version,uow)
  | capture_reference_resolution_changed(context,state,uow)
  |   -> map_reference_resolution_changed(state)
  |   -> exact ReferenceResolution(state id,version);occurred_at=last_checked_at
  |   -> complete v1 envelope -> fixed schema/digest
  |   -> snapshot.freeze -> capture.capture -> repository.capture(...,same uow)
  | retain exact capture_ref;commit source UoW
  v
[Post-commit application continuation]
  | collaborate_captured_event(capture_ref)
  |   -> official snapshot only;no state/ref/resolver reload
  |   -> Captured collaborate or IntentBound external get
  |   -> outcome source check -> optional short-UoW bind
  | outcome cannot fabricate external truth or change canonical state
```

#### 33.4.4 Rust-style function pseudocode

```rust
async fn outbound_reference_resolution_changed_capture_and_collaborate_flow(
    &self,
    context: &CapabilityOperationContext,
    state: &ReferenceResolutionState,
    source_uow: &dyn CapabilityUnitOfWork,
) -> Result<CapabilityEventCaptureRef, ApplicationError> {
    context.assert_write_metadata_complete()?;
    let policy = ReferenceResolutionPolicy::default_for_capability_references();
    policy.validate_subject_kind(&state.reference_subject, &state.reference_kind)?;
    if state.trace_id != context.trace_id
        || !state.matches_subject(&state.reference_subject, &state.reference_kind)
    {
        return Err(/* canonical-state source consistency classification */);
    }
    /* Reassert the Step 6 positive exact-version invariant without inventing a
       version helper;current-only or missing versions are never capture sources. */
    self.outbound_capture_service
        .capture_reference_resolution_changed(context, state, source_uow)
        .await
}

let capture_ref = outbound_reference_resolution_changed_capture_and_collaborate_flow(
    &context, &state, source_uow.as_ref()).await?;
capture_refs.push(capture_ref.clone());
uow_manager.commit(source_uow).await?;
let outcome = event_collaboration_service
    .collaborate_captured_event(capture_ref).await?;
Ok(outcome)
```

`validate_subject_kind` and `matches_subject` are the existing Step 6 policy/object callables. The version invariant comment introduces no helper. Resolver selection and observation validation remain upstream in the source-owning Command/Consumer/Job and are never repeated here.

#### 33.4.5 Phase / transaction boundary

| Phase | Exact boundary |
|---|---|
| resolver phase | if needed,matching resolver returns a body-free observation before accepted state construction;it is not an event source and is not called after capture |
| Phase A | actual canonical state revision + affected material revisions/captures where owned by source flow + stored result/receipt/report/completion + this state event snapshot/capture share the source UoW |
| no-op | same value + same reason produces no state revision、capture or collaboration |
| Phase B | starts only after source commit;loads official capture/snapshot by exact ref |
| Phase C | binds source-validated stable intent in independent short UoW |
| external failure | cannot transition state、rewrite external ref、repair exposure/relation/truth or rerun resolver |

#### 33.4.6 Error / reentry mapping

| Branch | Required result |
|---|---|
| subject-kind、state id/version or state/context trace mismatch | source consistency failure;source UoW rollback |
| same value + same reason no-op supplied | ineligible source;no fake check time/revision/capture |
| locator/resolver response/current external owner body supplied as authority | forbidden source material;reject without body persistence |
| state save/snapshot/capture failure | source UoW rolls back state、affected materials/result/completion together |
| source commit failure | no collaboration |
| stored snapshot missing/asymmetric | consistency error;no state/ref/resolver lookup or mapper rerun |
| external typed failure/unavailable | stable intent may bind;canonical state remains accepted |
| external `ApplicationError` / bind failure | source result unchanged;capture remains recoverable where applicable |
| IntentBound reentry | external get only;no resolver、collaborate、bind or second state event |

| canonical truth | event observes the accepted state;it neither creates nor advances another state revision |
| external | body-free notification intent/status only;no owner body or resolver response |
| absent | no identity/registry/descriptor/seam/relation/exposure repair、no external document/secret/method/governance/runtime body、no locator export |

#### 33.4.8 Test cuts

1. Initial accepted and actual transitioned states map exact id/version/value and `last_checked_at` occurrence.

### 35.2 Original gap and controlled-reopen closure

旧共享算法只有`reservation UoW -> per-target UoW* -> final-report UoW`,target detail保留在request-local accumulator。target effect与outbound capture提交后若进程在final report前崩溃,同key `Reserved`重入无法区分已提交target、失败target和未尝试target；按run反查report、重扫scope或读取current truth都会丢失exact historical output并可能重复revision / capture。

本批关闭面:

| Gap | Controlled reopen / clarification | Result |
|---|---|---|
| reservation单独可见 | initial UoW原子提交fresh idempotency `Reserved`与matching complete execution journal | missing half-state被contract拒绝 |
| broad planning无法恢复 | journal冻结完整typed target plan；planning未闭合时丢弃prefix并以typed run issue形成Failed / Retryable空计划 | reserved reentry不重扫scope |

### 35.3 Canonical phase algorithm

```text
[Exact idempotency preflight]
  | Completed + match -> typed stored report replay;STOP
  | Reserved + match  -> exact execution-journal load;resume
  | mismatch          -> conflict;STOP
  | absent            -> deterministic planning
  v
[Deterministic planning;no local UoW]
  | expand complete closed scope in declared stable order
  | freeze typed target identity、exact refs / versions and body-free output inputs
  | stable per-target prerequisite failure -> PreclassifiedFailure at same ordinal
  | complete zero-target scan -> [] + no stable/retryable run issue
  | safe planning failure -> [] + typed StableFailure / RetryablePrerequisite
  | unsafe untyped failure -> no reservation / journal;STOP
  v
[Initial UoW]
  | reserve_if_absent
  | fresh -> create complete CapabilityJobExecutionRecord in same UoW
  | concurrent Existing -> rollback;discard local plan;classify winner only
  | commit reservation + journal atomically
  v
[Per-target UoW loop]
  | exact-load journal -> next_planned_target in frozen ordinal order
  | PreclassifiedFailure -> zero-effect record_failed + journal save -> commit
  | declared resolver / collaboration call where required
  | business effect + optional outbound snapshot / capture
  | record_succeeded + journal save in same UoW -> commit
  | confirmed rollback + exact safe-terminalization gate
  |   -> separate no-effect UoW may record Failed / Skipped
  | control-plane / consistency / unknown outcome
  |   -> keep Planned;return exact ApplicationError;STOP
  | exact reload before selecting next target
  v
[Final-report UoW]
  | exact-load same journal + reservation
  | require all target outcomes terminal and identities symmetric
  | pure variant-bound assembler -> typed response
  | save typed report + Finalized journal + Completed reservation,same result ref
  | commit atomically
```

The planning phase may allocate existing domain/material/report ids needed by a frozen creation target,but a concurrent reservation winner makes those losing request-local ids unreachable and unusable。No implementation may persist or reuse them through a side table。The initial write UoW begins only after one complete planning outcome exists。

### 35.4 Crash / race / reentry matrix

| Interruption / race point | Durable state | Required reentry | Forbidden recovery |
|---|---|---|---|
| before complete planning | no reservation、no journal、no target effect | a later request may plan anew | partial prefix persistence |
| planning complete,initial UoW not committed | no durable local state | a later request may plan anew | treating generated ids as committed targets |
| concurrent winner appears after absent preflight | winner reservation/journal only | rollback loser UoW,discard loser plan,exact-classify winner | overwrite / merge / append loser targets |
| reservation + journal commit,zero target | complete zero-target or typed planning-failure journal | pure final assembly;no scan | deriving disposition fromempty vector alone |
| reservation + journal commit,targets Planned | frozen full plan visible | process first ordinal Planned target | re-expand All* / scan scope |
| next target is PreclassifiedFailure | exact target identity + typed failure aredurable;no effect attempted | zero-effect UoW records exact Failed outcome,then reload | source read、fake summary、resolver、factory、capture orrun-issue collapse |
| external read/collaboration returns before local target commit | target remains Planned | concrete flow may repeat only the declared idempotent exact-ref external operation | claim local success、create capture outside target UoW |
| target UoW confirmed rollback | target remains Planned | exact reload;record typed failure / skip only when exact target + closed issue + typed impact + zero-effect gate passes,otherwise return the original error | write failure before rollback confirmation、generic error-to-target conversion |
| target rollback fails or commit outcome is unknown | target durability cannot be safely classified | return `TransactionRollbackFailed / CommitOutcomeUnknown`;exact-read recovery remains Step 13-owned | terminalize target、continue another ordinal or claim zero effect |
| target UoW commits | business effect / snapshot / capture and terminal success all visible | skip terminal target;continue next Planned ordinal | rerun factory、regenerate revision / capture、call resolver again for that target |
| terminal failure / skip UoW commits | no business effect;terminal outcome visible | skip target;continue next Planned ordinal | convert failure to success by current-truth inspection |
| all targets terminal,final UoW not committed | journal remains execution `Planned` with all terminal outcomes | rerun pure assembly and final UoW only | report-by-run、current material/ref reconstruction |
| final UoW rolls back | no Completed result visible;prior target commits remain | exact reload all-terminal journal;retry final assembly | claim prior target rollback |
| final UoW commits,response not observed | Completed reservation + Finalized journal + typed stored report | completed duplicate typed replay | rerun planning / targets / collaboration |
| Reserved exists but journal missing / asymmetric | invalid technical state | consistency-class failure;later Step 12/13 maps recovery | rescan、create replacement journal、guess outcome |

External resolver reads cannot be locally rolled back。For event-collaboration repair,the exact stable intent / capture source is frozen in the plan and external idempotency remains owned by the Step 7 collaboration Port;this gate guarantees no duplicate local revision / snapshot / capture。The concrete `9.12` flow must still state whether a pre-local-commit external outcome is obtained by exact `get` or idempotent `repair`;it may not invent a second local delivery-state owner。

### 35.5 Stable target identity and exact-read audit

| Plan variant | Frozen identity / execution input | Exact execution read | No-current-truth rule |
|---|---|---|---|
| registry / derived reconciliation | preallocated report id、scope、complete truth/material refs、source versions、finding summary、report state / optional failure reason | load only frozen refs/versions needed for parity;append planned report id | no`find_by_job_run`,no recompute findings on reentry |
| preclassified failure | public target ref + exact typed redacted failure / impact | no domain/source read;zero-effect journal transition only | no success、skip、run-issue substitution orcurrent-state repair |
| controlled view | existing exact view ref or preallocated view id、exposure ref、consumer ref、descriptor summary、source versions | exact exposure / optional view pair and owner parity | no audience rescan or current descriptor-summary substitution |
| directory projection | existing exact projection ref or preallocated id、exact registry/descriptor/exposure chain、display summary、facets、versions | exact source chain / optional projection | no current accepted-chain replacement |
| audit export | existing exact export ref or preallocated id、exact trace revision、scope、allowed summary、ordered audit ref plans、versions | trace repository `get_revision`;for each audit id construct typed subject,exact-load ref and require frozen `reference_version`;exact-load frozen `resolution_state_ref` and verify ref/state subject pair | no locator/body lookup、no current audit state fallback、no raw audit read |
| ecosystem discovery | existing exact summary ref or preallocated id、exposure ref、ecosystem context、discoverability summary、versions、expected Ready/Partial/Unavailable state andoptional reason | exact exposure / optional summary and owner pair;apply onlythe frozen state/reason | no marketplace lookup、optional-source rescan or current summary/state derivation |
| reference resolution | subject、kind、reference version、canonical state ref | exact subject load + version equality;exact state-ref load + subject/id parity;then matching body-free resolver | no initial-state fabrication、no current state-id replacement、no locator/body scan |
| event capture | exact capture revision joined to official immutable snapshot | `get_with_snapshot(exact capture ref)` | no source repository reload or mapper rerun |
| collaboration intent | exact intent ref + immutable source ref | external exact-intent `get / repair` with source parity | no new intent fromcurrent truth |

Audit/reference planning therefore does not require a new repository method。The existing `CapabilityExternalReferenceRepository::get_with_version(ReferenceSubjectRef)` plus frozen object version and `ReferenceResolutionStateRepository::get_with_version(ReferenceResolutionStateRef)` form the exact pair。A protocol-declared normally absent target may form`SubjectMissing`;aregistered ref withmissing mandatory state,or anyloaded version / union / subject / state-id asymmetry,isexact`ConsistencyDefect`,never a broad scan、body fallback ordegraded target failure。

### 35.6 Journal-only response and disposition audit

Eight existing Step 8 assemblers share these closed rules:

1. accept only matching operation / Job / schema / run / digest identity,execution still`Planned`,all target outcomes terminal,andno final result link;
2. traverse targets only in frozen ordinal order and preserverun issue stored order;
3. derive typed success detail andgeneric changed refs only from`CapabilityJobExecutionSuccess`paired with its plan;
4. derive failed / skipped vectors only frommatching terminal outcomes;
5. derive public issue refs fromjournal `run_issues`;impact remainsapplication-local;
6. perform no repository read、sort、dedup repair、id generation、serialization or journal mutation。

Disposition precedence is deterministic:

| Durable journal content | Disposition |
|---|---|
| any target failure orrun issue with`RetryablePrerequisite` | `Retryable` |
| one reconciliation success with persisted`report_state=Failed` + required`MaterialUnavailable / StableFailure` run issue | `Failed` before generic mixed-success precedence |
| at least one success plus failed / skipped or`StableFailure` run issue | `PartiallyCompleted` |
| no success plus failed / skipped or`StableFailure` run issue | `Failed` |
| all targets succeeded,or complete zero-target scan withonlyAdvisory / no run issue | `Completed` |

`Unchanged`is a successful inspected target,not`Skipped`。A complete zero-target scan and a planning-failure empty plan can never collapse to the same disposition。Opaque issue refs、error text、material state display、external status display orprivate counters are not disposition inputs。

### 36.1 `job_run_capability_registry_reconciliation_flow`

#### 36.1.1 Entry and target

| Item | Exact contract |
|---|---|
| protocol | `CapabilityJobRequest<RunCapabilityRegistryReconciliationJobInput>` -> `CapabilityJobResponse<CapabilityRegistryReconciliationJobResult>` |
| trigger / schema | `capability-hub.job.run-capability-registry-reconciliation.v1`;schema `1` |
| entry / application | `CapabilityOperationsJobHandlers::run_capability_registry_reconciliation` -> `CapabilityOperationsJobService::run_capability_registry_reconciliation` |
| declared source | registry-centered `truth_scope` + mapped `material_scope`;complete committed snapshot pages and exact current material revisions |
| durable target | zero targets for a complete empty scan / typed planning failure,or exactly one preallocated immutable reconciliation report target |
| allowed write | `CapabilityReconciliationReportRepository::append` + `capture_derived_material_refreshed(ReconciliationReport)` + matching journal success |
| forbidden write | `CapabilityRegistryRepository::save`;any identity / descriptor / relation / exposure save;Command synthesis;`CapabilityRegistryChanged` capture |
| result assembler | only `assemble_registry_reconciliation_response(&execution,result_ref)` |

#### 36.1.2 Request, planning, and frozen-field provenance

| Frozen value | Exact source / validation |
|---|---|
| `operation_name / job_name / schema / run / key / actor / trace` | validated closed runner metadata -> `CapabilityOperationContext::from_job`;journal preserves the first actor / trace for every later target and event |
| request digest | schema `1` + normalized `reconciliation_scope`、`truth_scope`、`material_scope`;excludes run id、trace、actor、cursor andgenerated report id |
| internal truth scope | 1:1 mapping from `CapabilityJobTruthSnapshotScope`;must be registry-centered andmust not widen an exact variant to all truth |
| `source_truth_refs` | all `CapabilityTruthSnapshotRepository::load_snapshot_page` pages,stable page/item order,duplicate-free union;at least one registry subject is required for a report target |
| `inspected_material_refs` | all `CapabilityDerivedMaterialRepository::list_material_refs` pages under the mapped maintenance-safe scope,then exact typed loads;duplicate-free stable order |
| exact material reads | controlled view `get_with_version`;directory / audit / ecosystem exact current get methods;immutable report `get`；normal absent source may becomeafinding / typed planning failure,while loaded wrong-kind / owner / version / source-marker asymmetry is`ConsistencyDefect`,never silent omission |
| `source_versions / finding_summary / report_state / failure_reason` | deterministic comparison of the complete exact basis;only body-free markers/findings are frozen;`Failed` requires a safe `failure_reason` |
| report id / target ref | `IdGeneratorPort::new_reconciliation_report_id()` only after a complete non-empty comparison basis;target is `DerivedMaterial(ReconciliationReport(report_id))` |
| run issues | stable redacted issues in discovery order;`Partial` basis uses `StableFailure`,`Inconsistent / RebuildRequired` may use `Advisory`,`Failed` must use `StableFailure`;temporary prerequisite uses `RetryablePrerequisite` |

If scope expansion completes with no eligible basis,`targets=[]`is valid only when the scan is genuinely empty and no blocking issue exists。Missing exact input、incomplete page coverage or temporary store failure that can be safely classified uses`targets=[]`plus the typed stable/retryable run issue and discards any prefix candidates。An untyped wiring / invariant / serialization error leaves no reservation and no journal。

#### 36.1.3 ASCII call graph

```text
[Jobs runner]
  | validate exact trigger / job name / schema 1 / concrete body
  | CapabilityOperationContext::from_job(...)
  v
[Registry reconciliation application service]
  | validate registry-centered scopes;compute digest;idempotency preflight
  | completed same request -> get_job_report -> into_duplicate_response -> return
  | reserved same request  -> exact journal load;no scope scan
  | absent -> page complete truth snapshot + material refs;exact-load materials
  |        -> freeze zero-target outcome or one RegistryReconciliation target
  | initial UoW:reserve_if_absent + execution.create -> commit
  |
  | while next_planned_target exists:
  |   target UoW
  |     -> CapabilityReconciliationReport::from_findings / failed(frozen basis)
  |     -> DerivedMaterialPolicy::validate_reconciliation
  |     -> report_repository.append
  |     -> capture_derived_material_refreshed(ReconciliationReport)
  |     -> execution.record_succeeded(Reconciliation(view)) + execution.save
  |   commit;optional post-commit collaborate exact capture only
  |   exact journal reload;never find report by run
  |
  | final UoW:assemble from all-terminal journal
  |   -> save_job_report + execution.finalize + reservation.complete -> commit
  v
[Typed response]
  one optional report view;zero registry mutation;duplicate is stored replay only
```

Key diagram notes:

- Snapshot/material scans happen only before the fresh initial UoW;reserved reentry starts at exact journal load。
- The one report target uses the first accepted execution actor / trace from the journal,not a reentry transport trace。
- The report append、derived event capture andterminal success are one atomic target set;external collaboration is after commit andnot part of the Job disposition。

#### 36.1.4 Rust-style function pseudocode

```rust
async fn job_run_capability_registry_reconciliation_flow(
    &self,
    context: CapabilityOperationContext,
    input: RunCapabilityRegistryReconciliationJobInput,
) -> Result<CapabilityJobResponse<CapabilityRegistryReconciliationJobResult>, ApplicationError> {
    context.assert_write_metadata_complete()?;
    /* Validate schema-bound registry-centered scope shape and duplicate-free
       typed members before any Clock, id generation, scan, or UoW. */
    let job_name = /* closed Step 8 value:RunCapabilityRegistryReconciliation */;
    let request_digest = /* Step 13 canonical digest of schema + normalized input */;
    let key = &context.idempotency_key;

    let mut loaded_execution = match self.idempotency_repository
        .get_with_version(key).await?
    {
        Some(loaded) if loaded.value.matches(
            &CapabilityOperationChannel::OperationsJob,
            &context.operation_name,
            &request_digest,
        ) && loaded.value.state == CapabilityIdempotencyState::Completed => {
            let result_ref = loaded.value.completed_result_ref()?.clone();
            let stored = self.stored_result_repository
                .get_job_report(&result_ref).await?
                .ok_or(/* consistency: completed reservation without Job report */)?;
            return match stored.into_duplicate_response()? {
                CapabilityStoredJobResponse::RegistryReconciliation(response) => Ok(response),
                _ => Err(/* consistency: wrong stored Job union variant */),
            };
        }
        Some(loaded) if loaded.value.matches(
            &CapabilityOperationChannel::OperationsJob,
            &context.operation_name,
            &request_digest,
        ) && loaded.value.state == CapabilityIdempotencyState::Reserved => {
            let journal = self.job_execution_repository
                .get_with_version(key).await?
                .ok_or(/* consistency: reserved without journal */)?;
            if !journal.value.matches_request(
                &context, &job_name, &CapabilityProtocolSchemaVersion(1), &request_digest,
            ) {
                return Err(/* exact journal identity/digest consistency error */);
            }
            journal
        }
        Some(_) => return Err(/* conflict;preserve original reservation/result */),
        None => {
            /* Page the mapped truth scope to exhaustion,then page the mapped
               material scope to exhaustion and exact-load every typed material.
               Build stable AccessTruthRefSet / DerivedMaterialRefSet / source
               versions / findings only after complete coverage. No helper here
               widens scope or reads raw material/external bodies. */
            let (targets, run_issues) = /* complete deterministic planning outcome */;
            let planned_at = self.clock.now();
            let reservation = CapabilityIdempotencyRecord::reserve(
                &context, request_digest.clone(), planned_at.clone(),
            )?;
            let execution = CapabilityJobExecutionRecord::plan(
                &context, job_name.clone(), CapabilityProtocolSchemaVersion(1),
                request_digest.clone(), targets, run_issues, planned_at,
            )?;
            let tx = self.uow_manager.begin().await?;
            match self.idempotency_repository
                .reserve_if_absent(reservation, tx.as_ref()).await?
            {
                CapabilityIdempotencyReserveResult::Reserved(_) => {
                    let created = self.job_execution_repository
                        .create(execution, tx.as_ref()).await?;
                    self.uow_manager.commit(tx).await?;
                    created
                }
                CapabilityIdempotencyReserveResult::Existing(_) => {
                    self.uow_manager.rollback(tx).await?;
                    drop(execution);
                    let winner = self.idempotency_repository
                        .get_with_version(key).await?
                        .ok_or(/* consistency: reserve loser cannot reload winner */)?;
                    if !winner.value.matches(
                        &CapabilityOperationChannel::OperationsJob,
                        &context.operation_name,
                        &request_digest,
                    ) {
                        return Err(/* idempotency conflict;winner unchanged */);
                    }
                    match winner.value.state {
                        CapabilityIdempotencyState::Completed => {
                            let stored = self.stored_result_repository
                                .get_job_report(winner.value.completed_result_ref()?).await?
                                .ok_or(/* consistency: completed winner without report */)?;
                            /* Validate operation/job/schema/digest and the same
                               run id before mapping the exact typed report. */
                            return match stored.into_duplicate_response()? {
                                CapabilityStoredJobResponse::RegistryReconciliation(response) => Ok(response),
                                _ => Err(/* consistency: wrong stored Job union variant */),
                            };
                        }
                        CapabilityIdempotencyState::Reserved => {
                            let journal = self.job_execution_repository
                                .get_with_version(key).await?
                                .ok_or(/* consistency: reserved winner without journal */)?;
                            /* First validate journal symmetry with the winner;
                               a coherent journal owned by another run is an
                               idempotency conflict,not a consistency defect. */
                            if !journal.value.matches_request(
                                &context, &job_name, &CapabilityProtocolSchemaVersion(1), &request_digest,
                            ) {
                                return Err(/* exact asymmetry or different-run classification */);
                            }
                            journal
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    };

    loop {
        let Some(target) = loaded_execution.value.next_planned_target().cloned() else { break };
        let CapabilityJobExecutionTargetPlan::RegistryReconciliation {
            report_id, reconciliation_scope, source_truth_refs,
            inspected_material_refs, source_versions, finding_summary,
            report_state, failure_reason,
        } = target.plan else {
            return Err(/* wrong journal plan variant */);
        };
        let execution_context = CapabilityOperationContext::from_job(
            loaded_execution.value.operation_name.clone(),
            loaded_execution.value.actor_context.clone(),
            loaded_execution.value.run_id.clone(),
            loaded_execution.value.trace_id.clone(),
            loaded_execution.value.idempotency_key.clone(),
        )?;
        let now = self.clock.now();
        let report = match failure_reason {
            Some(reason) => CapabilityReconciliationReport::failed(
                report_id, reconciliation_scope, source_truth_refs,
                inspected_material_refs, source_versions, finding_summary, reason,
                loaded_execution.value.run_id.clone(),
                loaded_execution.value.actor_context.clone(),
                loaded_execution.value.trace_id.clone(), now.clone(),
            )?,
            None => CapabilityReconciliationReport::from_findings(
                report_id, reconciliation_scope, source_truth_refs,
                inspected_material_refs, source_versions, finding_summary, report_state,
                loaded_execution.value.run_id.clone(),
                loaded_execution.value.actor_context.clone(),
                loaded_execution.value.trace_id.clone(), now.clone(),
            )?,
        };
        let policy = DerivedMaterialPolicy::default_for_derived_material();
        policy.validate_reconciliation(&report)?;
        let target_tx = self.uow_manager.begin().await?;
        let report_ref = self.reconciliation_report_repository
            .append(report.clone(), target_tx.as_ref()).await?;
        let capture_ref = self.outbound_capture_service
            .capture_derived_material_refreshed(
                &execution_context,
                CapabilityDerivedMaterialRefreshSource::ReconciliationReport(&report),
                target_tx.as_ref(),
            ).await?;
        let view = CapabilityReconciliationJobReportView {
            report_ref, report_state: report.report_state,
            source_truth_refs: report.source_truth_refs.clone(),
            inspected_material_refs: report.inspected_material_refs.clone(),
            finding_summary: report.finding_summary.clone(),
        };
        loaded_execution.value.record_succeeded(
            target.ordinal,
            CapabilityJobExecutionSuccess::Reconciliation(view),
            now,
        )?;
        self.job_execution_repository.save(
            loaded_execution.value.clone(), loaded_execution.expected_version,
            target_tx.as_ref(),
        ).await?;
        self.uow_manager.commit(target_tx).await?;
        let _ = self.event_collaboration_service
            .collaborate_captured_event(capture_ref).await;
        loaded_execution = self.job_execution_repository
            .get_with_version(key).await?
            .ok_or(/* consistency: committed target lost journal */)?;
    }

    let mut final_execution = self.job_execution_repository
        .get_with_version(key).await?
        .ok_or(/* consistency: final journal missing */)?;
    let mut final_reservation = self.idempotency_repository
        .get_with_version(key).await?
        .ok_or(/* consistency: final reservation missing */)?;
    if !final_execution.value.matches_request(
        &context, &job_name, &CapabilityProtocolSchemaVersion(1), &request_digest,
    ) || final_execution.value.next_planned_target().is_some()
        || final_reservation.value.state != CapabilityIdempotencyState::Reserved
    {
        return Err(/* final identity/all-terminal consistency error */);
    }
    let result_id = self.id_generator.new_application_result_id();
    let application_result_ref = CapabilityApplicationResultRef {
        operation_name: final_execution.value.operation_name.clone(),
        result_id: result_id.clone(),
    };
    let protocol_result_ref = CapabilityProtocolResultRef {
        operation_name: /* same safe operation-name value */,
        result_id,
    };
    let response = assemble_registry_reconciliation_response(
        &final_execution.value, protocol_result_ref,
    )?;
```

#### 36.1.5 Transaction, failure, state/event, and reentry matrix

| Branch | Transaction / result rule |
|---|---|
| invalid trigger/schema/body/scope | `Rejected`;no Clock、scan、id、UoW、reservation orjournal |
| completed same request | typed `get_job_report` replay;no snapshot/material read、report append、capture orClock/id |
| reserved same request | exact journal only;terminal report target is never appended/captured again |
| complete valid empty scan | empty journal/no blocking issue -> final `Completed`,detail `reconciliation=None` |
| safely classified planning failure | empty journal + stable/retryable run issue -> final `Failed`/`Retryable`;no fabricated report |
| valid comparison basis | one report target;report state/finding frozen before initial UoW |
| report state `Failed` | report still appends/captures as `Succeeded(Reconciliation)`;required `StableFailure` run issue makes final Job `Failed` under Step 8 §11.3.1 |
| append/capture/journal-save/target commit failure | rollback target UoW;after rollback exact-load Planned target,then record typed Failed/Skipped in a no-effect UoW only when safely classifiable |
| post-commit collaboration failure | report/capture/journal success remains committed;no target failure or registry rollback;capture stays recoverable |
| final-report failure | prior target remains terminal;reserved reentry performs final assembly only andnever calls `find_by_job_run` |

State and effect rules:

- exactly one new immutable `CapabilityReconciliationReport` revision for a successful non-empty target;it has no update/delete path;
- exactly one `DerivedMaterialRefreshed` local capture for that report revision;zero `CapabilityRegistryChanged` captures;
- `Inconsistent` / `RebuildRequired` is a report finding,not an automatic material rebuild orCommand;
- response `reconciliation_report_refs` and`changed_material_refs[ReconciliationReport]` both derive from the same journal success view;current repository state is never consulted during final assembly。

#### 36.1.6 Test cuts and single-flow stop review

1. Reject material-only or widened registry scope before idempotency and verify zero repository scans/writes。
2. Exhaust multi-page truth/material scopes in stable order;duplicate or asymmetric typed ref fails instead of silent deduplication。
3. Valid empty scan persists empty journal andreplays `Completed` without rescanning。
4. Stable andretryable planning failures persist issue-bearing empty journals andreplay exact`Failed / Retryable`。
5. Completed、Partial、Inconsistent、RebuildRequired andFailed domain reports preserve frozen sets/findings/state;Failed hasrequired stable impact andJob `Failed`。
6. Report append、event snapshot/capture andjournal success commit/rollback atomically。
7. Crash after target commit skips report/id/capture regeneration andretries only final assembly。
8. Completed duplicate calls only`get_job_report`;`find_by_job_run`、truth/material scans andregistry save counts remain zero。
9. Post-commit event collaboration failure does not alter report、journal orJob detail。

Planning freezes one `ControlledView` plan only after all its safe inputs are complete。Its existing `descriptor_summary`field freezes bothbody-free summary andtyped partial-kind set,soReserved reentry neverreclassifies anoptional source。The plan's `existing_consumer_view_ref` is `Some(exact current ref)` or`None + preallocated id`;it never stores a repository cursor、visibility object、runtime state ordescriptor body。A page/scope failure before complete target identities uses the run-level empty-plan rule;an identified bad consumer uses the per-target failure variant。

#### 36.2.5 Transaction, error, state/event, and reentry rules

| Branch | Required behavior |
|---|---|

| post-commit collaboration failure | does not mark view unavailable/stale、changeJob item orwrite exposure;official capture remains repairable |

#### 36.3.1 Entry, scope, and target identity

| Item | Exact contract |
|---|---|
| protocol | `CapabilityJobRequest<RebuildDirectorySearchBrowseProjectionJobInput>` -> `CapabilityJobResponse<DirectorySearchBrowseProjectionRebuildJobResult>` |
| trigger / schema | `capability-hub.job.rebuild-directory-search-browse-projection.v1`;schema `1` |
| source | exact non-retired registry + accepted descriptor + accepted/active formal exposure owner chain |
| successful target | `DerivedMaterial(DirectoryProjection(projection_id))`;existing exact ref orpreallocated id |
| failed target before material identity | `Truth(RegistryEntry(registry_entry_id))` foran invalid explicit/registry source;existing-projection failure keeps its exact derived-material target |
| allowed write | one directory projection create/update + one`DerivedMaterialRefreshed`capture + journal success |
| no-op | exact existingReady projection has identical three source refs、display/facets and`matches_sources(frozen_versions)` |
| forbidden | registry/descriptor/exposure create orsave、provider lookup、search-engine runtime/index state、ranking ormarketplace listing |
| result assembler | only`assemble_directory_projection_rebuild_response` |

Scope expansion:

| Scope variant | Exact expansion |
|---|---|
| `ExplicitSources` | preserve request order;exact-load each three-ref chain;validate registry/descriptor/exposure owner andaccepted-state symmetry |
| `RegistryEntries` | preserve request order;exact-load registry ref,then `AdapterDescriptorRepository::find_current_by_registry_entry` and`FormalExposureRepository::find_current_by_registry_entry`;freeze returned exact refs |
| `ExistingProjections` | preserve request order;`get_directory_projection_with_version(exact ref)`,then exact-load its three stored source refs;never replace corrupt stored refs with current chain |

For every valid chain,planning calls`find_directory_projection_by_registry_entry`to choose`Some(exact existing ref)`or`None + new_directory_projection_id()`。It derives `CapabilityDirectoryDisplaySummary`、non-empty`DirectorySearchFacetSet` and`DerivedMaterialSourceVersionSet` solely fromthe exact safe chain。A normally absent / retired / unresolved prerequisite witha stable target identity may become`PreclassifiedFailure`;aloaded registry/descriptor/exposure/projection owner、id、version、union orsource-chain mismatch is`ConsistencyDefect`andmust notenter the plan asfailure。A page/wiring failure before complete expansion uses the run-level planning-failure rule onlywhenanexisting closed issue andtyped impact are available。

#### 36.3.2 ASCII call graph

```text
[Directory rebuild handler]
  | closed trigger/schema/body -> from_job context
  v
[Application planning]
  | completed -> typed stored replay;STOP
  | reserved  -> exact journal;no source resolution
  | absent:
  |   expand one of three closed scope variants in stable order
  |   exact source chain -> optional existing projection -> freeze safe material
  |   bad identified source -> PreclassifiedFailure at same ordinal
  |   initial UoW:reservation + complete journal -> commit
  v
[Ordinal target loop]
  | PreclassifiedFailure -> zero-effect Failed journal transition

  |   exact-load frozen registry / descriptor / exposure + optional projection
  |   complete match -> Unchanged journal-only target UoW
  |   else build_from_access_truth / refresh_from_access_truth
  |        -> validate_directory_projection
  |        -> save_directory_projection
  |        -> capture_derived_material_refreshed(DirectoryProjection)
  |        -> record_succeeded + journal save -> commit
  |   exact journal reload;terminal ordinals never rerun
  v
[Final-report UoW]
  directory assembler -> typed stored report + Finalized + Completed -> commit
```

Key diagram notes:

- Exact source-chain resolution is frozen beforeinitial reservation andisnever repeated forreserved reentry。
- Existing-projection source corruption cannot be repaired bycurrent descriptor/exposure lookup。
- OnlyCreated/Updated branches own a projection save andderived-event capture;Unchanged owns neither。

#### 36.3.4 Transaction, error, state/event, test cuts, and single-flow stop review

| Branch | Exact result |
|---|---|
| complete exact match | `Unchanged`;no projection save/version/time/capture;success journal only |
| valid create/update | projection save + derived snapshot/capture + success journal one target UoW |
| identified invalid chain | preclassified failed row;zero material effect;remaining ordinals continue |
| exact prerequisite is normally absent after planning | after zero-effect proof,exact `SubjectMissing / StaleSource` target failure；never current-chain replacement |
| loaded source/projection owner、id、version or chain asymmetry | exact `ConsistencyDefect`;target remains`Planned`,no report finalization |
| projection optimistic conflict | confirmed rollback + exact journal reload may record `OptimisticConflict + RetryablePrerequisite`;do not infer another writer's projection as this target success |
| final/report crash | terminal journal reconstructs exact items/order;no projection scan orsource derivation |

State/effect rules:

- build/refresh ends in`DirectoryProjectionState::Ready`;refresh accepts anyloaded projection state,includingreserved-originRebuilding / Unavailable,but core source state isread-only;
- this Job nevercalls`mark_rebuilding`or`mark_unavailable`andneverpersists anintermediate orfailure projection revision；a target failure leaves the prior material unchanged andonlyterminalizes the journal row afterrollback;
- each actual create/update forms one`DerivedMaterialRefreshed`;Unchanged / failure forms zero event;
- projection remains`is_read_only()==true`;no search engine/index/ranking state is persisted bythis flow;
- generic changed refs include onlyCreated/Updated projection ids in journal order。

Test cuts:

1. Cover all three scope variants,stable ordering andduplicate rejection。
2. Existing-projection corrupt source refs fail without current fallback。
3. Registry-entry missing descriptor/exposure ispreclassified while valid siblings commit。
4. No-op requires exact source/display/facets/Ready symmetry andforms no capture。
5. Create/update save、capture andjournal outcome areatomic under each failure point。
6. Crash after commit does not regenerate projection id orrepeat refresh/capture。
7. Duplicate performs onlytyped stored replay;registry/descriptor/exposure/material reads remain zero。
8. Provider lookup、marketplace、runtime index、ranking andcore save call counts remain zero。

| Gate | Result |
|---|---|
| scope-to-source closure | pass;three variants use declared exact/current reads only |
| partial failed-target retention | pass;PreclassifiedFailure,not fake projection |
| no-op/source parity | pass;complete match required |
| material/capture/journal atomicity | pass |
| registry / marketplace boundary | pass;read-only sources,no listing/index truth |
| structure comments | pass;no new declaration in this flow |

### 36.4 `job_prepare_audit_friendly_export_summary_flow`

#### 36.4.1 Entry, target, and frozen source contract

| Item | Exact contract |
|---|---|
| protocol | `CapabilityJobRequest<PrepareAuditFriendlyExportSummaryJobInput>` -> `CapabilityJobResponse<AuditFriendlyExportPreparationJobResult>` |
| trigger / schema | `capability-hub.job.prepare-audit-friendly-export-summary.v1`;schema `1` |
| validated input | non-empty duplicate-free exact trace refs、one body-free`AuditExportScope`、stable duplicate-free optional audit ids |
| target identity/order | one`TraceabilityRecord(exact trace ref)`per request trace,in request order |
| source | exact historical trace revision + deterministic allowed summary + optional exact local audit-ref/current-state pairs |
| existing/material id | `find_audit_export_by_traceability(exact trace,scope)` -> exact existing ref,or`new_audit_export_id()`for creation |
| allowed write | one audit-export create/update + `DerivedMaterialRefreshed(AuditExport)` capture + journal success |
| forbidden | raw audit/observability read、handoff call、evidence alias/signature、trace/change mutation orcore truth write |
| result assembler | only`assemble_audit_export_preparation_response` |

Planning field provenance:

| Plan field | Source / rule |
|---|---|
| `traceability_ref` | input exact ref -> `CapabilityTraceabilityRepository::get_revision`;missing stays a preclassified failed trace target,no current/latest fallback |
| `allowed_summary` | exact trace + its body-free change refs / safe reasons;forbidden-body scanner must pass;no log/span/metric/audit body |
| `existing_export_ref / export_id` | exact trace+scope lookup;missing preallocates id only after valid trace/summary basis |
| each audit plan | `ReferenceSubjectRef::ObservabilityAudit(id)` -> `CapabilityExternalReferenceRepository::get_with_version`;freeze object `version`;`ReferenceResolutionStateRepository::find_current_by_subject` -> freeze exact state ref |
| source versions | exact trace marker plus every audit canonical-state marker actually inspected;stable typed set |
| `Invalid / Forbidden` | trace target becomes`PreclassifiedFailure(PolicyRejected + StableFailure)`;no export object orcapture iscreated/updated |
| other values | `Resolved` contributes a saved attachment;`Unavailable` selectsUnavailable;`Unresolved/Stale/Expired` selectsPartial;stable first matching resolution reason is copied through`to_audit_export_gap_reason()` |

A declared audit ref that is normally absent may producea preclassified failed trace target。Oncea ref orstate row isloaded,wrong union/kind/owner/version/state-id ormissing mandatory paired state is`ConsistencyDefect`;it must notbecome`PreclassifiedFailure`oradegraded export。An empty `observability_ref_ids` vector is valid andproduces a Ready export with`observability_refs=None`。Planning never contacts an audit handoff Port orresolves a locator/body。

#### 36.4.2 ASCII call graph

```text
[Audit export Job handler]
  | exact trigger/schema/non-empty trace body -> from_job context
  v
[Planning;fresh only]
  | for each trace in request order:
  |   get_revision(exact)
  |   derive body-free allowed summary / source versions
  |   for each audit id in request order:
  |     get typed local ref + exact current canonical state;freeze versions/refs
  |   normal missing -> PreclassifiedFailure(SubjectMissing + StableFailure)
  |   Invalid/Forbidden -> PreclassifiedFailure(PolicyRejected + StableFailure)
  |   loaded pair asymmetry/missing mandatory state -> ConsistencyDefect;STOP
  |   else AuditExport plan + optional exact existing ref / preallocated id
  | initial UoW:reservation + complete journal -> commit
  v
[Target loop]
  | PreclassifiedFailure -> zero-effect journal Failed
  | AuditExport:
  |   exact get_revision + optional exact export
  |   exact-load every frozen audit ref version + state ref;derive final outcome
  |   matches_preparation(all final fields) -> Unchanged journal-only UoW
  |   else build_from_traceability OR refresh_from_traceability(clear old refs)
  |      -> attach onlyResolved pairs in frozen order
  |      -> at most one mark_partial / mark_unavailable
  |      -> validate_export -> save_audit_export
  |      -> capture_derived_material_refreshed(AuditExport)
  |      -> journal success -> commit
  |   post-commit collaboration exact capture only;no audit handoff
  v
[Final-report UoW]
  audit assembler -> stored typed report + Finalized + Completed -> commit
```

Key diagram notes:

- `get_revision` preserves the request's historical trace authority;current/latest trace isnever substituted。
- Canonical-state precedence is evaluated beforematerial mutation andproduces at mostone degraded transition。
- Event collaboration isnot audit handoff anddoes not create evidence、delivery receipt oracceptance fact。

```rust
            match self.idempotency_repository
                .reserve_if_absent(reservation, initial_tx.as_ref()).await?
            {
                CapabilityIdempotencyReserveResult::Reserved(_) => {
                    let created = self.job_execution_repository
                        .create(execution, initial_tx.as_ref()).await?;
                    self.uow_manager.commit(initial_tx).await?;
                    created
                }
                CapabilityIdempotencyReserveResult::Existing(_) => {
                    self.uow_manager.rollback(initial_tx).await?;
                    drop(execution);
                    let winner = self.idempotency_repository
                        .get_with_version(&context.idempotency_key).await?
                        .ok_or(/* consistency: reserve loser cannot reload winner */)?;
                    if !winner.value.matches(
                        &CapabilityOperationChannel::OperationsJob,
                        &context.operation_name, &digest,
                    ) {
                        return Err(/* idempotency conflict;winner unchanged */);
                    }
                    match winner.value.state {
                        CapabilityIdempotencyState::Completed => {
                            let stored = self.stored_result_repository
                                .get_job_report(winner.value.completed_result_ref()?).await?
                                .ok_or(/* consistency: completed winner without report */)?;
                            /* Validate the same run and exact stored envelope. */
                            return match stored.into_duplicate_response()? {
                                CapabilityStoredJobResponse::AuditExportPreparation(response) => Ok(response),
                                _ => Err(/* consistency: wrong stored Job variant */),
                            };
                        }
                        CapabilityIdempotencyState::Reserved => {
                            let journal = self.job_execution_repository
                                .get_with_version(&context.idempotency_key).await?
                                .ok_or(/* consistency: reserved winner without journal */)?;
                            if !journal.value.matches_request(&context, &job_name, &schema, &digest) {
                                return Err(/* exact asymmetry or different-run classification */);
                            }
                            journal
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    };

    while let Some(target) = loaded_execution.value.next_planned_target().cloned() {
        if let CapabilityJobExecutionTargetPlan::PreclassifiedFailure { failure } = target.plan {
            loaded_execution.value.record_failed(
                target.ordinal, failure, self.clock.now(),
            )?;
            let tx = self.uow_manager.begin().await?;
            self.job_execution_repository.save(
                loaded_execution.value.clone(), loaded_execution.expected_version, tx.as_ref(),
            ).await?;
            self.uow_manager.commit(tx).await?;
            loaded_execution = self.job_execution_repository
                .get_with_version(&context.idempotency_key).await?
                .ok_or(/* journal missing */)?;
            continue;
        }
        let CapabilityJobExecutionTargetPlan::AuditExport {
            export_id, existing_export_ref, traceability_ref, export_scope,
            allowed_summary, observability_refs, source_versions,
        } = target.plan else {
            return Err(/* wrong plan variant */);
        };
        let trace = self.traceability_repository
            .get_revision(traceability_ref.clone()).await?
            .ok_or(/* planned exact trace missing */)?;
        let existing = match existing_export_ref.clone() {
            Some(export_ref) => Some(self.derived_material_repository
                .get_audit_export_with_version(export_ref).await?
                .ok_or(/* planned exact export missing */)?),
            None => None,
        };
        let mut resolved_pairs = Vec::new();
        let mut first_partial_reason = None;
        let mut first_unavailable_reason = None;
        for planned in observability_refs.iter() {
            let subject = ReferenceSubjectRef::ObservabilityAudit(planned.audit_ref_id.clone());
            let loaded_ref = self.external_reference_repository
                .get_with_version(subject.clone()).await?
                .ok_or(/* planned local audit ref missing */)?;
            let audit_ref = match loaded_ref.value {
                CapabilityExternalReference::ObservabilityAudit(value) => value,
                _ => return Err(/* target failure:wrong reference union variant */),
            };
            if audit_ref.version != planned.reference_version {
                return Err(/* target failure:no current-version substitution */);
            }
            let loaded_state = self.reference_state_repository
                .get_with_version(planned.resolution_state_ref.clone()).await?
                .ok_or(/* planned canonical state missing */)?;
            if !loaded_state.value.matches_subject(
                &subject, &ReferenceKind::ObservabilityAudit,
            ) {
                return Err(/* target failure:ref/state pair mismatch */);
            }
            match loaded_state.value.resolution_value {
                ReferenceResolutionValue::Resolved => {
                    resolved_pairs.push((audit_ref, loaded_state.value));
                }
                ReferenceResolutionValue::Unavailable => {
                    if first_unavailable_reason.is_none() {
                        first_unavailable_reason = Some(
                            loaded_state.value.resolution_reason.to_audit_export_gap_reason(),
                        );
                    }
                }
                ReferenceResolutionValue::Unresolved
                | ReferenceResolutionValue::Stale
                | ReferenceResolutionValue::Expired => {
                    if first_partial_reason.is_none() {
                        first_partial_reason = Some(
                            loaded_state.value.resolution_reason.to_audit_export_gap_reason(),
                        );
                    }
                }
                ReferenceResolutionValue::Invalid
                | ReferenceResolutionValue::Forbidden => {
                    return Err(/* consistency:these values must be preclassified */);
                }
            }
        }
        let resolved_ids: Vec<ObservabilityAuditRefId> = resolved_pairs
            .iter().map(|(audit_ref, _)| audit_ref.observability_audit_ref_id.clone()).collect();
        let (expected_state, expected_reason) = if let Some(reason) = first_unavailable_reason {
            (AuditExportState::Unavailable, Some(reason))
        } else if let Some(reason) = first_partial_reason {
            (AuditExportState::Partial, Some(reason))
        } else {
            (AuditExportState::Ready, None)
        };
        let unchanged = existing.as_ref().map(|loaded| loaded.value.matches_preparation(
            &trace, &export_scope, &allowed_summary, &resolved_ids, &source_versions,
            &expected_state, expected_reason.as_ref(),
        )).unwrap_or(false);
        let now = self.clock.now();
        if unchanged {
            let current = existing.as_ref().ok_or(/* no-op without existing */)?;
            let saved_ids = current.value.observability_refs.as_ref()
                .map(|refs| refs.iter().cloned().collect()).unwrap_or_default();
            let item = CapabilityAuditExportPreparationItem {
                export_ref: existing_export_ref.clone().ok_or(/* exact ref */)?,
                traceability_ref, export_state: current.value.export_state.clone(),
                observability_ref_ids: saved_ids,
                change: CapabilityJobItemChange::Unchanged,
            };
            loaded_execution.value.record_succeeded(
                target.ordinal, CapabilityJobExecutionSuccess::AuditExport(item), now,
            )?;
            let tx = self.uow_manager.begin().await?;
            self.job_execution_repository.save(
                loaded_execution.value.clone(), loaded_execution.expected_version, tx.as_ref(),
            ).await?;
            self.uow_manager.commit(tx).await?;
        } else {
            let policy = DerivedMaterialPolicy::default_for_derived_material();
            let (mut export, expected, change) = match existing {
                Some(loaded) => {
                    let mut value = loaded.value;
                    value.refresh_from_traceability(
                        &trace, export_scope.clone(), allowed_summary,
                        source_versions, &policy, now.clone(),
                    )?;
                    (value, Some(loaded.expected_version), CapabilityJobItemChange::Updated)
                }
                None => (
                    AuditFriendlyExportSummary::build_from_traceability(
                        export_id, &trace, export_scope.clone(), allowed_summary,
                        source_versions, &policy, now.clone(),
                    )?,
                    None,
                    CapabilityJobItemChange::Created,
                ),
            };
            for (audit_ref, state) in resolved_pairs.iter() {
                export.attach_observability_ref(audit_ref, state, now.clone())?;
            }
            match expected_state {
                AuditExportState::Partial => export.mark_partial(
                    expected_reason.ok_or(/* partial reason missing */)?, now.clone(),
                )?,
                AuditExportState::Unavailable => export.mark_unavailable(
                    expected_reason.ok_or(/* unavailable reason missing */)?, now.clone(),
                )?,
                AuditExportState::Ready => {}
                AuditExportState::Stale => return Err(/* impossible planned final state */),
            }
            policy.validate_export(&export)?;
            let execution_context = CapabilityOperationContext::from_job(
                loaded_execution.value.operation_name.clone(),
                loaded_execution.value.actor_context.clone(),
                loaded_execution.value.run_id.clone(), loaded_execution.value.trace_id.clone(),
                loaded_execution.value.idempotency_key.clone(),
            )?;
            let tx = self.uow_manager.begin().await?;
            let export_ref = self.derived_material_repository
                .save_audit_export(export.clone(), expected, tx.as_ref()).await?;
            let capture_ref = self.outbound_capture_service
                .capture_derived_material_refreshed(
                    &execution_context,
                    CapabilityDerivedMaterialRefreshSource::AuditExport(&export),
                    tx.as_ref(),
                ).await?;
            let saved_ids = export.observability_refs.as_ref()
                .map(|refs| refs.iter().cloned().collect()).unwrap_or_default();
            let item = CapabilityAuditExportPreparationItem {
                export_ref, traceability_ref,
                export_state: export.export_state.clone(),
                observability_ref_ids: saved_ids,
                change,
            };
            loaded_execution.value.record_succeeded(
                target.ordinal, CapabilityJobExecutionSuccess::AuditExport(item), now,
            )?;
            self.job_execution_repository.save(
                loaded_execution.value.clone(), loaded_execution.expected_version, tx.as_ref(),
            ).await?;
            self.uow_manager.commit(tx).await?;
            let _ = self.event_collaboration_service
                .collaborate_captured_event(capture_ref).await;
        }
        loaded_execution = self.job_execution_repository
            .get_with_version(&context.idempotency_key).await?
            .ok_or(/* journal missing after target */)?;
    }

    let mut final_execution = self.job_execution_repository
        .get_with_version(&context.idempotency_key).await?
        .ok_or(/* final journal missing */)?;
    let mut final_reservation = self.idempotency_repository
        .get_with_version(&context.idempotency_key).await?
        .ok_or(/* final reservation missing */)?;
    if !final_execution.value.matches_request(&context, &job_name, &schema, &digest)
        || final_execution.value.next_planned_target().is_some()
        || final_reservation.value.state != CapabilityIdempotencyState::Reserved
    {
        return Err(/* final identity/all-terminal consistency error */);
    }
    let result_id = self.id_generator.new_application_result_id();
    let application_result_ref = /* operation + result_id */;
    let protocol_result_ref = /* same operation safe value + same result_id */;
    let response = assemble_audit_export_preparation_response(
        &final_execution.value, protocol_result_ref,
    )?;
    let stored_response = CapabilityStoredJobResponse::AuditExportPreparation(response.clone());
    let surface_ref = self.id_generator.new_stored_result_surface_ref();
    let surface = /* exact serialized stored_response + matching digest */;
    let final_at = self.clock.now();
    let shell = StoredCapabilityOperationResult::from_surface(
        application_result_ref.clone(), StoredCapabilityResultKind::JobReport,
        /* fresh OperationsJob disposition */, surface_ref.clone(),
        surface.surface_digest.clone(), final_execution.value.trace_id.clone(),
        final_at.clone(),
    )?;
    let envelope = CapabilityStoredJobReportEnvelope::try_new(
        application_result_ref.clone(), final_execution.value.operation_name.clone(),
        job_name, schema, final_execution.value.run_id.clone(), surface_ref,
        stored_response,
    )?;
    final_execution.value.finalize(application_result_ref.clone(), final_at.clone())?;
    final_reservation.value.complete(application_result_ref, final_at)?;
    let final_tx = self.uow_manager.begin().await?;
    self.stored_result_repository.save_job_report(
        shell, surface, envelope, final_tx.as_ref(),
    ).await?;
    self.job_execution_repository.save(
        final_execution.value, final_execution.expected_version, final_tx.as_ref(),
    ).await?;
    self.idempotency_repository.save(
        final_reservation.value, final_reservation.expected_version, final_tx.as_ref(),
    ).await?;
    self.uow_manager.commit(final_tx).await?;
    Ok(response)
}
```
