#### 38.2.5 Transaction, external outcome, reentry, and ownership matrix

| Branch | Exact behavior |
|---|---|
| invalid trigger/schema/body/scope/duplicate refs | `Rejected` before Clock/id/list/UoW |
| complete empty capture/intent scan | empty journal -> `Completed`,empty items/statuses |
| planning list/get failure before complete target set | typed empty planning-failure journal when safely classifiable;otherwise no reservation/journal |
| explicit capture orintent is normally absent during complete planning | `PreclassifiedFailure(SubjectMissing)`；other valid targets continue |
| loaded capture/snapshot five-tuple、intent/source or typed outcome is asymmetric | exact `ConsistencyDefect`;no preclassified/failed item andno report finalization |
| Captured target -> typed Candidate/Pending/Delivered/Failed/HandoffUnavailable | stable intent isvalid forbinding;capture bind + item success + journal save same target UoW |
| Captured external call succeeds,local target commit fails | external intent may exist;capture remains old Captured andjournal remainsPlanned;reentry repeats same stored candidate andrequires same stable intent semantics |
| IntentBound capture | exact external `get`;no `collaborate`、`repair`orbind;journal-only success |
| intent status Candidate/Delivered | inspect only;no `repair`;journal-only success |
| intent status PendingDelivery/Failed/HandoffUnavailable | exact same-intent `repair`;typed outcome thenjournal-only success |
| external typed Failed/HandoffUnavailable | success item withstatus + redacted issue;not automaticallya failed target orlocal state write |
| external temporary/stable Port failure with no typed outcome | no inferred item；after zero-effect proof,closed `DependencyFailure + RetryablePrerequisite / StableFailure` may terminalize target |
| external invalid/unclassified return、missing bound item or source/intent mismatch | exact `PortFailure` or`ConsistencyDefect`；target remains`Planned`,no truth rollback or fabricated item |
| completed duplicate | typed stored Job replay only;zero capture/intent get/list/collaborate/repair/bind calls |
| reserved reentry | exact journal only;terminal target isnevercalled externally again |

State / ownership rules:

- local capture hasonly `Captured -> IntentBound`;the Job stores no Candidate/Pending/Delivered/Failed/HandoffUnavailable state locally;
- binding uses the loaded capture's `expected_version`,preserves capture source / snapshot id / schema / digest / captured time andthe associated immutable snapshot-owned trace / complete bytes,andreturnsone successor capture ref;
- external intent remainsopaque andstable. The Job never changes intent identity,parses it orcreates another local capture for it;
- no new Outbound Event isformed. Repair reuses the exact immutable bytes fromthe official snapshot anddoes not invoke any Step 8 mapper/capture callable;
- typed item `capture_ref / intent_ref / source_ref / capture_binding / status / issue_ref` ispersisted injournal success andcopied bythe pure assembler. Final report never rereads capture orPort status;
- external repair result cannot roll backorchange identity、registry、descriptor、relation、exposure、reference state、material、change、trace orsource operation result.

Test cuts:

1. Exercise all five public repair scopes,stable ordering,pagination andduplicate rejection.
2. Public/application source union mapping covers all five variants andpreserves exact payload/version;opaque intent mapping performsno parsing.
3. Explicit missing capture/snapshot/digest/source mismatch andmissing/asymmetric intent become failed targets withoutmapper/source reload.
4. Captured success binds exactly one stable intent;bind/journal save commit androllback atomically at every failure point.
5. Crash afterexternal collaborate butbeforelocal commit repeats the same stored candidate anddoes notform a second intent;successful reentry commits one successor capture revision.
6. IntentBound capture calls external`get`once and`collaborate/repair/bind`zero times.
7. Candidate/Delivered intent calls`repair`zero times;Pending/Failed/HandoffUnavailable calls`repair`once onthe same intent andvalidates returnedsource.
8. Typed Failed/HandoffUnavailable outcome producesa status item withredacted issue anddoes notcopydelivery state locally;untyped error producesno item fromerror text.
9. Final assembly andcompleted duplicate performzero capture/Port reads;items/statuses retain journal order andsymmetry.
10. Mapper、source repository、new snapshot/capture、core truth/material/reference writes、topic/attempt/retry counter andexternal body calls remainzero.
